papers.title: TOPSIS-RAD: Ranking According to Desires
papers.abstract_en: Traditional TOPSIS derives its reference points -- the Positive Ideal Solution ($PIS$) and Negative Ideal Solution ($NIS$) -- from the observed alternative set, making rankings susceptible to misalignment with decision-maker (DM) requirements, sensitivity to outlier performances, and rank reversal. This paper proposes TOPSIS-RAD, which addresses these issues by incorporating two arrays of DM-defined reference levels. Vetoed Performance Levels ($VPL$) exclude non-viable alternatives before normalisation, preventing them from distorting the ranking frontiers. Desired Performance Levels ($DPL$) cap performances at the DM's desired level before normalisation, anchoring the $PIS$ in explicit aspirations rather than dataset extremes. Three toy examples demonstrate each mechanism: $VPL$ reshapes normalisation boundaries by removing a non-viable alternative; fixed $DPL$ frontiers stabilise rankings by limiting the influence of performances well above the desired level. The method preserves the familiar distance-based structure of TOPSIS while grounding the ranking in stable, DM-specified boundaries. Limitations and future research directions are also discussed.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 15 Tables and 6 figures. The numerical computation of the data that appear in the Toy Examples was Supported by the Visual TOPSIS RAD that is available at https://topsis-ranking.vercel.app/. The data of the Toy examples are also available in this URL and can be loaded in the app as the template "Article"
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TOPSIS-RAD 方法，通过引入决策者定义的否决绩效水平 (VPL) 和期望绩效水平 (DPL) 来改进传统 TOPSIS 方法，解决排名与决策者需求不一致、对异常值敏感以及排名反转等问题。三个玩具示例展示了 VPL 和 DPL 机制如何重塑归一化边界并稳定排名。该方法保留了 TOPSIS 基于距离的结构，同时将排名锚定在决策者指定的稳定边界上。
Motivation: 传统 TOPSIS 的参考点（正理想解 PIS 和负理想解 NIS）从观测方案中推导，导致排名可能与决策者需求不一致、对异常值敏感且易出现排名反转。
Method: 提出 TOPSIS-RAD，在归一化前引入两个决策者定义的参考水平：VPL 排除不可行方案，防止其扭曲排名边界；DPL 将性能上限设定为决策者期望水平，使 PIS 锚定于明确期望而非数据集极值。
Result: 三个玩具示例显示：VPL 通过移除不可行方案重塑归一化边界；固定 DPL 边界通过限制远高于期望水平的性能的影响来稳定排名。
Conclusion: 方法保留了 TOPSIS 基于距离的结构，同时将排名稳定在决策者指定的边界上。讨论了局限性和未来研究方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reconstructing Multi-Decadal Forest Disturbances: A Spatio-Temporal Transformer Approach
papers.abstract_en: Accurate monitoring of forest disturbances is essential for understanding carbon dynamics and land management, yet traditional approaches typically rely on pixel-wise analysis of satellite time-series, ignoring spatial context. We present a deep learning framework that maps 38 years (1984-2022) of forest disturbance across the contiguous United States by modeling temporal trajectories and spatial neighborhoods simultaneously. By leveraging a vision transformer architecture, our approach effectively filters noise from weak supervision signals to produce spatially coherent disturbance maps. We perform exhaustive evaluations across multiple satellites (Landsat, Sentinel-1, Sentinel-2) and temporal windows (38 years and the more recent 6 years), validating performance against a novel, manually annotated validation dataset (n=300) and independent fire perimeter dataset (n=706). The results highlight the complexity of the task: while our spatio-temporal model demonstrates high precision (up to 98.2% for +-1 year detection on MTBS and up to 71.3% on the CONUS validation datasets, with F1-scores up to 75.8% and 47.3%, respectively) and effectively reduces spatial artifacts, it exhibits performance trade-offs across different disturbance regimes compared to pixel-wise baselines. Our method offers a promising foundation for consistent forest monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于视觉Transformer的时空模型，利用1984-2022年Landsat等多源卫星影像重建美国本土的森林扰动图，同时建模时间轨迹和空间邻域。在手动标注验证集（n=300）和独立火线数据集（n=706）上评估，最高精确率达98.2%（±1年检测），但也揭示了不同扰动类型下的性能权衡。
Motivation: 传统森林扰动监测主要依赖像素级时间序列分析，忽略了空间上下文，导致扰动图存在空间不连续性和噪声。
Method: 采用视觉Transformer架构，结合时间轨迹和空间邻域信息，从弱监督信号中过滤噪声，生成空间上连贯的扰动图。评估覆盖多个卫星（Landsat、Sentinel-1/2）和两个时间窗口（38年和最近6年）。
Result: 在CONUS验证集上，±1年检测精确率达98.2%（MTBS）和71.3%，F1分数分别为75.8%和47.3%；相比像素级基线有效减少空间伪影，但在不同扰动类型间存在性能权衡。
Conclusion: 该方法为一致的森林监测提供了有前景的基础，但需要根据具体扰动类型调整。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Theory of learning of high-dimensional controlled non-linear dynamical systems (I): models and methods
papers.abstract_en: Neural ordinary differential equations (neural ODEs) have rapidly gained prominence as a powerful and unifying framework for conceptualizing artificial neural networks, elegantly connecting the continuous-time modeling of dynamical systems with the discrete, data-driven paradigm of modern deep learning. Beyond their practical advantages they offer fresh theoretical insights into the training and generalization properties of neural networks. The distinctive feature of this framework is its dual dynamical nature: inference dynamics, which govern the ODE evolution during forward computation, and training dynamics, which control the optimization of model parameters. This makes neural ODEs a particularly well-suited theoretical framework for studying a large variety of settings such as multi-layer neural networks (ResNets for example), autoregressive models (with next-token generation dynamics), generative models, and recurrent neural networks in theoretical neuroscience. In this work, we introduce a theoretically grounded class of models for studying neural ODEs trained via online stochastic gradient descent. We solve the training dynamics of these models via dynamical mean field theory and derive learning curves in the high-dimensional limit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文为神经ODE的在线随机梯度下降训练建立了一个理论框架，通过动力平均场理论求解训练动力学，并在高维极限下推导出学习曲线。
Motivation: 神经ODE虽成为连接连续时间动力系统与深度学习的统一框架，但缺乏对在线训练过程的理论分析。
Method: 引入一类理论模型，利用动力平均场理论（dynamical mean field theory）分析在线SGD训练动力学，并推导高维极限下的学习曲线。
Result: 在高维极限下得到学习曲线的解析表达式，揭示了训练动态的定量特征。
Conclusion: 该工作为理解神经ODE的训练和泛化特性提供了新的理论视角，但仅限于在线SGD设置和高维极限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AI Sovereignty: A Qualitative Model of Strategic Competition as AI Becomes an Instrument of National Power
papers.abstract_en: AI sovereignty is the extent to which a nation independently controls its artificial intelligence (AI) technologies. The race toward ever-more-sophisticated frontier AI models is of increasing strategic importance, with nations considering how AI might improve their economic situations, competitive advantage, and overall national power. However, the costs of AI sovereignty are enormous, and we lack definitions and conceptual models to navigate evolving AI sovereignty dynamics. We address this gap with definitions relevant to AI sovereignty, along with a first-of-its-kind qualitative model that incorporates micro, meso, and macro contributors. Model-based qualitative forecasts highlight competitive dynamics and evolving potential for AI-driven national power. The model identifies key leverage points that nations can use to enhance their own growth or degrade an adversary's, including consideration of accelerators, electricity, water, data sets and skilled workforce. These leverage points can be activated at strategic and operational levels through both direct kinetic actions, such as Iran's targeting of data centers with drones, and indirect non-kinetic effects including cyber, space, information, economic coercion and diplomacy. If our assumptions and hypotheses are valid, this strategic competition may come to define how nations improve their economic situations, competitive advantage, and overall national power in the 21st Century.

papers.title: Beyond Waypoints: A Trajectory-Centric Waypointing Paradigm for Vision-Language Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments (VLN-CE) requires agents to follow natural-language instructions while navigating in real-world-like environments. Most VLN-CE approach\-es adopt a three-stage framework: a waypoint predictor proposes navigable waypoints, and a navigator selects the best waypoint, with a low-level controller executing the movement to it. However, this decoupled paradigm often leads to unreachable waypoints or inconsistencies between planning and control. In this work, instead of predicting isolated waypoints, we introduce a novel paradigm called Trajectory Waypoint, which grounds each candidate waypoint in an executable trajectory. To realize this, we design a Trajectory Waypoint Predictor formulated as a TSDF-guided diffusion policy, which steers trajectory generation away from obstacles, inherently ensuring the reachability of the predicted waypoints. We further propose a trajectory-enhanced navigator that injects the associated trajectory as additional information for planning, enabling strict consistency between high-level semantic decisions and low-level execution. Extensive experiments on the VLN-CE benchmark show that our Trajectory Waypoint paradigm achieves superior performance over the baselines.

papers.title: Generative Molecular Morphing for Flexible-Size Design via Unbalanced Optimal Transport
papers.abstract_en: The success of generative molecular design hinges on a model's steerability toward high-reward samples. Because many molecular properties are intrinsically linked to molecular size, accurately capturing the joint distribution of properties and the number of atoms is essential. However, current diffusion and flow-based models fix the number of atoms, which ultimately limits their ability to navigate this complex relationship. To address this, we introduce Morph, a flexible-size generative model for conditional and unconditional 3D molecular design based on geometric graphs. By dynamically adapting size, Morph can seamlessly integrate existing structural priors, like scaffolds, and significantly enhances property steering. We show that Morph matches current fixed-size state-of-the-art models while offering the benefit of unparalleled sampling flexibility. We demonstrate out-of-distribution generation in regimes where previous models fail, paving the way for enhanced generative modeling for molecular design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于几何图的灵活尺寸分子生成模型 Morph，通过动态调整原子数来联合建模分子性质与尺寸分布，解决了当前扩散/流模型固定原子数的局限。方法基于不平衡最优传输 (Unbalanced Optimal Transport) 实现分子形变 (morphing)，支持条件生成（如整合骨架 scaffold）和无条件生成。实验显示 Morph 在性能上匹敌现有固定尺寸模型，同时提供更灵活的采样能力，并能生成先前模型失败的分布外样本。
Motivation: 许多分子性质与分子尺寸（原子数）密切相关，但现有生成模型（如扩散、流模型）固定原子数，限制了模型在性质-尺寸联合空间中的导航能力，尤其难以输出所需性质对应的高奖励样本。
Method: 引入 Morph，一种基于几何图的灵活尺寸生成模型，利用不平衡最优传输 (Unbalanced Optimal Transport) 实现分子形变 (morphing)，动态调整原子数，并支持整合结构先验（如 scaffold）。
Result: Morph 在分子设计任务上匹配当前固定尺寸最先进模型的性能，同时提供前所未有的采样灵活性，并在先前模型失败的分布外生成场景中取得成功。
Conclusion: Morph 通过灵活尺寸设计增强了分子生成模型的性质导向能力，为更广泛的生成分子建模铺平了道路。

papers.title: When Large Language Models Fail in Healthcare: Evaluating Sensitivity to Prompt Variations
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in healthcare for tasks such as clinical question answering, diagnosis support, and report summarization. Despite their promise, these models remain highly sensitive to subtle prompt perturbations, both lexical and syntactic, posing serious risks in safety-critical clinical applications. In this study, we conduct a systematic sensitivity analysis to evaluate the robustness of both general-purpose (e.g., GPT-3.5, Llama3) and medical-specific LLMs (e.g., ClinicalBERT, BioLlama3, BioBERT) using the MedMCQA benchmark. We categorize perturbations into natural and adversarial types and examine their effect on model consistency, accuracy, and reliability in clinical reasoning tasks. Our findings reveal that medical LLMs are not intrinsically safe. Even minor variations in phrasing can alter clinical advice, and targeted adversarial prompts can provoke harmful outputs. In high-stakes settings like healthcare, such unpredictability is unacceptable-models that change diagnoses due to reworded inputs or hallucinate medications when slightly rephrased cannot be reliably trusted by clinicians. While models tend to show resilience to simple lexical substitutions or paraphrasing, they often break down under syntactic reordering or misleading contextual cues. This fragility is evident across both general-purpose and domain-specific LLMs. Notably, adversarial manipulations can lead to clinically dangerous outputs, such as recommending incorrect dosages or omitting critical findings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了大语言模型在医疗场景下对提示词扰动（包括词汇和句法变化）的鲁棒性。使用MedMCQA基准测试通用模型（GPT-3.5, Llama3）和医学专用模型（ClinicalBERT, BioLlama3, BioBERT），发现即使是医学专用模型也存在严重的不稳定性：细微的措辞改变可导致临床建议变动，特定对抗性提示可引发危险输出（如推荐错误剂量或遗漏关键发现）。研究表明，模型对简单词汇替换或释义有一定韧性，但在句法重排或误导性上下文提示下会失效。
Motivation: 大语言模型在医疗领域应用日益增多，但对提示词微小变化的高度敏感性可能带来严重安全风险，现有工作缺乏对此类脆弱性的系统评估。
Method: 在MedMCQA基准上，对通用和医学专用LLM施加两类扰动（自然扰动和对抗性扰动），分析模型在临床推理任务中的一致性、准确性和可靠性。
Result: 医学LLM并不内在安全；甚至微小的措辞变化也能改变临床建议；对抗性扰动可产生危险输出，如推荐错误剂量或遗漏关键发现。模型对简单词汇替换较鲁棒，但句法重排和误导性上下文易导致失效。
Conclusion: 在医疗等高风险场景中，LLM对输入变化的不可预测性是不可接受的；需要更严格的鲁棒性验证才能用于临床。

papers.title: FLOWREADER: Min-Cost Flow Optimization for Multi-Modal Long Document Q&A
papers.abstract_en: Long, multimodal documents force retrieval-augmented systems to assemble answers from evidence fragmented across text, tables, and slides broken across cells in a long table, spread over multiple slides, or split between a figure and its discussion. Top-$k$ chunk retrieval treats each fragment independently and cannot represent how evidence connects. We introduce FLOWREADER, which reframes evidence assembly as a min-cost flow problem on a multimodal node graph: a single scoring vector $h$ controls source selection (via MMR), sink selection (via a length-aware answerability proxy), and the costs and capacities of every edge. The optimal flow is decomposed into candidate evidence paths, a compact non-redundant subset is selected by entropy-regularized replicator dynamics, and parallel VLM workers under a dual-process gate produce the answer with a single System-2 refinement pass triggered when answer consistency is low or the routed flow is strained. On VisDoMBench, FLOWREADER is best on the two subsets dominated by fragmented evidence PaperTab ($58.40$, $+1.30$ over G^{2}-Reader) and SlideVQA ($72.93$, $+0.62$) and competitive on SPIQA, FetaTab, and SciGraphQA. Macro-averaged across all five subsets, FLOWREADER ($65.47$) is within $0.74$ of the strongest baseline (G^{2}-Reader, $66.21$). Overall, these results show that min-cost flow performs well on fragmented multimodal evidence, where top-$k$ retrieval fails. It also provides a unified way to control scoring, routing, selection, and adaptive compute together.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLOWREADER 将多模态长文档问答中的证据组装建模为最小费用流问题，通过构建多模态节点图、统一评分向量控制源选择、目标选择及边成本/容量，优化分解为候选证据路径，并利用熵正则化复制者动力学选择紧凑子集，结合并行 VLM 工作器与双过程门控生成答案。在 VisDoMBench 基准上，FLOWREADER 在碎片化证据主导的 PaperTab 和 SlideVQA 子集上取得最佳结果，宏平均分（65.47）与最强基线 G²-Reader（66.21）差距仅 0.74。
Motivation: 现有 top-k 块检索将每个证据碎片独立处理，无法表示碎片化多模态证据（如跨表格、幻灯片、图文）的连接，导致长文档问答中证据组装困难。
Method: 提出 FLOWREADER，将证据组装转化为最小费用流问题：定义一个多模态节点图，通过单一评分向量 h 控制源选择（MMR）、目标选择（可回答性代理）及每条边的成本与容量；最优流分解为候选证据路径，经熵正则化复制者动力学选择非冗余子集；并行 VLM 工作器在双过程门控下生成答案，仅在答案一致性低或流负荷高时触发一次 System-2 精化。
Result: 在 VisDoMBench 的五个子集上，FLOWREADER 在 PaperTab（58.40，+1.30 高于 G²-Reader）和 SlideVQA（72.93，+0.62）上最佳；在 SPIQA、FetaTab 和 SciGraphQA 上具有竞争力；宏平均（65.47）与最强基线 G²-Reader（66.21）相差 0.74。
Conclusion: 最小费用流方法在处理碎片化多模态证据上优于 top-k 检索，并能统一控制评分、路由、选择和自适应计算。

papers.title: Does Appearance Help? A Systematic Study of Image-Based Re-Identification in Online 3D Multi-Pedestrian Tracking
papers.abstract_en: LiDAR-based 3D Multi-Object Tracking (MOT) typically relies solely on geometric information, which is often insufficient to distinguish between targets during prolonged occlusions or in crowded human-populated environments. While integrating RGB-based Re-Identification (ReID) offers a theoretical solution for preserving identity context, existing approaches often rely on computationally expensive parallel detectors that hinder real-time robot responsiveness. This work presents a systematic study of image-based ReID in online 3D MOT, utilizing a lightweight projection-based framework to decouple geometric and appearance modeling for mobile robots. A comprehensive analysis of feature extraction architectures is conducted, employing lightweight CNNs and Vision Transformers, and evaluating various multi-modal data association strategies to balance computational latency with robust tracking. Experiments on the Pedestrian class of the KITTI dataset reveal that naive linear fusion, of appearance and motion costs, degrades performance due to visual noise. Conversely, a cascaded matching strategy successfully recovers occluded tracks without compromising overall precision, effectively preventing identity switches to maintain human-robot interaction continuity. We show that lightweight architectures can offer an optimal trade-off between the low latency required for safe navigation and the discriminative power needed for social awareness.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the 35th IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (RO-MAN 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于LiDAR的3D多目标跟踪在遮挡和拥挤场景中身份保持困难的问题，系统研究了图像重识别（ReID）的作用。提出轻量级投影框架解耦几何与外观建模，在KITTI行人数据集上比较多种特征提取架构和数据关联策略。结果表明朴素线性融合因视觉噪声而性能下降，而级联匹配策略能有效恢复遮挡轨迹、防止身份切换，且轻量架构可实现低延迟与高判别力的平衡。
Motivation: 现有3D多目标跟踪仅依赖几何信息，在长时间遮挡或人群密集环境中难以区分目标；集成RGB重识别虽有理论优势，但现有方法计算开销大，难以满足移动机器人实时性要求。
Method: 提出基于投影的轻量级框架，将RGB图像投影到3D空间以实现几何与外观解耦。系统评估轻量CNN和Vision Transformer等特征提取架构，并设计多种多模态数据关联策略（包括朴素线性融合和级联匹配）进行对比。
Result: 在KITTI数据集行人跟踪上，朴素线性融合因引入视觉噪声反而降低性能；而级联匹配策略成功恢复被遮挡轨迹，不降低整体精度，并有效防止身份切换。
Conclusion: 轻量级架构可在低延迟（安全导航所需）和强判别力（社会意识所需）之间取得最优折衷，级联匹配是优于线性融合的数据关联策略。

papers.title: DEFINED: A Data-Efficient Computational Framework for Fine-Grained Creativity Assessment in Debate Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Human creativity has emerged as a critical competency in the era of large language models. Assessing creativity in complex, open-ended environments is a grand challenge in data mining, currently hindered by a reliance on standardized simple tasks and the scarcity of fine-grained expert data. As an ecologically valid assessment context, debate reflects multiple dimensions of creativity, encompassing both divergent thinking and convergent thinking. Moreover, debate is a data-rich domain, with a large volume of publicly accessible materials. Current mainstream automated scoring methods are poorly suited to complex settings such as debate, and therefore still rely on costly human evaluation. To this end, this paper proposes DEFINED, a data-efficient computational framework for fine-grained creativity assessment in debate scenarios. DEFINED operationalizes debate creativity through a hierarchical eight-dimensional metric system, implemented via a pre-trained autoregressive language model with a hierarchical scoring head that supports both fine-grained and coarse-grained evaluation. Statements and their associated expert scores were obtained from authentic debate competitions, and a constrained data augmentation strategy was employed to address the elite bias inherent in the original data. DEFINED adopts a mixed-granularity training strategy enabling robust learning from limited fine-grained supervision annotated by trained graduate experts. To rigorously validate ecological validity beyond synthetic benchmarks, we incorporate an empirical study with debate-naive participants, utilizing these authentic data to serve as a qualitative case study for mid-to-low proficiency populations. Across our evaluation protocol, our scoring model achieves accurate and stable scoring, outperforming prompt-based large language model evaluators and existing debate scoring methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DEFINED 框架，用于在辩论场景中进行细粒度创造力评估。该框架通过分层八维度指标系统、预训练自回归语言模型和分层评分头实现细粒度和粗粒度评估。采用约束数据增强策略解决原始数据中的精英偏差，并利用混合粒度训练策略从有限专家标注中学习。实验表明，该评分模型优于基于提示的大语言模型评估器和现有辩论评分方法。
Motivation: 当前创造力评估依赖标准化简单任务，缺乏细粒度专家数据；辩论作为生态效度高的评估场景，其自动化评分仍依赖昂贵人工评估。
Method: 提出 DEFINED 框架，包括分层八维度指标系统、基于预训练自回归语言模型的分层评分头、约束数据增强策略和混合粒度训练策略。
Result: 在真实辩论竞赛数据上，该评分模型实现准确稳定的评分，优于基于提示的大语言模型评估器和现有辩论评分方法，并通过实证研究验证了生态效度。
Conclusion: DEFINED 实现了辩论场景中数据高效的细粒度创造力评估，为复杂开放环境下的创造力评估提供了可扩展方案。

papers.title: DualGate-Net: A Prior-Gated Dual-Encoder Framework for Histopathology Cell Detection
papers.abstract_en: Cell detection in histopathology images strongly depends on surrounding tissue context, where visually similar cells may belong to different classes under different microenvironments. Recent tissue-aware methods incorporate contextual priors, but often rely on static fusion strategies that may propagate noisy information. In this work, we propose DualGate-Net, a prior-aware dual-encoder framework that combines a ConvNeXtV2-based local encoder and a SegFormer-based global encoder through a learnable prior-gated fusion mechanism. The proposed module adaptively regulates the influence of tissue priors across spatial locations, while an auxiliary foreground reconstruction branch preserves high-frequency cellular structures during training. In addition, auxiliary cellness-guided cues are incorporated to further improve localization robustness. Experiments on the OCELOT benchmark demonstrate consistent improvements, achieving macro F1-scores of 0.7722 on the validation set and 0.7345 on the test set, highlighting the effectiveness of adaptive prior integration for robust histopathology cell detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DualGate-Net，一种基于先验门控的双编码器框架，用于组织病理学图像中的细胞检测。该框架结合 ConvNeXtV2 局部编码器和 SegFormer 全局编码器，通过可学习的先验门控融合机制自适应调节组织先验的影响，并引入辅助前景重建分支和细胞性引导线索。在 OCELOT 基准上取得宏 F1 分数 0.7722（验证集）和 0.7345（测试集）。
Motivation: 现有组织感知方法依赖静态融合策略，可能传播噪声信息，影响细胞检测的准确性。
Method: 提出 DualGate-Net，包含局部-全局双编码器（ConvNeXtV2 和 SegFormer）、可学习先验门控融合模块、辅助前景重建分支以及细胞性引导线索。
Result: 在 OCELOT 基准上，宏 F1 分数达到验证集 0.7722、测试集 0.7345，表明自适应先验融合的有效性。
Conclusion: 自适应先验集成能够提升组织病理学细胞检测的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Robotic Policy Adaptation via Weight-Space Meta-Learning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are emerging as a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation, enabling general-purpose policies trained from large corpora of demonstrations and action labels. However, adapting these models to new tasks still typically requires task-specific demonstrations, action annotations, and additional fine-tuning, making deployment costly and difficult to scale. We propose WIZARD, a weight-space meta-learning framework that sidesteps task-specific fine-tuning by generating task-specific LoRA parameters for a frozen VLA policy. Given only a language instruction and a short demonstration video, WIZARD predicts the corresponding adaptation weights in a single forward pass, without target-task action labels or test-time optimization. During meta-training, WIZARD learns to map task evidence directly to expert LoRA updates, capturing relationships between tasks in weight space. Experiments on LIBERO show that WIZARD improves performance by up to ~2x on unseen dataset collections and up to ~14x on unseen tasks. On a Franka Emika Panda, WIZARD consistently improves over a real-domain adapted baseline, showing that generated adapters provide task-level specialization beyond simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WIZARD，一个权重空间元学习框架，用于将预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型适应到新任务，无需任务特定微调或动作标签。给定语言指令和演示视频，WIZARD 通过单次前向传播生成 LoRA 参数，并在 LIBERO 基准上实现性能提升，最高达约2倍（未见数据集）和约14倍（未见任务），同时在真实机器人上验证了泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型适应新任务仍需要任务特定的演示、动作标注和额外微调，部署成本高且难以扩展。
Method: 提出 WIZARD，一种权重空间元学习方法，通过元训练学习从任务证据直接映射到专家 LoRA 更新的函数，生成适应权重以冻结的 VLA 策略，无需测试时优化或目标任务动作标签。
Result: 在 LIBERO 基准上，WIZARD 在未见数据集集合上提升性能约2倍，在未见任务上提升约14倍；在 Franka Emika Panda 真实机器人上，持续优于实域适应基线，表明生成的适配器提供了超越仿真的任务级特化。
Conclusion: WIZARD 通过生成式权重预测避免了任务特定微调，展示了在机器人操作中高效适应新任务的潜力，但实验仅基于特定基准和机器人平台，泛化性需进一步验证。

papers.title: Principal Component Analysis for Multivariate Extremes
papers.abstract_en: This chapter explores ways to reduce the dimensionality of the data while preserving key information relevant to the analysis of multivariate extreme values.
papers.comment: Chapter 11 in "Handbook of of Statistic of Extremes", edited by Miguel de Carvalho, Raphaël Huser, Philippe Naveau, and Brian Reich
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本章探讨如何在保持多变量极值分析关键信息的同时降低数据维度，主要介绍主成分分析（PCA）在多元极值中的扩展与应用。
Motivation: 多变量极值数据通常维度较高，直接分析困难且噪声大，需要降维方法保留极端事件的关键结构。
Method: 基于PCA框架，针对极值数据的非正态性和尾部相关性进行适配，可能包括对称化变换、协方差谱分解等步骤。
Result: 本章未提供具体数值结果，主要贡献在于概念框架和算法描述。
Conclusion: PCA为多变量极值降维提供了可行路径，但需谨慎处理极值数据的特殊性质（如渐进独立性）。

papers.title: An Abstract Architecture for Explainable Autonomy in Hazardous Environments
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous robotic systems are being proposed for use in hazardous environments, often to reduce the risks to human workers. In the immediate future, it is likely that human workers will continue to use and direct these autonomous robots, much like other computerised tools but with more sophisticated decision-making. Therefore, one important area on which to focus engineering effort is ensuring that these users trust the system. Recent literature suggests that explainability is closely related to how trustworthy a system is. Like safety and security properties, explainability should be designed into a system, instead of being added afterwards. This paper presents an abstract architecture that supports an autonomous system explaining its behaviour (explainable autonomy), providing a design template for implementing explainable autonomous systems. We present a worked example of how our architecture could be applied in the civil nuclear industry, where both workers and regulators need to trust the system's decision-making capabilities.
papers.comment: Originally published 20th of October 2022 at the Second International Workshop on Requirements Engineering for Explainable Systems (RE4ES), which was hosted by the International Requirements Engineering Conference 2022
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出一个支持自主系统解释自身行为的抽象架构（explainable autonomy），并给出在民用核工业中的应用示例。强调可解释性应内建于系统设计，而非事后添加。
Motivation: 在危险环境中使用自主机器人时，人类需要信任系统；可解释性是信任的关键，但当前缺乏将可解释性作为设计目标的方法。
Method: 提出一个抽象架构作为设计模板，用于实现可解释的自主系统，并以民用核工业为例进行工作示例说明。
Result: 论文未报告实验结果，而是提出了体系结构和示例应用。
Conclusion: 可解释性应像安全性一样从一开始就设计进系统；该抽象架构提供了实现可解释自主系统的设计模板。

papers.title: Entropy as a Structural Prior: How a Log-Barrier on DiT Belief Space Drives Musical Diversity and Development
papers.abstract_en: Confidence-based loss weighting is usually avoided in generative models because it accelerates errors when the model is confidently wrong, but this intuition breaks down in supervised diffusion training. We introduce the Eisbach log-barrier, a parameter-free weight derived from the entropy of the DiT output's spatial energy distribution: high entropy damps the gradient, while low entropy preserves it. Applied to LoRA fine-tuning of Stable Audio 3 Medium on MusicCaps, it unexpectedly yields stronger thematic development, clearer acoustic differentiation, and higher textural diversity than unweighted training, the opposite of mode collapse. This works because in supervised diffusion the gradient direction is locked to ground truth, so confidence only scales the step size, and because temporal entropy downweights flat samples while preserving high-contrast ones. The result is an online, self-referential data curriculum that emerges purely from the forward pass, with analyzed noise-level dynamics and testable predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Eisbach log-barrier，一种基于DiT输出空间能量分布熵的参数自由权重，用于监督扩散训练中的损失加权。在Stable Audio 3 Medium的LoRA微调中，该方法意外地增强了主题发展、声学区分和纹理多样性，而非模式崩溃。其有效性源于监督扩散中梯度方向固定，置信度仅缩放步长，且时间熵能降低平坦样本权重、保留高对比度样本。
Motivation: 传统置信度加权在生成模型中会加速错误，但该直觉在监督扩散训练中可能失效，需要重新审视。
Method: 提出Eisbach log-barrier，根据DiT输出空间能量分布的熵计算权重：高熵时抑制梯度，低熵时保留梯度。在MusicCaps数据集上对Stable Audio 3 Medium进行LoRA微调。
Result: 相比未加权训练，该方法带来更强的主题发展、更清晰的声学区分和更高的纹理多样性，避免了模式崩溃。
Conclusion: 该方法利用监督扩散中梯度方向锁定于真实值的特点，置信度仅调节步长；时间熵动态选择高对比度样本。这形成了一个在线、自参考的数据课程，并给出了噪声水平动态分析和可测试预测。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出Eisbach log-barrier，一种基于DiT输出空间能量分布熵的参数自由权重，用于监督扩散训练中的损失加权。在Stable Audio 3 Medium的LoRA微调中，该方法意外地增强了主题发展、声学区分和纹理多样性，而非模式崩溃。其有效性源于监督扩散中梯度方向固定，置信度仅缩放步长，且时间熵能降低平坦样本权重、保留高对比度样本。
summary_sections.motivation: 传统置信度加权在生成模型中会加速错误，但该直觉在监督扩散训练中可能失效，需要重新审视。
summary_sections.method: 提出Eisbach log-barrier，根据DiT输出空间能量分布的熵计算权重：高熵时抑制梯度，低熵时保留梯度。在MusicCaps数据集上对Stable Audio 3 Medium进行LoRA微调。
summary_sections.result: 相比未加权训练，该方法带来更强的主题发展、更清晰的声学区分和更高的纹理多样性，避免了模式崩溃。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法利用监督扩散中梯度方向锁定于真实值的特点，置信度仅调节步长；时间熵动态选择高对比度样本。这形成了一个在线、自参考的数据课程，并给出了噪声水平动态分析和可测试预测。

papers.title: Towards Tight Bounds for Streaming Attention
papers.abstract_en: The attention mechanism is a cornerstone of modern transformer architectures. However, its expressive power comes at the cost of quadratic runtime and linear space usage. In particular, the classical transformer architecture explicitly stores all previously seen input elements (tokens) in order to generate the next one. The problem of implementing a transformer in limited space, known as KV cache compression, has received much interest over the past few years, spurring the development of powerful heuristics. Recent works of Haris et al, COLT'25 and Kochetkova et al, NeurIPS'25, formalized KV cache compression as the streaming attention approximation problem, providing both upper bounds (based on discrepancy theory) and information theoretic lower bounds. However, those papers left open a significant gap between the upper and lower bounds. For example, the space usage of their algorithms increases with the precision parameter, but the lower bound does not get stronger. In this work, we revisit the streaming attention approximation problem and provide nearly tight bounds on its space complexity. On the algorithmic side, we achieve the result through a surprisingly tight interplay between three distinct methods for kernel density estimation: discrepancy-based coreset constructions (e.g., Charikar-Kapralov-Waingarten'24), the polynomial method (e.g., Greengard-Rokhlin'87, Alman-Song'23), and space partitioning (e.g., Andoni-Laarhoven-Razenshteyn-Waingarten'17, Charikar-Kapralov-Nouri-Siminelakis'20). On the lower bound side, our main technical contribution is a new technique for using the INDEX problem with a large amount of side information that we hope will prove useful in other high dimensional geometric estimation problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究流式注意力近似问题，旨在压缩Transformer中的KV缓存，通过结合差异核心集、多项式方法和空间划分三种核密度估计技术，给出了几乎紧的空间复杂度上下界，并提出了基于INDEX问题的新下界技术。
Motivation: 现有流注意力近似问题的空间复杂度上下界之间存在显著差距，例如算法空间随精度参数增加而增加，但下界并未加强。
Method: 算法侧结合三种核密度估计方法：差异核心集、多项式方法和空间划分；下界侧利用带有大量侧信息的INDEX问题。
Result: 给出了几乎紧的空间复杂度界限，缩小了已有上下界之间的差距。
Conclusion: 新的下界技术有望推广到其他高维几何估计问题。

papers.title: Structure-Preserving Correction Learning for Sparse Bayesian Inference in Brain Source Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Classical sparse Type-II Bayesian methods for M/EEG brain imaging support joint estimation of source and noise hyperparameters, but rely on fixed iterative update rules. Although these updates are principled and interpretable, their dynamics cannot be adapted from data. We propose to learn the update mechanism itself while preserving the underlying Bayesian structure by unfolding a classical joint hyperparameter-learning solver into a trainable neural architecture whose layers mirror the original iterations. The resulting framework is initialized to recover the classical solver exactly before training and is enriched through progressively more expressive correction-learning mechanisms, ranging from learnable biases to adaptive MLP and attention-based contextual refinements. In this way, training does not replace Bayesian inference with a black-box predictor, but instead learns structured correction terms while retaining the interpretability and model-based character of the original update dynamics. Structured correction learning therefore aims to improve empirical reconstruction performance without replacing the original model-based inference mechanism. Experimental results show that the learned correction variants improve reconstruction performance and convergence behavior over the baseline unfolded solver while preserving its algorithmic transparency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对M/EEG脑成像中的稀疏Type-II贝叶斯方法，提出一种结构保持的校正学习框架。通过将经典联合超参数学习求解器展开为可训练神经网络，在保留原始迭代步骤的同时引入可学习偏差、MLP或注意力机制的校正项。实验表明该方法改进了重建性能和收敛行为，且保持了算法透明度。
Motivation: 经典稀疏贝叶斯方法依赖固定迭代规则，无法从数据中自适应，限制了其重建性能。
Method: 将经典联合超参数学习求解器展开为可训练神经架构，初始化时精确恢复原始求解器，通过逐步增加可学习偏置、MLP或注意力机制的结构化校正项来增强。
Result: 摘要报告称学习到的校正变体在重建性能和收敛行为上优于基线展开求解器，同时保持了算法透明度。
Conclusion: 结构保持的校正学习旨在不替换原始模型推理的情况下提升经验重建性能，该方法适用于M/EEG脑源成像。

papers.title: AdaTok: Self-Budgeting Image Tokenization with Quality-Preserving Dynamic Tokens
papers.abstract_en: Image tokenizers, from 2D grids to recent 1D sequences, typically encode every image with the same fixed number of tokens. Yet visual complexity is highly heterogeneous, so a uniform budget overspends on simple inputs and underserves complex ones. Existing elastic tokenizers expose variable-length reconstructions, but often leave token length as a deployment-time operating point, a search target, or an external prediction rather than an output of the tokenizer itself. In this work, we ask whether a discrete visual tokenizer can budget itself in one pass. Our central finding is that actionable elasticity requires a representation--allocation co-design: prefixes must remain decodable across budgets, and the tokenizer must learn which prefix each image needs. We propose AdaTok, a self-budgeting discrete 1D tokenizer. AdaTok combines Prioritized Representation Learning, which orders tokens with nested tail masking and resolves budget-dependent semantic shift through Multi-Head LoRA decoder heads, with Adaptive Token Allocation, which trains a lightweight deterministic-group GRPO policy over candidate budgets. Dynamic Pareto Weighting balances fidelity and efficiency during policy training without manual trade-off sweeps. On ImageNet-1K, AdaTok-Full reaches rFID 1.31 at 256 tokens, while AdaTok-Adaptive attains rFID 1.50 using only ~118 tokens on average, outperforming discrete 1D baselines at comparable budgets. In autoregressive image generation, the shorter adaptive representation yields ~2.1x throughput over a fixed 256-token decode, suggesting that visual token count can be learned as a content-conditioned output rather than set as a fixed hyperparameter.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AdaTok，一种自预算（self-budgeting）的离散一维图像标记化方法，能够一次性根据图像内容动态分配 token 数量。通过优先级表示学习（Prioritized Representation Learning）和自适应标记分配（Adaptive Token Allocation），在保持重建质量的同时减少平均 token 开销。在 ImageNet-1K 上，AdaTok-Adaptive 平均仅使用约 118 个 token 即达到 rFID 1.50，相比固定 256 token 的基线节省近一半 token，并在自回归图像生成中带来约 2.1 倍的吞吐量提升。
Motivation: 现有图像分词器（tokenizer）对所有图像使用固定数量的 token，忽视了视觉复杂度的异质性，导致简单图像过度分配、复杂图像分配不足。已有弹性分词器往往将 token 长度作为部署时的超参数或外部预测，而非分词器自身输出。
Method: AdaTok 结合两大模块：一是优先级表示学习，通过嵌套尾部掩码（nested tail masking）对 token 排序，并利用多头 LoRA 解码器缓解预算变化带来的语义偏移；二是自适应标记分配，训练一个轻量级确定性组 GRPO 策略（deterministic-group GRPO policy）在候选预算中选择，并采用动态 Pareto 加权在训练中自动平衡保真度与效率。
Result: 在 ImageNet-1K 上，AdaTok-Full（固定 256 token）达到 rFID 1.31；AdaTok-Adaptive 平均仅使用约 118 个 token，rFID 为 1.50，优于同等预算下的离散一维基线。在自回归图像生成中，自适应表示相比固定 256 token 解码吞吐量提升约 2.1 倍。
Conclusion: 实验表明，视觉 token 数量可以学习为内容条件的输出，而无需固定为超参数，为高效图像生成提供新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RETROSPECT: RETROsynthesis via Sequential Prediction, and Chemically Transformed-ranking
papers.abstract_en: Single-step retrosynthesis needs both accurate first-ranked suggestions and candidate lists that are rich enough for downstream selection. We study this as a proposal-selection decomposition. Our system, RETROSPECT, combines a single Transformer proposal model, which we call the ChemAlign Transformer, with a LambdaMART reranker over structural, reaction-template, upstream-score, and optional DFT-derived descriptors. The generator is trained with hybrid root-aligned and random SMILES augmentation, Pre-LayerNorm, tied embeddings, exponential moving average weights, and a differentiable atom-balance auxiliary loss. On the full USPTO-50K test set of 5,007 reactions, the generator reaches 55.00% top-1 and 86.18% top-10 exact-match accuracy with 99.86% top-1 validity. On the merged candidate-pool benchmark used for reranking, which contains 5,007 test products and about 111 candidates per product, a LambdaMART model trained on the structural feature set reaches 59.4% top-1 with 0.7171 mean reciprocal rank. Feature ablations show that upstream proposal score and template-frequency statistics provide most of the reranking signal, while DFT and reaction-center DFT features provide smaller and less consistent gains. These results support a modular view of retrosynthesis: stronger single-model proposal and learned candidate selection are complementary, and the proposal model can serve as a drop-in component for ensemble systems such as RetroChimera (Maziarz et al., 2024)
papers.comment: Accepted at the AI for Science workshop (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RETROSPECT系统，将单步逆合成分解为提案-选择两个阶段：使用ChemAlign Transformer作为生成器产生候选，再通过LambdaMART重排序器对结构、模板频率等特征进行排序。在USPTO-50K上，生成器达到55.00% top-1准确率和99.86%有效性，重排序后top-1提升至59.4%。实验表明上游提案分数和模板频率是重排序的主要信号，DFT特征贡献有限。
Motivation: 单步逆合成需要同时保证首选推荐的准确性和候选列表的丰富性，现有方法难以兼顾。
Method: 将逆合成分解为提案模型（ChemAlign Transformer）和重排序模型（LambdaMART），生成器使用根对齐SMILES增强、Pre-LayerNorm等技巧训练，重排序器使用结构、模板分数、上游分数等特征。
Result: 在USPTO-50K测试集上，生成器top-1准确率55.00%，top-10准确率86.18%，有效性99.86%；重排序后top-1达59.4%，平均倒数排名0.7171。
Conclusion: 更强的单模型提案与学习型候选选择互补，提案模型可作为即插即用组件集成到现有系统中。

papers.title: OPTIMUS-Prime: Minimal and Sufficient Concept Explanations for Deep Vision Models
papers.abstract_en: The growing demand for transparency in automated decision-making has propelled eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) to the forefront of machine learning research. In computer vision, however, existing explanation methods often prioritize end-user accessibility at the expense of formal guarantees, leaving a critical gap between practical utility and theoretical rigor. In this paper, we address this gap by introducing OPTIMUS, a novel framework for generating concept-based visual explanations for deep classification models. OPTIMUS explanations take the form of visual heatmaps that not only remain interpretable to end users, but are grounded in the well-established theory of prime implicants, providing formal guarantees that have been largely absent from existing saliency-based methods. Specifically, OPTIMUS explanations satisfy two desirable properties: sufficiency, ensuring that the highlighted concepts provably guarantee the classifier's prediction, and minimality, ensuring that no strict subset of those concepts retains this guarantee. Together, these properties yield explanations that are both logically tight and visually coherent. We validate our approach on a visual classification benchmark, demonstrating that OPTIMUS heatmaps naturally and faithfully surface the decision-relevant concepts underlying model predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OPTIMUS框架，用于生成深度视觉分类模型的概念级视觉解释，以热力图形式提供形式化保证，确保解释的充分性和最小性（基于素蕴含项理论）。在视觉分类基准上验证了该方法能自然且忠实地揭示模型决策相关的概念。
Motivation: 现有计算机视觉中的解释方法往往优先考虑终端用户可访问性而缺乏形式化保证，导致实用性与理论严谨性之间存在差距。
Method: 提出OPTIMUS框架，基于素蕴含项理论生成概念级视觉热力图，满足充分性（突出概念能保证预测）和最小性（无严格子集保留该保证）属性。
Result: 在视觉分类基准上验证，OPTIMUS热力图自然且忠实地呈现了模型决策相关概念。
Conclusion: OPTIMUS提供了兼具逻辑严密性和视觉连贯性的解释，填补了现有显著图方法缺乏形式化保证的空白。

papers.title: EvoGS: Constructing Continuous-Layered Gaussian Splatting with Evolution Tree for Scalable 3D Streaming
papers.abstract_en: Streaming 3D Gaussian Splatting requires highly scalable, progressive representations. Existing progressive methods rely on \textit{discrete layering}, accumulating separate splat sets for each level of detail. This structural independence between layers inherently leads to error accumulation, severe splat redundancy, and uncontrolled quality transitions. We propose EvoGS, the first \textit{continuous-layering} representation. Organized as an Evolution Tree, EvoGS generates finer details via an explicit, wavelet-inspired parent-child refinement. This empowers child nodes to structurally correct ancestral errors, yield inherently sparse and highly compressible inter-layer signals. Extensive experiments show EvoGS eliminates splat redundancy from over 65\% to under 25\%. Compared to state-of-the-art baselines, it reduces transmission payload and GPU VRAM footprint by up to 2.4$\times$ and 5.5$\times$, respectively, and achieves smooth quality transitions optimal for real-time adaptive streaming. Project page: https://yuang-ian.github.io/evogs/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: EvoGS 提出首个连续分层（continuous-layering）的 3D 高斯溅射表示，通过演化树（Evolution Tree）将父节点细化生成子节点，允许子节点结构性地修正祖先误差，消除冗余并提高可压缩性。实验表明，该方法将 splat 冗余从 65% 以上降至 25% 以下，传输负载和 GPU 显存占用分别降低至 2.4 倍和 5.5 倍，且实现平滑质量过渡，适用于实时自适应流式传输。
Motivation: 现有基于离散分层（discrete layering）的渐进式 3D 高斯溅射表示存在误差累积、严重冗余和不稳定的质量过渡问题。
Method: 提出 EvoGS，以演化树组织连续分层表示，子节点通过类小波的父-子细化明确生成，从而结构性地修正父节点误差，产生稀疏且高度可压缩的层间信号。
Result: Splat 冗余从超过 65% 降至 25% 以下；与基线相比，传输负载和 GPU 显存占用分别降低至 2.4 倍和 5.5 倍；实现平滑质量过渡。
Conclusion: EvoGS 是首个连续分层表示，有效解决了离散分层方法的冗余和误差累积问题，适用于可扩展 3D 流式传输。

papers.title: Seeing Without Exposing: Adaptive Privacy Control for Open-World, Context-Hungry MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have raised new privacy challenges. On the data side, user-provided inputs often include unpredictable sensitive information; while on the downstream task side, model reasoning depends on rich visual context that may itself be privacy-sensitive. Existing privacy protection methods, however, rely on predefined sensitive categories and fixed obfuscation strategies, struggling to tackle such challenges in MLLMs. To address this dilemma, we propose Anchored Privacy Drifting (APD), a training-free method that drifts privacy-sensitive elements toward semantically equivalent alternatives while anchoring contextual cues to the source image. To systematically evaluate this dual objective of privacy protection and contextual preservation, we introduce AdaptShield, a comprehensive benchmark covering 22 privacy categories, which combines conventional privacy metrics with MLLM-based assessments of contextual utility. Extensive experiments show that our method achieves balanced improvements in both privacy sanitization and content retention, with average gains of 10.4% on textual categories and 8.5% under MLLM-based evaluation across four MLLM series, i.e., Qwen2.5, Qwen3, InternVL3, and InternVL3.5.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在开放世界场景下的隐私保护问题，提出了一种无需训练的方法——锚定隐私漂移（APD），该方法将隐私敏感元素漂移到语义等价的替代项，同时锚定上下文线索到源图像。为系统评估隐私保护和上下文保留的双重目标，作者引入综合基准AdaptShield，涵盖22个隐私类别。实验表明，该方法在四个MLLM系列（Qwen2.5, Qwen3, InternVL3, InternVL3.5）上平均提升隐私净化与内容保留，文本类别提升10.4%，基于MLLM的评估提升8.5%。
Motivation: 现有隐私保护方法依赖预定义的敏感类别和固定混淆策略，难以应对MLLM中用户输入不可预测的敏感信息以及模型推理依赖的视觉上下文本身可能敏感的问题。
Method: 提出锚定隐私漂移（APD），一种无需训练的方法，通过将隐私敏感元素漂移到语义等效的替代项，同时将上下文线索锚定到源图像，实现隐私保护与上下文保留的平衡。
Result: 在四个MLLM系列上的实验显示，相比基线方法，APD在文本类别上平均提升10.4%，在基于MLLM的评估上平均提升8.5%。
Conclusion: APD在无需训练的情况下，能有效平衡隐私净化和内容保留，适用于开放世界、上下文敏感的MLLM场景。

papers.title: Textual Supervision Enhances Geospatial Representations in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Geospatial understanding is a critical yet underexplored dimension in the development of machine learning systems for tasks such as image geolocation and spatial reasoning. In this work, we analyze the geospatial representations acquired by three model families: vision-only architectures (e.g., ViT), vision-language models (e.g., CLIP), and large-scale multimodal foundation models (e.g., LLaVA, Qwen, and Gemma). By evaluating across image clusters, including people, landmarks, and everyday objects, grouped based on the degree of localizability, we reveal systematic gaps in spatial accuracy and show that textual supervision enhances the learning of geospatial representations. Our findings suggest the role of language as an effective complementary modality for encoding spatial context and multimodal learning as a key direction for advancing geospatial AI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了视觉-only（ViT）、视觉语言模型（CLIP）和大规模多模态基础模型（LLaVA等）在地理空间理解任务中的表现。通过分析不同可定位性程度的图像簇（人物、地标、日常物品），发现文本监督能有效增强地理空间表示的准确性，表明语言作为补充模态在编码空间上下文中具有重要作用。
Motivation: 地理空间理解是机器学习的关键但未被充分探索的维度，现有模型在空间准确性上存在系统性差距。
Method: 通过比较视觉-only、视觉语言模型和多模态基础模型三类架构，在包含人物、地标、日常物品的图像簇上评估其地理空间表示质量，分析文本监督的影响。
Result: 文本监督显著提升了地理空间表示的准确性，揭示了语言作为编码空间上下文的有效补充模态。
Conclusion: 多模态学习是推进地理空间AI的关键方向，语言模态能有效增强空间上下文编码。

papers.title: When Recovery Matters: The Blind Spot of Surrogate Privacy in MLLM Editing
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) enable flexible instruction-driven image editing, but privacy risks arise when user images expose diverse and user-specific private content. Canonical privacy protection strategies typically substitute sensitive regions with surrogate content before cloud editing. Yet, the resulting output is often an edited surrogate rather than the desired edited source image, neglecting the local recovery in both design and evaluation scope. To this end, we introduce SPPE (Surrogate-based Privacy-Preserving Editing), the first recovery-oriented benchmark covering 36 fine-grained privacy categories and 65 editing instructions. It defines two complementary tasks: 1) editability assessment, which estimates before cloud interaction whether a surrogate can induce an edit consistent with the original image; and 2) surrogate-to-source edit recovery, which evaluates whether the edited surrogate can be transferred back to the private source with the edit effect preserved. We address each task with a dedicated method: ERMA predicts surrogate editability through instruction-aware multimodal relation modeling, while \method performs cycle-consistent recovery by using the surrogate editing pair as visual edit evidence and the source image as a source-preserving anchor. Experiments on SPPE and InstructPix2Pix show consistent improvements on both tasks. For editability assessment, ERMA improves over the best-performing baselines by 13.9% in SRCC and 12.3% in PLCC. For surrogate-to-source edit recovery, C2E-S2SER outperforms SOER across all 8 source integrity and edit consistency metrics on SPPE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大模型（MLLM）指令驱动图像编辑中的隐私问题，指出现有替代隐私保护策略忽略了本地恢复，导致输出为编辑后的替代而非源图像。作者提出首个面向恢复的基准SPPE，涵盖36个细粒度隐私类别和65个编辑指令，定义可编辑性评估和替代到源编辑恢复两个任务，并分别提出ERMA和C2E-S2SER方法。实验显示，ERMA在可编辑性评估中SRCC提升13.9%、PLCC提升12.3%，C2E-S2SER在SPPE上所有8个指标上优于基线。
Motivation: 现有替代隐私保护策略将敏感区域替换为替代内容后交给云端编辑，但输出是编辑后的替代而非源图像，设计时忽视了编辑后的本地恢复，评估也未覆盖这一环节，造成隐私保护盲点。
Method: 提出SPPE基准，包含两个任务：1）可编辑性评估（ERMA方法），通过指令感知多模态关系建模预测替代能否诱导出与源图像一致的编辑；2）替代到源编辑恢复（C2E-S2SER方法），利用替代编辑对作为视觉证据、源图像作为源保留锚点进行循环一致性编辑恢复。
Result: 在SPPE和InstructPix2Pix上，ERMA在可编辑性评估中SRCC提升13.9%、PLCC提升12.3%；C2E-S2SER在SPPE上所有8个源完整性和编辑一致性指标均优于SOER基线。
Conclusion: 现有替代隐私保护策略因忽略恢复而存在盲点，本文提出的基准和方法能够更全面地评估和实现图像编辑中的隐私保护与编辑效果兼顾。

papers.title: UrduMMLU: A Massive Multitask Benchmark for Urdu Language Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Meaningful multilingual evaluation must test models in the target language and educational context. Urdu, spoken by more than 230 million people, lacks a broad MMLU-style benchmark built from native educational sources. We introduce UrduMMLU, a benchmark of 26,431 Urdu MCQs across 26 subjects and five domains, collected from native Urdu MCQ banks and public examination PDFs. Unlike translation-based resources, UrduMMLU covers both standard academic subjects and Urdu- and region-specific content. We label the exam-derived portion through dual human annotation with strict consensus filtering. We evaluate 30 LLMs under English and Urdu prompts, yielding 60 zero-shot evaluations, and further evaluate four open-source LLMs under multiple few-shot settings across both prompt languages. Gemini-3.5-Flash performs best, reaching 90.20% and 90.34% accuracy, while no other model exceeds 85%. The strongest open-source model trails by 7.79 and 8.92 points, and many models lose 25 to 40 points on Urdu-centered Humanities subjects compared with STEM. Few-shot prompting yields only modest gains. UrduMMLU shows that Urdu knowledge remains uneven in current LLMs, especially for regionally grounded content.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 18 figures, 17 tables, Submitted to ARR May 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: UrduMMLU 是一个面向乌尔都语理解的大规模多任务基准，包含 26,431 道多选题，覆盖 26 个科目和 5 个领域，数据来源于本土乌尔都语题库和公开考试 PDF。评估了 30 个大语言模型，发现 Gemini-3.5-Flash 表现最佳（准确率约 90%），而多数模型在乌尔都语特定人文科目上表现显著差于 STEM 科目。
Motivation: 乌尔都语有超过 2.3 亿使用者，但缺乏基于本土教育资源的 MMLU 风格基准，现有翻译类资源可能无法准确衡量模型对乌尔都语和区域特定内容的理解。
Method: 从本土乌尔都语 MCQ 题库和公开考试 PDF 收集题，经双人标注和严格共识过滤构建基准；在英语和乌尔都语提示下评估 30 个 LLM，进行零样本和少样本测试。
Result: Gemini-3.5-Flash 达到最高准确率 90.20% 和 90.34%，其他模型均低于 85%；最强开源模型落后约 8 个百分点；许多模型在乌尔都语人文科目上比 STEM 低 25-40 个百分点；少样本提示仅带来微小提升。
Conclusion: 当前 LLM 对乌尔都语知识掌握不均，尤其是区域特定内容存在显著差距，UrduMMLU 可促进乌尔都语 NLP 评估。

papers.title: TraRA: Trajectory-level Recognition Aggregation for Video Text Spotting in Urban Surveillance
papers.abstract_en: Video Text Spotting (VTS) is essential for urban surveillance and intelligent transportation systems, enabling automated reading of street signs, vehicle markings, and scene text in video streams. However, reliable recognition remains challenging due to dynamic video factors common in surveillance scenarios, including motion blur, occlusion, and scale variation, which degrade frame-level recognition. Existing VTS methods typically perform recognition independently on each frame, leading to inconsistent and inaccurate results across sequences. To address these limitations, we propose TraRA (Trajectory-level Recognition Aggregation for VTS), a plug-and-play method that performs trajectory-level text recognition by leveraging temporal and multimodal consistency. TraRA integrates two key modules: (1) the Temporal Clustering and (2) the Vision-Language Aggregation. The former refines noisy trajectories by grouping temporally and visually coherent text instances, while the latter employs a Low-Rank Adaptation-enhanced Vision-Language model to fuse visual cues with linguistic context across frames. By aggregating information over entire text trajectories, TraRA achieves robust text recognition even under challenging surveillance conditions. Extensive experiments on four public benchmarks, including road and urban scene datasets (RoadText, BOVText, ArTVideo, and ICDAR15), demonstrate that TraRA consistently improves tracking and recognition performance over state-of-the-art VTS methods. The source code is available at https://github.com/trid2912/TraRA.
papers.comment: 22nd IEEE International Conference on Advanced Visual and Signal-Based Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TraRA 是一种针对城市监控场景中视频文本识别（VTS）的即插即用方法，通过轨迹级文本识别聚合来应对运动模糊、遮挡和尺度变化等挑战。该方法包含时序聚类和视觉-语言聚合两个模块，前者通过分组时序和视觉一致的文本实例去噪轨迹，后者利用低秩自适应增强的视觉-语言模型融合多帧视觉线索与语言上下文。在 RoadText、BOVText、ArTVideo 和 ICDAR15 四个公开基准上，TraRA 持续提升了现有 VTS 方法的跟踪与识别性能。
Motivation: 现有视频文本识别方法逐帧独立识别，导致序列间结果不一致且不准确；城市监控场景中的运动模糊、遮挡和尺度变化进一步加剧了帧级识别的不可靠性。
Method: 提出 TraRA，包含两个模块：(1) 时序聚类模块，通过分组时序和视觉上一致的文本实例来精化噪声轨迹；(2) 视觉-语言聚合模块，采用低秩自适应增强的视觉-语言模型，跨帧融合视觉线索与语言上下文。
Result: 在 RoadText、BOVText、ArTVideo 和 ICDAR15 四个公开基准上，TraRA 一致性地提升了现有最先进 VTS 方法的跟踪和识别性能。

papers.title: Think Fast: Estimating No-CoT Task-Completion Time Horizons of Frontier AI Models
papers.abstract_en: Many efforts to ensure frontier AI models are safe rely on monitoring their chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. If models become able to perform sufficiently complex reasoning internally, without explicit thinking tokens, this would undermine such oversight. We measure how well frontier models reason without CoT across a suite of over 30,000 questions spanning 43 benchmarks in domains including math, coding, puzzles, causality, theory-of-mind, and strategic reasoning. To compare models against humans, we estimate the $50\%$-task-completion time horizon (TH): the human time required for tasks a model completes with $50\%$ success rate. We complement this with a $50\%$ reasoning token horizon: the minimum number of o3-mini reasoning tokens needed for tasks a model solves with $50\%$ success rate. We find that the no-CoT $50\%$ TH of frontier models has been doubling roughly every year over the past six years, with GPT-5.5's TH reaching over 3 minutes and reasoning token horizon exceeding 1,500 tokens. Our median estimates predict that frontier no-CoT THs could exceed 7 minutes by 2028, and 25 minutes by 2030, though these projections carry substantial uncertainty. We recommend frontier developers track this explicitly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估前沿AI模型在没有思维链（CoT）推理情况下的能力，通过超过30,000个问题和43个基准测试，测量模型在数学、编程、谜题、因果推理、心理推理和战略推理领域中的表现。研究发现，最新模型GPT-5.5的无CoT任务完成时间中位数超过3分钟，推理token数超过1,500个，且该能力在过去六年中每年翻倍。预测到2028年，无CoT任务完成时间可能超过7分钟，到2030年超过25分钟。
Motivation: 许多前沿AI模型的安全措施依赖于监控其思维链推理过程。如果模型能够在没有显式推理token的情况下进行足够复杂的内部推理，将削弱这种监督。因此，需要量化模型在无CoT情况下的推理能力水平。
Method: 提出使用50%任务完成时间范围（TH）和50%推理token范围作为指标，对比模型与人类的表现。通过一系列基准测试，测量模型无需CoT的推理能力。
Result: 前沿模型的无CoT 50% TH在过去六年中每年翻倍，GPT-5.5的TH超过3分钟，推理token范围超过1,500个。中位数预测显示，无CoT TH可能在2028年超过7分钟，2030年超过25分钟。
Conclusion: 建议前沿模型开发者明确跟踪无CoT任务完成时间，因为该能力增长迅速，可能影响现有安全监控机制的有效性。

papers.title: No-Harm Physics-Informed Inverse Learning with Residual-Calibrated Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed learning is increasingly used for partial differential equation (PDE)-governed inverse problems, but its reliability remains difficult to certify. This paper develops a no-harm certification-and-selection framework for physics-informed inverse learning. A learned reconstruction is accepted only when its residual-calibrated radius is no worse than the baseline radius, namely when $$R_{\mathrm{learn}}\le R_{\mathrm{base}}+\varepsilon_{\mathrm{safe}};$$otherwise, the method returns the baseline. The certificate combines data, physics, boundary or initial-condition, and optimization residuals. Under a conditional stability estimate, these residuals yield an a posteriori reconstruction-error bound and a deterministic uncertainty radius. A high-probability certificate is also derived for physics residuals estimated from independent random collocation points. Numerical tests on Poisson source recovery, inverse heat reconstruction, limited-angle tomography, elliptic coefficient identification, and stochastic residual validation show that the selector accepts certified improvements, rejects shifted, hallucinated, or unfinished candidates, and becomes conservative in strongly ill-posed regimes. The framework is therefore a certification-and-selection layer, not another reconstruction architecture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个无伤害认证与选择框架，用于物理信息逆学习。该框架基于残差校准的不确定度半径，只有当学习重建的半径不超过基线半径加上安全裕度时才接受，否则返回基线。结合数据、物理、边界/初始条件和优化残差，在后验误差界和确定性不确定度半径下提供认证。数值测试包括泊松源恢复、逆热重建、有限角度CT、椭圆系数识别和随机残差验证，表明该选择器能够接受认证改进，拒绝偏移、幻觉或不完整候选，并在强不适定问题中趋于保守。
Motivation: 物理信息学习在PDE逆问题中广泛使用，但其可靠性难以认证。现有方法缺乏一种保证不会产生比基线更差结果的机制。
Method: 提出一个认证-选择层，基于残差校准的半径比较：仅当学习重建的半径不大于基线半径加上安全裕度时才接受，否则退回基线。该半径由数据、物理、边界/初始条件和优化残差计算，并利用条件稳定性估计得到后验误差界和确定性不确定度半径。此外还推导了基于独立随机配点的高概率认证。
Result: 在五个逆问题（泊松源恢复、逆热重建、有限角度CT、椭圆系数识别、随机残差验证）上，选择器正确接受认证的改进，拒绝偏移、幻觉或不完整候选，在强不适定问题中表现保守。
Conclusion: 该框架作为一个认证与选择层，而非新的重建架构，可以增强物理信息逆学习的可靠性，但不改变底层重建算法。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Geodesics of Dynamic Graphs for Regime Change Detection
papers.abstract_en: Traditional change point detection in dynamic networks assumes abrupt transitions between stationary states, overlooking scenarios of continuous evolution which arise in most real-world applications, such as social networks or physical systems. We address this gap by formally defining regimes as periods of coherent dynamics in temporal graphs, which we characterize as trajectories along geodesics in a suitably defined graph space. This original perspective allows us to define regime changes as significant drifts in dynamics, either toward new trajectories or with pace changes. We leverage graph regression methods to measure the cumulative distance of sequences of observed graphs from the estimated geodesics between their endpoints, in the relevant graph space, which we can combine with change point detection algorithms. We present experiments on dynamic networks, with changing trajectories and varying speeds, in which we outperform state of the art change point detection models. Then, we analyse mobility data during the Covid-19 pandemic, and show that our assumptions on regular network evolution lead to change points that are more aligned to external events compared to the outcomes of baseline methods. Our work is the first to model and detect changes between evolving regimes in graph space, providing a realistic and powerful tool for analyzing complex temporal graph data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文定义动态网络中的“状态”为时间图上沿测地线的一致动态轨迹，并通过图回归方法度量观测图序列与估计测地线之间的累积距离，结合变化点检测算法识别状态变化。实验在合成动态网络和COVID-19疫情期间的移动数据上优于基线方法。
Motivation: 传统变化点检测假设动态网络在状态间突变，忽略了真实世界（如社交网络、物理系统）中常见的连续演化，导致无法捕捉渐变的动态变化。
Method: 将动态网络中的一致动态时期定义为“状态”，并建模为图空间中沿测地线的轨迹；利用图回归估计端点间测地线，计算观测序列与测地线的累积距离作为变化指标，再结合变化点检测算法。
Result: 在合成动态网络和COVID-19移动数据上，该方法在检测轨迹变化和速度变化方面优于现有变化点检测模型；在COVID-19数据中，检测到的变化点与外部事件对齐更好。
Conclusion: 本文首次在图空间中建模和检测演化状态之间的变化，为复杂时间图数据分析提供了更现实的工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Privacy to Workflow Integrity: Communication-Graph Metadata in Autonomous Agent Interoperability
papers.abstract_en: Agent-interoperability protocols such as A2A and MCP standardize what agents say to one another, but assume address-based transport over HTTP(S). Such transports protect message content, increasingly with end-to-end encryption. What they leave in the clear is the communication graph: which agent contacts which, when, and how often. In agent systems this graph is more consequential than a privacy framing suggests. Endpoints are often capability-labeled, workflows are structured and chained, and interactions are coupled to real actions, so an observer recovers more than past relationships. It can infer the pending workflow, the task being assembled and the action likely to follow. At machine speed, it can act on that inference before the workflow completes. The threat is therefore one of workflow integrity, not privacy alone: predictive leverage over autonomous action. We give a threat model for the agent communication graph; identify what makes agent metadata distinctively revealing (semanticity, prospectivity, actuation); define transport- and bootstrap-layer privacy properties and weigh candidate transports (SimpleX/SMP, Tor, mixnets) against them; and present an A2A case study in which a metadata-protecting binding is expressible but surfaces the protocol's identity assumptions. We test these on a generative model anchored to a real A2A capture. From passive metadata alone, with no payloads, a classifier recovers a task's class well above chance, from only the workflow's opening; applied together, the properties drive that recovery sharply back toward chance. Beyond what an observer can recover, we measure the leverage of acting on the leak: from a workflow's opening and under a fixed budget, an adversary choosing which workflows to act on realizes in this model most of a clairvoyant attacker's advantage over a metadata-blind one, and the same properties suppress it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文探讨了自主代理互操作性协议（如A2A和MCP）中通信图元数据的隐私与工作流完整性问题。尽管消息内容受到保护，但通信图（谁联系谁、何时、频率）在代理系统中比隐私问题更严重：观察者可以推断出待处理的工作流、正在组装的任务以及即将执行的动作，从而在任务完成前采取行动。论文给出了威胁模型，定义了传输层和引导层的隐私属性，评估了候选传输方案，并基于A2A案例进行了实证测试。
Motivation: 现有代理互操作性协议（如A2A和MCP）虽然保护消息内容，但通信图元数据暴露，这在代理系统中不仅威胁隐私，更威胁工作流完整性：观察者可以预测并干扰自主行动。
Method: 构建了代理通信图的威胁模型，识别了代理元数据的独特泄露性（语义性、前瞻性、可执行性），定义了传输层和引导层的隐私属性，评估了SimpleX/SMP、Tor、混合网络等传输方案，并在A2A案例中测试了元数据保护绑定。
Result: 通过仅基于被动元数据（无载荷）的分类器，能从工作流开头恢复任务类别远高于随机水平；而应用所定义的隐私属性后，恢复率大幅下降。在固定预算下，利用泄露的对手能实现近乎全知攻击者的优势，而隐私属性可抑制该优势。
Conclusion: 强调代理通信图元数据的威胁不仅是隐私，更是工作流完整性；需要元数据保护传输属性来抵御预测性攻击。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Decision-Aware Evaluation of Physics-Informed Surrogates
papers.abstract_en: Physics-informed machine learning is often assessed by curve error, although engineering use depends on downstream decisions: ranking candidates, avoiding infeasible designs and limiting regret. We introduce pinn-gym, an open benchmark for material-conditioned lattice design that couples a transparent reduced-order crush-and-impact oracle with five printable polymer cards, dimensionless force-response targets and a protocol spanning curve fidelity, physical admissibility, top-k retrieval and mass regret. Across per-material, pooled and cross-material settings, low nRMSE is frequently insufficient to identify useful design selections. Physics-informed losses alter trade-offs rather than monotonically improving all metrics, and dimensionless conditioning improves comparability without making transfer symmetric. The benchmark is not a certified material model; within the released oracle, candidate generator and material cards, pinn-gym provides a reproducible testbed for evaluating PIML surrogates as decision systems rather than curve predictors alone.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Code and data available at https://github.com/Dyniel/pinn-gym
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个开放式基准测试 pinn-gym，用于评估物理信息机器学习代理模型在材料条件晶格设计中的决策性能，而非仅基于曲线误差。该基准包含透明降阶碰撞冲击预言机、五种可打印聚合物卡片、无量纲力响应目标，以及涵盖曲线保真度、物理可行性、top-k 检索和质量遗憾的评估协议。实验表明，低 nRMSE 不足以识别有用的设计选择，物理信息损失会改变权衡而非单调改善所有指标。
Motivation: 物理信息机器学习通常仅通过曲线误差评估，但工程应用中依赖于下游决策（如候选排序、避免不可行设计、限制遗憾），现有评估方式与决策需求脱节。
Method: 提出 pinn-gym 基准测试，包含一个透明的降阶碰撞冲击预言机、五种可打印聚合物材料卡片、无量纲力响应目标，并设计多维度评估协议（曲线保真度、物理可接受性、top-k 检索、质量遗憾），支持每材料、池化和跨材料设置。
Result: 低 nRMSE 常不足以识别有用设计选择；物理信息损失改变了各指标间的权衡，并未单调改进所有指标；无量纲条件化改善了可比性，但未使迁移对称。
Conclusion: pinn-gym 提供了一个可重复的测试平台，用于评估物理信息机器学习代理模型作为决策系统的性能，而不仅仅是曲线预测器。但该基准并非认证的材料模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Consistent-Inversion: Reverse Consistency Guidance for Structure-Preserving Visual Editing
papers.abstract_en: Text-guided diffusion models have become effective tools for real-image visual editing, where the edited image must follow a target instruction while preserving editing-irrelevant structure. Most training-free editors rely on inversion: a source image is mapped to a noisy latent trajectory and the terminal latent is reused for target-prompt denoising. This reuse is useful for preservation, but it also couples source reconstruction and target editing. The resulting trajectory mismatch may either damage background/layout details or over-constrain the intended edit. This paper presents Consistent-Inversion, a training-free reverse consistency guidance framework for structure-preserving visual editing. Instead of treating the inverted source latent as a fixed initialization, Consistent-Inversion checks whether an intermediate target trajectory can be reversed toward the source inversion trajectory under the source prompt. To make this check well-defined, we construct an auxiliary target-side noise representation, perform source-guided reverse denoising, and use the resulting reverse consistency discrepancy as a correction signal for selected early target denoising steps. The method does not update model parameters, is compatible with inversion-based editors, and introduces only a small inference overhead when applied sparsely. Experiments on PIE-Bench show that Consistent-Inversion improves background and structural fidelity under a unified SD3.5 protocol while maintaining target-prompt alignment, and compatibility experiments further verify the same correction principle on classical Stable-Diffusion inversion pipelines.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia; 10 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Consistent-Inversion，一种无需训练的反向一致性引导框架，用于保持结构的视觉编辑。它通过检查中间目标轨迹能否在源提示下反向到源反转轨迹，并利用反向一致性差异作为修正信号，从而改善编辑后的背景和结构保真度，同时保持目标提示对齐。在PIE-Bench上的实验表明，该方法在统一SD3.5协议下提升了背景和结构保真度，且与经典Stable-Diffusion反转流水线兼容。
Motivation: 现有基于反转的文本引导扩散编辑方法将源图像倒转为噪声轨迹并复用终端潜变量，但这种方式将源重建与目标编辑耦合，导致轨迹不匹配，可能损害背景/布局细节或过度约束预期编辑。
Method: 提出Consistent-Inversion框架，不更新模型参数，通过构造辅助目标侧噪声表示，执行源引导的反向去噪，并利用反向一致性差异作为早期目标去噪步骤的修正信号，稀疏应用时仅增加少量推理开销。
Result: 在PIE-Bench上，Consistent-Inversion在统一SD3.5协议下提升了背景和结构保真度，同时保持目标提示对齐；在经典Stable-Diffusion反转流水线上验证了相同的修正原理。
Conclusion: 该方法是一种无需训练、与基于反转的编辑器兼容的补充技术，通过反向一致性引导解耦源重建与目标编辑，从而改善结构保持效果。

papers.title: Freo Doctor: Atmospheric Modelling for Meteorite Falls and Spacecraft Re-Entries
papers.abstract_en: How much does the wind affect the path of meteorite falls? We finely model the lower ~30 km of the atmosphere using Weather Research and Forecasting open source tools at 1 km spatial resolution. Models initialised at different times give different results, which can be used as a proxy for uncertainty. We find that in most cases the differences on the ground positions are significant: median shift for a 1 kg meteorite is 143 m, doubling to 307 m for a 10 g rock, though these vary by over an order of magnitude between events. The differences wind model choice makes on the ground are significantly larger than the typical uncertainty on meteoroid state vector obtained from bright flight observations of the fireball (<100 m), and should be taken into account when predicting meteorite free-fall path to the ground. Unsurprisingly the cases where we see the largest differences coincide with documented extreme weather events. We also find that high spatial resolution models (1 vs. 3 km) tend to perform better. We have successfully used these models to guide field teams to the location of 12 fallen meteorites after fireball observations. We release as open data 1107 models we have calculated for 302 meteorite fall events and spacecraft re-entries around the world.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables, submitted to PASA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) 开源工具，以1 km空间分辨率精细模拟大气下层约30 km，研究风对陨石下落路径的影响。结果表明，风造成的落地位置偏移显著（1 kg陨石中位偏移143 m，10 g陨石中位偏移307 m），且远大于火球观测的不确定性。作者已成功用这些模型指导野外团队找到12颗陨石，并公开发布了302个事件的1107个模型。
Motivation: 量化风对陨石下落路径的影响，因为现有模型未充分考虑风造成的偏移，而这对预测陨石落点至关重要。
Method: 使用Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) 开源工具，以1 km空间分辨率对大气下层约30 km进行精细建模，并通过不同初始时间的模型结果表征不确定性。
Result: 对于1 kg陨石，风造成的落地位置中位偏移为143 m；对于10 g陨石，偏移增至307 m，且事件间差异超过一个数量级。这些偏移显著大于火球观测的典型不确定性（<100 m）。
Conclusion: 风对陨石下落路径的影响显著，应在预测中予以考虑。高分辨率模型（1 km vs 3 km）表现更好，已成功用于指导陨石搜寻。

papers.title: REMEDI: A Benchmark for Retention and Unlearning Evaluation in Multi-label Clinical Disease Inference
papers.abstract_en: Language models trained for clinical disease inference are trained on patient data, which may include sensitive and private information, and data owners may request the removal of their data from a trained model due to privacy or copyright concerns. However, exactly unlearning patient-specific data is intractable, and retraining with minor data removal is resource-intensive. While there exists several machine unlearning methods that can be used, their utility is generally restricted to non-medical domains. Moreover, the existing benchmarks for evaluating such unlearning methods primarily utilize synthetically curated datasets, which are not truly representative of real-world systems. Hence, the effectiveness of these unlearning methods in the medical domain is largely unclear. To this end, we introduce REMEDI, an extensive benchmark for machine unlearning tailored to multi-label and multiclass clinical disease inference, where label correlations, longitudinal structure, and safety constraints make unlearning particularly challenging. Unlike the existing benchmarks, REMEDI considers: (1) a relevant application domain (medical), (2) comprehensive unlearning setups involving diverse sets of forget instances, (3) challenging unlearning scenarios including multi-label and multi-class classification tasks, and (4) evaluation metrics involving performance both in terms of utility and extent of unlearning achieved. REMEDI is developed using the MIMIC-III clinical database that contains comprehensive clinical data of patients. Experiments with existing unlearning methods indicate that there exists a trade-off between utility and unlearning performance. They are also largely unsuited to multi-label classification tasks. To facilitate reproducibility, we make our benchmark publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了REMEDI，一个针对多标签和多类临床疾病推断的机器遗忘基准测试。该基准利用MIMIC-III临床数据库，考虑了标签相关性、纵向结构和安全性约束，评估现有遗忘方法在医疗领域的效用和遗忘程度。实验表明现有方法在效用和遗忘性能之间存在权衡，且不适用于多标签分类。
Motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法主要在非医疗领域评估，且现有基准使用合成数据集，无法真实反映实际系统。医疗领域的数据敏感性使得遗忘至关重要，但缺乏专门针对临床疾病推断的基准。
Method: 基于MIMIC-III临床数据库构建基准，涵盖多标签和多类分类任务，设计多种遗忘设置（不同遗忘实例集），并采用评估指标同时衡量模型效用和遗忘程度。
Result: 实验发现现有遗忘方法在效用和遗忘性能之间存在权衡，且大多数方法不适用于多标签分类任务。
Conclusion: REMEDI填补了医疗领域机器遗忘基准的空白，揭示了现有方法在临床疾病推断中的局限性，有助于推动更适合医疗场景的遗忘方法研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Explaining Unsupervised Disease Staging in Huntington's Disease: Insights into Model Representations and Clusters
papers.abstract_en: Huntington's disease (HD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder that affects motor, cognitive, and behavioral functions, where accurate characterization of disease progression remains essential to improve patient outcome and quality of life. Unsupervised machine learning (ML) approaches have demonstrated the ability to uncover disease progression trajectories and meaningful latent stages from longitudinal data; however, their limited interpretability restricts clinical trust and translation. We extend a previously proposed ML-based disease staging framework by applying an explainability analysis to the extracted feature representations and discovered disease stages. Applied to the Enroll-HD dataset, we first project the learned representations into a lower-dimensional space to intuitively assess whether the resulting clusters align with the progression of established clinical measures. We then use saliency maps to identify the clinical features that most strongly contribute to the learned embeddings over time. Finally, we train a surrogate classifier and apply SHAP to quantify feature importance for cluster assignments and to analyze which clinical variables drive transitions between disease stages. The explainability analysis indicates that the learned embeddings capture clinically meaningful disease structure, aligning with established motor and functional severity scores and exhibiting progressive deterioration across clusters. Within this analysis, SHAP reveals a stratification of disease stages, ranging from early cognitive-motor impairment to severe functional dependency, consistent with known clinical progression patterns, while also highlighting intra-stage variability.
papers.comment: Accepted for oral presentation and as a full-length paper at the International Conference on AI in Healthcare 2026 (26-28 August 2026, Imperial College London) and will be published by Springer in the Lecture Notes in Computer Science (LNCS) series
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对亨廷顿病的无监督机器学习疾病分期框架进行可解释性分析，使用降维、显著性图和SHAP等方法，在Enroll-HD数据集上验证了学习到的表征和聚类与临床进展一致。
Motivation: 无监督疾病分期方法可发现疾病进展轨迹，但可解释性不足，限制了临床信任和应用。
Method: 对已有框架进行可解释性分析：投影到低维空间观察聚类与临床指标的一致性，用显著性图识别对嵌入贡献大的特征，训练代理分类器并用SHAP量化特征重要性。
Result: 可解释性分析表明学习到的嵌入捕捉了临床有意义的结构，与运动功能评分一致，SHAP揭示了从早期认知运动障碍到严重功能依赖的分期，并展示了分期内变异性。
Conclusion: 该可解释性分析增强了无监督疾病分期模型的临床可信度，有助于临床转化。

papers.title: $α$-PFN: Fast Entropy Search via In-Context Learning
papers.abstract_en: Information-theoretic acquisition functions such as Entropy Search (ES) offer a principled exploration-exploitation framework for Bayesian optimization (BO). However, their practical implementation relies on complicated and slow approximations, i.e., a Monte Carlo estimation of the information gain. This complexity can introduce numerical errors and requires specialized, hand-crafted implementations. We propose a two-stage amortization strategy that learns to approximate entropy search-based acquisition functions using Prior-data Fitted Networks (PFNs) in a single forward pass. A first PFN is trained to be conditioned on information about the optima; second, the $α$-PFN is trained to predict the expected information gain by training on information gains measured with the first PFN. The $α$-PFN offers a flexible learned approximation, which replaces the complex heuristic approximations with a single forward pass per candidate, enabling rapid and extensible acquisition evaluation. Empirically, our approach is competitive with state-of-the-art entropy search implementations on synthetic and real-world benchmarks, while accelerating the different entropy search variants across all our experiments, with speed ups over 50x. Source code: https://github.com/automl/AlphaPFN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种两阶段平摊（amortization）策略，利用Prior-data Fitted Networks（PFNs）来近似熵搜索（Entropy Search）采集函数，实现单次前向传播即可评估信息增益。第一阶段训练一个PFN以最优值为条件；第二阶段训练α-PFN预测期望信息增益。该方法在合成和真实基准上达到与最先进熵搜索实现相当的性能，同时加速超过50倍。
Motivation: 熵搜索等信息论采集函数的实际实现依赖于复杂且缓慢的蒙特卡洛近似，易引入数值误差且需要专门的手工实现。
Method: 提出两阶段平摊策略：先训练一个以最优值为条件的PFN，再训练α-PFN通过在第一阶段PFN上测量的信息增益来预测期望信息增益，从而用单次前向传播替代复杂启发式近似。
Result: 在合成和真实贝叶斯优化基准上，该方法与最先进的熵搜索实现性能相当，并在所有实验中实现了超过50倍的加速。
Conclusion: α-PFN提供了一种灵活的学习近似，能够快速且可扩展地评估采集函数，显著加速熵搜索变体。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出了一种两阶段平摊（amortization）策略，利用Prior-data Fitted Networks（PFNs）来近似熵搜索（Entropy Search）采集函数，实现单次前向传播即可评估信息增益。第一阶段训练一个PFN以最优值为条件；第二阶段训练α-PFN预测期望信息增益。该方法在合成和真实基准上达到与最先进熵搜索实现相当的性能，同时加速超过50倍。
summary_sections.motivation: 熵搜索等信息论采集函数的实际实现依赖于复杂且缓慢的蒙特卡洛近似，易引入数值误差且需要专门的手工实现。
summary_sections.method: 提出两阶段平摊策略：先训练一个以最优值为条件的PFN，再训练α-PFN通过在第一阶段PFN上测量的信息增益来预测期望信息增益，从而用单次前向传播替代复杂启发式近似。

summary_sections.conclusion: α-PFN提供了一种灵活的学习近似，能够快速且可扩展地评估采集函数，显著加速熵搜索变体。

papers.title: A machine-learning-assisted progressive digit-randomness screening framework for detecting non-random patterns in raw numerical research data
papers.abstract_en: Raw numerical datasets remain less systematically examined in integrity screening than images, plagiarism, or summary-statistic inconsistencies. We developed the Fabrication-risk Digit Randomness Screening model (FDRS), a statistical and machine-learning framework for detecting non-random digit-pattern irregularities in numerical research data. FDRS integrates single- and joint-decimal-digit tests, Cramer's V, entropy metrics, Kullback-Leibler divergence, digit-preference indices, progressive subsampling, and semi-supervised risk scoring. It was evaluated using an instrument-derived enzymatic absorbance dataset (RawData, n=253) and a blinded manually simulated irregular dataset (ErrData, n=255). RawData showed no significant deviation in single third-decimal-digit analysis, whereas ErrData showed a significant deviation. In joint third-fourth decimal digit analysis, ErrData showed higher Cramer's V, lower normalized entropy, higher KL divergence, and a more persistent progressive-subsampling deviation signal. In internal validation, Elastic-net Logistic Regression achieved the highest AUC (0.98395) and lowest Brier score (0.048439), while Random Forest achieved the highest accuracy (0.926667) and balanced accuracy (0.935). RawData received a low ensemble risk score of 0.124627 and was classified as Grade 0; ErrData received a score of 0.740760 and was classified as Grade 3. External real-world benchmarks supported graded risk stratification: three datasets without identified public post-publication concerns were classified as Grade 0 or 1, whereas two datasets from publicly questioned or institutionally handled articles were classified as Grade 2 or 3. FDRS can prioritize raw numerical datasets for further review by integrating interpretable statistical and machine-learning features. It is an auxiliary digit-structure screening tool, not standalone evidence of fabrication or misconduct.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FDRS框架，结合统计检验和机器学习方法检测原始数值研究数据中的非随机数字模式异常。在酶学吸光度数据集和模拟异常数据集上验证，弹性网络逻辑回归取得最高AUC 0.98395，随机森林最高准确率0.926667。外部基准支持分级风险分层，但框架仅为辅助筛选工具，不能作为造假证据。
Motivation: 原始数值数据在完整性筛查中受到的关注少于图像、文本抄袭或汇总统计不一致，现有方法缺乏系统性的数字随机性检查。
Method: 开发FDRS模型，集成单小数位和联合小数位检验、Cramer's V、熵度量、KL散度、数字偏好指数、渐进子采样和半监督风险评分，并用弹性网络逻辑回归和随机森林等进行内部验证。
Result: 内部验证中，弹性网络逻辑回归AUC最高0.98395，Brier分数最低0.048439；随机森林准确率最高0.926667，平衡准确率0.935。RawData风险评分0.124627（Grade 0），ErrData风险评分0.740760（Grade 3）。外部基准中，无公共问题的数据集评为Grade 0或1，被质疑的数据集评为Grade 2或3。
Conclusion: FDRS可作为辅助数字结构筛查工具，帮助优先审查原始数值数据集，但不能作为不当行为的独立证据。

papers.title: Learning Explicit Behavioral Models with Adaptive Questions and World-Model Probes
papers.abstract_en: Interactive agents trained only against task return can achieve high scores while failing to represent the mechanisms that make their actions succeed. This makes brittle behavior difficult to diagnose and limits adaptation when environment dynamics change. Existing LLM reflection and policy-code repair can revise behavior from failed trajectories, but questions and world-understanding tests are usually used only after training. We introduce an Explicit Symbolic Behavioral Model (ESBM), a trainable behavioral model that couples task performance with evidence-grounded question answering and executable mechanism prediction. An ESBM represents behavior through typed predicates, weighted rules, bounded options and mechanism memory; the mechanism layer predicts symbolic events, object changes, rewards and terminal consequences under action interventions. After each rollout, adaptive questions and active world-model probes convert score failures, QA errors and transition-prediction errors into constraints for local ESBM edits. Candidate models are selected by a multi-criterion rule that jointly evaluates task score, answerability and active world-model consistency. Under the tested Atari-style protocols, ESBM learns high-scoring policies while producing explicit answers and executable mechanism predictions, indicating that adaptive questions can serve as both training pressure and reusable benchmarks for mechanistic policy learning in this setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习智能体仅基于任务回报训练导致行为脆弱、难以诊断和适应环境变化的问题，提出显式符号行为模型（ESBM）。该模型通过类型谓词、加权规则、有限选项和机制记忆表示行为，并耦合任务表现、基于证据的问答和可执行机制预测。每次 rollout 后，自适应问题和主动世界模型探针将得分失败、QA 错误和转换预测错误转化为局部编辑约束，通过多准则规则选择候选模型。在 Atari 风格协议下，ESBM 学习到高分策略并产生显式答案和可执行机制预测。
Motivation: 现有交互式智能体仅由任务回报训练，可能取得高分但无法表示动作成功机制，导致行为脆弱且难以适应环境变化。现有 LLM 反思和策略代码修复方法仅在训练后使用问答和世界理解测试，缺乏训练阶段的机制约束。
Method: 提出显式符号行为模型（ESBM），包含自适应问题和主动世界模型探针。ESBM 通过类型谓词、加权规则、有限选项和机制记忆表示行为；机制层预测符号事件、对象变化、奖励和动作干预下的终端后果。每次 rollout 后将失败、QA 错误和过渡预测错误转化为局部 ESBM 编辑的约束，并通过多准则规则选择候选模型。
Result: 在 Atari 风格协议下，ESBM 学习到高分策略，同时产生显式答案和可执行机制预测。
Conclusion: 自适应问题可以同时作为训练压力和机制性策略学习的可复用基准。
