papers.title: Information-Theoretic Bounds for Sparse Covariance Estimation in the Vertical-Split Distributed Model
papers.abstract_en: We study the minimax estimation error for distributed covariance matrix estimation in the vertical-split (feature-split) setting, where two agents each observe different coordinates of $m$ i.i.d. sub-Gaussian samples and communicate a limited number of bits to a central server. While Rahmani et al. [2025] established nearly tight bounds for dense (unstructured) cross-covariance matrices, we investigate whether imposing elementwise $s$-sparsity on the cross-covariance $C_{21}$ can reduce the required communication and sample complexity. In contrast to the horizontal-split setting, where Braverman et al. [2016] showed that sparsity does not reduce communication cost for mean estimation, we prove that sparsity does help for cross-covariance estimation in the vertical split. Specifically, we establish minimax lower bounds showing that the communication budget per agent scales as $B_k = Ω(σ^4 d_k\, s' \log(d_1 d_2/s')/\varepsilon^2)$ and the sample complexity for cross-covariance estimation as $m = Ω(σ^4\, s' \log(d_1 d_2/s')/\varepsilon^2)$, where $s' = s \wedge d_{\min}$. For the $1$-sparse case, this yields an exponential improvement from $d_1 d_2$ to $\log(d_1 d_2)$ compared to the dense rate. Our lower bounds are established via Fano's method with an explicit sparse packing using a Varshamov--Gilbert-type argument for signed partial permutation matrices combined with the Conditional Strong Data Processing Inequality of Rahmani et al. [2025]. We show the bounds are tight with a matching achievable scheme, based on covering-net quantization and entry-wise hard thresholding, that attains the $s$-sparse lower bound up to polylogarithmic factors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究垂直分割（特征分割）分布式设置下的稀疏协方差矩阵估计的极小最大误差。与密集情况相比，作者证明对交叉协方差施加元素稀疏性可以降低通信和样本复杂度，建立了紧的下界并给出了匹配的可达方案。
Motivation: 在垂直分割分布式模型中，两个代理观测不同特征且通信有限，现有工作仅针对密集协方差矩阵给出紧界，稀疏性是否能降低复杂度尚不明确。
Method: 利用Fano方法与Varshamov-Gilbert型论证构造稀疏压缩，结合Rahmani等人的条件强数据处理不等式推导下界；可达方案采用覆盖网络量化与逐项硬阈值估计。
Result: 对于s-稀疏交叉协方差矩阵，通信预算下界为Ω(σ⁴ d_k s' log(d1 d2/s')/ε²)，样本复杂度下界类似；1-稀疏时复杂度从d1 d2指数级降至log(d1 d2)，且下界紧，可达方案匹配至多polylog因子。
Conclusion: 摘要强调垂直分割中稀疏性有助于协方差估计，与水平分割中均值估计的结论相反，并给出了信息论最优界。

papers.title: Beyond Linear and Overcomplete Regimes: A Mean-Field Analysis of Bottleneck Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Autoencoders (AEs) learn low-dimensional representations by mapping data into a latent space while minimizing reconstruction error. Despite their empirical success, theoretical understanding remains limited and largely restricted to linear models or settings without a bottleneck. In this work, we study nonlinear AEs with a fixed finite-dimensional bottleneck in the mean-field (MF) regime. We derive explicit MF learning dynamics for both encoder and decoder, providing a tractable characterization of training in the nonlinear setting. We show that, over finite time horizons, the empirical risk of finite-width networks trained with stochastic gradient descent closely tracks the MF risk trajectory with high probability. At optimality, we further establish that the finite-width risk converges to the MF optimum, demonstrating that finite networks are sufficiently expressive to approximate the infinite-width solution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在平均场（mean-field）框架下分析非线性瓶颈自编码器（bottleneck autoencoders）的训练动态，推导了编码器和解码器的显式平均场学习动力学，并证明有限宽度网络的实证风险以高概率逼近平均场风险轨迹，且在最优时有限宽度风险收敛到平均场最优。
Motivation: 自编码器在实际应用中成功，但理论分析主要限于线性模型或无瓶颈设置，非线性瓶颈自编码器的理论理解有限。
Method: 采用平均场方法，将有限宽度网络视为无限宽度极限的近似，推导编码器和解码器的确定性学习动力学，并用随机梯度下降训练。
Result: 有限时间水平内有限宽度网络的实证风险以高概率跟踪平均场风险轨迹；在最优性下，有限宽度风险收敛到平均场最优。
Conclusion: 有限宽度网络足以表达无限宽度解，为非线性瓶颈自编码器提供了理论基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Three-Ring Architecture: Governing Agents in the Era of On-Platform Organisations
papers.abstract_en: The current phase of enterprise AI deployment faces a structural failure: organisations are acquiring agentic capability without the infrastructure to govern it. The result is expected to reproduce the error of the first wave of AI deployment: decentralised intelligence without a federation layer leading to a 95% project failure rate. This paper formalises the Three-Ring Architecture as the governing infrastructure of the on-platform organisation. Ring 1 is the existing production architecture; Ring 2 is the M2 federation layer built on strategies-based agentic AI; Ring 3 is the LLM-based frontier intelligence layer. Ring 2 constitutes, in the technically exact sense, the operating system of the agentic enterprise - performing at the organisational level what a computing OS performs at the device level: resource abstraction, process coordination, permission enforcement, and a stable platform for compounding intelligence. A central contribution is the formal distinction between Ring 2 and Ring 3 risk profiles. Strategies-based agents operate within a deterministic framework: their consequences are traceable, their permissions enforceable, their deviations recoverable. LLM-based agents introduce a categorically distinct risk: a non-deterministic actor whose deviations propagate through complex organisational systems without retrospective traceability. Ring 2 is not a useful addition - it is a necessary condition of control and compliance. A further consequence: every improvement in LLM capability is a structural tailwind for this architecture. More capable non-deterministic actors produce larger consequences when they deviate. The governance requirement scales with capability. The architecture has been validated across a decade of deployment in financial services, government, procurement, and compliance among other sectors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了三层架构作为平台型组织中智能体治理的基础设施：第一层是现有生产架构，第二层是基于策略的代理AI的M2联邦层，第三层是基于LLM的前沿智能层。第二层在技术上构成代理企业的操作系统，并严格区分了第二层与第三层的风险特征。该架构已在金融服务、政府、采购和合规等领域经过十年部署验证。
Motivation: 当前企业AI部署面临结构性失败，组织获得了代理能力却没有治理基础设施，预计将重复第一波AI部署的错误，即去中心化智能缺乏联邦层，导致95%的项目失败率。
Method: 形式化定义了三层架构：Ring 1（现有生产架构）、Ring 2（基于策略的代理AI的M2联邦层）、Ring 3（基于LLM的前沿智能层）。Ring 2作为代理企业的操作系统，执行资源抽象、进程协调、权限执行和复合智能的稳定平台。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值，但指出该架构已在金融服务、政府、采购和合规等领域经过十年部署验证，并强调Ring 2是控制与合规的必要条件，LLM能力的每次提升都会因为偏差产生更大后果，治理需求随能力扩展。
Conclusion: Ring 2不是有用的附加组件，而是控制与合规的必要条件；LLM能力提升是架构的结构性顺风，但非确定性行为者的偏差会在复杂组织系统中传播而无追溯性。

summary_sections.motivation: 当前企业AI部署面临结构性失败，组织获得了代理能力却没有治理基础设施，预计将重复第一波AI部署的错误，即去中心化智能缺乏联邦层，导致95%的项目失败率。
summary_sections.method: 形式化定义了三层架构：Ring 1（现有生产架构）、Ring 2（基于策略的代理AI的M2联邦层）、Ring 3（基于LLM的前沿智能层）。Ring 2作为代理企业的操作系统，执行资源抽象、进程协调、权限执行和复合智能的稳定平台。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值，但指出该架构已在金融服务、政府、采购和合规等领域经过十年部署验证，并强调Ring 2是控制与合规的必要条件，LLM能力的每次提升都会因为偏差产生更大后果，治理需求随能力扩展。
summary_sections.conclusion: Ring 2不是有用的附加组件，而是控制与合规的必要条件；LLM能力提升是架构的结构性顺风，但非确定性行为者的偏差会在复杂组织系统中传播而无追溯性。

papers.title: Native3D: End-to-End 3D Scene Generation via Unified Mesh-Texture Modeling and Semantic Alignment
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents Native3D, the first end-to-end 3D scene generation framework that completely bypasses 2D intermediate representations. Traditional approaches typically require adapting 3D representations to the 2D domain to leverage pre-trained diffusion models, which inevitably introduces domain adaptation issues including geometric structural distortion and texture detail degradation. To address these limitations, we design a unified mesh-texture joint representation that simultaneously models both geometric structures and texture features through a Transformer-based scene encoder, effectively maintaining spatial relationships and visual consistency among objects within scenes. We further propose the 3D Representation Alignment Loss (3D REPA Loss), which employs an improved contrastive learning mechanism to align multi-level semantic representations in the latent space, significantly enhancing geometric and textural fidelity. Experimental results demonstrate that Native3D outperforms existing methods in both generation quality and editing flexibility, providing a novel solution for 3D scene editing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Native3D，第一个完全绕过 2D 中间表示的端到端 3D 场景生成框架。通过设计统一的网格-纹理联合表示（mesh-texture joint representation），由 Transformer 场景编码器同时建模几何结构和纹理特征，并引入 3D 表示对齐损失（3D REPA Loss）以对比学习对齐多级语义表示。实验表明该方法在生成质量和编辑灵活性上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 传统 3D 场景生成方法通常需要将 3D 表示适应到 2D 域以利用预训练扩散模型，但引入几何结构扭曲和纹理细节退化等域适应问题。
Method: 设计统一的网格-纹理联合表示，通过 Transformer 场景编码器同时建模几何和纹理；提出 3D REPA Loss，采用改进的对比学习机制在潜空间中对齐多级语义表示。
Result: 摘要报告 Native3D 在生成质量和编辑灵活性上优于现有方法，为 3D 场景编辑提供了新方案。
Conclusion: Native3D 是首个完全绕过 2D 中间表示的端到端 3D 场景生成框架，有效保持场景内物体的空间关系和视觉一致性。

papers.title: OffQ: Taming Structured Outliers in LLM Quantization by Offsetting
papers.abstract_en: Low-bit quantization has been widely adopted to accelerate the inference of large language models (LLMs) by significantly reducing computational cost and memory usage. However, activation outliers pose a major challenge to effective quantization, often leading to notable performance degradation. In this paper, we introduce OffQ, a method designed to mitigate activation outliers in low-bit quantization through a novel offsetting mechanism. Specifically, OffQ first identifies a low-dimensional outlier subspace in the activations using a proposed top-1 PCA, and then concentrates high-magnitude activations into 1 channel via rotation. OffQ then absorbs this concentrated outlier channel by converting its magnitude into a shared offset, thereby reducing the standard deviation of the activations. This offsetting strategy enables effective W4A4KV4 quantization of LLMs using deployment-friendly uniform-grid and uniform-precision quantization. Extensive experiments across diverse LLM architectures and benchmarks demonstrate that OffQ outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, consistently improving model accuracy while preserving low-bit efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: OffQ提出一种偏移机制来消除大语言模型低比特量化中的激活异常值。该方法通过top-1 PCA识别低维异常子空间，利用旋转将高幅激活集中到单个通道，然后将其转换为共享偏移量以降低激活标准差，从而实现部署友好的W4A4KV4均匀网格量化。实验表明OffQ在多种LLM架构和基准上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 低比特量化中激活异常值导致精度严重下降，现有方法难以在不牺牲效率的情况下有效处理。
Method: 先通过top-1 PCA找出激活中的低维异常子空间，再通过旋转将高幅值集中到一个通道，最后将该通道的值吸收为共享偏移量，从而均匀化激活分布。
Result: 在W4A4KV4量化条件下，OffQ在多种LLM和基准上一致优于SOTA，保持了低比特效率同时提升了模型精度。
Conclusion: OffQ通过简单的偏移机制有效缓解了激活异常值问题，为实用化低比特LLM量化提供了新思路。

papers.title: 3DMorph: Single-Image-Guided Local 3D Shape Editing and Morphing
papers.abstract_en: Despite recent progress in 3D generation, intuitive editing of existing shapes remains limited. Unlike images, which benefit from well-established inpainting tools, general 3D objects such as meshes still lack simple and effective methods for local shape editing. Existing approaches are often global, domain-specific, require complex user interaction, or focus on appearance (color and texture) rather than geometry. We introduce 3DMorph, a training-free framework for single-image-guided local 3D shape editing and morphing. Given an edited image showing a desired shape modification, our method automatically localizes the relevant 3D region and transfers 2D modifications to 3D while preserving unmodified areas. 3DMorph also enables intermediate shape generation between the original and edited objects, facilitating design exploration. To benchmark editing quality, we introduce Delta3D, an image-guided local 3D editing benchmark with paired ground-truth edits. Experimental results show that 3DMorph translates intuitive 2D edits into 3D, outperforming state-of-the-art generative and editing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 3DMorph，一种无需训练的单图像引导局部 3D 形状编辑与变形框架。通过将编辑后的图像中的 2D 修改自动定位并迁移到 3D 区域，同时保持未修改区域不变，该方法还能生成介于原始和编辑对象之间的中间形状，支持设计探索。同时引入 Delta3D 基准测试，实验表明 3DMorph 优于当前最先进的生成与编辑方法。
Motivation: 现有 3D 形状编辑方法通常局限于全局编辑、需复杂交互或仅关注外观而非几何，缺乏简单有效的局部形状编辑工具。
Method: 提出无需训练的框架，基于单张编辑图像自动定位相关 3D 区域，将 2D 修改迁移至 3D，并保持未修改区域不变，同时支持中间形状生成。
Result: 在 Delta3D 基准上，3DMorph 将直观的 2D 编辑有效转化为 3D 修改，优于当前最先进的生成与编辑方法。
Conclusion: 3DMorph 为 3D 形状局部编辑提供了一种简单、无需训练且有效的解决方案，但评估仅限于几何编辑，未涉及纹理或更复杂的编辑场景。

papers.title: DIFFRACT: Neuralized Utility Maximization for Wireless Networks by Differentiable Programming
papers.abstract_en: Next-generation wireless networks, including satellite-to-Open RAN systems, demand agile and intelligent resource management capable of handling dynamic multi-user interference under stochastic quality of service constraints. This paper introduces DIFFRACT, a neuralized utility maximization framework that leverages differentiable programming to integrate deep learning with optimization in wireless networks. Central to our approach is the exploitation of the mathematical structure of standard interference functions, which are foundational in wireless power control. By developing a duality theory for these functions, we map iterative interference management algorithms into differentiable neural network architectures via algorithm unrolling. This enables distributed, end-to-end gradient-based learning at the network edge, supporting real-time adaptation to interference in both terrestrial and non-terrestrial environments. DIFFRACT allows for scalable and robust utility maximization by modeling complex channel dynamics and leveraging the expressiveness of differentiable models. Experimental results confirm the framework's theoretical soundness and practical effectiveness for next-generation wireless systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DIFFRACT 是一个神经化效用最大化框架，利用可微编程将无线网络中的干扰管理算法展开为可微神经网络架构，实现分布式端到端梯度学习。实验验证了其在下一代无线系统中的理论正确性和实际有效性。
Motivation: 下一代无线网络（包括卫星到 Open RAN 系统）需要敏捷智能的资源管理，以处理随机服务质量约束下的动态多用户干扰。
Method: 基于标准干扰函数的数学结构，发展对偶理论，通过算法展开将迭代干扰管理算法映射为可微神经网络架构，支持分布式端到端梯度学习。
Result: 实验验证了框架的理论正确性和实际有效性，适用于下一代无线系统。
Conclusion: DIFFRACT 通过可微编程实现了可扩展且鲁棒的效用最大化，能够实时适应地面及非地面环境中的干扰。

papers.title: Beyond Post-hoc Explanation: Toward Glassbox AI via Probabilistic Mediation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are rapidly becoming infrastructural components in high-stakes institutional settings, including public administration, legal reasoning, and healthcare, where opacity is not merely inconvenient but institutionally and legally untenable. Existing approaches to explainability are predominantly post-hoc, offering unstable, non-contestable accounts that have no formal relationship to the reasoning process that produced the output. We argue that the problem is not the absence of explanation but the absence of structured reasoning in the first place. This paper makes the case for a fundamentally different architecture, which we call the Glassbox Framework, in which Bayesian networks serve as transparent, ante-hoc mediation layers for generative models. Bayesian networks encode domain knowledge, causal assumptions, and probabilistic dependencies before inference occurs, enabling auditable reasoning traces, uncertainty quantification, and contestable outputs. We characterise the architecture of this framework and ground it in a benefit eligibility scenario, identifying the foundational challenges spanning semantic alignment, dynamic model construction, probabilistic grounding, and human governance that must be solved to realise it at scale. By shifting from post-hoc explanation to ante-hoc probabilistic mediation, this work outlines a principled path toward AI systems that are not only powerful but fundamentally accountable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文批判了事后解释（post-hoc explanation）的不稳定性，提出基于贝叶斯网络的“玻璃箱框架”（Glassbox Framework），作为生成模型的透明前事中介层。在福利资格判断场景中展示了框架潜力，并指出语义对齐、动态模型构建等规模化挑战。核心主张是从事后解释转向事前概率中介，以实现可问责的AI系统。
Motivation: 现有解释方法多为事后解释，与模型内部推理过程无形式关联，不稳健且不可质疑。在高风险制度场景（公共行政、法律、医疗）中，不透明性在制度和法律上不可接受。
Method: 提出Glassbox Framework，使用贝叶斯网络作为生成模型的透明前事（ante-hoc）中介层。在推理之前编码领域知识、因果假设和概率依赖，从而产生可审计的推理轨迹、不确定性量化和可争议输出。
Result: 在福利资格判断场景中进行了架构描述，识别了语义对齐、动态模型构建、概率基础、人类治理四大基础挑战，未报告具体实验数值。
Conclusion: 论文主张从事后解释转向事前概率中介是构建强大且可问责AI系统的原则性路径，但强调规模化仍需解决多个基础挑战。

papers.title: DyCon: Dynamic Reasoning Control via Evolving Difficulty Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) demonstrate remarkable performance improvements by iteratively reflecting, exploring, and executing complex tasks, yet suffer from inefficiencies due to redundant reasoning, known as "overthinking". Existing methods to mitigate this issue either rely on static difficulty estimates or require task-specific training, and thus fail to adapt to the dynamic complexity during reasoning. In this work, we empirically show that the problem difficulty evolves dynamically throughout the reasoning process and is linearly encoded in the LRM's step-level embeddings. Building on this insight, we propose DyCon, a training-free framework that leverages latent step-level representations to explicitly model the evolving task difficulty, enabling the dynamic control of reasoning depth to mitigate the overthinking issue. Extensive experiments conducted on four models ranging from 4B to 32B, and across twelve benchmarks in math reasoning, general question answering, and coding tasks demonstrate that DyCon significantly enhances reasoning efficiency by reducing redundant steps without sacrificing accuracy or generalization. Project page and code are available at https://github.com/yu-lin-li/DyCon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型推理模型（LRM）中的过度思考问题，提出DyCon框架，通过利用潜在步骤级别表示显式建模任务难度的动态演变，实现推理深度的动态控制。实验在4B至32B的四个模型和十二个基准上表明，DyCon在不牺牲准确率或泛化能力的情况下显著提高推理效率。
Motivation: 现有缓解过度思考的方法依赖静态难度估计或需要任务特定训练，无法适应推理过程中动态变化的复杂度。
Method: 提出无训练框架DyCon，利用LRM的步骤级别嵌入线性编码的难度信息，动态建模任务难度演变，并据此控制推理深度。
Result: 在四个模型和十二个基准（涵盖数学推理、通用问答和编程任务）上，DyCon减少了冗余推理步骤，同时保持准确率和泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过显式建模动态难度可以有效缓解过度思考问题，提升推理效率。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调通过显式建模动态难度可以有效缓解过度思考问题，提升推理效率。

papers.title: GP-Adapter: Gaussian Process CLIP-Adapter for Few-Shot Out-of-Distribution Detection
papers.abstract_en: We propose GP-Adapter, a training-free framework that augments CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training) with Gaussian Process (GP) uncertainty modeling for few-shot classification and out-of-distribution (OOD) detection. While CLIP achieves strong zero-shot recognition, it yields deterministic similarity scores and offers limited uncertainty information, which is critical under distribution shift and data scarcity. GP-Adapter constructs modality-specific, class-wise one-class GPs on top of frozen CLIP embeddings using an RBF kernel for image features and a linear kernel for text prompts and fuses their predictive statistics to produce a variance-aware confidence score for OOD detection. The method requires no fine-tuning of the CLIP backbone and relies only on a small $K$-shot cache and lightweight hyperparameter selection, with memory cost scaling as $O(CK^2)$ for $C$ classes and $K$ shots. Experiments on ImageNet and multiple OOD benchmarks show that GP-Adapter provides competitive few-shot performance and consistently improves OOD detection when combined with prompt-learning baselines, highlighting the complementarity between GP-based uncertainty modeling and prompt learning. Overall, our results suggest that integrating probabilistic inference with large pre-trained vision-language models can improve reliability in low-data and distribution-shifted settings. Code is available at https://github.com/tms-byte/GP-Adapter
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GP-Adapter，一种无需训练的框架，通过高斯过程（GP）不确定性建模增强 CLIP 模型，用于少样本分类和分布外（OOD）检测。方法在冻结的 CLIP 嵌入上构建模态特定、类别的单类 GP，融合图像和文本特征的预测统计以生成方差感知的置信度分数。在 ImageNet 和多个 OOD 基准上，GP-Adapter 在少样本性能上具有竞争力，并能持续提升与提示学习基线结合时的 OOD 检测效果。
Motivation: CLIP 在零样本识别上表现优异，但输出为确定性相似度分数，缺乏不确定性信息，在分布偏移和数据稀缺场景下可靠性不足。
Method: 在冻结的 CLIP 嵌入上构建图像特征（RBF 核）和文本提示（线性核）的类级单类 GP，融合两者的预测统计（均值与方差）得到方差感知的置信度分数用于 OOD 检测；无需微调 CLIP 骨干，仅依赖少量 K-shot 缓存和轻量超参数选择。
Result: 在 ImageNet 和多个 OOD 基准上，GP-Adapter 在少样本设置下具有竞争力的分类性能，并与提示学习基线结合时一致提升 OOD 检测效果。
Conclusion: 结合概率推断与大规模预训练视觉-语言模型（如 CLIP）能够在低数据和分布偏移场景下提升可靠性；GP 不确定性建模与提示学习具有互补性。

papers.title: LARA: Latent Action Representation Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Visual-language action (VLA) models enable robots to predict actions directly from observations and language instructions, but their performance depends on large-scale, high-quality data and is limited by the scarcity of real-world robot action datasets. To facilitate VLA model learning with abundant unlabeled human videos, Latent Action Models (LAM) learn latent action representations from visual dynamics to provide additional supervision for VLA learning. However, LAM and VLA are typically trained separately, leaving LAM ungrounded during VLA training and VLA models constrained by frozen LAM representations. To address these issues, we propose Latent Action Representation Alignment (LARA), a plug-and-play framework that jointly optimizes LAM and VLA via representation alignment. This enables reciprocal benefits where LAMs learn with action trajectories to avoid spurious visual changes, while VLAs are regularized by forward dynamics learned within LAMs to reduce hallucinations of functionally ineffective trajectories. We demonstrate LARA versatility and effectiveness for pre-training, post-training enhancement of pre-trained VLA models, and LAM refinement, achieving an average of ~10%, ~5%, and ~15% improvement over 3 simulation and 1 meticulously designed real-world robotic manipulation benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LARA（Latent Action Representation Alignment），一个即插即用的框架，通过表示对齐联合优化 Latent Action Model（LAM）和 Vision-Language-Action Model（VLA），使两者互为受益：LAM 借助动作轨迹避免虚假视觉变化，VLA 借助 LAM 的前向动力学减少功能无效轨迹的幻觉。在 3 个仿真和 1 个真实机器人操控基准上，LARA 在预训练、后训练增强和 LAM 精调三种场景下分别取得约 10%、5% 和 15% 的平均性能提升。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型依赖大规模高质量机器人动作数据集，而真实数据稀缺；Latent Action Model（LAM）可从无标注人类视频学习潜在动作表示，但 LAM 与 VLA 通常分开训练，导致 LAM 在 VLA 训练中未接地、VLA 受冻结 LAM 表示限制。
Method: 提出 LARA，一个即插即用的表示对齐框架，联合优化 LAM 和 VLA，通过表示对齐使两者相互正则化：LAM 学习动作轨迹以去除虚假视觉变化，VLA 利用 LAM 的前向动力学损失来减少功能无效轨迹的幻觉。
Result: 在 3 个仿真和 1 个真实机器人操控基准上，LARA 在预训练、后训练增强和 LAM 精调三种设置下分别平均提升约 10%、5% 和 15%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 LARA 作为一种通用框架，能够有效提升 VLA 模型性能，同时精调 LAM，避免独立训练的局限性。

papers.title: SigmaScale: LLM Compression with SVD-based Low-Rank Decomposition and Learned Scaling Matrices
papers.abstract_en: We present SigmaScale, a method for learning auxiliary scaling matrices $S$ to aid truncated Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) based Large Language Model (LLM) compression. Instead of deriving scaling matrices analytically, SigmaScale optimizes two sets of vectors that define diagonal row and column scaling transformations under an activation-aware compression loss. We show that learned scaling lowers the effective intrinsic rank of weight matrices, as reflected by reductions in effective-rank entropy, and that this reduction is strongly correlated with compression loss. Experiments on Llama 3.1 8B Instruct and Qwen3-8B show that SigmaScale is competitive with closely related state-of-the-art SVD-based compression methods across perplexity and zero-shot benchmarks. By using learned activation-aware transformations, SigmaScale explores a more flexible route to low-rank LLM compression by adapting to the structure of individual model weights. The advantage observed in specific tasks makes our approach a valid option for applications requiring a reduced LLM-inference computing cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SigmaScale，一种通过学习辅助缩放矩阵 $S$ 来改进基于截断奇异值分解（SVD）的大语言模型（LLM）压缩的方法。该方法优化两组向量，定义对角行和列缩放变换，使用激活感知的压缩损失进行训练。实验表明，学习缩放降低了权重矩阵的有效本征秩，且与压缩损失强相关。在 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 和 Qwen3-8B 上的实验显示，SigmaScale 在困惑度和零样本基准上与现有最先进 SVD 压缩方法竞争力相当。该方法通过激活感知变换探索了更灵活的低秩 LLM 压缩路径。
Motivation: 现有基于 SVD 的 LLM 压缩方法通常使用解析推导的缩放矩阵，可能无法充分适应模型权重的结构，限制了压缩效果。
Method: SigmaScale 学习两组向量定义对角行和列缩放变换，并在激活感知压缩损失下优化这些向量，以辅助截断 SVD 压缩。
Result: 在 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct 和 Qwen3-8B 上，SigmaScale 在困惑度和零样本基准上与最先进的 SVD 压缩方法竞争力相当，且学习缩放有效降低了权重矩阵的有效本征秩。
Conclusion: SigmaScale 通过学习激活感知的缩放矩阵，提供了一种比传统解析推导更灵活的低秩 LLM 压缩方法，适用于需要降低推理计算成本的应用场景。

papers.title: MetaConfigurator: AI-Assisted RDF Authoring from JSON Data
papers.abstract_en: Scientific workflows increasingly generate structured JSON data that is easy to exchange but difficult to interpret consistently across systems due to lacking semantic interoperability. While JSON Schema ensures structural validation, it provides no native support for Linked Data semantics. This paper presents an RDF Authoring View extending the open-source JSON Schema editor MetaConfigurator, enabling researchers to transform existing JSON, YAML, or CSV data into RDF using AI-assisted RML mappings, refine triples, execute SPARQL queries, visualize knowledge graphs, and export RDF serializations within a single integrated web interface. This workflow is supported by ontology-aware IRI auto-completion, bidirectional synchronization between JSON-LD text views and RDF triple tables, and AI-assisted SPARQL query generation from natural language hints. We demonstrate the workflow using laboratory data from metal-organic framework (MOF) synthesis experiments. Protocol data describing reagents, procedure steps, and quantities is converted from JSON to ontology-based JSON-LD via RML mappings. We then refine the semantic representation, query relationships between experimental conditions and outcomes, and explore the resulting knowledge graph interactively. This integrated environment bridges conventional structured data management with Semantic Web technologies while preserving experimental context and lowering technical barriers through AI assistance.
papers.comment: Submitted as post-proceedings for the deRSE26 conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个在开源JSON Schema编辑器MetaConfigurator中扩展的RDF创作视图，支持研究者使用AI辅助的RML映射将JSON/YAML/CSV数据转换为RDF，并在统一Web界面中精炼三元组、执行SPARQL查询、可视化知识图谱及导出RDF序列化。通过金属有机框架(MOF)合成实验数据演示工作流。
Motivation: 科学工作流产生的结构化JSON数据缺乏语义互操作性，JSON Schema仅保证结构验证而不支持Linked Data语义，需要一种工具桥接结构化数据管理与语义网技术。
Method: 在MetaConfigurator中扩展RDF Authoring View，提供本体感知的IRI自动补全、JSON-LD文本视图与RDF三元组表的双向同步、以及从自然语言提示生成SPARQL查询的AI辅助功能。
Result: 摘要报告使用MOF合成实验数据演示了从JSON到基于本体的JSON-LD的转换，并通过RML映射、精炼表示、查询和交互式知识图谱探索。
Conclusion: 该集成环境通过AI辅助降低了技术门槛，在保留实验上下文的同时桥接了结构化数据管理与语义网技术。

papers.title: The discovery of the effects of women employment participation on the fertility of developing countries: A panel data approach
papers.abstract_en: The fertility trend in developing countries has experienced a significant decline in the last few decades; at the same time, the role of women in the workplace has improved. To have a better insight of the causality of the rate of women participation in the labor market on the total fertility rate in developing world, this paper divides the dataset of 115 developing countries in the period of 1991-2018 into four continents group (Africa, North/South America, Asia/Pacific, Europe) and then applies a data-driven panel data econometric procedure to mitigate omitted bias. The results suggest that the fertility behaviors of women in the North/South America continents are influenced by their career choice; meanwhile in society of other regions, other factors might be more important to women when thinking of having children. In conclusion, policymakers can reference to the paper and formulate policies to have more incentives in making reproductive decisions and further research in the field needs to consider family policies and patrilocality of developing countries as important data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文采用面板数据计量方法，将115个发展中国家按四大洲分组（非洲、北美/南美、亚太、欧洲），分析1991-2018年间妇女劳动参与率对总生育率的影响。结果表明，仅在北美/南美地区，妇女的生育行为显著受职业选择影响；其他地区则受其他因素主导。结论建议政策制定者关注家庭政策和从夫居等文化因素。
Motivation: 发展中国家生育率持续下降，而妇女职场角色提升，但两者间的因果关系尚不明确。现有研究可能遗漏关键变量，需更严谨的因果推断。
Method: 采用数据驱动的面板数据计量方法，将115个发展中国家按四大洲分组，以缓解遗漏变量偏误。
Result: 发现北美/南美地区妇女劳动参与率显著负向影响生育率；其他地区则无显著影响，提示其他因素（如家庭政策、从夫居）更为关键。
Conclusion: 政策制定者应参考该结果制定鼓励生育的激励政策；未来研究需将家庭政策和从夫居等文化因素纳入重要变量。

papers.title: Detecting Temporally Localized Manipulations in Authentic Video Streams
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of video editing and generative artificial intelligence technologies has made realistic video manipulation increasingly accessible. Although existing datasets have significantly advanced research in deepfake detection, object removal, and video inpainting, they do not adequately model scenarios in which a short manipulated segment is inserted into an otherwise authentic video and the original video continues afterward. In this study, we review representative datasets from the literature, analyze their characteristics, and discuss their limitations with respect to temporally localized realistic manipulation detection. Based on this analysis, we motivate the need for a new dataset specifically designed for authentic videos containing short and highly realistic manipulated intervals. Finally, we evaluate two complementary approaches on our custom-curated test set to establish an initial benchmark for this challenging scenario. The first employs a linear probe on DINOv3 features, assessed under three thresholding strategies. The second leverages DINOv3 features with a consecutive frame similarity-based method to detect temporal manipulation boundaries. Together, these experiments provide an initial benchmark for partially manipulated video detection and highlight the need for content-adaptive thresholding mechanisms. The dataset, code, and supplementary materials are publicly available at https://github.com/OkanUmur/temporally-localized-video-manipulation-detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出现有视频操作检测数据集未能模拟“短操作片段插入真实视频后原视频继续播放”的场景，为此构建了一个专注于时间局部化、高真实感操作检测的新数据集，并评估了两种互补方法（DINOv3线性探测和连续帧相似性方法）作为初始基准。
Motivation: 现有的deepfake检测、物体移除和视频修复数据集没有充分建模真实视频中插入短操作片段且后续内容不变的情况，导致该场景的检测方法缺乏针对性评估。
Method: 作者首先回顾并分析了代表性数据集的局限性，然后自建测试集，评估两种方法：1) 在DINOv3特征上使用线性探测（三种阈值策略）；2) 基于DINOv3特征的连续帧相似性方法检测时间操作边界。
Result: 实验提供了部分操作视频检测的初始基准，并表明需要内容自适应的阈值机制。数据集、代码和补充材料已公开。
Conclusion: 当前方法在检测短时时间局部化操作上仍有局限，未来需发展更精细的自适应阈值策略。

papers.title: Residual-Controlled Multiplier Learning for Stochastic Constrained Decision-Making
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic constrained decision-making requires optimizing performance objectives while enforcing statistical requirements such as safety or fairness. However, standard primal--dual methods struggle to update multipliers robustly under stochastic mini-batch feedback, as the noise of mini-batch gradients and constraint estimates can be directly accumulated into the multiplier memory. To address this issue, we propose Residual-Controlled Multiplier Learning (RCML), which reformulates multiplier updating as projected-pressure feedback. The central idea is to decompose the projected multiplier into an effective pressure signal for primal descent and a pressure-memory residual for finite-gain multiplier tracking. To handle heterogeneous and noisy observations, we further augment this residual-integral backbone with modular stochastic stabilization components. For the convex-affine backbone, we establish finite-gain convergence, derive a stochastic residual bound under mini-batch feedback, and show that the residual feedback law admits a local KKT-residual interpretation near regular KKT points of nonconvex problems. Experiments across optimization, allocation, and fair-ranking tasks show that RCML improves feasibility control and multiplier stability while maintaining competitive objective performance. Code is available here.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对随机约束决策问题中标准原始-对偶方法因小批量噪声导致乘子更新不稳定的问题，提出残差控制乘子学习（RCML）。该方法将乘子更新重构为投影压力反馈，通过将投影乘子分解为有效压力信号和压力记忆残差，并引入模块化随机稳定化组件来处理异构有噪声观测。在凸仿射骨干下证明有限增益收敛，并导出小批量反馈下的随机残差界。实验在优化、分配和公平排序任务上表明RCML改善了可行性控制和乘子稳定性，同时保持目标性能。
Motivation: 标准原始-对偶方法在随机小批量反馈下，小批量梯度和约束估计的噪声会直接累积到乘子记忆中，导致乘子更新不稳健。
Method: 提出残差控制乘子学习（RCML），将投影乘子分解为有效压力信号用于原始下降，以及压力记忆残差用于有限增益乘子跟踪；并增加模块化随机稳定化组件以处理异构有噪声观测。
Result: 在凸仿射骨干下建立了有限增益收敛性，给出了小批量反馈下的随机残差界。实验在优化、分配和公平排序任务上显示RCML改善了可行性控制和乘子稳定性，同时保持竞争性目标性能。
Conclusion: RCML提供了一种稳健的乘子更新方法，在非凸问题的正则KKT点附近，残差反馈律具有局部KKT残差解释。

papers.title: An Adaptive Data cleaning Framework for Noisy Label Detection
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks (DNNs) excel in computer vision tasks given large annotated datasets. In real-world applications, however, labels are often corrupted by ambiguity, human error, or dynamic environments. Over-parameterized DNNs easily memorize these noisy labels during training, degrading model accuracy and generalization. Existing data-cleaning and sample-selection strategies often rely on manually specified thresholds, prior knowledge of the noise ratio, or a single metric (either learning dynamics or geometric structure), making them unstable in complex data regimes. This paper proposes a self-adaptive data-cleaning framework that integrates local, global, and learning dynamics cues for robust noisy-label detection. Samples are mapped into a unified low-dimensional feature space through a modular feature concatenation paradigm. We provide two instantiations: a 2D metric integrating class-adaptive KNN-based local disagreement with k-means-based global centroid distance, and a 3D multi-metric that additionally incorporates a z-normalized score. Unlike conventional 1D Gaussian Mixture Models applied to a single scalar metric, our framework performs multi-metric clustering on the feature space to adaptively partition samples into clean-dominant and noise-dominant components without requiring manual thresholds or noise priors. Experiments on CIFAR-10, MNIST, and ImageNet-100 with 5% to 40% symmetric label noise show high recall across settings, including near-perfect recall (>=98%) on ImageNet-100 at 40% noise. Subsequent training yields accuracy gains across evaluated settings, especially under severe corruption on ImageNet-100. These findings suggest that multi-metric integration provides a threshold-free, practical, and low-tuning strategy for noisy label detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度神经网络训练中标签噪声难以检测的问题，提出一种自适应的数据清理框架，融合局部、全局和学习动态线索，通过多度量聚类在特征空间中自适应划分干净样本和噪声样本，无需人工设定阈值或噪声先验。在CIFAR-10、MNIST和ImageNet-100上，在5%至40%对称标签噪声下实现了高召回率，尤其在ImageNet-100上40%噪声时召回率接近完美（>=98%）。
Motivation: 现有数据清理方法依赖人工阈值、噪声率先验或单一度量（学习动态或几何结构），在复杂数据场景下不稳定。
Method: 提出自适应的多度量数据清理框架：将样本映射到统一的低维特征空间，通过模块化特征拼接整合局部（类自适应KNN）、全局（k-means质心距离）和学习动态（z归一化分数）线索，并在特征空间上进行多度量聚类以自适应划分干净和噪声成分。
Result: 在CIFAR-10、MNIST和ImageNet-100上，5%至40%对称噪声下召回率高，ImageNet-100在40%噪声时召回率>=98%；后续训练准确率提升，尤其在严重噪声下。
Conclusion: 多度量集成提供了一种无需阈值、低调参的实用噪声标签检测策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the Geometry of On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) is increasingly used to improve large language model reasoning, but its training dynamics remain poorly understood. We characterize the trajectory of OPD updates in parameter space and compare it with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). A suite of parameter-space diagnostics consistently places OPD in a relaxed off-principal regime: compared with SFT, its updates affect fewer weights and avoid principal directions more strongly, while compared with RLVR, they remain less tightly constrained. Beyond this static localization, OPD exhibits subspace locking: its cumulative updates rapidly enter a narrow low-dimensional channel. Constraining training to the update subspace formed early in training preserves OPD performance but substantially degrades SFT, indicating that the locked subspace is functionally sufficient for OPD. Control experiments further show that sparsifying the update tokens and shifting rollout generation off-policy preserve the rank dynamics, whereas mixing the OPD objective with RLVR changes them. Overall, these results suggest that OPD is not merely an intermediate point between SFT and RLVR, but induces its own update geometry in parameter space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从参数空间几何角度刻画在线策略蒸馏（OPD）的训练动态，并与监督微调（SFT）和可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）进行对比。作者发现OPD的更新轨迹处于一个“松散的离主方向”区域：相比SFT，其更新影响更少的权重且更强烈地避开主方向；相比RLVR，其约束更宽松。此外，OPD表现出子空间锁定：累积更新快速进入一个狭窄的低维通道，且在该子空间内约束训练能保持OPD性能但严重损害SFT。消融实验表明，token稀疏化和移除外推策略保持秩动态，而混合RLVR目标会改变之。
Motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在提升大语言模型推理方面应用广泛，但其训练动态（特别是参数空间中的几何特性）尚不明确。
Method: 在参数空间中刻画OPD更新的轨迹，通过一系列诊断指标将其与SFT和RLVR进行对比；并利用子空间锁定现象分析OPD训练动态。
Result: OPD更新的参数空间几何与SFT和RLVR均不同，具有更稀疏的权重影响和更弱的约束；OPD的累积更新迅速进入一个低维子空间，且该子空间对OPD功能充分。
Conclusion: OPD并非介于SFT和RLVR之间的中间点，而是具有独特的参数空间更新几何。约束到该子空间可保持OPD性能。

papers.title: dots.tts Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: We present dots.tts, a 2B-parameter continuous autoregressive text-to-speech (TTS) foundation model that models speech in a continuous latent space. Compared with existing continuous autoregressive models, our key innovations are threefold. First, we train an AudioVAE with multiple objectives to build a semantically structured and prediction-friendly continuous speech space. Second, we use full-history conditioning in the flow-matching head to preserve long-range consistency and reduce drift during generation. Third, we apply reward-free self-corrective post-training to the flow-matching head to further improve robustness and acoustic quality. After being trained on a large-scale multilingual corpus, dots.tts achieves the best average performance on Seed-TTS-Eval, with WERs of 0.94%/1.30%/6.60% and SIM scores of 81.0/77.1/79.5 on the zh/en/zh-hard test sets, respectively. Across other benchmarks, dots.tts also consistently demonstrates open-source state-of-the-art performance, exhibiting strong generation stability, voice cloning ability, and emotional expressiveness. For efficient inference, we further apply CFG-aware MeanFlow distillation, enabling low-latency speech generation with first-packet latencies of 85/54 ms in output streaming and dual-streaming modes, respectively. To facilitate reproducible research and practical deployment, we release the training and inference code, together with the pretrained, post-trained, and MeanFlow-distilled checkpoints, under the Apache 2.0 license.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: dots.tts 是一个 2B 参数的连续自回归文本转语音（TTS）基础模型，在连续潜在空间中建模语音。其关键创新包括：多目标训练 AudioVAE 以构建语义结构化和预测友好的连续语音空间；在流匹配头中使用全历史条件以保持长程一致性并减少生成漂移；对流匹配头应用无奖励自我纠正后训练以提升鲁棒性和声学质量。在大型多语言语料库上训练后，dots.tts 在 Seed-TTS-Eval 上取得最优平均性能，在中文/英文/中文困难测试集上的词错误率（WER）分别为 0.94%/1.30%/6.60%，说话人相似度（SIM）分别为 81.0/77.1/79.5。进一步通过 CFG 感知的 MeanFlow 蒸馏实现低延迟语音生成，输出流式和双流模式下的首包延迟分别为 85/54 毫秒。代码和检查点以 Apache 2.0 许可证开源。
Motivation: 现有连续自回归 TTS 模型在语音表示和生成长序列时存在结构不完善和漂移问题，需要更一致的潜在空间和生成策略。
Method: 提出三个创新：1）多目标训练 AudioVAE 构建语义结构化的连续语音空间；2）流匹配头中采用全历史条件以保持长程一致性；3）无奖励自我纠正后训练提升流匹配头的鲁棒性和声学质量。此外，应用 CFG 感知的 MeanFlow 蒸馏实现高效推理。
Result: 在 Seed-TTS-Eval 上，中文/英文/中文困难测试集 WER 分别为 0.94%/1.30%/6.60%，SIM 分别为 81.0/77.1/79.5。输出流式和双流式下首包延迟分别为 85/54 毫秒。在其他基准上一致达到开源 SOTA。
Conclusion: dots.tts 在生成稳定性、语音克隆能力和情感表现力上表现强劲，并通过开源代码和检查点促进可复现研究和实用部署。

papers.title: AsyncPatch Diffusion: spatially-flexible image generation
papers.abstract_en: Standard diffusion models corrupt an entire sample with a single shared noise level, forcing all spatial regions to follow the same denoising trajectory. We introduce AsyncPatch Diffusion, a joint-diffusion framework that assigns distinct noise levels to different input dimensions, such as image pixels, or latent tokens. We show how this asynchronous corruption defines a valid generative process while supporting a richer family of spatially heterogeneous denoising trajectories, and prove the first valid ELBO for this process. We show that a single pretrained model can perform spatially adaptive generation, where different regions are denoised on different schedules. A key challenge is training: naive independent noise-level sampling overemphasizes highly heterogeneous configurations and underrepresents homogeneous noise levels, that are crucial during sampling. We address this with a controlled noise-level sampler that regulates both the average corruption level and its spatial variability. AsyncPatch achieves generation quality comparable to conventional diffusion on ImageNet 256 and LSUN, while being natively suited for inpainting without task-specific fine-tuning. We further introduce input guidance, which uses clean or partially corrupted regions to guide the generation of unknown regions, improving local consistency and texture matching. Finally, we demonstrate adaptive generation strategies including uncertainty-guided acceleration and autoregressive sampling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AsyncPatch Diffusion，一种允许不同图像区域使用不同噪声水平的联合扩散框架，从而支持空间异质的去噪轨迹。证明了该过程的变分下界（ELBO），并设计了受控噪声水平采样器以平衡异构与同构配置。在ImageNet 256和LSUN上达到与标准扩散模型相当的质量，并天然适用于图像修复（inpainting），无需任务特定微调。还引入了输入引导和自适应生成策略。
Motivation: 标准扩散模型对所有空间区域使用相同的噪声水平，限制了去噪轨迹的灵活性，无法高效处理空间异质任务（如修复）。
Method: 提出异步补丁扩散，为不同像素或潜在令牌分配独立噪声水平，形成一个有效的生成过程；推导了首个有效的ELBO。通过在训练中使用受控噪声水平采样器来调节平均噪声水平和空间变异性，避免了对异构配置的过度强调。
Result: 在ImageNet 256和LSUN上，生成质量与标准扩散模型相当；无需微调即可进行图像修复，并优于现有方法。输入引导提高了局部一致性和纹理匹配。
Conclusion: 异步噪声框架为空间自适应生成提供了理论保证和实用方法，未来可探索更复杂的调度策略。

papers.title: SlimSearcher: Training Efficiency-Aware Web Agents via Adaptive Reward Gating
papers.abstract_en: Deep research agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in complex information-seeking tasks, yet this power comes at a steep computational cost. Driven by accuracy-focused training paradigms, current models adopt brute-force strategies characterized by blind tool dependency and performative reasoning-generating long, redundant trajectories that are far from necessary for resolving these tasks, leading to wasteful tool calls and excessive token consumption. To overcome this efficiency trap, we propose SlimSearcher, a principled framework that pushes the Pareto frontier between accuracy and computational cost across both Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL). In the SFT stage, SlimSearcher employs Pareto-efficient filtration to distill trajectories that are both successful and economical, guiding the model toward inherently efficiency-aware search behaviors. During RL, we introduce Adaptive Reward Gating, a dynamic reward-shaping mechanism that evaluates relative tool and token efficiency within a sampled cohort. By cascading these adaptive efficiency metrics with a strict correctness gate, our approach effectively avoids the brevity bias associated with absolute penalties and mitigates reward hacking. Extensive experiments on long-horizon benchmarks, including GAIA, BrowseComp, and XBenchDeepSearch, demonstrate that SlimSearcher reduces average tool-call rounds by 17%-58% while maintaining or improving accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SlimSearcher框架，旨在提升Web智能体的训练效率，在监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）阶段分别引入Pareto高效过滤和自适应奖励门控（Adaptive Reward Gating），以平衡准确性与计算成本。在GAIA、BrowseComp和XBenchDeepSearch等长时程基准上，该方法将工具调用轮数减少17%-58%，同时保持或提升准确率。
Motivation: 当前深度研究智能体在复杂信息搜索任务中依赖暴力策略，导致冗余工具调用和过高令牌消耗，存在计算效率低下的问题。
Method: SFT阶段采用Pareto高效过滤，从成功且经济的轨迹中蒸馏；RL阶段引入自适应奖励门控，基于样本群组的工具和令牌效率动态调整奖励，并通过正确性门控避免奖励破解。
Result: 在GAIA、BrowseComp和XBenchDeepSearch基准上，平均工具调用轮数减少17%-58%，且准确率保持或改善。
Conclusion: SlimSearcher通过效率感知的训练范式，在准确性与计算成本之间实现了更优的帕累托前沿，有效缓解了冗余推理问题。

papers.title: Bias in Filter Feature Selection Evaluation: A Meta-Analysis of Datasets, Baselines, and Experimental Design Choices
papers.abstract_en: Background: Since 1990 many feature selection methods have been proposed across heterogeneous applications. To validate the usefulness of a new method, it needs to be compared against at least one baseline method from the existing literature on a feature selection task using at least one dataset. Recent developments in tabular Deep Learning (DL) and data valuation in Machine Learning (ML) suggest that the evaluation of new methods, algorithms, and models may be consciously or unconsciously biased. We hypothesise that a similar trend exists in feature selection (FS), particularly in filter feature selection (FFS). The aim of this study is therefore to examine FFS studies to identify factors that influence the evaluation and that might consist entry point for biases in order to recommend stronger principles for FFS evaluation. Methods: We analyse a sample of 28 high profile FFS studies published between 1994 and 2025. The analysis provides reflections on how to examine FFS studies, highlights lessons learned throughout the process, and gives five evidence-based recommendations for future FFS evaluation. Results: Multivariate Linear Regression analysis achieved a score of $R^2=0.33$. It means that 33% of the variance in the performance of new methods against chosen baselines (win rate) is explained by the number of datasets (#Datasets), the number of baselines (#Baselines), and the number of new methods (#NewMethods). Discussion: $R^2=0.33$ is considered medium explanation; which is promising given that this is the first such study. The medium explanation result is due to the fact that win rate is influenced by additional factors such as the maturity of the feature selection domain, the type of datasets and baselines, and the simplicity of the regression model used to explain the relationship.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文通过分析28篇高影响力过滤式特征选择（FFS）研究，使用多元线性回归发现33%的新方法胜率方差可由数据集数量、基线数量和新方法数量解释，并提出五项证据驱动的FFS评估改进建议。
Motivation: 特征选择评估中可能存在有意或无意的偏差，尤其是过滤式特征选择（FFS），但缺乏系统性研究来识别影响评估的因素。
Method: 抽取1994-2025年间28篇FFS研究，通过多元线性回归分析胜率与数据集数量、基线数量、新方法数量的关系。
Result: 多元线性回归R²=0.33，即33%的胜率方差可由三个变量解释；剩余方差归因于领域成熟度、数据集与基线类型、回归模型简单性等因素。
Conclusion: 这是首次系统量化FFS评估偏差的研究，表明实验设计选择（如数据集、基线数量）显著影响方法比较结果，需建立更严格的评估原则。

papers.title: Beyond Universality: The GCC-FER Dataset and Culture-Aware Adaptation for Dynamic Facial Expression Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic Facial Expression Recognition (DFER) is a key enabling technology in affective computing, human-computer interaction, and intelligent multimedia systems. Despite the significant influence of cultural nuances on FER performance, most existing FER systems assume that emotional expressions are universally consistent across populations. This variation can be attributed to systematic differences in facial muscle activation patterns across cultures. A major challenge in advancing cross-cultural FER lies in the scarcity of culturally diverse benchmark datasets. To address this, a new hybrid multicultural video dataset termed Global Cross-Cultural Facial Expression Recognition (GCC-FER) is introduced. GCC-FER comprises 23,934 video samples spanning four cultural groups (African, Caucasian, East Asian, and South Asian) across seven basic expressions, combining psychologically supervised in-house data collection for underrepresented populations with rigorous ethnicity filtering of existing sources. To the best of our knowledge, GCC-FER is the first large-scale global cross-cultural DFER dataset designed to address these demographic gaps. Leveraging this dataset, behaviorally grounded cultural priors are derived for each cultural group and a global prior for practical deployment. A Culture-Aware FER (CA-FER) system is proposed to mitigate cultural bias by adaptively recalibrating latent facial representations. Extensive experiments on GCC-FER and DFEW demonstrate that the proposed system consistently improves FER performance across multicultural settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对动态面部表情识别（DFER）中缺乏文化多样性数据集的问题，构建了包含23,934个视频样本的全球跨文化面部表情识别（GCC-FER）数据集，涵盖非洲、高加索、东亚和南亚四个文化群体及七种基本表情。基于该数据集，提出文化感知FER（CA-FER）系统，通过行为学文化先验自适应校准潜在面部表征以减轻文化偏见。实验表明CA-FER在GCC-FER和DFEW数据集上提升了跨文化设置的FER性能。
Motivation: 现有FER系统假设情感表达跨文化一致，忽略了文化差异对性能的影响，且缺乏文化多样性的基准数据集，限制了跨文化FER的发展。
Method: 构建GCC-FER数据集（23,934视频样本，四文化群体，七表情），从中提取行为学文化先验和全局先验；提出CA-FER系统，利用文化先验自适应重校准潜在面部表征以缓解文化偏差。
Result: 在GCC-FER和DFEW数据集上的实验表明，CA-FER系统在多文化设置下持续提升了FER性能。
Conclusion: 文化感知方法可有效缓解FER中的文化偏差，GCC-FER数据集为跨文化DFER研究提供了重要基准。

papers.title: Constructing VAE Latent Spaces with Prescribed Topology
papers.abstract_en: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) learn low-dimensional latent representations of high-dimensional data. When the data lies on a manifold with non-Euclidean topology, the standard Gaussian prior introduces a topological mismatch that degrades reconstruction quality and prevents faithful representation. We present a constructive mathematical framework that resolves this mismatch for all manifolds that admit a product covering space. These are manifolds expressible as products of elementary factors (circles, intervals, or lines) or as quotients of such products by a finite symmetry group. The class includes cylinders, tori, Möbius strips, Klein bottles, and real projective spaces. Factorized distributions over the elementary factors yield product topologies with closed-form, decoupled KL divergences, so that each latent factor can be shaped independently while keeping training tractable. We catalogue reparametrizable encoder-prior pairs for periodic, bounded, and unbounded supports, and provide coordinate transformations that allow standard neural networks to output non-Euclidean parameters with smooth gradients. For quotient manifolds, the decoder receives group-invariant features of the covering-space coordinates, so that identified points produce identical outputs. Anchor constraints fix the coordinate system relative to the data or create soft topological holes. Experiments on synthetic manifolds and real-image datasets (rotated and cyclically shifted MNIST) confirm that a topology-matched prior aligns KL regularization with the data manifold. The resulting topology-aware models outperform the Gaussian baseline at all practically relevant regularization strengths. The code is available at https://github.com/JvHulst/VAE-Topology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对变分自编码器(VAE)中标准高斯先验与数据流形拓扑不匹配导致重建质量下降的问题，提出一个构造性数学框架，适用于所有具有乘积覆盖空间的流形（如圆柱、环面、莫比乌斯带、克莱因瓶、实射影空间）。通过因子化分布得到闭式解耦KL散度，使得每个潜在因子可独立塑造；同时提供可重参数化的编码器-先验对及坐标变换，允许标准神经网络输出非欧几里得参数。在合成流形和旋转/循环移位MNIST数据集上，拓扑匹配先验在所有实际正则化强度下均优于高斯基线。
Motivation: 标准VAE使用高斯先验假设潜在空间为欧几里得拓扑，当数据位于非欧几里得流形（如环面或莫比乌斯带）时会产生拓扑不匹配，导致重建质量下降和表示不忠实。
Method: 提出一个构造性框架，针对所有具有乘积覆盖空间的流形，将潜在空间分解为基本因子（圆、区间或直线）的乘积或其有限对称群商空间。采用因子化分布得到闭式解耦KL散度，并设计可重参数化的编码器-先验对，通过坐标变换使神经网络输出非欧几里得参数。对于商流形，解码器接收覆盖空间坐标的群不变特征以保证等价点输出一致。
Result: 在合成流形和真实图像数据集（旋转/循环移位MNIST）上，拓扑匹配先验在所有实际正则化强度下均优于高斯基线，KL正则化与数据流形对齐。
Conclusion: 拓扑感知的VAE模型通过显式匹配潜在空间与数据流形拓扑，在广泛的正则化强度下提升了重建质量和表示忠实性，且KL散度保持闭式可解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TRACE: Trajectory Reasoning through Adaptive Cross-Step Evidence Aggregation for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous LLM agents can pursue hidden malicious objectives through sequences of individually benign actions, making sabotage difficult to detect using standard trajectory-level monitoring. Existing approaches either evaluate complete trajectories in a single pass or partition them into independently scored windows, limiting their ability to connect evidence across temporally distant actions. We propose TRACE, a monitoring framework for long-horizon LLM agent trajectories. TRACE operates through a TIJ (Triage-Inspect-Judge) loop that identifies high-signal regions, performs targeted inspection while maintaining accumulated evidence across reasoning steps, and synthesizes a trajectory-level verdict. We evaluate TRACE on ten task domains from SHADE-Arena against state-of-the-art baselines. TRACE achieves an aggregate F1 of 0.713 and recall of 0.844, with the largest gains on tasks requiring long-range evidence linking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE 是一种针对长周期 LLM 智能体轨迹的监控框架，通过 TIJ（分诊-检查-判断）循环聚合跨步骤证据，检测隐藏的恶意目标。在 SHADE-Arena 十个任务域上，TRACE 达到 0.713 的 F1 和 0.844 的召回率，尤其在需要长距离证据关联的任务上提升显著。
Motivation: 现有方法将完整轨迹一次性评估或分割为独立窗口，难以连接时间上分散的证据，导致隐藏恶意行为难以检测。
Method: 提出 TRACE 框架，采用 TIJ 循环：识别高信号区域，在积累证据的同时进行针对性检查，最后合成轨迹级判决。
Result: 在 SHADE-Arena 十个任务域上，TRACE 的聚合 F1 为 0.713，召回率为 0.844，长距离证据关联任务上增益最大。
Conclusion: TRACE 能有效检测需要跨步证据关联的隐蔽恶意行为，但摘要未讨论局限性。

papers.title: TrioPose: Native Triple-Stream Diffusion Transformers for Pose-Guided Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Pose-guided text-to-image generation often suffers from limb distortions and feature crosstalk in complex multi-person scenarios. While existing UNet-based adapters struggle with long-range spatial dependencies, emerging Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) offer superior global modeling. However, naive signal concatenation in MM-DiTs severely disrupts pre-trained latent distributions. To address this, we propose TrioPose, a native pose-driven framework built upon the SD3.5M architecture. Specifically, we introduce a Triple-Stream Pose-Aware DiT (TSPA-DiT) that treats pose as an independent modality. It employs layer-wise activation and zero-initialized dual-residual injection to smoothly enforce geometric constraints while preserving pre-trained latent stability. To resolve severe multi-instance occlusions, we design a Learnable Relational Bias Mask that categorizes topological connectivity into fine-grained physical states, mapping them into continuous attention soft constraints to effectively decouple inter-instance interference. Furthermore, a Pose-Guided Spatial Loss Weighting strategy modulates the native diffusion objective using heatmap-derived error maps, focusing anatomical supervision strictly on distortion-prone regions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TrioPose achieves state-of-the-art performance across challenging benchmarks, including Human-Art, CrowdPose, and OCHuman. Notably, it attains an AP of $64.33$ on Human-Art, representing a $30\%$ improvement over prior arts, while setting new standards for visual fidelity and text-image semantic alignment in complex multi-human generation.

papers.title: Front-to-Attractors: Modifying the Front-to-Front Heuristic in Bidirectional Search
papers.abstract_en: Heuristics play a central role in the performance of bidirectional search algorithms, which commonly rely on two main classes. Front-to-end (F2E) heuristics estimate the distance from a state s to the target of the search (the goal for forward search or the start for backward search). In contrast, front-to-front (F2F) heuristics estimate the distance from s to the opposite search frontier using a pairwise function h(s, s'), where s' ranges over frontier states. Although F2F heuristics are typically more informative and therefore reduce the number of node expansions, their reliance on extensive pairwise evaluations incurs substantial computational overhead. To address this limitation, we introduce a new heuristic class, front-to-attractors (F2A), that preserves much of the informativeness of F2F while dramatically reducing its computational cost. Rather than evaluating distances to all states on the opposite frontier, F2A estimates the distance from s to a small, dynamically maintained set of attractors in the opposite search direction. These attractors serve as a surrogate for the full frontier, enabling rich heuristic guidance at a fraction of the computational expense while maintaining the optimality guarantees offered by F2F. We evaluate F2A across multiple domains and show that it reduces the number of pairwise evaluations by up to 11.2x compared to F2F, while achieving 4.8x fewer node expansions than F2E on average.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出前向-吸引子（Front-to-Attractors, F2A）启发式类，用于双向搜索。F2A 通过维护一个小型动态吸引子集替代完整前沿，在保持最优性的同时大幅降低计算开销。实验表明，与前端-前端（F2F）相比，F2A 将成对评估次数减少最多 11.2 倍，且平均节点扩展数比前端-末端（F2E）少 4.8 倍。
Motivation: 双向搜索中，前端-前端（F2F）启发式虽信息丰富但计算开销大，因为需要评估当前状态与对面前沿所有状态的距离。本文旨在保留 F2F 信息量的同时降低其计算成本。
Method: 引入前向-吸引子（F2A）启发式类：不是评估到对面前沿所有状态的距离，而是估计到一个小型动态维护的吸引子集的距离，该吸引子集作为完整前沿的代理，保持最优性保证。
Result: 在多个领域上的实验显示，F2A 相比 F2F 将成对评估次数减少最多 11.2 倍，相比 F2E 平均减少 4.8 倍节点扩展。
Conclusion: F2A 是一种有效的启发式方法，在保持最优性的同时显著减少计算开销，适用于双向搜索。

papers.title: Hierarchical Forecast Reconciliation for Urban Rail Transit Demand Prediction under Operational Disruptions
papers.abstract_en: Accurate and coherent passenger demand forecasting is essential for Urban Rail Transit (URT) operations. Passenger demand has a hierarchical structure in which origin-destination (OD) flows aggregate to station-level inflows and outflows through conservation constraints. In practice, station-level and OD-level forecasts are often generated independently, producing incoherent predictions that violate these constraints and introduce inconsistencies into operational decision-making. Such issues become more severe during disruptions, when forecasting reliability is most critical. This paper presents the first hierarchical forecast reconciliation framework for joint station-level and OD-level URT demand prediction. A neural Fully Connected Reconciler (FCR) learns a non-linear mapping from incoherent base forecasts to coherent hierarchical predictions while guaranteeing exact structural consistency by construction. The method is benchmarked against OLS, WLS, and Minimum Trace (MinT) variants using Rejsekort smart-card data from the Copenhagen S-train network under one-step, multi-step, and disruption forecasting scenarios. Results show that reconciliation consistently improves OD forecasting accuracy while ensuring hierarchical coherence. Under normal conditions, FCR performs competitively with MinT-based methods. An oracle analysis indicates that perfect station-level forecasts could reduce OD prediction error by up to 34 percent, highlighting the value of improved base forecasts. Under severe disruptions, FCR outperforms classical methods, reducing OD forecasting error by up to 17.45 percent in multi-step destination-side delay scenarios. These findings establish hierarchical reconciliation as an effective mechanism for improving forecast robustness, with the largest benefits occurring under the most challenging operating conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了首个用于城市轨道交通（URT）需求预测的层次协调框架，通过神经全连接协调器（FCR）学习从非一致基预测到一致层次预测的非线性映射，保证结构一致性。在哥本哈根S-train网络数据上，基于一步、多步和中断场景进行评估，结果显示协调持续提高OD预测准确性，在严重中断下FCR优于经典方法，最高减少17.45%的OD预测误差。
Motivation: 现有方法中，站点级和OD级预测通常独立生成，导致预测不一致，违反守恒约束，在运营中断时问题更严重。需要一种能保证结构一致性的协调框架。
Method: 提出神经全连接协调器（FCR），学习非一致基预测到一致层次预测的非线性映射，通过构造保证精确的结构一致性。与OLS、WLS、MinT等基准方法对比。
Result: 在正常条件下，FCR与MinT方法表现相当；在严重中断下，FCR优于经典方法，多步目标侧延迟场景下OD预测误差降低17.45%。完美站点级预测可将OD误差降低34%。
Conclusion: 层次协调是提高预测鲁棒性的有效机制，在最具挑战性的运营条件下收益最大。

papers.title: STREAM: Stochastic Riemannian Flow Matching with Anisotropic Decoder for Digital Histopathology Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic histopathology image generation addresses critical challenges in computational pathology, including patient privacy and the growing need for large-scale training data for foundation models. Latent diffusion models have dominated the image generation domain, with recent works emphasizing that the choice of latent space is critical to the quality of generated images. Existing state-of-the-art generative models in histopathology use pretrained Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) as conditioning signals, and we observe that this leads to "conditioning collapse," where the conditioning signal dominates the latent space and lowers the quality and diversity of generated samples. Therefore, we instead use pretrained histopathology VFMs as the latent space itself, leveraging their patch-token features that encode rich semantic information. We empirically show that these features are $\ell_2$-normalized and lie on the unit hypersphere $\mathcal{S}^{d-1}$ with strong angular dominance and intrinsic curvature, making them naturally suited for a Riemannian formulation. We therefore present STREAM, the first framework to apply Riemannian flow matching in the pathology domain. STREAM consists of two stages: 1) a bridge-type stochastic perturbation that establishes per-token rectifiability on $\mathcal{S}^{d-1}$ for training a Diffusion Transformer (DiT) in latent space, and 2) a novel anisotropic decoder that allocates robustness to low-energy directions of the velocity-field Jacobian while preserving fidelity along its high-energy directions. Together, STREAM achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction and generation performance on breast and colorectal cancer datasets. The code will be publicly released upon acceptance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对组织病理学图像生成中条件信号主导潜空间导致多样性和质量下降的问题，提出STREAM框架。该框架将预训练的组织病理学视觉基础模型作为潜空间，利用其patch-token特征（位于单位超球面上），采用黎曼流匹配(Riemannian flow matching)生成图像。由两个阶段组成：桥式随机扰动建立每个token在超球面上的可整流性，以及各向异性解码器在保持高能方向保真度的同时增强低能方向的鲁棒性。在乳腺癌和结直肠癌数据集上达到最佳重建和生成性能。
Motivation: 现有组织病理学图像生成方法使用预训练视觉基础模型作为条件信号会导致“条件崩溃”，即条件信号主导潜空间，降低生成样本的质量和多样性。作者观察到这些特征位于单位超球面上，适合黎曼流形建模。
Method: 提出STREAM，包含两个阶段：1）桥式随机扰动，在超球面上建立每个token的可整流性，用于训练潜空间中的扩散Transformer(DiT)；2）各向异性解码器，对速度场雅可比的低能方向分配鲁棒性，同时保持高能方向的保真度。
Result: 在乳腺癌和结直肠癌数据集上实现了最先进的重建和生成性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调STREAM是第一个在病理学领域应用黎曼流匹配的框架，通过利用超球面潜空间和各向异性解码器解决了条件崩溃问题。

papers.title: ForensicConcept: Transferable Forensic Concepts for AIGI Detection
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated image detectors achieve high accuracy on in-distribution data but often fail on unseen generators. A key obstacle to understanding this failure is the black-box nature of current detectors: they do not reveal which evidence drives their decisions. We propose ForensicConcept, a framework that extracts explicit forensic concepts from detectors and enables their transfer across backbones. Our method localizes decision-critical patches via Transformer attribution, clusters them into a compact concept codebook, and uses a concept-aligned projection to produce auditable evidence readouts. Motivated by prior studies showing that DINO representations can guide diffusion generation and exhibit concept-level correspondence with diffusion features, we introduce a generation-trace reference based on CleanDIFT diffusion features and quantify backbone-trace alignment via neighborhood-structure consistency (CKNNA). We further propose concept codebook injection to transfer diffusion-derived concepts into target backbones. Experiments on GenImage, GAN-family, and Chameleon benchmarks show consistent improvements over prior methods. We also find that CKNNA alignment predicts transfer effectiveness, providing a principled explanation for why some backbones yield more transferable forensic evidence than others.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ForensicConcept框架，用于从AI生成图像检测器中提取显式取证概念（forensic concepts）并实现跨骨干网络迁移。通过Transformer归因定位关键决策区域、聚类为紧凑概念码本、以及概念对齐投影，生成可审计的证据。利用CleanDIFT扩散特征作为生成痕迹参考，通过邻域结构一致性（CKNNA）量化骨干痕迹对齐度，并提出概念码本注入将扩散模型概念迁移至目标骨干。在GenImage、GAN族和Chameleon基准上取得一致改进。
Motivation: 当前AI生成图像检测器在分布内数据上准确率高，但对未见生成器泛化失败，且缺乏可解释性——无法揭示驱动决策的证据。
Method: 提取显式取证概念：首先通过Transformer归因定位决策关键补丁，聚类为紧凑概念码本；然后使用概念对齐投影产生可审计证据；引入CleanDIFT扩散特征作为生成痕迹参考，用邻域结构一致性（CKNNA）量化骨干痕迹对齐度，并通过概念码本注入实现跨骨干迁移。

papers.title: Hierarchical Semantic-Constrained Heterogeneous Graph for Audio-Visual Event Localization
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary audio-visual event localization (OV-AVEL) jointly models audio-visual cues to recognize and temporally localize events, including categories unseen during training. Existing methods primarily learn joint audio-visual representations in Euclidean space, but still face two significant challenges. First, the lack of supervision signals for unseen categories makes it difficult to maintain audio-visual consistency across multiple temporal scales. Second, the lack of hierarchical constraints between segment- and video-level semantics prevents the model from establishing semantic consistency across different levels. To address these challenges, we propose a hierarchical semantic constrained heterogeneous graph (HSCHG) for audio-visual event localization framework. We first construct a heterogeneous hierarchical graph in Euclidean space, which includes audio and visual segment nodes and their corresponding video-level nodes. We use multi-directional temporal edges to capture complete temporal information within each modality. Simultaneously, we employ a dual-threshold filtering gated fusion strategy, introducing cross-modal information only when the alignment confidence is high. Furthermore, we introduce bidirectional semantic constraints between segment- and video-level representations to achieve semantic consistency across different levels. Based on this, we map the multi-level audio-visual representations and text prototypes uniformly into hyperbolic space. We use a hierarchical entailment regularization loss to characterize the hierarchical relationships between videos and segments. Extensive experimental results show that our method outperforms existing methods on the OV-AVEL benchmark. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出分层语义约束异构图 (HSCHG) 框架，用于开放词汇音视频事件定位。通过构建异构图、双向语义约束和双曲空间层级正则化，在未见类别上也取得了优于现有方法的效果。
Motivation: 现有开放词汇音视频事件定位方法面临两个挑战：缺乏未见类别的监督信号，难以保持多时间尺度下的音视频一致性；缺乏片段级与视频级语义之间的分层约束。
Method: 构建包含音视频片段节点和视频级节点的异构图，利用多向时序边捕捉模态内完整时序信息，采用双阈值滤波门控融合策略仅在对齐置信度高时引入跨模态信息；引入双向语义约束实现跨层级语义一致性；将多级表示与文本原型映射到双曲空间，使用层级蕴含正则化损失刻画视频与片段间的层级关系。
Result: 在开放词汇音视频事件定位基准上超过现有方法，消融实验验证了各模块的有效性。
Conclusion: 该框架通过分层语义约束和双曲空间嵌入有效解决了开放词汇场景下音视频事件定位的语义一致性问题。

papers.title: Never Seen Before: Benchmarking Genuine Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval with Consistent Video-Sourced Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval (ZS-CIR) aims to retrieve a target image based on a query composed of a reference image and a relative caption without training samples. Existing ZS-CIR datasets often suffer from complete irrelevance between reference and target images due to noisy image sources, and do not achieve a true zero-shot scenario as they use public image datasets that models like CLIP have been trained on. To tackle these challenges, we introduce ZeroSight, a novel benchmark for ZS-CIR. It includes a dataset with consistent reference-target pairs sourced from videos, a data construction pipeline, and evaluation methods that consider the ranking of multiple positive and negative target images. We ensure visually and semantically consistent reference-target pairs by extracting frames from a single video and generating relative captions using LLM-assisted methods. To ensure a true zero-shot scenario, we use video data published after March 31, 2022, ensuring it was not included in CLIP's pre-training data. Additionally, we propose a training-free MLLM-driven method, SC4CIR (Symmetric Consistency for CIR), which can effectively identify hard negative targets through 3 symmetric consistency checks. This method is plug-and-play, seamlessly integrating with various CIR methods and significantly improving performance. Our experimental results from 27 methods reveal that current ZS-CIR datasets and evaluation metrics result in inflated retrieval performance, exaggerating the capabilities of CIR methods. Our benchmark and models can be accessed at https://github.com/sotayang/ZeroSight.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ZeroSight基准，用于真实零样本组合图像检索（ZS-CIR）。该基准包含从视频中提取的一致参考-目标图像对，使用2022年3月后发布的视频数据确保CLIP未预训练，并提出基于多模态大模型的无需训练方法SC4CIR，通过三种对称一致性检查识别难负样本。实验表明现有ZS-CIR数据集和评估指标导致检索性能被夸大。
Motivation: 现有ZS-CIR数据集存在参考与目标图像完全无关的问题，且使用CLIP已训练过的公共图像数据集，无法实现真正的零样本场景。
Method: 构建从视频中提取的参考-目标图像对数据集，利用LLM生成相对描述；提出训练无关的MLLM驱动方法SC4CIR，通过三种对称一致性检查识别难负样本。
Result: 对27种方法的实验表明，当前ZS-CIR数据集和评估指标导致检索性能被夸大，高估了CIR方法的能力。
Conclusion: ZeroSight提供了更真实的零样本CIR评估，SC4CIR可作为即插即用模块提升性能。

papers.title: CF-JEPA: Mask-free forward prediction with asymmetric encoder utilization for time-series representation learning
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) for time-series representation learning is dominated by two paradigms: contrastive methods, which face challenges in constructing positive or negative pairs, and masking-based methods, which disrupt the temporal continuity of time-series signals. Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) offers a promising alternative by predicting in representation space rather than reconstructing raw inputs. However, existing time-series JEPA variants still rely on masking and therefore inherit its continuity problem. Crop-based Forward JEPA (CF-JEPA) is proposed as an innovative mask-free framework that replaces masking with multi-horizon forward prediction: random crops serve as context views, and short-, mid-, and long-horizon future representations are predicted in the forward temporal direction, directly leveraging the inherent temporal ordering of time-series data as a learning signal. A strong asymmetry is also identified between the online encoder and the exponential moving average (EMA) target encoder, both produced from a single training run: the online encoder develops higher-rank discriminative features, while the EMA target encoder develops smoother, lower-rank temporal features. Exploiting this asymmetry, classification is routed to the online encoder and forecasting or anomaly detection to the EMA target encoder, achieving a 27% reduction in multivariate forecasting mean squared error (MSE) at no additional training cost. Across 126 University of California, Riverside (UCR) and 26 University of East Anglia (UEA) classification datasets, eight electricity transformer temperature forecasting benchmarks, and Key Performance Indicator /Yahoo anomaly detection, CF-JEPA achieves the highest average accuracy and rank on UCR and UEA among self-supervised baselines and ranks second on univariate forecasting and k-nearest neighbors-scored anomaly detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出CF-JEPA，一种无掩码的自监督时间序列表示学习框架。它用随机裁剪作为上下文视图，并预测短、中、长期未来表示，利用时间序列的时序顺序。在线编码器和EMA目标编码器之间存在不对称性：在线编码器学习高区分性特征，EMA编码器学习更平滑的低维时序特征。论文利用这种不对称性将分类路由到在线编码器，预测和异常检测路由到EMA编码器。在126个UCR和26个UEA分类数据集、8个变压器温度预测基准以及KPI/Yahoo异常检测上，CF-JEPA在自监督基线中取得了平均最高的UCR和UEA分类准确率和排名，并在单变量预测和k近邻异常检测中排名第二。
Motivation: 现有时间序列自监督学习方法（对比学习和掩码方法）存在构造正负样本对困难或破坏时间连续性的问题。JEPA虽能在表示空间预测，但仍依赖掩码，继承了连续性问题。
Method: 提出CF-JEPA，一种无掩码框架：用随机裁剪作为上下文视图，在时间正向方向预测短、中、长期未来表示。识别在线编码器与EMA目标编码器之间的不对称性，并根据任务类型分配编码器（分类用在线，预测/异常检测用EMA）。
Result: 在126个UCR和26个UEA分类数据集上，CF-JEPA在自监督基线中取得最高平均准确率和排名；在8个变压器温度预测基准上，多变量预测MSE降低27%；在KPI/Yahoo异常检测上，单变量预测和k近邻异常检测排名第二。
Conclusion: CF-JEPA通过无掩码的前向预测和不对称编码器利用，为时间序列表示学习提供了有效的自监督方案，无需额外训练成本即可提升下游任务性能。

papers.title: Phonetic Error Analysis of Raw Waveform Acoustic Models
papers.abstract_en: We analyse error patterns of raw waveform acoustic models on TIMIT phone recognition beyond the overall phone error rate (PER). PER is decomposed across three broad phonetic class (BPC) categorisations, and confusion matrices are constructed from substitution errors. Our models combine parametric (SincNet, Sinc2Net) or non-parametric CNNs with Bidirectional LSTMs, achieving 13.9%/15.3% PER on Dev/Test, the best reported results for raw waveform models on TIMIT. Transfer learning from WSJ reduces PER to 11.3%/12.3%, surpassing the Filterbank baseline. Per-BPC analysis reveals that BLSTM layers benefit transition-dependent classes most, while WSJ transfer learning improves consonants roughly three times more than vowels. Confusion patterns are consistent across raw waveform and Filterbank systems, indicating that the dominant confusions reflect inherent phonetic similarities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析了原始波形声学模型在TIMIT音素识别中的错误模式，超越整体音素错误率(PER)，将PER分解为三个宽泛音素类别(BPC)并构建混淆矩阵。模型结合参数化(SincNet, Sinc2Net)或非参数化CNN与双向LSTM，在TIMIT上达到原始波形模型的最佳报告结果(Dev/Test 13.9%/15.3%)，通过WSJ迁移学习进一步降至11.3%/12.3%，超过Filterbank基线。BPC分析表明BLSTM层对过渡依赖类最有利，WSJ迁移学习对辅音提升约为元音的三倍。
Motivation: 现有研究多关注整体PER，缺乏对原始波形声学模型在不同音素类别上错误模式的细致分析，无法深入理解模型行为与混淆来源。
Method: 使用参数化(SincNet, Sinc2Net)或非参数化CNN与双向LSTM结合的原始波形模型，并采用WSJ迁移学习；通过BPC分解和混淆矩阵分析错误模式。
Result: 模型在TIMIT上达到Dev/Test 13.9%/15.3% PER，为原始波形模型最佳结果；WSJ迁移学习将PER降至11.3%/12.3%，超过Filterbank基线。BLSTM层显著改善过渡依赖类，WSJ迁移学习对辅音提升是元音的三倍。
Conclusion: 原始波形与Filterbank系统的混淆模式一致，表明主要混淆源于固有语音相似性，而非前端特征差异。

papers.title: StainFlow: Entity-Stain Tracking and Evidence Linking for Process Rewards in GUI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become a promising approach for improving GUI Agents in long-horizon, stochastic digital environments, but trajectory-level success feedback is too sparse to provide reliable credit assignment for intermediate exploration steps. To mitigate this issue, recent studies introduce Process Reward Models (PRMs), which provide finer-grained training feedback through global milestone verification or local step-level evaluation. However, these methods still suffer from two level-specific limitations: global milestone decomposition is subjective and singular, making it difficult to accommodate the multiple valid execution paths in real GUI tasks, while fixed local judging windows may miss long-range key evidence or dilute the decision signal with irrelevant frames. Inspired by stain-tracing mechanisms in network flow analysis, we propose StainFlow, an entity-stain-flow process reward model for GUI Agents. To reduce the subjectivity of global partitioning, we introduce the Global Entity Stain Tracking module, which extracts visually verifiable task entities and tracks how their stain concentrations and states evolve along the trajectory, allowing task phases to be objectively separated by changes in the entity evidence flow. To improve the accuracy of local verification, we introduce the Local Stain Evidence Linking module. Centered on the triggering entities of each candidate key node, it retrieves relevant steps based on their stain concentrations and state changes, and dynamically constructs high-density evidence windows for verifying true key nodes. Extensive experiments on AndroidWorld and OGRBench show that StainFlow relatively improves online RL success by 3.2% and trajectory completion judgment accuracy by 1.8%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: StainFlow 是一种面向 GUI 智能体的过程奖励模型，通过实体-污渍追踪和证据链接机制，解决全局里程碑分解主观性和局部判断窗口视野有限的问题。在 AndroidWorld 和 OGRBench 上的实验表明，该方法相对提升了在线强化学习成功率 3.2% 和轨迹完成判断准确率 1.8%。
Motivation: 现有的过程奖励模型（PRM）在全局里程碑分解上主观且单一，难以适应 GUI 任务的多有效执行路径；而局部固定判断窗口可能遗漏长距离关键证据或引入无关帧稀释决策信号。
Method: 提出 StainFlow，包含全局实体污渍追踪模块（Global Entity Stain Tracking）和局部污渍证据链接模块（Local Stain Evidence Linking）。前者从轨迹中提取视觉可验证的任务实体，追踪其污渍浓度和状态变化，客观划分任务阶段；后者以候选关键节点的触发实体为中心，依据污渍浓度和状态变化检索相关步骤，动态构建高密度证据窗口以验证真正关键节点。
Result: 在 AndroidWorld 和 OGRBench 上，StainFlow 相对提升在线强化学习成功率 3.2%，轨迹完成判断准确率 1.8%。
Conclusion: StainFlow 通过实体-污渍追踪和证据链接，改善了 GUI 智能体过程奖励的全局分解客观性和局部验证准确性，但实验仅限于两个特定基准，未讨论跨领域泛化或计算开销。

summary_sections.result: 在 AndroidWorld 和 OGRBench 上，StainFlow 相对提升在线强化学习成功率 3.2%，轨迹完成判断准确率 1.8%。

papers.title: GuideCAD: A Lightweight Multimodal Framework for 3D CAD Model Generation via Prefix Embedding
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal approaches used for 3D CAD generation require substantial computational resources, necessitating efficient training. To address this, we propose GuideCAD, which leverages semantically rich visual-textual representations having only a small number of trainable parameters to generate 3D CAD models. Specifically, GuideCAD uses a mapping network that converts image embeddings into prefix embeddings, enabling a pretrained large language model to integrate visual and textual information. As a result, a transformer-based decoder predicts the construction sequence using the visual-textual embeddings in order to generate the 3D CAD model. For experimental evaluation, we construct a new dataset, referred to as GuideCAD, which consists of text-image pairs. Each pair includes a text prompt that represents a 3D CAD construction sequence and its corresponding 3D CAD image. Our experimental results show that GuideCAD generates comparably high-quality 3D CAD models while using approximately four times fewer parameters and achieving twice the training efficiency compared to fine-tuning approaches. We have released the source code and dataset for our method at: https://github.com/mskimS2/GuideCAD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GuideCAD，一种轻量级多模态框架，利用少量可训练参数通过前缀嵌入（prefix embedding）生成3D CAD模型。采用映射网络将图像嵌入转换为前缀嵌入，使预训练大语言模型融合视觉和文本信息，最后由Transformer解码器预测构造序列来生成3D CAD模型。在自建文本图像对数据集上实验表明，相比微调方法，GuideCAD参数减少约四倍，训练效率提升两倍，且生成模型质量相当。
Motivation: 现有的3D CAD生成多模态方法需要大量计算资源，训练效率低。论文旨在通过仅使用少量可训练参数实现高效的3D CAD模型生成。
Method: 提出GuideCAD框架，使用映射网络将图像嵌入转换为前缀嵌入，输入预训练大语言模型以融合视觉和文本信息；Transformer解码器根据视觉-文本嵌入预测构造序列，生成3D CAD模型。
Result: 实验结果显示，GuideCAD生成与微调方法相当质量的高质量3D CAD模型，但参数数量减少约四倍，训练效率提升两倍。
Conclusion: GuideCAD展示了利用少量可训练参数实现高效3D CAD生成的能力，并开源了代码和数据集。

papers.title: The Sim-to-Real Gap of Foundation Model Agents: A Unified MDP Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Foundation model agents are increasingly deployed for real-world decision-making, but suffer from the sim-to-real gap. While robotics and classical control have mature frameworks to address this gap, the foundation model community is treating agent robustness as an entirely novel phenomenon. Our paper proposes formalizing the foundation model agent evaluation and training gap as a classical sim-to-real problem structured entirely around the four elements of a Markov Decision Process, including Observation, Action, Transition, and Reward. In this paper, we set a comprehensive research agenda that translates classical discrepancies into the foundation model domain and advocates for adopting established solutions like domain randomization. We provide concrete examples, such as a multilingual tool calling to demonstrate how severe observation space gaps lead to operationally invalid actions despite correct semantic intent. Ultimately, this agenda aims to drive a paradigm shift, yielding a unified vocabulary and standardized stress test benchmarks to foster a new generation of highly trustworthy agents for reliable real-world applications.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted by KDD 2026 Blue Sky Ideas Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将基础模型智能体（foundation model agents）的仿真到现实差距（sim-to-real gap）形式化为一个经典的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）问题，围绕观察、动作、转移和奖励四个要素构建统一框架。文章呼吁采用域随机化（domain randomization）等已有解决方案，并通过多语言工具调用示例展示观察空间差距如何导致语义正确但操作无效的动作。该议程旨在推动范式转变，建立统一术语和标准化压力测试基准，以提升智能体在真实应用中的可信度。
Motivation: 现有研究将基础模型智能体的鲁棒性视为全新现象，而机器人学和经典控制已有成熟框架应对仿真到现实差距，本文旨在弥合这一认知鸿沟。
Method: 将智能体评估和训练中的差距形式化为MDP四要素（观察、动作、转移、奖励）上的经典仿真到现实问题，并倡导采用域随机化等已有解决方案。
Result: 通过多语言工具调用示例具体说明了观察空间差距如何导致语义正确但操作无效的动作，但未提供定量实验结果。
Conclusion: 旨在推动范式转变，为社区提供统一术语和标准化压力测试基准，从而构建更可靠的真实世界智能体。

papers.title: An Integrated Roadside Sensing and Communication Framework for Vulnerable Road User Safety at Signalized Intersections
papers.abstract_en: Vulnerable road users (VRUs) account for approximately half of urban traffic deaths globally, with intersections concentrating a disproportionate share of these casualties. Recent reviews of sensing technology for VRU protection have cataloged dozens of single-sensor and dual-sensor deployments, yet none of the surveyed systems couples multi-modal sensing with edge-side near-miss analytics and bidirectional vehicle-to-everything (V2X) and pedestrian-to-everything (P2X) messaging in a single intersection cabinet. This paper presents an integrated framework for VRU protection at signalized intersections, combining LiDAR, radar, RGB camera, and thermal camera at the perception layer, edge-based prediction and surrogate-safety analytics at the computation layer, V2X and P2X messaging at the communication layer, and adaptive signal control at the actuation layer. The framework is grounded in an empirical case study using R-LiViT, the first publicly released roadside LiDAR-Visual-Thermal dataset, which provides 200 multi-modal sequences and 2,400 annotated RGB-T frames at three German intersections. Analysis of 53,319 detection annotations reveals that VRUs comprise approximately 49% of all road-user observations, that day-to-night density drops by 38% for pedestrians and 45% for vehicles while the night distribution shows a higher close-proximity share, that per-frame close-proximity event counts vary approximately 10-fold across the eight unique locations at three intersections, and that 83% of pedestrian bounding boxes are small in image space, indicating that VRUs are typically far from any single sensor. These findings support multi-modal sensing, edge-side analytics, and adaptive context-sensitive deployment rather than uniform single-sensor solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个集成 LiDAR、雷达、RGB 相机和热成像相机的多模态感知框架，结合边缘端近碰撞分析和 V2X/P2X 通信，用于保护信号交叉口的易受伤道路使用者（VRUs）。基于 R-LiViT 数据集的分析表明，VRUs 占所有道路使用者观测的约 49%，夜间密度下降，且大多数行人边界框较小，支持多模态感知而非单一传感器方案。
Motivation: 现有 VRU 保护系统未将多模态感知与边缘端近碰撞分析和双向 V2X/P2X 通信集成于一个路口机柜中，导致保护不足。
Method: 提出一个四层框架：感知层（LiDAR、雷达、RGB 相机、热成像相机）、计算层（边缘端预测和代理安全分析）、通信层（V2X 和 P2X 消息）以及执行层（自适应信号控制）。基于公开数据集 R-LiViT 进行实证案例研究。
Result: 分析 53,319 个检测注释显示：VRUs 约占所有道路使用者的 49%；白天到夜间密度下降（行人 38%，车辆 45%）；近碰撞事件计数在不同位置变化约 10 倍；83% 的行人边界框在图像空间中小尺寸。
Conclusion: 多模态感知、边缘端分析和自适应上下文敏感部署比单一传感器方案更有效。
