papers.title: Towards Unified Song Generation and Singing Voice Conversion with Accompaniment Co-Generation
papers.abstract_en: While song generation and singing voice conversion (SVC) have evolved significantly, they have long been developed isolated: the former lacks zero-shot speaker cloning, while the latter overlooks vocal-accompaniment synergy. To bridge this gap, we propose UniSinger, the first end-to-end framework unifying speaker cloning song generation and accompaniment co-generation SVC. Building on the multimodal diffusion transformer, we construct a unified speaker embedding space transferring speaker representation from SVC to song generation, endowing fine-grained cross-task timbre control. To mitigate multi-task optimization conflicts, we design a curriculum learning strategy using task-specific modality masking to guide the model to gradually master the generative mechanisms among semantic content, vocal timbre, and accompaniment. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance on both tasks and realizes complementary benefits, offering new possibilities for intelligent music production.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UniSinger，首个统一说话人克隆歌曲生成与伴奏协同生成歌声转换（SVC）的端到端框架。基于多模态扩散Transformer，构建统一说话人嵌入空间，将说话人表示从SVC迁移至歌曲生成，实现跨任务音色控制。采用课程学习策略缓解多任务优化冲突。实验表明在两项任务上达到最优性能，并实现互补收益。
Motivation: 歌曲生成和歌声转换长期孤立发展：前者缺乏零样本说话人克隆，后者忽略人声与伴奏的协同。
Method: 构建基于多模态扩散Transformer的统一框架，设计统一的说话人嵌入空间以及任务特定的模态掩码课程学习策略。
Result: 两项任务均达到当前最优性能，且任务间存在互补收益。
Conclusion: 该框架首次统一了歌曲生成与歌声转换，为智能音乐制作提供新可能。

papers.title: A Geometric View for Understanding Concept Learning and Neuron Interpretation in Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: We propose a unified mathematical framework for a geometric understanding of concept learning and neuron interpretation in sparse autoencoders (SAEs). While SAEs improve interpretability of neural networks by learning sparse feature representations, a principled definition of ''concept'' and ''learning'' remains unclear. We formalize concepts as sets of data points and cast concept learning as a set-alignment problem between human-defined and model-induced concepts. This formulation distinguishes three increasingly strong notions of learning -- detection, separation, and approximation -- and yields geometric conditions, error bounds, and capacity constraints for when concepts can be represented by individual neurons or multi-neuron units. It also provides a set-theoretic account for common SAE phenomena, including feature splitting, feature absorption, feature families, and hierarchical concepts. Finally, we connect concept learning and neuron interpretation through formal concept analysis, showing that the two directions need not agree and that their many-to-many structure can be organized by concept lattices. Experiments on synthetic data with ReLU and Top-$K$ SAEs illustrate the theory and reveal the effects of SAE size and sparsity on concept learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的几何框架来理解稀疏自编码器（SAE）中的概念学习和神经元解释。将概念形式化为数据点集合，概念学习视为人类定义与模型诱导概念之间的集合对齐问题，区分了检测、分离和近似三种学习强度，并给出了几何条件、误差界和容量约束。还通过形式概念分析连接概念学习和神经元解释，实验使用ReLU和Top-K SAE在合成数据上验证。
Motivation: SAE虽然提高了可解释性，但缺乏对“概念”和“学习”的严格定义，需要一个统一的数学框架。
Method: 将概念定义为数据点集合，概念学习作为集合对齐问题，提出三种学习强度（检测、分离、近似），导出几何条件和容量约束，并通过形式概念分析建立概念学习与神经元解释的联系。
Result: 实验在合成数据上使用ReLU和Top-K SAE，揭示了SAE大小和稀疏性对概念学习的影响，并解释了特征分裂、吸收、族和层次概念等常见现象。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了理解SAE中概念学习和神经元解释的几何视角，但实验限于合成数据，未见真实数据验证。

papers.title: RASFT: Rollout-Adaptive Supervised Fine-Tuning for Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is a prevailing method for adapting large language models to reasoning tasks by imitating offline expert demonstrations, often treating a single expert trajectory as the target behavior. However, reasoning is not simple path imitation: rigidly following one demonstrated solution may overfit to surface forms and suppress the model's own reasoning distribution. We propose Rollout-Adaptive Supervised Fine-Tuning (RASFT), a policy-aware SFT framework that calibrates expert supervision according to problem-level solvability estimated from verified on-policy rollouts. For each problem, RASFT strengthens expert guidance when the current policy struggles, while relaxing rigid imitation and incorporating correct self-generated trajectories when the model already exhibits reliable reasoning behavior. To preserve useful reasoning priors, RASFT further introduces a clipped inverse ratio between the frozen reference model and the current policy to constrain excessive policy drift. Experiments across multiple models on six mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two code reasoning benchmarks show that RASFT achieves better overall performance than SFT, SFT variants, and representative RL methods. The code is available at https://github.com/zjd1sq/RASFT.

Motivation: 现有 SFT 通过模仿单一专家轨迹来适应推理任务，但推理不是简单路径模仿，严格跟随专家演示可能导致过拟合表面形式并抑制模型自身的推理分布。
Method: RASFT 利用验证的 on-policy rollouts 估计每个问题的可解性，据此校准专家监督。当策略困难时加强专家指导，当模型表现可靠时放松严格模仿并采纳正确的自生成轨迹。同时引入参考模型与当前策略的裁剪逆比例来防止过度策略漂移。
Result: 在多个模型上，RASFT 在 6 个数学推理基准和 2 个代码推理基准上取得比标准 SFT、SFT 变体及代表性 RL 方法更优的整体性能。
Conclusion: RASFT 通过自适应调整专家监督，在推理任务中有效平衡了模仿学习与策略自主性，显著提升了微调效果。

papers.title: DataEvolver: Automatic Data Preparation for Large Language Models through Multi-Level Self-Evolving
papers.abstract_en: High-quality training data is essential to large language models (LLMs) and typically requires extensive and costly manual curation. Existing automatic data preparation methods rely on predefined pipelines or customized human instructions, which limits their adaptability to diverse data distributions and lacks principled guidance from high-quality examples. In this paper, we introduce DataEvolver, the first self-evolving data preparation system that automatically constructs pipelines to transform raw data into high-quality data. DataEvolver employs a multi-level mechanism to ensure both pipeline executability and effectiveness. At the operator level, it incrementally expands the operator set to construct a logical plan while resolving dependency conflicts. At the pipeline level, it instantiates logical plans into executable code and iteratively refines pipeline orchestration through a feedback loop that reduces the distribution gap between prepared data and high-quality examples. Experiments on seven benchmarks show that DataEvolver substantially improves data quality and achieves an average 10\% gain in downstream LLM performance compared with training on original data, highlighting new opportunities for the iterative co-evolution of LLMs and data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DataEvolver，一个自进化的数据准备系统，能够自动构建管道将原始数据转化为高质量训练数据，用于大语言模型（LLM）。该系统通过多层级机制（操作符级和管道级）确保管道的可执行性和有效性，并利用反馈循环缩小准备数据与高质量示例之间的分布差异。实验表明，与原始数据训练相比，DataEvolver在七个基准上平均提升下游LLM性能10%，展现了LLM与数据迭代共进的新可能性。
Motivation: 高质量训练数据对LLM至关重要但手动整理成本高昂；现有自动方法依赖预定义管道或人工指令，缺乏对多样数据分布的适应性和高质量示例的引导。
Method: DataEvolver采用多层级自进化机制：操作符级逐步扩展操作符集并解决依赖冲突以构建逻辑计划；管道级将逻辑计划实例化为可执行代码，并通过反馈循环迭代优化管道编排，减少准备数据与高质量示例的分布差距。
Result: 在七个基准上，DataEvolver平均提升下游LLM性能10%（相比原始数据训练）。
Conclusion: DataEvolver是首个自进化的数据准备系统，LLM与数据可迭代共进化，但摘要未提及明确的局限性。

papers.title: Teaching the Way, Not the Answer: Privileged Tutoring Distillation for Multimodal Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Recent post-training methods, particularly Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), have significantly enhanced the reasoning ability of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). However, the sparse nature of verifiable rewards provides little token-level supervision for failed rollouts, often leading to inefficient exploration in complex multimodal reasoning tasks. Although policy distillation can offer dense guidance, external teacher based methods introduce substantial computational overhead, while answer conditioned tuning methods may expose answer-level information and induce shortcut-like generation behavior. To address these limitations, we propose PTD-PO, a Privileged Tutoring Distillation Policy Optimization framework for RLVR that provides dense guidance without exposing the answer to the student policy. Specifically, PTD-PO constructs structured privileged hints from spatial attention guidance and intermediate textual reasoning steps, and uses them through in-context learning to produce step-wise token-distribution supervision. The student is still optimized under the original answer-free context, and its failed rollouts are aligned with the hint-augmented reference model at the token-distribution level. To further stabilize distillation under the distribution shift between guided and unguided contexts, we introduce a Top-K Jensen-Shannon divergence objective that focuses alignment on informative token probabilities while reducing memory overhead. Experiments on LVLMs ranging from 2B to 8B parameters show that PTD-PO consistently outperforms RLVR and distillation baselines, mitigates entropy collapse, and improves complex multimodal reasoning performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PTD-PO框架，用于多模态策略优化中的特权辅导蒸馏。该方法通过构建结构化特权提示（空间注意力引导和中间推理步骤），在RLVR训练中提供密集的token级监督，而不向学生策略暴露答案。实验表明，在2B到8B参数的LVLM上，PTD-PO优于RLVR和蒸馏基线，缓解熵崩溃，提升复杂多模态推理性能。
Motivation: 现有RLVR方法在复杂多模态推理任务中因奖励稀疏导致探索效率低；外部教师蒸馏计算量大，而答案条件微调可能导致捷径式生成。
Method: PTD-PO框架：构建空间注意力引导和中间推理步骤的结构化特权提示，通过上下文学习产生逐步token分布监督；学生策略在无答案上下文中优化，其失败rollout与提示增强参考模型在token分布级别对齐；引入Top-K Jensen-Shannon散度目标稳定分布偏移下的蒸馏。
Result: 在2B-8B参数的LVLM上，PTD-PO一致优于RLVR和蒸馏基线，缓解熵崩溃，提升复杂多模态推理性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调PTD-PO通过特权提示提供密集监督而不暴露答案，有效提升了RLVR训练的效果。

papers.title: Don't Pause: Streaming Video-Language Synchrony for Online Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Online Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) have advanced toward seamless human-AI interaction through frame-by-frame processing and proactive responding. However, a critical challenge remains in streaming scenarios: existing models typically pause video perception while generating responses, breaking real-time video-language synchrony and causing stutters. To address this, we introduce a novel paradigm for online video understanding: Streaming Video-Language Synchrony (SVLS), and present LyraV, a live streaming assistant built upon a hierarchical control framework with two core innovations. First, the Frame-Driven Transition Controller (FDTC), a training-free verification-based finite-state machine, makes high-level semantic decisions on when to continue speaking, start a new response, or stay silent. Second, the Streaming Token Pacer (SToP), a plug-and-play lightweight predictive module, dynamically adapts the language generation rate to match the pace of the visual content. Concretely, LyraV performs \emph{per-frame incremental, sub-budget decoding}: within each frame interval it emits only a small chunk of tokens that fits the real-time budget, so perception is never blocked for a full sentence. Together, these components enable LyraV to seamlessly interleave incoming video frames with generated word tokens, achieving a fine-grained synchrony. Extensive experiments conducted on five online and three offline benchmarks demonstrate that LyraV preserves the backbone's general understanding ability while substantially improving streaming synchrony and narrative fluency, delivering a 98.29\% synchrony with video playback and a real-time processing speed of 3.89 FPS. Interestingly, we observe an empirical capability in LyraV: dynamic reasoning over streaming tokens, enabling continuous interpretation and "thinking" alongside visual input.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对在线视频理解中模型生成回答时暂停视频感知导致不同步的问题，提出流式视频-语言同步（SVLS）范式，并构建LyraV系统。通过帧驱动转换控制器（FDTC）和流式令牌节奏器（SToP）实现帧级增量解码，使得视频帧与生成令牌交错处理，达到细粒度同步。实验表明LyraV在不损失理解能力的前提下显著提升流式同步性和叙述流畅度，同步率达98.29%，实时处理速度3.89 FPS，并展现动态推理能力。
Motivation: 现有在线视频-语言模型在生成回答时会暂停视频感知，破坏了实时视频-语言同步，导致卡顿。
Method: 提出SVLS范式，并构建LyraV系统，包含两个核心组件：训练无需验证的有限状态机FDTC，用于高层语义决策；即插即用的轻量预测模块SToP，动态调整语言生成速率以匹配视觉内容速度。具体采用每帧增量、子预算解码，在每个帧间隔内只输出一小块令牌以适应实时预算。
Result: 在5个在线和3个离线基准测试中，LyraV保持骨干网络通用理解能力，大幅提升流式同步性和叙述流畅度，实现98.29%的视频播放同步率和3.89 FPS的实时处理速度，并展现动态推理能力。
Conclusion: 本文提出的方法和系统有效解决了在线视频理解中的同步问题，实现了细粒度的视频-语言同步，且具备动态推理能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Accelerating Reproducible Research in Synthetic EHR Generation
papers.abstract_en: The generation of high-fidelity synthetic Electronic Health Records (EHR) is crucial for advancing medical research while preserving patient privacy. However, head-to-head comparison of existing generative models is hindered by disjointed codebases, incompatible data loaders, conflicting library dependencies, and inconsistent evaluation protocols. To address these gaps, we introduce a lightweight, end-to-end benchmarking framework for reproducible synthetic EHR evaluation, organized as a unified pipeline spanning data ingestion, standardized model training, and architecture-agnostic evaluation. Our current implementation targets the generation of longitudinal ICD diagnosis codes -- the most commonly studied modality in this literature -- and is built on the community-maintained PyHealth library. We reimplement and unify strong baselines (MedGAN, CorGAN, PromptEHR, HALO) under full ICD-9 vocabulary granularity, and add a lightweight GPT-2 baseline from the general-purpose sequence-modeling literature. We contribute a rigorous, architecture-agnostic privacy-utility evaluation suite that applies identically to GAN- and transformer-based generators, and report bootstrapped confidence intervals across all metrics. We further analyze the poor long-tailed performance of existing models and discuss the extensibility of our framework beyond diagnosis codes. By lowering the engineering barrier to running, extending, and evaluating under a single pipeline, we introduce a starting point for community-driven reproducibility and benchmarking synthetic EHR models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个轻量级的端到端基准框架，用于可重复的合成电子健康记录（EHR）评估。该框架基于PyHealth库，统一了数据摄入、标准化模型训练和与架构无关的评估流程，并重新实现了多个基线模型（MedGAN、CorGAN、PromptEHR、HALO）以及GPT-2基线。框架提供了严格的隐私-效用评估套件和自助置信区间，并分析了现有模型在长尾分布上的不足。
Motivation: 现有合成EHR生成模型由于代码库不统一、数据加载器不兼容、依赖冲突和评估协议不一致，难以进行公平的对比。
Method: 构建了一个统一的端到端流水线，覆盖数据摄入、标准化模型训练和评估；基于PyHealth库重新实现了MedGAN、CorGAN、PromptEHR、HALO等强基线，并加入GPT-2基线；提供了架构无关的隐私-效用评估套件，并报告了所有指标的自助置信区间。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但指出分析了现有模型在长尾诊断代码生成上的性能不佳，并讨论了框架扩展到其他数据类型的可能性。
Conclusion: 通过降低工程门槛，该框架为社区驱动的可重复性和合成EHR模型的基准测试提供了一个起点。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Heterogeneous Effects of Green Finance on Urban Decarbonization: Evidence from 285 Cities in China
papers.abstract_en: While green finance has become a key instrument for low-carbon city transitions, its actual decarbonization effects and transmission mechanisms remain unclear. This study employs econometric models and machine learning-based analysis to examine whether and how green finance reduces city-level carbon intensity. Results show that green finance significantly lowers carbon intensity, with green bonds and green investment having the strongest impacts and evident spatial spillovers. The effects vary by development level, being most pronounced in Fourth- and Fifth-tier cities. Mediation analysis reveals that green finance operates mainly through energy structure optimization, followed by industrial upgrading, foreign direct investment, and technological innovation. SHAP analysis confirms substantial differences across financial instruments, with green bonds, funds, and credit contributing most to decarbonization. Moreover, the marginal impact is stronger in cities with low technological capacity, high industrial dependency, and coal-based energy mixes. These findings provide theoretical support and policy guidance for building a multi-level, regionally differentiated green finance system to promote inclusive low-carbon transitions. Keywords: Green Finance; Carbon Intensity; Decarbonization Effect; Machine Learning; City
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用计量模型和机器学习方法，基于中国285个城市的数据，考察绿色金融对城市碳强度的影响。结果显示绿色金融显著降低碳强度，其中绿色债券和绿色投资效果最强，且存在空间溢出效应。异质性分析表明效果在四五线城市最为显著，中介机制以能源结构优化为主。SHAP分析进一步揭示了不同金融工具的贡献差异。
Motivation: 绿色金融作为低碳城市转型的关键工具，其实际的脱碳效果和传导机制尚不明确，亟需实证研究。
Method: 采用计量经济模型结合机器学习（SHAP分析），对285个中国城市的面板数据进行回归分析、中介效应检验和异质性分析。
Result: 绿色金融显著降低城市碳强度，绿色债券和绿色投资效果最强，且存在空间溢出；效果在四五线城市最明显；能源结构优化是主要中介路径；SHAP分析显示绿色债券、基金和信贷贡献最大。
Conclusion: 研究表明需构建多层次、区域差异化的绿色金融体系以促进包容性低碳转型，但摘要未明确提及局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Accelerating Multi-Objective Bayesian Optimisation via Predictive-Gradient Catalysts
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a general acceleration mechanism for multi-objective Bayesian optimisation (MOBO) that leverages Gaussian process predictive gradients as auxiliary signals. Rather than replacing existing Pareto-compliant acquisition functions, the proposed approach augments them with local stationarity information derived from surrogate-derived gradients, enabling faster convergence toward the global Pareto set under limited evaluation budgets. Two catalyst instantiations are investigated: an adaptive Multiple-Gradient Descent Algorithm-Based Catalyst (MGDA) and a predefined-weight variant that enables focused exploration when budgets are tight. Experiments on the DTLZ benchmark suite (using 2 objectives and 10 decision variables) show that predictive gradient catalysis can deliver significant acceleration compared to other acquisition functions (EHVI, AugTch, tMPoI, SAF) when surrogates are accurate, particularly for stationary problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种通过高斯过程预测梯度作为辅助信号来加速多目标贝叶斯优化（MOBO）的通用机制。该方法不替换现有Pareto合规采集函数，而是利用代理导出的局部平稳性信息进行增强，从而在有限评估预算下更快收敛到全局Pareto集。在DTLZ基准套件（2目标10变量）上的实验表明，当代理模型准确时，预测梯度催化相比其他采集函数（EHVI、AugTch、tMPoI、SAF）能显著加速，尤其在平稳问题上。
Motivation: 多目标贝叶斯优化在昂贵评估下收敛速度慢，现有采集函数未充分利用代理模型的梯度信息来加速搜索。
Method: 提出了两种催化剂实例：自适应多梯度下降算法基础催化剂（MGDA）和预定义权重变体，通过向Pareto合规采集函数注入代理导出的局部平稳性信息来驱动更快收敛。
Result: 在DTLZ基准上，预测梯度催化在代理准确时显著优于EHVI、AugTch、tMPoI、SAF等采集函数，尤其对平稳问题加速效果明显。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一种通用加速机制，但依赖代理模型准确性，且仅在平稳问题上验证了有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DaX: Learning General Pathology Representations Across Scales
papers.abstract_en: Computational pathology requires visual representations that transfer across diverse clinical endpoints and remain robust to variation in magnification, staining, scanner type, slide preparation, and input resolution. We present DaX, a pathology vision foundation model that adapts DINOv3-style self-supervised learning to whole-slide histopathology. DaX is initialized from natural-image DINOv3 weights and incorporates continuous magnification training, cross-scale tissue views, orientation-agnostic and acquisition-robust augmentation, multi-input-size training, and Gram-anchored dense consistency. These designs aim to connect local cellular morphology with global tissue architecture while stabilizing dense token-level representations across input scales. We further construct a WSI-level benchmark comprising 161 clinically meaningful tasks from 44 public datasets, covering 28,182 patients and 34,394 slides across four clinical domains and nine task categories. All models are evaluated under a fixed patient-level cross-validation protocol with fold-level statistical ranking, enabling reproducible comparisons that are less sensitive to split-dependent variation. Across this benchmark, DaX achieves the highest mean performance across tasks and consistently strong task-level ranking scores, with gains spanning diagnostic pathology, biomarker and molecular profiling, tissue/specimen context, and risk, response, and prognosis. These results support DaX as a transferable visual encoder for computational pathology and provide a standardized evaluation framework for future pathology foundation models. Project page: https://alibaba-damo-academy.github.io/DaX/benchboard/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DaX，一个基于 DINOv3 自监督学习的病理视觉基础模型，专为全切片组织病理学设计。模型通过连续放大训练、跨尺度视图、多输入尺寸训练等技术，连接局部细胞形态与全局组织结构，并在包含161个临床任务的WSI基准上取得最高平均性能。
Motivation: 计算病理学需要跨多种放大倍数、染色、扫描仪和输入分辨率的鲁棒视觉表示，现有方法难以兼顾这些变化。
Method: DaX 从自然图像 DINOv3 权重初始化，引入连续放大训练、跨尺度组织视图、方向无关与采集鲁棒增强、多输入尺寸训练，以及 Gram 锚定密集一致性，以稳定不同输入尺度下的密集 token 表示。
Result: 在包含44个公开数据集、161个临床任务的WSI基准上，DaX 实现了最高的平均任务性能，并在诊断病理学、生物标志物分析、组织分类及预后等多个领域获得一致强排名分数。
Conclusion: DaX 可作为计算病理学的可迁移视觉编码器，同时提供的标准化评估框架有助于未来病理基础模型的公平比较。

papers.title: CL-CLIP: CLIP-Based Continual Learning Framework with Cost-Volume Category Decoupling for Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Continual Object Detection (COD) requires a detector to acquire new categories over time while preserving previously learned ones. This goal is closely related to open-vocabulary detection, since both settings require reasoning over categories that are not fully covered by the annotations available at the current training stage. Recent CLIP-based open-vocabulary detectors have shown strong zero-shot generalization, and frameworks such as F-ViT demonstrate that vision-language pretraining can provide powerful zero-shot detection ability for unseen categories. However, real-world deployments cannot remain purely zero-shot: once these detectors are continually updated on newly introduced categories, they suffer severe catastrophic forgetting and quickly lose their previously calibrated detection ability. We therefore propose CL-CLIP, a CLIP-based COD framework that equips open-vocabulary detectors with better continual learning ability through cost-volume-guided category decoupling. Specifically, following CAT-Seg, we compute a CLIP image-text similarity cost volume, defined as dense category-wise response maps between visual tokens and class text embeddings. This zero-shot spatial prior decomposes shared region features into class-specific pathways, which are then processed by a Multi-Expert RoI head. Extensive experiments on PASCAL VOC and MS-COCO show that CL-CLIP substantially improves the F-ViT baseline under continual fine-tuning and achieves competitive performance with existing continual object detectors, especially in adapting to newly introduced categories while preserving competitive base-class performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CL-CLIP，一个基于CLIP的持续目标检测（COD）框架，通过成本体积引导的类别解耦（cost-volume-guided category decoupling）来减轻灾难性遗忘。利用CLIP的图像-文本相似性成本体积作为零样本空间先验，将共享区域特征分解为类别特定路径，并由多专家RoI头处理。在PASCAL VOC和MS-COCO上的实验表明，CL-CLIP在持续微调下显著改进了F-ViT基线，并在适应新类别的同时保持基类性能。
Motivation: 开放词汇检测器在持续更新时遭受严重的灾难性遗忘，失去先前校准的检测能力。现有COD方法在适应新类别时往往牺牲旧类别性能。
Method: 基于CAT-Seg计算CLIP图像-文本相似性成本体积，即视觉tokens与类别文本嵌入之间的密集类别响应图。该零样本空间先验将共享区域特征解耦为类别特定路径，再由多专家RoI头处理。
Result: 在PASCAL VOC和MS-COCO上，CL-CLIP在持续微调下显著优于F-ViT基线，与现有持续目标检测器性能相当，特别是在适应新类别的同时保持基类性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调CL-CLIP通过成本体积引导的类别解耦有效提升了开放词汇检测器的持续学习能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exploring Agentic Tool-Calling Decisions via Uncertainty-Aligned Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based agents often make suboptimal tool-use decisions, including unsupported tool invocation and hallucinated direct responses, which may accumulate errors throughout multi-step interactions. Existing approaches mainly improve these behaviors through inference-time correction or coarse-grained reward signals based on decision outcomes and structured checklists, leaving the uncertainty characteristics of agent decisions underexplored. We observe that decision-oriented reinforcement learning tends to weaken the uncertainty separation between correct and incorrect actions, resulting in overconfident mistakes and weaker exploration signals. Therefore, we propose TRUST, which incorporates uncertainty quantification into reward design as a repulsive force for maintaining uncertainty separation, and labels lightweight key-turn annotations for unified post-training of multi-turn trajectories. Experimental results across diverse tool-use benchmarks show that TRUST consistently enhances both decision quality and agent performance while maintaining more reliable uncertainty estimates during optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TRUST框架，通过将不确定性量化纳入奖励设计作为维持不确定性分离的斥力，并标记轻量级关键轮次注释用于多轮轨迹的统一后训练，以改善基于LLM的智能体工具调用决策中的过度自信错误和探索信号弱的问题。实验表明TRUST在多个工具使用基准上持续提升决策质量和智能体性能，同时保持更可靠的不确定性估计。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的智能体在工具调用决策中常出现次优行为，如调用不存在的工具或产生幻觉式直接回答，且现有方法主要依赖推理时校正或基于决策结果的粗粒度奖励信号，忽略了决策不确定性特征；决策导向的强化学习会削弱正确与错误动作之间的不确定性分离，导致过度自信错误和弱探索信号。
Method: 提出TRUST框架，将不确定性量化纳入奖励设计作为维持不确定性分离的斥力机制，并引入轻量级关键轮次标注，用于多轮轨迹的统一后训练。
Result: 在多个工具使用基准上，TRUST一致地提升了决策质量和智能体性能，并在优化过程中保持更可靠的不确定性估计。
Conclusion: TRUST通过不确定性对齐的奖励设计有效改善了智能体工具调用决策，并强调了不确定性分离在强化学习中的重要性。

papers.title: Accounting for Context: Shaping Moral Credences for Value Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring that agent behaviours are aligned with human moral values inevitably raises the problem of how to account for the plurality of moral perspectives that societies -- and even individuals -- typically adopt. Work on moral uncertainty proposes mechanisms to fairly and democratically aggregate evaluations of actions across different moral theories. However, this paper argues that one needs to account for contextual factors when aggregating moral evaluations. For example, consequentialist perspectives assume an ability to accurately determine how an agent's actions change the world; an assumption that often does not hold in real world settings. We, therefore, formalise agent decision making under moral uncertainty, while also accounting for these kinds of contextual factors. We thereby show that a seemingly commonsensical property -- the weak Pareto principle -- is violated. We argue that this apparent problem is, in fact, a variation of Simpson's paradox, and hence reveals the limitations of aggregation mechanisms that ignore the impact of contextual factors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证在道德不确定性下聚合不同道德理论的评价时，必须考虑上下文因素（如后果主义假设能准确预测行动结果，但现实中常不成立）。作者形式化了一个考虑上下文因素的决策框架，并证明此时弱帕累托原则被违反，这实际上是辛普森悖论的一种变体，揭示了忽略上下文因素的聚合机制的局限性。
Motivation: 现有道德不确定性研究公平聚合不同道德理论对行动的评估，但忽略了上下文因素（例如后果主义依赖对行动后果的准确预测，这在现实世界中往往不成立）。
Method: 形式化了一个考虑上下文因素的道德不确定性下的智能体决策框架，并对聚合机制进行逻辑分析。
Result: 证明在考虑上下文因素时，弱帕累托原则（一个看似合理的性质）被违反，并将此现象归因于辛普森悖论。
Conclusion: 该结果表明，忽略上下文因素的道德聚合机制存在根本性局限，需要更细致的建模。

papers.title: GenPO++: Generative Policy Optimization with Jacobian-free Likelihood Ratios
papers.abstract_en: Generative policies provide expressive and multimodal action distributions, making them attractive for reinforcement learning (RL) in complex continuous-control tasks. Among them, flow-based policies are especially appealing because they generate actions through deterministic transport maps. However, applying such generative policies to likelihood-based on-policy learning remains limited by the difficulty of evaluating the probability of executed actions. Existing flow RL methods either replace the true action-density ratio with approximate surrogates, which can introduce biased updates, or recover exact likelihoods through dummy-action augmentation, which enlarges the policy space and increases computation. In this work, we propose GenPO++, a reversible generative policy optimization framework that uses history states as auxiliary memory in a high-order reversible ODE solver, yielding exact inversion without changing the original action dimension. The resulting generative policy map has a log-determinant determined only by fixed solver coefficients, enabling exact and Jacobian-free likelihood-ratio computation. This design preserves the expressiveness of generative flow policies while avoiding both action ratio bias and dummy-action overhead. We evaluate GenPO++ on large-scale simulated control, fine-tuning, and real-world robotic manipulation tasks, where it achieves competitive or superior performance over state-of-the-art on-policy RL methods, while improving training stability and computational efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GenPO++，一种可逆生成策略优化框架，利用历史状态作为高阶可逆ODE求解器中的辅助记忆，实现精确逆变换而不改变动作维度，消除了对近似似然比或虚拟动作增广的需求。在模拟控制、微调和真实机器人操作任务上取得了有竞争力的性能。
Motivation: 现有基于流的强化学习方法在策略优化中面临动作密度比评估困难：要么使用近似替代导致偏差，要么通过虚拟动作增广扩大策略空间并增加计算量。
Method: GenPO++使用历史状态作为辅助记忆，通过高阶可逆ODE求解器实现精确逆变换，使得生成策略映射的对数行列式仅由固定求解器系数决定，从而实现精确且无需雅可比矩阵的似然比计算。
Result: 在大型模拟控制、微调和真实机器人操作任务上，GenPO++在训练稳定性和计算效率方面优于现有最先进的策略强化学习方法。
Conclusion: GenPO++在保持生成流策略表现力的同时，避免了动作比偏差和虚拟动作开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Vision to Text: A Compact Multimodal Approach for Robust, Cross-Domain Presentation Attack Detection on ID Cards
papers.abstract_en: Cross-domain shifts challenge Presentation Attack Detection (PAD) on ID Cards, given the restricted data available due to privacy concerns. This work proposes a compact multimodal model, based on new generative and discriminative blocks, which combines visual and textual data for PAD on genuine and synthetic ID images. While multimodal models exhibit strong generalisation after supervised fine-tuning, they fail in zero-shot settings. Our findings underscore that model capacity and real-world data are essential for reliable PAD, while existing synthetic datasets may not reflect real-world challenges. We argue for a re-evaluation of synthetic data as a benchmark and emphasise the need for more realistic, diverse datasets to advance PAD research.
papers.comment: Publication under the revision process on IEEE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对ID卡展示攻击检测（PAD）中的跨域迁移问题，提出一种基于生成和判别模块的紧凑多模态模型，融合视觉与文本数据。实验表明，多模态模型在监督微调后泛化能力强，但在零样本设置下失效；研究强调模型容量和真实数据对可靠PAD的必要性，并指出现有合成数据集未能反映真实挑战，呼吁重新评估合成数据基准并构建更多样化的真实数据集。
Motivation: 由于隐私限制，ID卡PAD面临数据稀缺和跨域迁移挑战，现有方法在真实场景中泛化不足。
Method: 提出一个紧凑多模态模型，包含新的生成模块和判别模块，同时利用视觉图像和文本元数据（如证件信息）进行PAD检测。
Result: 多模态模型经监督微调后在跨域测试中表现良好，但在零样本设置下失败；合成数据集无法模拟真实世界的攻击变体，导致性能下降。
Conclusion: 论文主张重新评估合成数据作为基准的可靠性，并强调需要更真实、多样的数据集以推动PAD研究发展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: OpenHalDet: A Unified Benchmark for Hallucination Detection across Diverse Generation Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Hallucination detection is essential for the reliable deployment of large language models (LLMs). However, existing evaluations face two core challenges: inconsistent inference configuration and evaluation, and limited coverage of downstream domains and tasks. Consequently, reported detector performance is often difficult to compare, reproduce, and generalize beyond specific experimental settings. We introduce OpenHalDet, a unified benchmark for hallucination detection across diverse generation scenarios. OpenHalDet standardizes the evaluation pipeline, from prompt construction and response generation to truthfulness annotation, detector scoring, and metric computation. It supports heterogeneous detector families under different access settings, including black-box methods that use only generated outputs, gray-box methods that rely on probability-based signals, and white-box methods that exploit internal model signals. By bringing diverse tasks, models, and detectors into a shared framework, OpenHalDet enables controlled comparison and provides a systematic view of how different detection paradigms behave in LLM applications. We release OpenHalDet as an open and extensible codebase to facilitate reproducible evaluation and future development of hallucination detection methods. The code and datasets are available at https://github.com/Nellie179/Hallucination-Detection.
papers.comment: Preprint. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Nellie179/Hallucination-Detection
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OpenHalDet，一个用于检测大模型幻觉的统一基准，覆盖多种生成场景。该基准标准化了评估流程，支持黑盒、灰盒和白盒检测方法，使不同检测范式能在共享框架下比较。论文开源了代码和数据以促进可重复评估。
Motivation: 现有幻觉检测评估面临推理配置不一致、评测不统一以及下游任务覆盖有限的问题，导致检测器性能难以比较、复现和泛化。
Method: 提出 OpenHalDet 基准，标准化从提示构建、响应生成到真实性标注、检测器评分和指标计算的评估流程，支持基于输出、概率信号和模型内部信号的三类检测器。
Result: 摘要未报告量化实验结果，仅说明该基准支持受控比较和系统观察不同检测范式的行为。
Conclusion: 本文发布了一个开放可扩展的代码库，旨在推动幻觉检测方法的可重复评估和未来发展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MVSegNet: A Lightweight Boundary-Aware Network for Fetal Lateral Ventricle Segmentation and Atrial Width Estimation in Prenatal Ultrasound
papers.abstract_en: Fetal ventriculomegaly is assessed by measuring the atrial width of the lateral ventricle in prenatal ultrasound. Accurate segmentation is essential for this measurement, but acoustic shadowing, speckle noise, and poor contrast make it difficult. We developed MVSegNet, a lightweight encoder-decoder network combining multi-scale feature extraction and boundary-aware refinement. The model was trained and evaluated on 584 expert-annotated transventricular ultrasound frames using a 70/15/15 split. Performance was compared against six segmentation baselines using overlap, boundary, and measurement metrics. MVSegNet achieved a Dice score of 80.79%, IoU of 68.47%, Hausdorff distance of 4.07 mm, and atrial width mean absolute error of 3.40 mm. The model contains 2.31 million parameters and runs at 165.6 frames per second on an NVIDIA T4 GPU. MVSegNet outperformed all evaluated baselines on boundary and measurement metrics while maintaining low computational cost, supporting its use in automated fetal ultrasound analysis.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code and trained models will be released upon acceptance. Supplementary material available upon request
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MVSegNet，一种轻量级边界感知网络，用于产前超声图像中胎儿侧脑室分割和房室宽度估计。模型结合多尺度特征提取和边界感知细化，在584张专家标注的超声帧上训练评估，达到了80.79%的Dice分数、68.47%的IoU、4.07mm的Hausdorff距离和3.40mm的房室宽度平均绝对误差。模型参数仅2.31M，推理速度165.6 FPS（NVIDIA T4 GPU），在边界和测量指标上优于六种分割基线，且计算成本低。
Motivation: 胎儿脑室增大通过测量侧脑室房室宽度评估，但超声图像中的声影、散斑噪声和低对比度使准确分割困难，现有方法在边界和测量精度上不足。
Method: 提出MVSegNet，一个轻量级编码器-解码器网络，集成多尺度特征提取和边界感知细化模块，通过组合分割损失和边界损失进行训练。
Result: 在584帧超声数据（70/15/15划分）上，MVSegNet达到Dice 80.79%、IoU 68.47%、Hausdorff距离4.07mm、房室宽度平均绝对误差3.40mm，参数2.31M，速度165.6 FPS，在边界和测量指标上优于所有六种基线。
Conclusion: MVSegNet以低计算成本实现了高精度边界和测量性能，适用于自动化胎儿超声分析。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Deep Single-Index Fréchet Regression
papers.abstract_en: Predicting outputs that are located in non-Euclidean spaces, such as probability distributions, networks, and symmetric positive-definite matrices, is becoming increasingly important in modern data analysis, particularly when inputs are high-dimensional. We propose DeSI (Deep Single-Index Fréchet Regression), a semiparametric framework for regression with metric space-valued outputs and multivariate inputs that assumes a single-index structure for the conditional Fréchet mean. DeSI estimates an interpretable index direction, which quantifies the relative importance of inputs, using a deep neural network, and performs Fréchet regression along the resulting one-dimensional index in the target metric space. This structure mitigates the curse of dimensionality while retaining interpretability, which stands in contrast to standard deep neural networks. We establish theoretical guarantees for DeSI, including uniform approximation and convergence rates, and demonstrate its strong predictive performance through simulations on distributions, networks, and symmetric positive-definite matrices, as well as an application to compositional mood data from New Jersey.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DeSI（Deep Single-Index Fréchet Regression），一种半参数回归框架，用于处理输出位于度量空间（如分布、网络、对称正定矩阵）且输入为高维多元数据的问题。DeSI通过深度神经网络估计可解释的单指标方向，然后沿该一维指标在目标度量空间中进行Fréchet回归，从而缓解维数灾难并保持可解释性。文章提供了理论保证（一致逼近和收敛速率），并在仿真和实际音乐情绪数据上展示了预测性能。
Motivation: 当输出位于非欧几里得空间（如概率分布、网络、正定矩阵）且输入为高维数据时，现有方法常受维数灾难困扰且缺乏可解释性。作者希望开发一种既缓解维数灾难又保持可解释性的回归方法。
Method: 提出DeSI框架：先利用深度神经网络从多元输入中学习一个单指标方向（赋予每个输入特征相对重要性权重），然后沿该一维指标在输出度量空间中进行Fréchet回归（估计条件Fréchet均值）。这是一种半参数方法，结合了深度学习的灵活性和单指标模型的可解释性。
Result: 理论方面，建立了DeSI的一致逼近性和收敛速率。实验方面，通过针对分布、网络和对称正定矩阵的仿真以及新泽西州音乐情绪数据的应用，验证了其强预测性能。
Conclusion: DeSI在保持可解释性的同时有效缓解了高维输入下非欧几里得输出回归的维数灾难，但论文未讨论实际应用中的局限性或与其他深度方法的详细比较。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When is 3D Worth It? A Resource-Performance Frontier for CNNs and Transformers in Lung CT
papers.abstract_en: Three-dimensional models are widely assumed preferable for volumetric medical imaging, yet their practical value depends on whether performance gains justify added computational cost and complexity. Rather than proposing a new architecture, we study how input dimensionality (2D, 2.5D, 3D) affects model behavior across convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs) under a fixed training protocol. Using a leakage-free NLST cohort (n = 1,977) with supporting LIDC-IDRI data, we find that the 2.5D CNN offers the most favorable discrimination-stability trade-off in our comparison (ROC-AUC 0.682, 95% CI [0.546, 0.799]) with a stable operating point. In contrast, 3D CNNs show threshold instability, and transformers exhibit degenerate predictions, such as all-positive predictions. Confidence intervals are wide and overlapping, so we present these results as a controlled resource-performance frontier and a failure-mode taxonomy rather than as definitive superiority claims. For class-imbalanced lung cancer screening classification, 2D and 2.5D inputs provide a more reliable trade-off between performance, stability, and computational efficiency than full 3D representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究输入维度（2D、2.5D、3D）对卷积神经网络和视觉Transformer在肺CT影像分类中的影响。在无泄漏NLST队列（n=1,977）上，2.5D CNN在ROC-AUC（0.682）和稳定性之间取得最优平衡，而3D CNN存在阈值不稳定，Transformer出现退化预测（全正预测）。由于置信区间宽且重叠，作者强调这是资源-性能前沿和故障模式分类，而非确定性的优越性声明。
Motivation: 三维模型在体医学影像中被广泛认为更优，但实际价值取决于性能提升是否足以抵偿计算成本和复杂性。现有工作缺乏在固定训练协议下系统比较不同输入维度的研究。
Method: 固定训练协议，比较输入维度（2D、2.5D、3D）对CNN和Vision Transformer的影响，使用无泄漏NLST和LIDC-IDRI数据，评估ROC-AUC和稳定性。
Result: 2.5D CNN获得最佳ROC-AUC（0.682，95%CI [0.546,0.799]）且操作点稳定；3D CNN显示阈值不稳定；Transformer出现退化预测（全正）。置信区间宽且重叠，表明结果需谨慎解释。
Conclusion: 在类别不平衡的肺癌筛查分类中，2D和2.5D输入相比全3D表示在性能、稳定性和计算效率间提供更可靠的权衡。本文结果应被视为资源-性能前沿和故障模式分类，而非确定性优越性声明。

papers.title: Auditing Training Data in Domain-adapted LLMs: LoRA-MINT
papers.abstract_en: We present LoRA-MINT, a new methodology for Membership Inference Test (MINT) applied to recent Large Language Models (LLMs) fine-tuned for specific Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks through Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). The primary goal is to assess whether individual samples were part of the training data of these adapted models, providing a useful auditing tool for the management of intellectual property and sensitive data. Our analysis explores the relationship between model perplexity and membership status, providing a systematic framework for estimating data exposure in fine-tuned LLMs. We conducted experiments on four models and three benchmark datasets, obtaining precision values in determining if given data were used for training ranging from 0.77 to 0.92, which outperform state-of-the-art baselines and demonstrate the robustness and generality of the proposed method. In general, our findings underscore the potential of LoRA-MINT as an effective and scalable framework for auditing LLMs, improving transparency, and fostering the ethical and responsible deployment of AI and NLP technologies. For the sake of concreteness and current relevance, our discussion and experiments are centered on LoRAadjusted LLMs, but note that most of the presented methodology is easily applicable for auditing training data given any other technique for adapting LLMs or, more generally, any other domain-adapted AI models.

papers.title: SS-TPT: Stability and Suitability-Guided Test-Time Prompt Tuning for Adversarially Robust Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP achieve strong zero-shot recognition but remain highly fragile under adversarial perturbations. Recent test-time adaptation defenses improve robustness by leveraging many augmented views, but this leads to impractical slowdown and a clear robustness-throughput trade-off. To address this challenge, we present Stability and Suitability-guided Test-time Prompt Tuning (SS-TPT), evaluating the quality of each augmented view via two complementary scores: (1) stability, measuring prediction invariance to weak augmentations, and (2) suitability, measuring feature-space density among views. These stability and suitability (SS) scores guide both adaptation and inference through an SS-guided consistency loss and an SS-weighted prediction, amplifying trustworthy views while suppressing corrupted ones. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SS-TPT significantly outperforms prior state-of-the-art methods, achieving superior robustness-throughput trade-offs across diverse datasets and varying numbers of views, thereby demonstrating both strong practicality and generality. Our code is available at https://github.com/sunoh-kim/SS-TPT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SS-TPT 是一种针对视觉语言模型（如 CLIP）的测试时提示微调方法，通过稳定性（预测对弱增强的不变性）和适合性（特征空间密度）两个分数评估增强视图的质量，并利用 SS 引导的一致性损失和加权预测来提升对抗鲁棒性。实验表明，该方法在多个数据集上实现了优于现有方法的鲁棒性-吞吐量权衡。
Motivation: 现有测试时自适应防御方法依赖大量增强视图，导致推理速度慢且鲁棒性与吞吐量难以兼顾。
Method: 提出稳定性与适合性引导的测试时提示微调（SS-TPT），利用两个互补分数（稳定性和适合性）评估每个增强视图的质量，并通过 SS 引导的一致性损失和 SS 加权预测来提升鲁棒性。
Result: 在多个数据集和不同视图数量下，SS-TPT 显著优于先前最先进方法，实现了更好的鲁棒性-吞吐量权衡。
Conclusion: SS-TPT 通过选择性利用高质量增强视图，有效提升了视觉语言模型在对抗扰动下的鲁棒性和实用性。

papers.title: Didact: A Cross-Domain Capability Discovery System for Defence
papers.abstract_en: Policymakers in defence and defence-aligned sectors must monitor rapidly evolving research alongside sector priorities relevant to operational and strategic needs. In practice, these sources are fragmented across heterogeneous formats, disjoint repositories, and siloed update streams, making capability discovery slow and difficult to audit. We present Didact, a prototype that integrates publicly available defence reports and policy documents from Australia with a purpose-built knowledge graph derived from Australian research publications. Didact provides natural language conversations for policy-oriented workflows, and leverages a composite retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline. A key feature of Didact is an interactive Evidence Rail that visualises retrieved evidence and source relationships. Our evaluation of the output quality and runtime of Didact highlights its utility. While Didact has been co-developed as an academia-industry project for the Australian context, it is adaptable to other domains where knowledge is similarly fragmented. papers.title: Quantum-Inspired Trace-Augmented Evidence Selection for Reasoning over Structured Hypothesis Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) now solve a wide range of expert-level exams at or above human level, yet remain brittle on specialised, evidence-intensive domains such as law. On these tasks, errors arise not only from gaps in world knowledge but also from subtle distinctions between pieces of evidence and inconsistent use of supporting evidence. The most common aggregator over sampled chain-of-thought (CoT) traces, majority vote, returns the most popular answer regardless of whether its evidence is actually strongest. We propose to treat the selection of CoT reasoning fragments into a set of evidence as an explicit combinatorial optimisation problem, allowing well-supported but minority hypotheses to override noisy majorities, and to evaluate the approach on legal-reasoning benchmarks that are particularly sensitive to evidence quality. We introduce EP-HUBO (Evidence Pool Higher-Order Binary Optimisation), which generates multiple CoT traces with a small local model, parses fragments into per-hypothesis evidence pools, solves a higher-order unconstrained binary optimisation per pool with quality-derived weights (relevance, specificity, distinctiveness), and delegates a single adjudication call per question to a frontier model. We evaluate EP-HUBO on two evidence-intensive legal benchmarks using both simulated annealing on classical hardware and the Dirac-3 photonic entropy-quantum machine from Quantum Computing Inc. HUBO-style optimisation gives a principled way to aggregate reasoning fragments while preserving minority-but-correct hypotheses, and is most valuable in low-contamination domains where frontier models have not already absorbed the benchmark material.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出EP-HUBO框架，将大语言模型（LLM）的思维链（CoT）推理片段选择转化为组合优化问题，以改善证据密集型领域（如法律推理）的答案质量。通过小模型生成多条CoT轨迹，解析为每假设的证据池，使用高阶无约束二元优化（HUBO）结合质量权重（相关性、特异性、区分性）选择最优证据，并委托前沿模型进行一次裁决。在法律基准上评估，采用经典模拟退火和量子光学处理器Dirac-3。
Motivation: LLM在专业考试中表现出色，但在法律等证据密集型领域仍脆弱，错误源于证据间细微差别和不一致使用。多数投票聚合忽略证据强度，无法保留证据充分但非主流的假设。
Method: 引入证据池高阶无约束二元优化（EP-HUBO），分为三步：用小模型生成多个CoT轨迹并解析为每假设的证据池；对每个证据池求解HUBO问题，权重基于证据质量（相关性、特异性、区分性）；最后用前沿模型对每个问题进行一次裁决。
Result: 在证据密集型法律基准上评估，EP-HUBO通过组合优化聚合推理片段，能够保留正确但非主流的假设，尤其在低污染领域（前沿模型未吸收基准数据）中价值最大。
Conclusion: HUBO风格的优化为聚合推理片段提供了原则性方法，可提升证据质量敏感任务的鲁棒性，但依赖于小模型生成轨迹的质量和权重设计。

papers.title: When CLIP Sees More, It Fights Back Harder: Multi-View Guided Adaptive Counterattacks for Test-Time Adversarial Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models such as CLIP have achieved remarkable zero-shot recognition capabilities, yet their robustness against adversarial perturbations remains limited. Test-time counterattack (TTC) was recently proposed to improve CLIP's robustness by perturbing an input image to steer it away from a corrupted state during inference. However, TTC remains fragile under strong attacks because its counterattack relies on a directly corrupted original view and employs a noise-driven hard-gating scheme that cannot adapt to varying corruption severity. To address these limitations, we introduce Multi-view guided Adaptive Counterattack (MAC), which performs counterattacks for multi-view with corruption-aware soft weighting. Specifically, MAC first constructs augmented views of an input image to obtain diverse embeddings. It then performs counterattacks to refine corrupted embeddings of views. Next, MAC adaptively scales the counterattack intensity for each view based on its estimated corruption degree. Finally, the adaptively counterattacked views are aggregated to yield a robust final prediction. Extensive experiments across 20 datasets and diverse attack scenarios demonstrate that MAC substantially improves robustness while preserving high inference speed and memory efficiency with its tuning-free design. Our code is available at https://github.com/sunoh-kim/MAC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对CLIP视觉语言模型在测试时对抗鲁棒性不足的问题，提出多视图引导的自适应对抗攻击（MAC）。该方法通过构建多个增强视图、执行视图级对抗攻击、基于估计的损坏程度自适应缩放攻击强度，并聚合多视图预测，从而提升鲁棒性。在20个数据集和多种攻击场景下，MAC显著提高了鲁棒性，同时保持高推理速度和内存效率，且无需调优。
Motivation: 现有测试时对抗攻击（TTC）在强攻击下脆弱，因为其依赖直接损坏的原始视图和无法适应不同损坏程度的硬门控方案。
Method: MAC首先构建输入图像的多个增强视图获得嵌入，然后对每个视图执行对抗攻击以净化损坏嵌入，再根据估计的损坏程度自适应缩放攻击强度，最后聚合得到鲁棒预测。
Result: 在20个数据集和多种攻击场景下，MAC显著提升了鲁棒性，同时保持高推理速度和内存效率，且无需调优。
Conclusion: 摘要强调MAC通过多视图和自适应加权有效地增强了CLIP的对抗鲁棒性。

papers.title: Uniform Stability and Generalization Error of GD and SGD on Fixed-Point Parameters
papers.abstract_en: We analyze generalization error, uniform stability, and uniform argument stability of gradient descent (GD) and stochastic gradient descent (SGD) over discrete parameter spaces, where each update involves deterministic or stochastic rounding. We show that deterministic rounding degrades the generalization error of GD on convex, Lipschitz, and smooth loss functions, increasing the rate from $O(T/n)$ to $O(T/\sqrt{n})$, and establish matching lower bounds. We further prove that uniform stability of GD becomes $Ω(T)$, showing that stability-based generalization bounds are vacuous in this setting. In contrast, for the same losses, stochastic gradient descent with deterministic rounding admits nontrivial uniform stability guarantees, which differ qualitatively from the real-valued case and exhibit distinct dependencies on the number of iterations and the dimension: we prove tight bounds $O(T/n)$ for one dimension and $O(T^2/n)$ for higher dimensions. We also show that stochastic rounding can introduce generalization error that increases with the dimension; such a phenomenon is absent in standard real-valued optimization and in the deterministic rounding case. Finally, we provide upper bounds on uniform argument stability for stochastic rounding schemes and show that these bounds are tight when the loss can be represented as a sum of coordinate-wise functions.

TL;DR: 本文分析了梯度下降（GD）和随机梯度下降（SGD）在离散参数空间（含确定性或随机舍入）上的泛化误差、均匀稳定性和均匀参数稳定性。对于凸、Lipschitz且光滑的损失函数，确定性舍入使GD的泛化误差从O(T/n)恶化为O(T/√n)，并给出了匹配下界；GD的均匀稳定性达到Ω(T)，表明基于稳定性的泛化界在此设定下是平凡的。相比之下，SGD含确定性舍入时具有非平凡的均匀稳定性保证，在一维上紧界为O(T/n)，高维为O(T²/n)。随机舍入引入的泛化误差随维度增加，这一现象在实值优化和确定性舍入中不存在。还给出了随机舍入方案的均匀参数稳定性上界，并证明当损失可表示为坐标函数和时这些界是紧的。
Motivation: 现有理论主要关注实值优化中的泛化误差和稳定性，但离散参数空间（如量化或舍入）下的行为尚不明确，可能导致性能退化。
Method: 对GD和SGD在离散参数空间（每次更新进行确定性或随机舍入）上，分别推导了泛化误差、均匀稳定性和均匀参数稳定性的上界与下界，并通过构造损失函数证明紧性。
Result: 确定性舍入使GD的泛化误差从O(T/n)升至O(T/√n)，且GD的均匀稳定性为Ω(T)；SGD含确定性舍入时，一维紧界O(T/n)、高维O(T²/n)；随机舍入的泛化误差随维度增加。
Conclusion: 离散参数空间下的优化算法在泛化和稳定性上表现出与实值情况截然不同的定性行为，特别是维度依赖性和舍入策略的影响。

papers.title: SVHighlights: Towards Extremely Long Sport Video Highlight Detection
papers.abstract_en: While highlight detection for long-form videos is of great practical importance, most existing methods remain limited to short-form content, largely due to the absence of a suitable benchmark. To bridge this gap, we introduce SVHighlights, to the best of our knowledge, the first benchmark for highlight detection in extremely long sports videos, each exceeding one hour in duration, across multiple sports categories. SVHighlights is constructed from pairs of full-length sports videos and their corresponding official highlight videos using a dataset generation pipeline, enabling scalable label generation without conventional per-clip saliency annotation. The benchmark comprises 320 videos with an average duration of 2.00 hours and a total of 640.18 hours, substantially exceeding previous datasets. Existing methods also face fundamental challenges on long videos: models trained on short clips fail to generalize to hour-long content, and their clip-level scoring lacks the broader context needed to identify highlights. To address this and provide a strong baseline, we present TF-SELECTOR, a training-free segment-based approach that divides each video into context-aware segments by merging adjacent shots sharing the same semantic content, and predicts segment-level saliency scores using a large language model with multimodal inputs including visual captions, transcripts, and audio volume. Experiments demonstrate that TF-SELECTOR achieves superior performance across most metrics compared to Video Temporal Grounding (VTG)-tuned baselines, with improvements of +3.12 in HIT@1, +4.06 in HIT@K, and +2.95 in IoU. These results establish SVHighlights as a challenging testbed for long-form highlight detection and demonstrate that a simple segment-based strategy can effectively scale to hour-long videos.
papers.comment: Accepted to KDD 2026 (Datasets and Benchmarks Track). Project Page: https://leedongkyu2019.github.io/SVHighlights/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了SVHighlights，据称是首个针对超长体育视频（平均时长2小时，总计640小时）的精彩片段检测基准。同时提出TF-SELECTOR，一种无需训练的基于片段的方法，通过合并语义相近的镜头形成上下文感知片段，并利用大语言模型（LLM）结合视觉字幕、转录文本和音频音量等多模态输入预测片段级显著性分数。实验表明TF-SELECTOR在多数指标上优于视频时间定位（VTG）微调的基线方法，在HIT@1上提升3.12，HIT@K提升4.06，IoU提升2.95。
Motivation: 现有精彩片段检测方法主要针对短视频，缺乏适用于长视频（时长超过1小时）的基准，且短片段训练的模型难以泛化到小时级内容，片段级评分缺乏全局上下文。
Method: 构建SVHighlights数据集，通过全长体育视频与其官方精彩视频对的自动生成流程实现可扩展的标注。提出TF-SELECTOR，将视频分割为语义一致的片段，利用多模态LLM预测每个片段的显著性分数，无需额外训练。
Result: 在SVHighlights上，TF-SELECTOR相比VTG微调基线在HIT@1（+3.12）、HIT@K（+4.06）和IoU（+2.95）上取得显著提升。
Conclusion: SVHighlights是长视频精彩片段检测的挑战性新基准，而简单的基于片段的无训练策略可以有效扩展至小时级视频。

papers.title: From Sampled Outcomes to Capability Distributions: Rethinking Supervision for LLM Routing
papers.abstract_en: Existing LLM routing methods typically treat a model's single response to a query as its capability label for training routers. However, because LLM generation is inherently stochastic, such single-shot supervision provides only a noisy observation of a query-model pair's behavior rather than a reliable capability estimate. We show that this assumption introduces systematic noise into routing supervision, making learned routing policies less reliable. To address this issue, we propose DARS (Distribution-Aware Routing Supervision), a framework that constructs routing supervision from a distributional view of model behavior. Instead of relying on a single generated response, DARS considers uncertainty from both the input side and the output side, capturing how semantically equivalent query formulations and stochastic generations affect model performance. Based on these distribution-aware observations, DARS builds more reliable supervision signals for routing. Experiments across diverse tasks show that single-shot labels can be misleading for model selection, while distribution-aware supervision provides more stable labels and improves learned routing behavior. Our results suggest that reliable LLM routing should move beyond single-response observations and be grounded in query-level model capability distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对现有LLM路由方法使用单次生成结果作为模型能力标签引入噪声的问题，提出DARS框架，从分布视角构建路由监督信号，考虑输入和输出的不确定性。实验表明单次标签可能误导模型选择，而分布感知监督提供更稳定的标签并改善路由行为。
Motivation: 现有LLM路由方法依赖单次响应作为能力标签，但LLM生成具有随机性，导致监督信号不可靠。
Method: 提出DARS，从分布视角考虑输入和输出的不确定性，对语义等价的查询表述和随机生成进行建模，构建更可靠的监督信号。
Result: 实验表明单次标签可能误导模型选择，而分布感知监督提供更稳定的标签并改善学习路由行为。
Conclusion: 可靠的LLM路由应超越单次响应观察，基于查询级模型能力分布。

papers.title: Declarative Skills for AI Agents in Knowledge-Grounded Tool-Use Workflows
papers.abstract_en: We study orchestration mechanisms for tool-using AI agents in realistic customer-service workflows over an unstructured knowledge base. We argue that declarative agents -- AI agents equipped with natural-language skill files appended to the system prompt -- are an effective orchestration paradigm. Concretely, we compare (i) a DeclarativeAgent that reads three domain-specific skill files at inference time and decides its own control flow, (ii) an ImperativeAgent based on a programmatic state machine with explicit phases, and (iii) an unscaffolded baseline agent modeled after the $τ$-Knowledge benchmark agent. Our ImperativeAgent is motivated by externalised-control inference as in Recursive Language Models and graph-based orchestration frameworks. We formalise the three agents as policy classes within a decentralised partially-observable Markov decision process and analyse their information-theoretic and structural properties; we then test the predicted differences empirically on five language models and two retrieval regimes. Our results show that retrieval quality is a dominant bottleneck for AI agents: when evidence is incomplete or skewed, all agents degrade substantially, and skill files cannot recover lost performance. Under high-quality retrieval, however, declarative skills consistently improve accuracy on procedural tasks and reduce orchestration errors, while the imperative state machine's brittleness does not reliably improve task success or compliance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在非结构化知识库上的客服工作流中，使用自然语言技能文件的声明式代理（DeclarativeAgent）与基于程序状态机的命令式代理（ImperativeAgent）以及无架构基线代理的编排效果。实验表明检索质量是主要瓶颈，在高质量检索下声明式技能可提升程序任务准确性并减少编排错误。
Motivation: 现有AI代理在工具使用工作流中缺乏有效的编排机制，尤其面对非结构化知识库时性能不稳定，需要比较不同编排范式的优劣。
Method: 形式化三种代理为分散式部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（Dec-POMDP）的策略类，并在五个语言模型和两种检索机制下进行实证比较。
Result: 检索质量是主导瓶颈：当证据不完整或偏斜时所有代理性能显著下降。但在高质量检索下，声明式技能一致提升程序任务准确性并减少编排错误，而命令式状态机未能可靠改进任务成功或合规性。
Conclusion: 声明式技能在高质量检索下有效，但无法弥补检索缺陷；未来工作需改善检索鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Fine-Tuning Trap: Evaluating Negative Transfer and the Role of PEFT in Sub-1B Mathematical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Deploying Small Language Models (SLMs) on edge devices requires efficient fine-tuning strategies that adapt models to new tasks without degrading their general capabilities. In this study, we benchmark five sub-1B models (135M-1B) on mathematical reasoning tasks and uncover a critical vulnerability: Full Fine-Tuning (Full FT) actively harms performance in models under 300M parameters, often dropping accuracy below zero-shot baselines. This "negative transfer" makes Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) not just an efficiency preference, but a stability requirement. We find that while Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and Weight-Decomposed LoRA (DoRA) perform comparably, their strengths vary by task; DoRA excels in complex reasoning (GSM8K), while LoRA dominates pattern matching (OrcaMath). In particular, Full FT is outperformed by LoRA on aligned models (Qwen2.5-0.5B) and even by simple 5-shot In-Context Learning on the smallest architectures (SmolLM2-135M). Based on these findings, we recommend defaulting to PEFT for all aligned sub-1B models and caution against Full FT for any architecture smaller than 500M parameters to prevent catastrophic forgetting. Reproduction of this work can be found at https://github.com/gulguluu/tiny-slm-finetune-compare.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了5个子10亿参数的小语言模型(SLM)在数学推理任务上的微调策略，发现全参数微调(Full FT)对300M以下模型会造成负迁移，性能甚至低于零样本基线。因此参数高效微调(PEFT)不仅是效率选择，更是稳定性要求。LoRA和DoRA表现相当但各有优势：DoRA擅长复杂推理(GSM8K)，LoRA主导模式匹配(OrcaMath)。建议对对齐的子1B模型默认使用PEFT，并避免对500M以下架构进行Full FT以防止灾难性遗忘。
Motivation: 在边缘设备部署小语言模型需要高效的微调策略，既能适应新任务又不降低通用能力。现有研究未充分探索小模型上不同微调方法对数学推理任务的影响，尤其是负迁移风险。
Method: 在5个子1B模型(135M-1B)上，对比全参数微调(Full FT)与参数高效微调(PEFT)方法（包括LoRA和DoRA）在数学推理任务上的表现，使用GSM8K和OrcaMath等基准。
Result: Full FT对300M以下模型造成负迁移（准确率低于零样本）；PEFT（LoRA/DoRA）表现更稳定，其中DoRA在GSM8K上更优，LoRA在OrcaMath上更优；在最小模型(SmolLM2-135M)上，甚至5-shot上下文学习(ICL)优于Full FT。
Conclusion: 建议对对齐的子1B模型默认使用PEFT，并避免对500M以下架构进行Full FT以防止灾难性遗忘。

papers.title: DRIFT: From Robustness Gaps to Invariance Manifolds for AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: The rapid evolution of generative image models challenges existing AI-generated image detectors, particularly in open-world settings with unseen generators. Recent training-free approaches measure robustness gaps in frozen vision foundation models (VFMs), detecting fakes via perturbation-induced embedding drift. However, these methods rely on fixed invariance geometry inherited from pretraining and lack principled adaptation to the detection task. We instead formulate AI-generated image detection as learning a structured invariance manifold of real images under one-class supervision. Building upon a frozen VFM, we introduce lightweight projection heads that decompose representation space into complementary robust and fragile subspaces. The robust subspace is explicitly trained to suppress variations induced by physically plausible imaging transformations, approximating tangent directions of a real-image manifold, while the fragile subspace retains sensitivity to edit-like perturbations. A structured ordering margin enforces hierarchical separation between physical invariance and edit-induced variability, enabling detection as a margin-violation test relative to the learned manifold. At inference, multi-scale patch-wise drift under both transformation families yields a dual-channel invariance signature and interpretable localization. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong open-world generalization across unseen generators and resolutions, consistently outperforming training-free robustness-based baselines while providing interpretable invariance-violation maps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DRIFT方法，将AI生成图像检测问题转化为学习真实图像的结构化不变性流形。在冻结的视觉基础模型（VFM）上引入轻量级投影头，将表示空间分解为鲁棒子空间和脆弱子空间，通过结构化排序间隔实现物理不变性和编辑扰动的层次分离。实验表明该方法在未见过的生成器和分辨率下具有强开放世界泛化能力，并提供可解释的不变性违规图。
Motivation: 现有训练无关方法依赖预训练模型的固定不变性几何，缺乏对检测任务的自适应，难以应对开放世界中不断演化的生成模型。
Method: 基于冻结VFM，引入轻量级投影头将表示空间分解为鲁棒和脆弱两个互补子空间。鲁棒子空间通过训练抑制物理成像变换引起的扰动，近似真实图像流形的切方向；脆弱子空间保持对编辑类扰动的敏感性。使用结构化排序间隔强制物理不变性和编辑变化之间的层次分离，通过间隔违规测试进行检测。推理时使用多尺度局部漂移得到双通道不变性签名和可解释定位。
Result: 实验在多个未见过的生成器和分辨率上优于现有训练无关的鲁棒性基线方法，展示了强开放世界泛化能力。
Conclusion: 通过学习结构化不变性流形并分解鲁棒/脆弱子空间，可以有效检测AI生成图像并提供可解释的违规定位。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ThinkBooster: A Unified Framework for Seamless Test-Time Scaling of LLM Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Test-time compute (TTC) scaling has emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) reasoning by allocating additional compute during inference, e.g., via multi-sample generation and verifier-based reranking. Existing TTC scaling strategies and reasoning scorers remain fragmented, evaluated under inconsistent protocols, and are rarely analyzed through the lens of quality-cost trade-offs. We introduce ThinkBooster, a unified framework for seamless test-time compute scaling of LLM reasoning, which consists of (i) a modular Python library implementing state-of-the-art TTC scaling strategy and scorer families, (ii) a benchmark that jointly evaluates performance and computational efficiency, and (iii) a deployable OpenAI-compatible proxy service that enables drop-in integration of adaptive reasoning into real-world applications. We further provide a demo visual debugger for inspecting the reasoning trajectories, intermediate selection decisions, and alternative reasoning paths. Empirical results on mathematical and coding tasks reveal the performance-compute trade-offs of TTC scaling strategies and scoring methods and demonstrate that ThinkBooster provides practical gains in real-world tasks. The code is available online under an MIT license.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ThinkBooster，一个用于LLM推理的无缝测试时计算扩展的统一框架。该框架包含模块化库实现最新TTC策略和评分器，一个联合评估性能和计算效率的基准，以及一个支持即插式自适应推理的OpenAI兼容代理服务。通过可视化调试器可检查推理轨迹和选择决策。在数学和编程任务上的实验揭示了性能-计算权衡，并展示实际增益。
Motivation: 现有TTC扩展策略和推理评分器碎片化，在非一致协议下评估，且缺乏从质量-成本权衡角度的分析。
Method: 提出ThinkBooster框架，包括(1)模块化Python库实现SOTA TTC策略和评分器家族，(2)联合评估性能和计算效率的基准，(3)可部署的OpenAI兼容代理服务，以及可视化调试器。
Result: 在数学和编程任务上的实证结果揭示了TTC策略和评分方法的性能-计算权衡，并证明ThinkBooster在实际任务中提供了实际增益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调ThinkBooster提供了统一的框架来解决TTC扩展中的碎片化问题，并展示了实际可用性。

papers.title: polyDAG: Polynomial Acyclicity Constraints for Efficient Continuous Causal Discovery in Visual Semantic Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Modern image-analysis pipelines often convert images into structured semantic variables, such as facial attributes, object concepts, and scene descriptors. Learning directed dependencies among these variables can produce interpretable visual semantic graphs, but continuous directed acyclic graph learning is limited by the cost of enforcing acyclicity. We present polyDAG, a polynomial acyclicity framework for efficient continuous causal discovery in visual semantic graphs. polyDAG replaces the matrix-exponential acyclicity constraint with a finite polynomial trace constraint and proves that the new constraint is zero exactly for acyclic graphs. We further derive a geometric-series implementation that avoids the explicit summation loop while preserving the same acyclicity condition. Experiments on synthetic Erdos-Renyi graphs and CelebA facial visual attributes show that polyDAG improves efficiency and structure recovery. Averaged over the revised synthetic protocol with d in {100, 200, 500}, polyDAG reduces mean structural Hamming distance from 318.4 to 285.4 and improves mean F1 score from 0.725 to 0.756. At 100 nodes, the geometric variant runs in 3.44 seconds compared with 5.16 seconds for the exponential baseline, corresponding to a 33.4 percent speedup. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/wenhaoz-fengcai/polyDAG.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 polyDAG，一种基于多项式无环约束的连续因果发现框架，用于高效学习视觉语义图。它用有限多项式迹约束替代矩阵指数无环约束，并证明新约束在无环图上严格为零。进一步推导出几何级数实现以避免显式求和循环。在合成 Erdos-Renyi 图和 CelebA 面部属性上的实验表明，polyDAG 提高了效率并改进了结构恢复：平均结构汉明距离从 318.4 降至 285.4，平均 F1 分数从 0.725 提升至 0.756；100 节点时几何变体运行时间 3.44 秒，相比指数基线的 5.16 秒加速 33.4%。
Motivation: 连续有向无环图学习受限于强制无环性的计算成本，尤其是在视觉语义图等结构化变量场景中。
Method: 提出多项式无环约束，用有限多项式迹约束替换矩阵指数约束，并证明零值严格对应无环图；还推导出几何级数实现，避免显式循环。
Result: 在合成 Erdos-Renyi 图和 CelebA 面部属性上，polyDAG 将平均结构汉明距离从 318.4 降至 285.4，平均 F1 分数从 0.725 提升至 0.756；100 节点时速度提升 33.4%。
Conclusion: polyDAG 通过多项式约束有效降低了连续因果发现的无环性惩罚计算成本，在视觉语义图结构恢复上取得改进。

papers.title: SpectCount: Spectrotemporal Counting via Synthetic Signals Improves Large Audio Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large audio language models (LALMs) extend large language models with an audio encoder and large-scale audio data. However, the scarcity of high-quality annotated audio data remains a fundamental bottleneck for scaling. Through probing signal detectability analysis, we identify fine-grained spectrotemporal perceptual weaknesses in a foundation LALM. To address these challenges, we propose Spectrotemporal Counting (SpectCount), a data-efficient fine-tuning approach based on fully synthetic audio signals generated on-the-fly, without relying on real-world audio, annotations, or pretrained generative models. SpectCount not only resolves the observed weaknesses but also improves performance on diverse auditory benchmarks spanning sound, music, and speech, unseen during fine-tuning. These results suggest that weakness-targeted synthetic signals provide a data-efficient path toward enhanced auditory understanding capabilities in LALMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过探针信号检测性分析发现大型音频语言模型（LALMs）在细粒度频谱时间感知上存在弱点，并提出SpectCount方法，利用实时生成的合成音频信号进行数据高效微调。该方法无需真实音频、标注或预训练生成模型，不仅解决了上述弱点，还在声音、音乐、语音等多种未见过的听觉基准上提升了性能，表明合成信号为增强LALM的听觉理解能力提供了数据高效路径。
Motivation: 高质量标注音频数据的稀缺限制了LALM的扩展，且现有模型在细粒度频谱时间感知上存在弱点。
Method: 提出SpectCount，一种数据高效的微调方法，基于实时生成的全合成音频信号，不依赖真实音频、人工标注或预训练生成模型。
Result: SpectCount解决了LALM在细粒度频谱时间感知上的弱点，并在声音、音乐、语音等多种听觉基准（微调中未见）上提升了性能。
Conclusion: 弱点定向的合成信号为数据高效地增强LALM的听觉理解能力提供了可行路径。

papers.title: EASE-TTT: Evidence-Aligned Selective Test-Time Training for Long-Context Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Long-context question answering (QA) remains challenging for smaller language models even when answer-bearing evidence is already present in the input. Existing within-context retrieval methods localize and expose candidate evidence chunks for the question, but they stop at input-level evidence exposure rather than adapting the query-side attention parameters that control how the model allocates attention over full-context positions. In contrast, lightweight test-time adaptation methods, such as query-only test-time training (qTTT), leave evidence localization unresolved because their generic span-level self-supervised objectives do not identify which context positions support the current answer. In this paper, we propose Evidence-Aligned SElective Test-Time Training (EASE-TTT), a within-context retrieval-augmented test-time training framework that converts selected evidence chunks into a soft attention supervision target over their token positions. Instead of replacing the full context with retrieved chunks, EASE-TTT uses the resulting attention target to guide query-side adaptation, with the adapted model generating the final answer from the original full context. Experiments on six LongBench QA tasks and three small decoder-only language models show that EASE-TTT achieves the strongest macro-average performance among full-context inference, retrieval-only baselines, and qTTT, supporting evidence-aligned test-time adaptation in long-context QA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出证据对齐的选择性测试时训练框架（EASE-TTT），针对长上下文问答中小型语言模型难以利用输入中已有证据的问题。该方法将检索到的证据片段转换为软注意力监督目标，指导查询侧参数自适应，使模型从完整上下文中生成答案。在六个LongBench QA任务和三个小模型上的实验表明，EASE-TTT在宏平均性能上优于全上下文推理、仅检索基线和查询只测试时训练。
Motivation: 现有方法要么止步于输入级证据暴露，不调整查询侧注意力参数；要么在测试时训练中使用通用自监督目标，无法定位支持答案的上下文位置。
Method: 提出证据对齐的测试时训练框架，将检索到的证据片段转化为软注意力监督目标，用于指导查询侧的注意力参数自适应，模型在原始全上下文中生成答案。
Result: 在六个LongBench QA任务和三个小型解码器语言模型上，宏平均性能最强，优于全上下文推理、仅检索基线和qTTT。
Conclusion: EASE-TTT通过证据对齐的测试时自适应有效提升了长上下文问答性能，且无需替换完整上下文。

papers.title: ActionMap: Robot Policy Learning via Voxel Action Heatmap
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have advanced rapidly across backbones, training recipes, and data scale, yet the action decoder, which converts the backbone's hidden state into a continuous control signal, has barely changed and remains a single-point predictor across the majority of current VLAs. Whether implemented via autoregressive token bins, L1 regression, or flow-matching denoising, the resulting decoder treats the action space as unstructured, leaving the geometric proximity of neighboring actions unexploited during training. To advance this, we introduce ActionMap, a voxel heatmap action head that drops into an existing VLA in place of its native action decoder. For each new action, the head predicts a voxel heatmap over the action space, where each voxel directly stores the probability of the corresponding action. Across LIBERO simulation and real-world Franka manipulation, our heatmap head surpasses two architecturally distinct backbones at matched training steps (e.g., +8.2% over OpenVLA-OFT's L1 regression head on the LIBERO four-suite average), converges at comparable or faster rates on both backbones, and remains markedly more data-efficient at low training data. The cross-backbone consistency indicates that action representation is a real lever for VLA performance, distinct from further backbone or recipe scaling. Project Page: https://github.com/showlab/ActionMap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ActionMap，一种体素热图动作头，用于替换现有 VLA 模型中的单点预测动作解码器，通过将动作空间划分为体素并预测概率热图来利用几何邻近性。在 LIBERO 模拟和真实 Franka 操作上，该方法在多骨干网络上均优于原始解码器（例如在 LIBERO 四套件平均性能上比 OpenVLA-OFT 的 L1 回归头提升 8.2%），且数据效率更高。作者认为动作表示是提升 VLA 性能的关键杠杆。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型的动作解码器大多为单点预测，未利用动作空间的几何邻近性，导致表示效率低下。
Method: 提出基于体素热图的动作头，将动作空间离散化为体素，为每个体素预测概率，从而直接输出分布而非单点。
Result: 在 LIBERO 模拟和真实 Franka 操作中，动作热图头在相同训练步数下优于基线（如 LIBERO 四套件平均 +8.2%），收敛速度相当或更快，且数据效率更高。
Conclusion: 跨骨干网络的一致性表明，动作表示是独立于骨干网络缩放和训练策略的 VLA 性能提升因素，该工作强调动作解码器设计的重要性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在 LIBERO 模拟和真实 Franka 操作中，动作热图头在相同训练步数下优于基线（如 LIBERO 四套件平均 +8.2%），收敛速度相当或更快，且数据效率更高。
summary_sections.conclusion: 跨骨干网络的一致性表明，动作表示是独立于骨干网络缩放和训练策略的 VLA 性能提升因素，该工作强调动作解码器设计的重要性。

papers.title: Beyond Skeletons: Learning Animation Directly from Driving Videos with Same2X Training Strategy
papers.abstract_en: Human image animation aims to generate a video from a static reference image, guided by pose information extracted from a driving video. Existing approaches often rely on pose estimators to extract intermediate representations, but such signals are prone to errors under occlusion or complex poses. Building on these observations, we present DirectAnimator, a framework that bypasses pose extraction and directly learns from raw driving videos. We introduce a Driving Cue Triplet consisting of pose, face, and location cues that captures motion, expression, and alignment in a semantically rich yet stable form, and we fuse them through a CueFusion DiT block for reliable control during denoising. To make learning dependable when the driving and reference identities differ, we devise a Same2X training strategy that aligns cross-ID features with those learned from same-ID data, regularizing optimization and accelerating convergence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DirectAnimator attains state-of-the-art visual quality and identity preservation while remaining robust to occlusions and complex articulation, and it does so with fewer computational resources. Our project page is at https://directanimator.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DirectAnimator 框架，直接从驱动视频学习人体动画，无需姿态提取。通过驾驶线索三元组（姿态、面部、位置线索）和 CueFusion DiT 模块融合，以及 Same2X 训练策略，在身份保持和视觉质量上达到最先进水平，且计算资源更少。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖姿态估计器提取中间表示，在遮挡或复杂姿态下易出错。
Method: DirectAnimator 绕过姿态提取，使用驾驶线索三元组并通过 CueFusion DiT 模块融合；引入 Same2X 训练策略，对齐跨身份特征与同身份数据，正则化优化并加速收敛。
Result: 实验表明 DirectAnimator 在视觉质量和身份保持上达到 SOTA，对遮挡和复杂关节运动鲁棒，且计算资源更少。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法无需姿态提取，直接从驱动视频学习动画，具有鲁棒性和高效性。

papers.title: TALAN: Task-Aligned Latent Adaptation Networks for Targeted Post-Training of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Targeted post-training aims to improve reasoning, math, and code without degrading strengths. Low-rank adapters are efficient but task-global; activation interventions are input-aware but often require separate probes, vectors, or inference-time steering. We introduce TALAN (Task-Aligned Latent Adaptation Networks), a sequence-conditioned latent side path inserted into a transformer's residual stream and co-trained with a low-rank adapter in one SFT loop. TALAN compresses the active sequence into latent memory, remixes it into token-level perturbations, and writes them back through a controlled residual update. It is configured along six axes: insertion location, memory size, mixer, writeback rule, trainability scope, and gradient scale. Across four Qwen3-family backbones and four STEM/code benchmarks, TALAN improves matched LoRA and DoRA baselines. With LoRA, it yields a +1.41 point cross-model mean gain, positive on all four backbones and non-negative on all 16 model-benchmark cells. With DoRA, it yields a +1.85 point mean gain, positive on all backbones and on 13 of 16 cells. Paired seed checks support positive average effects but show nontrivial variance, so we treat them as sensitivity checks. Cost is small: <1% trainable parameters relative to the backbone and 1.01-1.02x inference overhead versus matched LoRA. A Llama-3.2-1B transfer probe is also positive under LoRA and rsLoRA across seven paired seeds, supporting a transfer beyond Qwen. Internal-state analyses suggest TALAN is a small complementary activation intervention. The matched adapter update is 80-1,700x larger than the TALAN perturbation, yet their directions have near-zero cosine; per-layer measurements show this small orthogonal perturbation propagates and amplifies through depth. TALAN offers a practical platform for studying steerable activation-level adaptation within standard adapter-based post-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TALAN（任务对齐潜在适配网络），一种在 Transformer 残差流中插入的序列条件潜在旁路，与低秩适配器联合训练，旨在提升定向后期训练中推理、数学和代码能力而不损害已有优势。在 Qwen3 系列和 STEM/code 基准上，TALAN 在 LoRA 和 DoRA 基线上分别获得平均 +1.41 和 +1.85 点的改进，且额外参数少于 1%，推理开销仅 1.01-1.02 倍。内部状态分析表明其扰动小而正交，随深度放大。
Motivation: 现有低秩适配器是任务全局的，而激活干预虽具有输入感知性但常需独立探针或推理时引导。目标是将输入感知的激活级适应融入标准适配器训练框架，以协同提升定向后期训练效果。
Method: TALAN 在 Transformer 残差流中插入一个序列条件的潜在旁路，将活动序列压缩为潜在记忆，重新混合为词元级扰动，并通过受控残差更新写回。配置涉及插入位置、记忆大小、混合器、写回规则、可训练范围和梯度缩放六个维度，并与低秩适配器（LoRA/DoRA）在一个 SFT 循环中共同训练。
Result: 在 Qwen3 系列四个骨干和四个 STEM/code 基准上，TALAN 匹配 LoRA 时跨模型平均提升 +1.41 点，所有骨干均为正，16 个模型-基准单元非负；匹配 DoRA 时平均提升 +1.85 点，13/16 为正。额外参数 <1%，推理开销 1.01-1.02x。在 Llama-3.2-1B 上的迁移探测也为正。
Conclusion: TALAN 提供了一种实用平台，可在标准适配器后期训练中研究可引导的激活级适应，其小幅度正交扰动随深度传播放大，与主适配器更新方向几乎正交。

papers.title: LUCID: Learning Unified Control for Image Deflaring and Exposure Mastery in Nighttime Photography
papers.abstract_en: Photography is the art of painting with light, yet nighttime scenes are shaped by competing degradations: intense flares obscure scene structure, while photon-limited regions collapse into noise. Conventional approaches address these factors in isolation, overlooking the fact that these degradations are fundamentally entangled. To bridge this gap, we introduce LUCID, a unified framework that reframes nighttime restoration as a continuous and controllable process rather than a fixed correction. We decompose nighttime restoration into two cooperative components: a flare disentanglement module that lifts the 'curtain' of optical artifacts to provide reliable structural guidance, and a diffusion-driven module that leverages generative priors to reconstruct clean and well-exposed imagery. Crucially, LUCID introduces explicit controllability through a novel four-mode training strategy, enabling users to steer the restoration process via classifier-free guidance (CFG) and allowing selective control over light sources and their associated flare and ghosting artifacts, while also supporting high dynamic range (HDR) reconstruction through continuous exposure control. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LUCID consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across diverse real-world nighttime scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LUCID，一个统一的夜间摄影去眩光与曝光控制框架。它将夜间图像恢复建模为连续可控过程，包含眩光解缠模块和扩散驱动模块，并通过四模式训练策略实现用户对光源、眩光伪影及高动态范围重建的显式控制。实验表明该方法在多种真实夜间场景中优于现有方法。
Motivation: 夜间摄影中强烈的眩光与光子不足区域的噪声相互纠缠，现有方法孤立处理这些退化，忽略了其根本上的耦合性。
Method: 将夜间恢复分解为两个协同组件：一个眩光解缠模块去除光学伪影以提供可靠结构指导，一个扩散驱动模块利用生成先验重建干净且曝光良好的图像。通过新颖的四模式训练策略引入显式可控性，利用无分类器引导（CFG）让用户选择性控制光源及其关联的眩光和鬼影伪影，并支持通过连续曝光控制实现高动态范围（HDR）重建。
Result: 在多种真实夜间场景中，LUCID 持续优于现有方法。
Conclusion: LUCID 将夜间恢复视为连续可控过程而非固定校正，实现了对去眩光和曝光控制的统一框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Lighting-Aware Representation Learning under Controllable Lighting Variation
papers.abstract_en: Variations in illumination remain a major challenge for visual representation learning, as they induce substantial appearance changes both across and within environments. While existing approaches typically address this issue through data augmentations that encourage models to become invariant to lighting changes, such strategies do not explicitly model lighting information during learning. Inspired by theories of human vision, we propose a lighting-aware representation learning framework that incorporates illumination variation as an explicit training signal rather than a nuisance factor to be suppressed. Our method extends contrastive learning by introducing an auxiliary objective that captures illumination-dependent variation in rendered scenes, enabling the model to jointly learn representations that preserve semantic consistency while remaining sensitive to lighting-dependent visual structure. We evaluate the proposed model on image classification and object detection tasks across the ImageNet, ExDark, and PASCAL VOC benchmarks. Results demonstrate that the proposed lighting-aware training consistently improves downstream performance over standard contrastive learning baselines, while maintaining the same architecture and training budget. Furthermore, our approach shows promising performance in supervised learning frameworks and under settings involving simpler lighting variation, suggesting broad applicability beyond complex illumination scenarios. These results indicate its potential to enhance model robustness and adaptability in complex visual environments as well as in more conventional image processing tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对光照变化导致的视觉外观变化，提出一种光照感知表示学习框架，在对比学习中引入捕获光照变化的辅助目标，联合学习语义一致且对光照敏感的表示。在ImageNet、ExDark和PASCAL VOC上的分类和检测任务中，该方法优于标准对比学习基线，并保持相同架构和训练预算。
Motivation: 现有方法通常通过数据增强使模型对光照变化不变，但未显式建模光照信息；受人类视觉理论启发，将光照变化作为显式训练信号而非噪声。
Method: 扩展对比学习，引入辅助目标来捕获渲染场景中的光照依赖变化，使模型同时学习保持语义一致性和对光照结构的敏感性。
Result: 在ImageNet、ExDark和PASCAL VOC的图像分类和物体检测任务上，该方法一致提升了下游性能，且不增加训练预算。
Conclusion: 方法在复杂光照场景下增强模型鲁棒性，并在简单光照设置及监督学习中也表现良好，具有广泛适用性。

papers.title: Workflow-to-Skill: Skill Creation via Routing-Workflow-Semantics-Attachments Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents increasingly rely on Skills to encode procedural knowledge, yet high-quality Skills remain costly to hand-write. This paper studies automatic Skill construction from heterogeneous interaction evidence, including demonstrations, agent trajectories, tool traces, and execution logs. We argue that trace-to-skill construction is not simple summarization tasks, because traces are fragmented, redundant, and may miss rare but safety-critical behaviors. To address this, we introduce RWSA, a workflow-oriented intermediate representation that decomposes Skills into Workflow structure, execution Semantics, and runtime Attachments, capturing task decomposition, control flow, verification, safety, rollback, and state management. Building on RWSA, we propose W2S, a framework that segments traces, induces local Skill drafts, aligns shared structures, reconciles branches, and compresses redundancy while preserving evidence and confidence annotations. Experiments on 70 Skills show that W2S improves behavioral replay consistency by 10.5% over summarization- and prompting-based baselines, highlighting the need to treat traces as executable runtime specifications rather than compressible text.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文研究从异构交互证据（如演示、轨迹、工具痕迹和执行日志）自动构建技能（Skills）的问题。作者指出痕迹到技能的转换不是简单的摘要任务，因为痕迹碎片化、冗余且可能遗漏安全关键行为。为此，提出工作流导向的中间表示 RWSA，将技能分解为工作流结构、执行语义和运行时附件，并基于此构建 W2S 框架，通过分段对齐、合并分支、去冗余等步骤生成技能。实验表明 W2S 在 70 个技能上相比摘要和提示方法行为回放一致性提升 10.5%。
Motivation: 高质量技能的人工编写成本高昂，而现有自动构建方法将痕迹当作可压缩文本而非可执行规约，导致行为一致性差。
Method: 提出 RWSA 中间表示，将技能分解为工作流结构（Workflow）、执行语义（Semantics）和运行时附件（Attachments）；并设计 W2S 框架，包括痕迹分段、局部技能草稿生成、共享结构对齐、分支调和以及冗余压缩，同时保留证据和置信度标注。
Result: 在 70 个技能上，W2S 的行为回放一致性（behavioral replay consistency）相比基于摘要和提示的基线提升 10.5%。
Conclusion: 应将痕迹视为可执行的运行时规约而非可压缩文本，以提升自动技能构建的可靠性和一致性。
