papers.title: GRASP: Geometry-aware Residual Alignment for Scalable Pretraining Data Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Scalable data attribution methods typically assign isolated utility scores to individual training examples. This prevalent additive assumption fundamentally fails to capture critical subset dynamics, including data redundancy and complementary coverage. In this work, we reframe attribution as subset-level counterfactual utility prediction and introduce GRASP, an interaction-aware surrogate. Grounded in a theoretical smoothness lower bound, GRASP explicitly models subset interactions through a quadratic geometric penalty. To achieve pretraining-scale efficiency without relying on hidden oracle tuning, we couple low-dimensional feature sketches with a strictly finite lower-confidence bound selection protocol. Extensive subset-retraining evaluations demonstrate that GRASP decisively outperforms existing scalable baselines. It more than doubles the task-level rank correlation for counterfactual subset fidelity while reducing upfront artifact construction costs by nearly an order of magnitude. Downstream diagnostics further show that this scoring mechanism transfers to language model curation and cross-domain vision selection, establishing a robust foundation for optimizing massive pretraining corpora.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GRASP，一种几何感知的残差对齐方法，用于可扩展的预训练数据归因。该方法将归重视为子集级别的反事实效用预测，通过二次几何惩罚显式建模子集交互，利用低维特征草图和有限下置信界选择协议实现预训练规模效率。实验表明，GRASP在反事实子集保真度上显著优于现有基线，任务级秩相关提升一倍以上，同时构建成本降低近一个数量级。
Motivation: 现有可扩展数据归因方法通常为每个训练示例分配独立的效用分数，这种加性假设无法捕捉子集动态，如数据冗余和互补覆盖。
Method: 提出交互感知的代理GRASP，基于理论平滑下界，通过二次几何惩罚建模子集交互；耦合低维特征草图和严格有限下置信界选择协议，避免依赖隐藏的oracle调优。
Result: 在大量子集重训练评估中，GRASP显著优于现有可扩展基线，反事实子集保真度的任务级秩相关提升超过一倍，前期构建成本降低近一个数量级。下游诊断表明该机制可迁移到语言模型策展和跨域视觉选择。
Conclusion: GRASP为优化大规模预训练语料库建立了一个鲁棒基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stream3D-VLM: Online 3D Spatial Understanding with Incremental Geometry Priors
papers.abstract_en: Despite advances in 3D scene understanding, existing 3D Large Multimodal Models operate in offline settings, requiring complete scene observations or predefined video clips. In this paper, we present an online 3D vision-language model that enables real-time spatial understanding from streaming video. Our approach adopts an autoregressive streaming control modeling based on the LLM's next-token prediction objective to learn when to respond, and employs a lightweight Visual-Spatial Feature Integration (VSFI) module to incrementally inject temporally aligned geometry priors into the visual stream. To alleviate long-context decoding overhead, we propose a plug-and-play Geometry-Adaptive Voxel Compression (GAVC) module for efficient visual token compression. To address the scarcity of streaming 3D-language data, we further develop a scalable data generation pipeline that curates over 1M online spatio-temporal 3D QA pairs and establishes a comprehensive benchmark spanning 29 tasks. Extensive experiments show that our approach significantly outperforms both proprietary and open-source models across online and offline 3D spatial understanding, reasoning, and grounding tasks. The project page is available at https://stream3d-vlm.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Stream3D-VLM，一个在线3D视觉语言模型，能够从流式视频中实时理解三维空间。模型采用自回归流式控制，基于LLM的下一token预测目标学习何时响应，并使用轻量级视觉-空间特征融合模块增量注入时间对齐的几何先验。通过几何自适应体素压缩模块减少长上下文解码开销，并构建了超过100万在线时空3D QA对的数据集及29个任务的基准。实验表明，该方法在在线和离线3D空间理解、推理和定位任务上显著优于现有模型。
Motivation: 现有3D大语言模型仅支持离线设置，需要完整场景或预定义视频片段，无法处理实时流式视频中的三维空间理解。
Method: 采用自回归流式控制建模，结合轻量级视觉-空间特征融合模块增量注入时间对齐的几何先验，并提出几何自适应体素压缩模块用于高效视觉token压缩。
Result: 在在线和离线3D空间理解、推理和定位任务上，显著优于专有和开源模型。
Conclusion: Stream3D-VLM实现了实时流式视频的三维空间理解，有效解决了长上下文解码开销问题。

papers.title: Diagnosing Visual Ignorance in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) frequently rely on language priors, producing confident answers that are weakly grounded in visual evidence. While this behavior is widely observed, its internal mechanisms and its impact on benchmark evaluation remain insufficiently understood. In this work, we study language-prior reliance from both mechanistic and behavioral perspectives. Internally, we combine counterfactual layer replacement with supervised layer-wise MLP probing to trace how ground-truth visual semantics and language-prior semantics compete across the language decoder. Our analysis reveals a multi-stage bottleneck: intermediate layers often fail to effectively retrieve visual information, while later layers can further suppress surviving visual signals in favor of text-space biases. Externally, we introduce a progressive visual decay metric based on multi-step Gaussian blurring, which identifies instances whose answers remain invariant even as visual content is increasingly destroyed. Across twelve visual question-answering benchmarks and three representative VLMs, we find that a substantial fraction of examples remain answerable under severe or total visual obfuscation, indicating that current benchmarks can inadvertently reward visual ignorance. These findings demonstrate that language-prior reliance is a systematic routing failure affecting both model internals and benchmark validity. Finally, we outline critical pathways for future research, highlighting the necessity of designing training distributions and evaluation protocols built on structurally isolated or counterfactual data to enforce genuine cross-modal grounding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）在回答时依赖语言先验而忽略视觉证据的现象。通过机制分析（反事实层替换和逐层MLP探针）揭示了语言解码器中视觉语义与语言先验语义的竞争过程，并发现中间层难以有效检索视觉信息，后续层可能进一步抑制视觉信号。外部实验使用多步高斯模糊的渐进视觉退化指标，发现大量样本在视觉信息被严重或完全破坏后仍能被正确回答，表明当前基准无法有效惩罚视觉忽视。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型常依赖语言先验产生弱视觉依据的自信回答，但其内部机制及对基准评估的影响尚不明确。
Method: 结合反事实层替换与监督逐层MLP探针分析语言解码器内部竞争；提出基于多步高斯模糊的渐进视觉退化指标，评估模型在视觉信息破坏下的回答不变性。
Result: 在12个VQA基准和3个VLM上，大量样本在严重或完全视觉模糊下仍可回答，证明语言先验依赖是系统性路由失败，且当前基准无意中奖励了视觉忽视。
Conclusion: 语言先验依赖是影响模型内部和基准有效性的系统性问题，未来需设计基于结构隔离或反事实数据的训练和评估协议以强制真实跨模态对齐。

papers.title: Data-Constrained Language Model Pretraining: Improved Regularization and Scaling Laws
papers.abstract_en: Classical scaling laws for language model pretraining balance model size against training dataset size under a fixed compute budget, assuming abundant data and a single pass over the corpus. As training compute grows faster than the supply of natural language data, pretraining is likely to enter a data-constrained, compute-rich regime where models train for multiple epochs over a finite dataset. We study data-constrained pretraining along two axes, regularization and scaling. For regularization, we study masked-input regularization (MIR), an auxiliary next-token prediction loss on randomly masked inputs. MIR tests whether the random masking central to diffusion language models can benefit autoregressive pretraining without architectural changes or inference overhead. Across 72M to 1.4B parameter models, we find that MIR added on top of strong weight decay improves validation loss over autoregressive strong-weight-decay-only models, with downstream gains at 1.4B. For scaling, we propose SoftQ, a scaling law that couples model size and data size to capture their interaction under repeated data. Classical alternatives such as the Chinchilla law use an additive form that decouples these terms, making them misspecified in the data-constrained regime. We find that SoftQ fits data-constrained experiments substantially better than these alternatives, and estimates MIR's gains as equivalent to roughly 1.3 times as much unique training data. We release our code at https://github.com/yixinw-lab/dc_pretrain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究数据受限条件下语言模型预训练的正则化与缩放定律。提出掩码输入正则化（MIR）作为辅助损失，在强权重衰减基础上持续改善验证损失，并在1.4B模型上带来下游任务增益；同时提出SoftQ缩放定律，在数据受限场景下优于Chinchilla定律，并估算MIR的增益相当于约1.3倍独特训练数据。
Motivation: 经典缩放定律假设数据充足且单次遍历，但实际中训练计算增长快于数据供应，预训练将进入数据受限、计算充裕的多轮训练阶段，现有正则化和缩放定律在此场景下表现不足。
Method: 提出两种方法：1) 掩码输入正则化（MIR），在自回归预训练中增加随机掩码输入的辅助下一token预测损失，无需架构修改或推理开销；2) SoftQ缩放定律，耦合模型大小和数据大小以捕捉重复数据下的交互效应。
Result: 在72M至1.4B参数模型上，MIR结合强权重衰减比单独使用强权重衰减改善了验证损失，1.4B模型上取得下游任务收益；SoftQ对数据受限实验的拟合显著优于Chinchilla等替代方案，且估算MIR带来的收益相当于约1.3倍独特训练数据。
Conclusion: MIR是一种有效的数据受限正则化方法，SoftQ缩放定律能更准确描述数据受限下的扩展行为，两者共同为未来数据稀缺环境下的预训练提供指导。

papers.title: ARAPDiffusion: ARAP Regularization for Diffusion-Based Deformable Shape Space Learning
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces ARAPDiffusion, a latent diffusion model to learn the underlying continuous shape space of a deformation shape collection. The key innovation is in injecting the as-rigid-as-possible (ARAP) deformation model as regularization losses into latent diffusion (LD), releasing the requirement of having abundant 3D training data for learning generative models. In contrast to the standard LD, we show how the ARAP model can be used to improve both the encoder/decoder and the LD model. The training procedure alternates between using the synthetic distribution defined by the LD model to develop a regularization loss that enhances the shape encoder/decoder and using the shape decoder to develop a regularization loss to improve the LD model. We also show the benefit of the LD paradigm in combining a representation-free LD process and an implicit shape decoder that is applicable to unorganized point clouds. The experimental results of unconditional and conditional shape generation demonstrate the advantages of ARAPDiffusion over baseline approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ARAPDiffusion，一种结合了尽可能刚性（ARAP）变形模型作为正则化损失的潜在扩散模型，用于从变形形状集合中学习连续形状空间。该方法通过交替使用LD模型生成的合成分布来增强形状编码器/解码器，并利用形状解码器改进LD模型，从而减少对大量3D训练数据的依赖。实验表明，在无条件与条件形状生成任务上，ARAPDiffusion优于基线方法。
Motivation: 现有生成模型在3D形状数据稀缺时难以学习变形形状的连续空间，需要大量训练数据。
Method: 在潜在扩散模型中注入ARAP变形正则化损失，交替优化编码器/解码器和LD模型：LD模型生成合成分布以正则化编码器/解码器，解码器反向正则化LD模型。
Result: 在无条件与条件形状生成实验中，ARAPDiffusion相比基线方法取得更优性能。
Conclusion: ARAP正则化能有效减少对大量3D训练数据的需求，并适用于无序点云。

papers.title: FreeAnimate: Training-Free Human Image Animation with Preview-Guided Denoising
papers.abstract_en: Human Image Animation has seen significant advancements, primarily driven by diffusion models. However, existing methods typically demand substantial training data and resources to achieve high-quality results, limiting generalization and accessibility. In this work, we introduce \emph{FreeAnimate}, a training-free framework that leverages the inherent capabilities of image diffusion models to enable temporal consistency, identity preservation, and background stability. Our approach incorporates a novel preview generation strategy that provides temporal and structural priors from generated preview frames, effectively guiding pose alignment and background consistency without training. Additionally, FreeAnimate introduces Inversion-Boosted Attention and Reference-Anchored Self-Attention modules to guarantee temporal consistency and identity preservation. Experimental results demonstrate that FreeAnimate outperforms existing training-free competitors and training-based baseline methods, achieving generation quality comparable to state-of-the-art methods and offering robust generalization across diverse datasets. Our project page is at https://freeani.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FreeAnimate，一个无需训练的人类图像动画框架，利用图像扩散模型的内在能力实现时间一致性、身份保持和背景稳定。该方法通过预览生成策略提供时间和结构先验，指导姿态对齐和背景一致性；同时引入 Inversion-Boosted Attention 和 Reference-Anchored Self-Attention 模块。实验表明，FreeAnimate 在无需训练的方法中表现最优，并可与训练方法媲美。
Motivation: 现有基于扩散模型的人类图像动画方法通常需要大量训练数据和资源，限制了泛化性和可获取性。本文旨在开发一个无需训练的框架，仅利用现有扩散模型的固有能力来生成高质量动画。
Method: FreeAnimate 包含预览生成策略、Inversion-Boosted Attention 和 Reference-Anchored Self-Attention 模块。预览生成从生成的预览帧中提取时间和结构先验，指导后续降噪过程；注意力模块则分别增强时间一致性和身份保持。
Result: 在多个数据集上，FreeAnimate 优于现有的无需训练方法和基于训练的方法，生成质量与最先进方法相当，并展现出良好的泛化能力。
Conclusion: FreeAnimate 证明了无需额外训练即可利用图像扩散模型进行人类图像动画的可行性，为降低资源需求提供了新思路。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: FreeAnimate 包含预览生成策略、Inversion-Boosted Attention 和 Reference-Anchored Self-Attention 模块。预览生成从生成的预览帧中提取时间和结构先验，指导后续降噪过程；注意力模块则分别增强时间一致性和身份保持。
summary_sections.result: 在多个数据集上，FreeAnimate 优于现有的无需训练方法和基于训练的方法，生成质量与最先进方法相当，并展现出良好的泛化能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: FreeAnimate 证明了无需额外训练即可利用图像扩散模型进行人类图像动画的可行性，为降低资源需求提供了新思路。

papers.title: GlucoFM-Bench: Benchmarking Time-Series Foundation Models for Blood Glucose Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Blood glucose forecasting models are foundational for modern diabetes management systems, as reliable short-term predictions can enable proactive interventions, support automated insulin delivery, and reduce the risk of hypo- and hyperglycemic events. From a modeling perspective, glucose forecasting poses unique challenges due to heterogeneous physiological dynamics across diabetes populations. Traditional machine learning and deep learning models have been extensively evaluated for glucose prediction, yet recent time-series foundation models (TSFMs) remain much less studied in this setting. To bridge this gap, we present GlucoFM-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark evaluating state-of-the-art TSFMs alongside supervised deep learning models for blood glucose forecasting. We assess eight representative architectures, including pre-trained TSFMs, time-series large language models, and task-specific deep learning models, across 15 publicly available diabetes-relevant datasets comprising 1,117 individuals with type 1 diabetes, type 2 diabetes, prediabetes, and no diabetes. Models are evaluated under zero-shot, few-shot, and full-shot protocols, with systematic variation in context length and prediction horizon. Across datasets, pre-trained TSFMs, especially Chronos-2 and TimesFM, show strong zero-shot and few-shot transfer, with the best zero-shot model performing within 5% of the best full-shot supervised model. Yet, when task-specific data are abundant, a lightweight LSTM remains strongest, outperforming TSFMs by 4--21% under full-shot training. Stratified analyses reveal persistent challenges in T1D cohorts and hypo-/hyperglycemic ranges, highlighting the need for evaluation beyond aggregate error metrics. Together, GlucoFM-Bench provides a standardized and reproducible foundation for evaluating, comparing, and improving foundation models for blood glucose forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GlucoFM-Bench是一个针对血糖预测的时间序列基础模型（TSFM）的综合基准。它评估了8种代表性架构（包括预训练TSFM、时间序列大语言模型和任务特定深度学习模型）在15个糖尿病相关数据集上的表现，涵盖零样本、少样本和全样本设置。结果显示预训练TSFM（如Chronos-2和TimesFM）在零样本和少样本迁移中表现强劲，但全样本下轻量级LSTM仍最优，并指出T1D和极端血糖范围的预测挑战。
Motivation: 血糖预测对糖尿病管理至关重要，但时间序列基础模型在该场景下研究不足。现有评估缺乏标准化基准，难以比较不同模型的迁移能力和任务特定性能。
Method: 构建GlucoFM-Bench基准，系统评估8种模型（预训练TSFM、时间序列LLM、深度学习模型）在15个数据集上的零样本、少样本和全样本性能，并变化上下文长度和预测水平。
Result: 最佳零样本模型（Chronos-2、TimesFM）性能在最优全样本监督模型的5%以内；全样本下轻量级LSTM仍优于TSFM 4-21%。分层分析显示T1D和低/高血糖范围预测仍困难。
Conclusion: GlucoFM-Bench为血糖预测的TSFM评估提供了标准化基础，强调需关注极端血糖范围和不同糖尿病类型的性能差异，而不仅仅是平均误差。

papers.title: A Cross-view Fusion Framework for Robust 6-DoF Grasp Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we propose a cross-view fusion framework that enhances the robustness of 6-DoF grasp pose estimation in corner views. Our framework alleviates occlusion by incorporating an auxiliary view and avoids the time-consuming, task-agnostic multi-view reconstruction through a post-fusion strategy. To enhance cross-view fusion, we propose a self-supervised contrastive learning strategy that leverages cross-view associations to regularize point cloud features. In brief, a cross-view point pair is considered a match if the two points correspond to the same 3D location, and a non-match if they represent distinct grasp directions. The learning strategy significantly enhances the spatial consistency and direction distinctiveness of point features, thereby facilitating cross-view fusion and improving estimation robustness. Furthermore, we propose a cross-view-aligned cylinder integration module to fuse grasp-relevant geometry into a comprehensive representation. Specifically, the module first aligns the cross-view points and features according to their similarity to enhance the robustness against noise. Subsequently, these points are registered into the cylindrical coordinate frame, emphasizing the rotation-symmetric geometry which is important for grasping. Finally, local self-attention and seed cross-attention layers are alternately employed, respectively enabling interactions within single views and across views, which supports fine-grained representation of grasp-relevant geometry. Our framework achieves strong performance on the GraspNet-1Billion benchmark and in real-world applications. Code is available at https://github.com/KJZhuAutomatic/Cross-view-Grasp.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种跨视角融合框架，用于增强角落视角下6自由度抓取姿态估计的鲁棒性。通过引入辅助视角缓解遮挡，并采用后融合策略避免耗时的多视角重建。提出自监督对比学习策略，利用跨视角关联正则化点云特征，增强空间一致性和方向区分性。进一步提出跨视角对齐圆柱体集成模块，融合抓取相关几何信息，在GraspNet-1Billion基准和真实世界应用中取得强性能。
Motivation: 角落视图下的6自由度抓取姿态估计存在严重遮挡问题，现有方法依赖多视角重建但耗时且任务无关，需要一种轻量鲁棒的融合策略。
Method: 提出跨视角融合框架，包含自监督对比学习（匹配同一3D位置的点对为正样本，不同抓取方向的点对为负样本）和跨视角对齐圆柱体集成模块（先根据相似性对齐点云与特征，再注册到圆柱坐标系强调旋转对称几何，交替使用局部自注意力和种子交叉注意力）。
Result: 在GraspNet-1Billion基准和真实世界应用中取得强性能（具体数值未在摘要中给出）。
Conclusion: 该框架通过跨视角对比学习和圆柱体集成有效提升遮挡场景下的抓取估计鲁棒性，代码已开源。

papers.title: Neuro-Symbolic Learning for Long-Horizon Task Planning Under Complex Logical Constraints
papers.abstract_en: Task planning often suffers from severe efficiency bottlenecks when robots must reason over long-horizon action sequences under complex logical constraints, including object affordances, spatial relationships, and sequential action dependencies. Recent neuro-symbolic methods improve planning efficiency by learning object-importance scores to prune task-irrelevant objects, but they typically rely on fixed offline supervision generated from full search spaces. This creates a train-test mismatch: at deployment, the planner operates in pruned search spaces induced by the model's own imperfect predictions, leading to exposure bias and degraded planning performance. To address this challenge, we formulate object-importance learning for task planning as an imperative learning-based bilevel optimization problem. The upper level optimizes a neural scorer, while the lower level solves a symbolic planning problem in the score-pruned search space. To stabilize this learning process, we introduce a 3R strategy into the lower-level planning, using parallel Repair, Restart, and Rollback recovery to provide reliable and adaptive feedback for upper-level learning. Experiments on three challenging benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, including an 80.04% reduction in failure rate and a 57.14% reduction in planning time. We further validate the framework on a quadruped-based mobile manipulator in simulation and the real world, demonstrating its potential for efficient and deployable neuro-symbolic task planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对机器人长时域任务规划中复杂逻辑约束下的效率瓶颈，提出一种基于命令式学习（imperative learning）的双层优化方法，将对象重要性评分学习形式化，并通过3R策略（Repair, Restart, Rollback）稳定训练。实验表明在三个基准上失败率降低80.04%，规划时间减少57.14%，并在四足移动机械臂上验证了真实世界部署能力。
Motivation: 现有神经符号方法依赖固定离线监督，导致训练和测试时的搜索空间不匹配，产生暴露偏差，降低规划性能。
Method: 将对象重要性学习建模为命令式学习的双层优化问题，上层优化神经评分器，下层在评分修剪后的搜索空间中求解符号规划问题，并引入并行修复、重启、回滚（3R）策略以稳定学习。
Result: 在三个基准上取得最优性能，失败率降低80.04%，规划时间减少57.14%；在仿真和真实世界四足移动机械臂上验证有效性。
Conclusion: 提出一种可部署的神经符号任务规划框架，通过命令式学习和3R策略有效缓解暴露偏差，显著提升规划效率和鲁棒性。

papers.title: Unified Safe In-context Image Generation in Multimodal Diffusion Transformers via Restricting Unsafe Information Flows
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) equipped with multimodal attention (MM-Attn) have become a dominant paradigm for image generation. However, preventing the generation of harmful content remains a critical challenge, particularly in image-to-image (I2I) editing tasks. Existing safety mechanisms are primarily designed for text-to-image (T2I) synthesis or U-Net-based architectures, which limits their effectiveness for unified safety mitigation in DiT-based frameworks. To bridge this gap, we propose Unified Visual Safety Regulator (UVR), a training-free safe generation framework that regulates unsafe semantics in generated images. UVR is grounded in an analysis of attention dynamics from the perspective of information flow in MM-Attn. We identify a task-independent start-up stage, during which unsafe semantics in output patches rapidly emerge and can be accurately localized, followed by task-specific semantic amplification and interference stages, where harmful signals are further propagated and entangled with benign content. Based on these observations, UVR mitigates unsafe generation through unified, targeted attention modulation and explicit restriction of harmful information flow over the identified unsafe output patches. Experiments across various concepts show that UVR achieves state-of-the-art safety performance by achieving 91% and 77% erase rate in image synthesis and editing tasks, while preserving visual quality and fidelity with minimal degradation. Code is available at https://github.com/deng12yx/UVR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态扩散Transformer（DiT）中的图像生成安全问题，提出了一种无需训练的安全生成框架UVR。通过分析多模态注意力中的信息流，识别出任务无关的启动阶段和任务相关的语义放大阶段，并据此通过注意力调制和限制有害信息流来抑制不安全内容的生成。实验表明，UVR在图像合成和编辑任务中分别达到91%和77%的擦除率，同时保持视觉质量。
Motivation: 现有安全机制主要针对文生图模型或U-Net架构，对基于DiT的框架（尤其是图像到图像编辑任务）效果有限，亟需统一的安全缓解方法。
Method: 提出UVR框架，基于多模态注意力中信息流的分析，通过识别不安全输出块并实施有针对性的注意力调制和显式限制有害信息流来实现安全生成。
Result: 在多种概念上，UVR在图像合成和编辑任务中分别达到91%和77%的擦除率，优于现有方法，且视觉质量退化极小。
Conclusion: UVR提供了一种无需训练且统一的安全生成方法，适用于DiT框架下的文生图和图生图任务，但实验局限在特定概念和测试场景。

papers.title: EgoPressDiff: Multimodal Video Diffusion for Egocentric UV-Domain Hand-Pressure Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Estimating hand-surface contact pressure from an egocentric view is crucial for AR/VR devices, robotic imitation, and ergonomic analysis. Existing methods often discretize pressure signal and process frames independently, leading to quantization errors and temporal inconsistencies. We present \emph{EgoPressDiff}, a conditional video diffusion framework that generates UV-pressure maps from visual input. The core of our approach is a multi-modal conditioning strategy, introducing a PoseNet and a Vertex Encoder to efficiently extract features from hand pose and 3D mesh vertices. These signals, along with depth information, guide the generative process to ensure the pressure fields are physically grounded. To effectively fuse these heterogeneous features, we further propose a Distribution-Calibrated Spatial Layer, which aligns their statistical properties before combination. Evaluated on the EgoPressure ego-view setting, EgoPressDiff achieves state-of-the-art results, improving Volumetric IoU by over 34\% relative to prior baseline, while reducing MAE and maintaining high temporal accuracy. Our project page is at https://egopressdiff.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EgoPressDiff，一个条件视频扩散框架，用于从第一人称视角的视觉输入生成 UV 域手部压力图。通过多模态条件策略（包括手部姿态和3D网格顶点特征）以及分布校准空间层实现特征融合，在 EgoPressure 数据集上取得了最先进的结果，Volumetric IoU 相比基线提升超过 34%。
Motivation: 现有方法将压力信号离散化并独立处理帧，导致量化误差和时间不一致性，需要更精确且时间一致的手部接触压力估计方法。
Method: 提出 EgoPressDiff 条件视频扩散框架，包括 PoseNet 和 Vertex Encoder 提取手部姿态和3D网格顶点特征，结合深度信息引导生成；并引入分布校准空间层（Distribution-Calibrated Spatial Layer）对齐异构特征的统计属性后进行融合。
Result: 在 EgoPressure 数据集上，EgoPressDiff 在 Volumetric IoU 上相比基线提升超过 34%，同时降低了 MAE 并保持了高时间精度。
Conclusion: 多模态条件视频扩散框架有效提升了第一人称视角下手部压力估计的准确性和时间一致性，通过分布校准融合策略增强了物理基础。

papers.title: Evidence-Grounded Ensemble Diagnosis of 802.11 Packet Captures: A Multi-Stage Pipeline with Deterministic Reliability Scoring
papers.abstract_en: Diagnosing 802.11 packet captures requires expert protocol knowledge, is slow, inconsistent across engineers, and unscalable. LLM-based approaches sound plausible but fabricate protocol events absent from captures (especially truncated traces), produce uncalibrated confidence scores, and suffer evaluation bias when golden references are co-produced by the model under test. We introduce PROBE (Protocol Reasoning Over evidence-Based Ensembles), a multi-stage pipeline addressing all three failures. It integrates (i) deterministic PCAP-to-text normalization with frame-level verifiability, (ii) multi-run, multi-candidate ensembles with optional cross-model second opinion and progressive obfuscation, (iii) a verdict-aware evidence framework treating absence of failure evidence as contributing evidence, and (iv) a fully deterministic composite reliability score from evidence validity, run-to-run stability, and cross-model agreement without LLM self-assessment. On 87 enterprise Wi-Fi captures (104 capture-reviewer pairs), single-pass LLM analysis raises weighted evidence F1 from 0.871 (expert baseline) to 0.912 but misses critical frames in 35% of cases. Naive ensemble voting drops below baseline (0.842) as majority voting amplifies conservative verdicts: 50% of confirmed failures are misclassified as 'no issue' or 'insufficient evidence.' Adding evidence-grounded reconciliation achieves 0.957 F1, a 96% auto-accept rate, and a worst-case floor above 0.70. LLM self-reported confidence clusters at 0.95 regardless of difficulty (71% report exactly 0.95), confirming it is uninformative. We also introduce a model-agnostic evaluation framework using per-field assertion matching, eliminating circular bias from model-co-produced golden references.

papers.title: Evidence-Based Intelligent Diagnostic and Therapeutic Visualization System with Large Language Models: Multi-Turn Interaction and Multimodal Treatment Plan Generation
papers.abstract_en: Aim: Existing AI-assisted traditional Chinese medicine diagnostic tools suffer from opaque reasoning processes, passive interaction, and limited treatment plan presentation. This study proposes a knowledge-enhanced visual diagnostic system to improve the transparency and interpretability of syndrome differentiation and treatment. Methods: The system is built upon a Neo4j knowledge graph comprising 241 syndromes, 1,263 symptoms, and 2,485 relations. It incorporates a four-stage symptom matching pipeline (exact, semantic, fuzzy, and large language model verification), an information gain-driven proactive questioning strategy optimized with genetic algorithms, and a multimodal treatment presentation integrating artificial intelligence-generated illustrations, three-dimensional meridian-acupoint models, and evidence-based literature. Results: Knowledge graph constraints reduced non-standard outputs by 32%. Case studies validated the effectiveness of the interactive workflow across patient self-assessment, clinician-assisted diagnosis, and traditional Chinese medicine education. Automated paired-comparison evaluation across 30 cases further demonstrated significant improvements in diagnostic trust (Cohen's d = 1.82, p < 0.001), reduced cognitive load (improvements in four of five dimensions), and higher credibility of evidence-based references (4.21 vs. 2.95). Conclusions: The proposed system enhances the transparency of traditional Chinese medicine diagnostic reasoning and the interpretability of treatment plans through knowledge graph-driven visualization and multimodal interaction, offering a practical solution for trustworthy artificial intelligence-assisted traditional Chinese medicine applications.

TL;DR: 本文针对现有AI辅助中医诊断工具推理过程不透明、交互被动、治疗方案展示有限的问题，提出一个知识增强的可视化诊断系统。系统基于包含241个证候、1263个症状和2485个关系的Neo4j知识图谱，采用四阶段症状匹配流水线（精确、语义、模糊和大语言模型验证）、信息增益驱动的主动提问策略（遗传算法优化）以及多模态治疗方案呈现（AI生成插图、3D经络穴位模型、循证文献）。案例研究和30例自动配对比较评估显示，该系统在诊断信任度（Cohen's d=1.82, p<0.001）、认知负荷（五个维度中四个改善）和循证参考文献可信度（4.21 vs 2.95）上均有显著提升。
Motivation: 现有AI辅助中医诊断工具存在推理过程不透明、交互被动以及治疗方案展示有限的问题，缺乏透明度和可解释性。
Method: 系统基于Neo4j知识图谱，包含241个证候、1263个症状和2485个关系；采用四阶段症状匹配流水线（精确、语义、模糊和大语言模型验证），信息增益驱动的主动提问策略（经遗传算法优化），以及多模态治疗方案呈现（AI生成插图、3D经络穴位模型、循证文献）。

Conclusion: 该系统通过知识图谱驱动的可视化和多模态交互，增强了中医诊断推理的透明度和治疗方案的可解释性，为可信AI辅助中医应用提供了实用方案。

papers.title: Multi-FRuGaL: Multimodal Flexible Redundancy-aware Decomposed Gated Learning for Cancer Diagnosis and Prognosis
papers.abstract_en: Modern medicine relies on heterogeneous data sources spanning radiology, pathology, text reports, and structured clinical information. However, real-world patient data are frequently incomplete, with missing or sparsely acquired modalities, limiting the effectiveness of standard multimodal fusion approaches. To this end, we propose the Multimodal Flexible Redundancy-aware decomposed GAted Learning (Multi-FRuGaL) framework, a decomposition-aware, adaptive gated intermediate-fusion framework that performs modality-level representation learning under missing data. Multi-FRuGaL integrates per-modality encoders with a signal decomposition layer, an input-conditioned gating network, and an information-aware fusion objective to separate redundant from modality-specific complementary signals, selectively upweighting informative modalities and suppressing redundant or noisy inputs, and remaining well-defined even when multiple modalities are absent. We evaluate Multi-FRuGaL on two multimodal head and neck cancer cohorts: the HANCOCK challenge dataset (N = 763) comprising five modalities and two prognostic endpoints (5-year survival and 2-year recurrence), and the HECKTOR challenge dataset (N = 588) comprising three modalities for human papillomavirus (HPV) status classification. Multi-FRuGaL consistently achieves higher mean performance than the evaluated baselines across multiple tasks, improving AUC from 0.601 to 0.8496 for survival, from 0.672 to 0.8102 for recurrence, and achieving 0.975 AUC for HPV prediction on HECKTOR. For survival analysis, it further achieves a concordance index of 0.6814 for overall survival, 0.7421 for recurrence-free survival, and 0.7143 for progression-free survival on HANCOCK, and 0.7203 for recurrence-free survival on HECKTOR. Qualitative analyses further show that Multi-FRuGaL learns discriminative and robust multimodal representations, even under severe missing-modality conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Multi-FRuGaL 框架，一种面向缺失模态的分解感知自适应门控中间融合方法，用于癌症诊断和预后。该框架通过信号分解层、输入条件门控网络和信息感知融合目标，分离冗余与互补信号，并在头颈癌数据集（HANCOCK 和 HECKTOR）上显著提升生存预测、复发预测和 HPV 状态分类的性能。
Motivation: 真实患者数据常存在模态缺失或稀疏采集的问题，限制了标准多模态融合方法的有效性，亟需能够鲁棒处理缺失模态的融合框架。
Method: 提出分解感知的自适应门控中间融合框架，包含每个模态的编码器、信号分解层、输入条件门控网络，以及信息感知融合目标，用于区分冗余信号和模态特异的互补信号，并自适应增强信息性模态。
Result: 在 HANCOCK 数据集上，生存 AUC 从 0.601 提升至 0.8496，复发 AUC 从 0.672 提升至 0.8102；在 HECKTOR 数据集上，HPV 预测 AUC 达 0.975。生存分析的 C-index 在多个指标上均优于基线。
Conclusion: Multi-FRuGaL 在严重缺失模态条件下仍能学习判别性和鲁棒的多模态表示，为临床决策提供可靠融合方案。

papers.title: Product units in gated recurrent units improve nuclear-mass prediction
papers.abstract_en: The prediction of masses of atomic nuclei using machine learning can complement theoretical models and advance the exploration of poorly known domains of the nuclear chart. We propose a machine learning technique based on gated recurrent units (GRU), which have demonstrated competitive performance in nuclear-mass prediction by exploiting long-term dependencies. By integrating multiplicative interactions and product-unit transformations within recurrent units, we report significant improvements in nuclear-mass prediction. Computations are performed in the complex domain to jointly capture amplitude and phase dynamics. For interpolation and temporal-extrapolation tasks based on the atomic mass evaluation (AME2016 and AME2020), the complex additive-multiplicative product-unit gated recurrent unit (AM-PU-GRU) model consistently achieves the lowest prediction errors, with an interpolation RMSE of 0.227 $\pm$ 0.004 MeV and an extrapolation RMSE of 0.179 $\pm$ 0.015 MeV. These results surpass other state-of-the-art machine learning models and also outperform the real-valued GRU baseline and product-unit ablation variants, while remaining robust to different theoretical priors, including WS4 and SEMF. Our findings establish complex-valued product-unit recurrent networks as a new benchmark for sequence-based nuclear-mass prediction.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于复数域加性-乘性乘积单元门控循环单元（AM-PU-GRU）的核质量预测模型，在AME2016和AME2020数据集上，插值RMSE为0.227±0.004 MeV，外推RMSE为0.179±0.015 MeV，优于现有机器学习模型和实数GRU基线。

papers.title: LRMIL: Efficient Low-Resolution Multiple Instance Learning via High-Resolution Knowledge Distillation for Whole Slide Image Classification
papers.abstract_en: Multiple instance learning (MIL) has become a standard paradigm for whole slide image (WSI) analysis in digital pathology, as it enables slide-level prediction without dense annotations. Existing MIL methods typically rely on exhaustive extraction and encoding of high-resolution patches. However, this practice suffers from two critical limitations in real-world clinical settings: it struggles to capture global visual cues at lower magnifications, and incurs substantial computational overhead due to the massive number of high-resolution patches per slide. To address these limitations, we propose an efficient low-resolution multiple instance learning (LRMIL) framework that transfers high-resolution knowledge to low-resolution representations. LRMIL adopts a two-stage distillation strategy. First, patch-level cross-resolution distillation aligns low-resolution patch embeddings with high-resolution representations. Second, slide-level knowledge distillation trains a low-resolution student MIL model under both slide-level supervision and teacher guidance. At inference time, LRMIL operates exclusively on low-resolution patches, substantially reducing data preprocessing and computational cost. Extensive experiments on multiple WSI benchmarks demonstrate that LRMIL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art MIL methods while achieving more efficient inference. These results highlight LRMIL as a practical and scalable solution for WSI analysis in clinical pathology.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LRMIL框架，通过两阶段知识蒸馏将高分辨率WSI知识迁移至低分辨率表示，推理时仅使用低分辨率补丁，大幅降低计算成本。在多个WSI基准上，LRMIL超越当前最优MIL方法，实现高效且可扩展的临床病理分析。
Motivation: 现有MIL方法依赖大量高分辨率补丁提取，计算开销巨大，且难以捕获低倍率下的全局视觉线索，限制了临床实用性。
Method: 采用两阶段蒸馏策略：1）补丁级跨分辨率蒸馏，对齐低分辨率补丁嵌入与高分辨率表示；2）滑级知识蒸馏，结合标签监督和教师模型指导训练低分辨率学生MIL模型。推理时仅使用低分辨率输入。
Result: 在多个WSI基准上，LRMIL一致超越现有最优MIL方法，并显著降低数据预处理和计算成本。
Conclusion: LRMIL是临床病理WSI分析中一种实用且可扩展的高效解决方案。

papers.title: Modeling Nonlinear Feature Interactions with Product-Unit Residual Networks
papers.abstract_en: Understanding nonlinear feature interactions is crucial in science and engineering, yet standard multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) often capture such interactions only implicitly, leading to entangled representations that can impair robustness and interpretability. We investigate product-unit residual networks (PURe) that integrate multiplicative product units with residual connections to explicitly model cross-feature couplings while stabilizing optimization. We conduct a systematic evaluation on an interaction-driven synthetic benchmark and two real-world datasets, assessing predictive accuracy, robustness to Gaussian feature noise, and performance under limited training data, and we compare real- and complex-valued variants under a matched parameter budget. Beyond accuracy, SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP)-based interaction analyses show that PURe learns more concentrated and structurally coherent interaction patterns than MLP baselines. Overall, PURe achieves competitive or improved performance, better robustness and sample efficiency in low-data regimes, and enhanced interaction-level interpretability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出乘积单元残差网络（PURe），通过集成乘法乘积单元与残差连接显式建模非线性特征交互，同时稳定优化。在交互驱动的合成基准和两个真实数据集上评估了预测准确性、对高斯噪声的鲁棒性及小样本性能，并与MLP基线对比。SHAP分析表明PURe学习到更集中且结构一致的交互模式。
Motivation: 标准MLP隐式捕获非线性特征交互，导致表示纠缠，损害鲁棒性和可解释性。需要显式建模交叉特征耦合的方法。
Method: PURe网络：在残差网络中引入乘法乘积单元，通过显式乘积运算建模特征交互，残差连接稳定训练。比较实数和复数变体。
Result: 在交互合成基准和两个真实数据集上，PURe达到与MLP相当或更优的预测性能，增强对高斯噪声的鲁棒性，在小样本场景下样本效率更高。SHAP交互分析显示其学习到更集中且结构一致的交互模式。
Conclusion: PURe通过显式乘积残差结构在非线性交互建模中实现更好的鲁棒性、样本效率和交互级可解释性。

papers.title: FS-DVS: A Frequency-Selective Dynamic Visual Sensing Paradigm for Enhancing Information Completeness
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic vision sensors (DVS) offer exceptional temporal resolution and dynamic range by asynchronously reporting pixel-level intensity changes. However, conventional DVS rely on a per-pixel independent triggering mechanism, ignoring the spatial integration performed by biological retinal ganglion cells (RGCs). Consequently, they lack the contrast sensitivity function (CSF) and its inherent sensitivity to mid-spatial frequencies, which inevitably leads to information incompleteness due to sub-threshold signal loss. To bridge this gap, we propose FS-DVS (Frequency-Selective Dynamic Vision Sensor), a novel paradigm that integrates a learnable spatial filter strictly preceding the event triggering process to mimic the RGC aggregation mechanism. By developing a differentiable event simulation framework, the spatial filter can be optimized end-to-end with downstream tasks. Our study reveals that starting from a delta function, the learned spatial filters spontaneously evolve into center-surround patterns that emphasize mid-frequency components, consistently aligning with human CSF. Beyond achieving substantial performance gains in object detection and action recognition, the consistent convergence to human-like CSF characteristics across different tasks underscores the universality of this mid-frequency selective mechanism. Compared to naively increasing sensor sensitivity or relying on post-processing, our paradigm achieves selective information enhancement with high noise resilience, providing a robust, biologically plausible blueprint for next-generation neuromorphic sensors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出FS-DVS（频率选择性动态视觉传感器），一种集成可学习空间滤波器的事件触发范式，以模拟视网膜神经节细胞（RGC）的汇聚机制，提高动态视觉传感器的信息完整性。摘要显示该方法在物体检测和动作识别任务上取得性能提升，且学习到的空间滤波器自发生成中心-环绕模式，强调中频成分，与人类对比敏感度函数（CSF）一致。
Motivation: 传统DVS基于逐像素独立触发机制，忽略生物视网膜神经节细胞的空间整合，缺乏对比敏感度函数（CSF）及其对中空间频率的固有敏感性，导致亚阈值信号丢失和信息不完整。
Method: 提出FS-DVS，在事件触发过程之前集成一个可学习的空间滤波器，以模仿RGC汇聚机制；通过开发可微分事件模拟框架，空间滤波器可与下游任务端到端优化。
Result: 摘要报告在物体检测和动作识别任务上取得显著性能提升；学习到的空间滤波器从delta函数自发生成中心-环绕模式，强调中频成分，且在不同任务中一致收敛到类似人类CSF的特征。
Conclusion: 与单纯提高传感器灵敏度或依赖后处理相比，该范式实现了选择性信息增强和强噪声韧性，为下一代神经形态传感器提供了鲁棒的、生物启发的蓝图。

papers.title: Stability beyond Bounded Differences: Sharp Generalization Bounds under Finite $L_p$ Moments
papers.abstract_en: While algorithmic stability is a central tool for understanding generalization of learning algorithms, existing high-probability guarantees typically rely on uniform boundedness or sub-Gaussian/sub-Weibull tail assumptions, which can be overly restrictive for modern settings with heavy-tailed or unbounded losses. We develop a stability-based framework that requires only a finite $L_p$ moment condition. Our first contribution is sharp concentration inequalities for functions of independent random variables under $L_p$ constraints, extending McDiarmid's bounded-differences techniques beyond the classical regime. Leveraging these results, we derive sharp high-probability generalization bounds across a range of learning paradigms, including empirical risk minimization, transductive regression, and meta-learning. These guarantees show that $L_p$ stability suffices for robust generalization even when boundedness fails, substantially weakening the standard assumptions in the stability literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于算法稳定性的泛化界分析框架，仅需损失函数具有有限L_p矩条件，无需传统的均匀有界或次高斯/次Weibull尾假设。通过扩展McDiarmid的有界差分技术到L_p约束下，推导出经验风险最小化、转导回归和元学习等学习范式下的高概率泛化界。
Motivation: 现有高概率泛化保证通常依赖有界性或次高斯尾假设，这在重尾或无界损失场景下过于严格，亟需更宽松的条件。
Method: 建立有限L_p矩条件下独立随机变量函数的尖锐集中不等式，基于此推导稳定性驱动的泛化界。
Result: 在经验风险最小化、转导回归和元学习等任务上获得了高概率泛化界，表明L_p稳定性足以在缺乏有界性时保证鲁棒泛化。
Conclusion: L_p稳定性条件可大幅弱化稳定性文献中的标准假设，拓展稳定性框架的适用场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Geometry of Last-Layer Model Stealing
papers.abstract_en: This paper uses geometry to explain how a machine learning model can be stolen using an already existing well-known method. The author has shown the exact conditions required to perfectly copy the final layer of a transformer network. When looking deeper into the hidden layers the author has explained clear limits. The author has also demonstrated that a hidden network cannot be fully reverse engineered just by looking at the final results. The research clearly maps out what can and cannot be stolen from a model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用几何学原理解释如何通过已知方法窃取机器学习模型。作者展示了完美复制Transformer网络最后一层的精确条件，并探讨了隐藏层的限制，指出无法通过最终结果完全逆向工程隐藏网络。研究清晰地界定了模型中哪些部分可以被窃取，哪些不能被窃取。
Motivation: 现有模型窃取方法缺乏理论解释，本文旨在从几何角度阐明模型窃取的条件和限制。
Method: 通过几何分析，研究Transformer网络最后一层和隐藏层的可复制性条件。
Result: 给出了完美复制最后一层的精确条件，并证明了隐藏层无法被完全逆向工程。
Conclusion: 本文为模型窃取提供了理论边界，明确了可窃取与不可窃取的部分。

papers.title: MotionEnhancer: Leveraging Video Diffusion for Motion-Enhanced Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: The new era has witnessed a remarkable capability to extend Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for tackling tasks of video understanding. While current VLMs excel at event- or story-level understanding, their ability to capture fine-grained motion details remains limited, primarily due to their focus on high-level static semantic structures and macro-event logic. In contrast, Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) are adept at modeling dynamic motion patterns, benefiting from large-scale video data and the intrinsic requirement of temporal generation. In this paper, we introduce MotionEnhancer, a novel approach that leverages motion priors distilled from a powerful video diffusion model as auxiliary supervision to enhance the motion understanding capability of a VLM via attention alignment. MotionEnhancer comprises two simple parameter-free modules, Motion-sensitive Head Selection (MHS) and Motion-salient Text Token Identification (MTTI), to directly extract and optimize motion-related attentions from the VDM in a computation-only manner. MotionEnhancer provides a scalable solution for motion understanding without additional training parameters, modifications to existing architectures, or tool calling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MotionEnhancer can achieve consistent improvements over state-of-the-art VLMs on two motion-level video understanding benchmarks, especially on motion-related metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MotionEnhancer，通过从视频扩散模型（VDM）中蒸馏运动先验，以辅助监督方式增强视觉语言模型（VLM）的运动理解能力。方法包含两个无参数模块：运动敏感头部选择（MHS）和运动显著文本标记识别（MTTI），通过注意力对齐提取并优化 VDM 中的运动相关注意力，无需额外训练参数或修改架构。实验表明，该方法在两个运动级视频理解基准上相比现有 VLM 取得一致提升，尤其在运动相关指标上。
Motivation: 当前 VLM 在视频理解中擅长事件或故事级别的高层语义，但捕捉细粒度运动细节的能力有限，主要因为它们聚焦于静态语义结构和宏观事件逻辑。
Method: 利用预训练视频扩散模型的运动先验作为辅助监督，通过注意力对齐来增强 VLM 的运动理解。具体包括两个无参数模块：Motion-sensitive Head Selection（MHS）和 Motion-salient Text Token Identification（MTTI），以计算方式提取和优化 VDM 的运动注意力。
Result: 在运动级视频理解基准上，该方法使现有 VLM 在运动相关指标上获得一致提升，超过现有最优模型。
Conclusion: MotionEnhancer 为运动理解提供了一种可扩展的解决方案，无需额外训练参数、修改架构或工具调用。

papers.title: CFRNet: Cycle-Consistent Fixed-Point Training for Real-Time Blind Face Restoration on Consumer Embedded NPUs
papers.abstract_en: Blind face restoration on consumer devices has to balance image quality against speed and memory. Strong methods such as GFPGAN and CodeFormer give good perceptual quality, but they rely on large pretrained generative priors and on operators such as attention, codebook lookup, and style modulation that are hard to compile and quantize on the small neural processing units (NPUs) used in consumer hardware. Small convolutional restorers run fast enough, but they tend to over-smooth and to leave artifacts around the eyes, nose, and mouth. We present CFRNet, a 2.0,M-parameter ResNet-style restorer for on-device use at $256\times256$, the common face-crop size on consumer NPUs. The main idea is Cycle-Consistent Fixed-Point Training (CCFP). Instead of training the network for one pass and then running it several times by hand, we train it to act as a fixed-point operator, so that applying it again to a restored face does not change the face. CCFP uses three training losses, namely progressive multi-cycle supervision, an idempotence loss, and a re-degradation cycle loss, and it adds no cost at inference. To compare fairly under our deployment limits, we retrain all baselines from scratch at the same $256\times256$ resolution. On a 300-image test set, CFRNet reaches the best perceptual score (LPIPS 0.250 at three cycles, which is 31% lower than one cycle) and also the best PSNR and SSIM at two cycles. It runs in about 23,ms per cycle in INT8 on a HiSilicon Hi3402 NPU, while the same baselines cannot be compiled to that chip. The cycle count $k$ acts as a simple quality knob that needs no retraining: PSNR is best at $k\!=\!2$ and LPIPS keeps improving up to $k\!=\!3$. We further show that the same idea works with a plain CNN that is even easier to deploy, and we run the model in real time on an in-car driver-monitoring board.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CFRNet，一个 2.0M 参数的 ResNet 风格盲人脸修复网络，面向消费级 NPU 上的实时应用。核心是循环一致不动点训练 (CCFP)，使网络成为不动点算子，多次应用不改变结果。在 300 张测试集上，三循环 LPIPS 达到 0.250（比单循环降低 31%），两循环 PSNR 和 SSIM 最佳。在 HiSilicon Hi3402 NPU 上 INT8 每循环约 23ms，基线方法无法在该芯片上编译。

Result: 在 300 张测试集上，三循环 LPIPS 0.250（比单循环低 31%），两循环 PSNR 和 SSIM 最佳。INT8 在 HiSilicon Hi3402 NPU 上每循环约 23ms，基线无法在该芯片上编译。
Conclusion: CCFP 训练策略使轻量网络能在消费级 NPU 上实现高质量盲人脸修复，且循环次数可作为无需重新训练的质量旋钮。

summary_sections.conclusion: CCFP 训练策略使轻量网络能在消费级 NPU 上实现高质量盲人脸修复，且循环次数可作为无需重新训练的质量旋钮。

papers.title: Physics-Driven Semantic Scattering Structure Understanding of Aircraft Target in SAR Images
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) has become indispensable for target interpretation owing to its all-day and all-weather observation capability. In SAR target interpretation, electromagnetic scattering information provides a physically grounded cue beyond visual texture and has been widely exploited for target interpretation. However, existing methods remain dominated by local scattering center representations. Such unordered and component-agnostic representations are highly unstable for aircraft targets. As a result, physically existing components with weak scattering responses are often missed, resulting in the incomplete reconstructed topology structure. To address this limitation, we establish Semantic Scattering Structure Understanding as a new paradigm for SAR aircraft interpretation. Semantic scattering keypoints are defined to associate local electromagnetic responses with physically meaningful aircraft components, while visibility-aware attributes are introduced to retain weakly observable yet physically existed components. The keypoints are further organized into a stable semantic scattering structure. Build upon this, we propose S3U-SAR, a physics-driven framework to localize semantic scattering keypoints and construct the complete representation constrained by multi-dimensional physical priors containing scattering heterogeneity, rigid-body topology, speckle uncertainty. A confidence-gated joint supervision strategy is further introduced to alleviate optimization conflicts. We construct KP-SAR-Aircraft-1.0, the first fine-grained benchmark for semantic scattering structure understanding. Extensive experiments demonstrate that S3U-SAR achieves the best performance compared with baselines. Cross-category and cross-dataset evaluations further verify its robustness and transferability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对SAR图像中飞机目标解释的局限性，提出语义散射结构理解新范式。通过定义语义散射关键点关联电磁响应与飞机部件，并引入可见性属性保留弱散射部件，构建稳定的语义散射结构。提出的S3U-SAR框架利用多维物理先验（散射异质性、刚体拓扑、斑点不确定性）进行约束，并采用置信门控联合监督策略。在新建的KP-SAR-Aircraft-1.0基准上取得最佳性能，跨类别和跨数据集评估验证了鲁棒性和可迁移性。
Motivation: 现有SAR目标解释方法依赖局部散射中心表示，无序且与部件无关，对飞机目标不稳定，容易遗漏弱散射响应的物理部件，导致重构拓扑结构不完整。
Method: 定义语义散射关键点，引入可见性属性保留弱散射部件，组织成语义散射结构。提出S3U-SAR框架，利用散射异质性、刚体拓扑、斑点不确定性等多维物理先验进行约束，并采用置信门控联合监督策略缓解优化冲突。
Result: 在新建的KP-SAR-Aircraft-1.0基准上，S3U-SAR达到最佳性能。跨类别和跨数据集评估验证了鲁棒性和可迁移性。
Conclusion: 该工作建立了语义散射结构理解的新范式，为SAR飞机目标解释提供了更完整的物理驱动表示。

papers.title: Loop Current Extension as an Effective Delayed Dynamical System
papers.abstract_en: The Loop Current is the dominant circulation feature of the Gulf of Mexico and exhibits pronounced variability associated with northward extension, retraction, and eddy shedding. Despite decades of study, the extent to which this variability admits a reduced dynamical description remains unclear. We investigate this question using delayed-coordinate representations constructed from satellite-altimetry observations of Loop Current extension. Ridge regression, multilayer perceptron forecasting, and Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics (SINDy) are applied to learn delayed evolution maps from the extension time series. Forecast skill consistently exceeds persistence at lead times of 30--90 days while requiring only a small number of delayed coordinates. Ridge regression reveals saturation with delayed-state dimension, indicating that much of the predictive information is contained within a compact representation. Neural-network forecasts provide modest additional improvements, while delayed SINDy identifies sparse evolution maps involving intraseasonal memory scales, from approximately two weeks to a few months, that remain stable under recursive iteration. Physical diagnostics associated with Yucatan Channel inflow, Florida Straits outflow, gateway geometry, and northern Caribbean vorticity contain predictive information but do not provide additional independent state information once the delayed Loop Current state is included. These results support the interpretation of Loop Current extension as an observable evolving on an effective low-dimensional delayed dynamical system. A substantial fraction of the predictable variability can be reconstructed from a small number of delayed observations and represented through compact delayed evolution maps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用卫星高度计观测数据，通过延迟坐标表示法研究墨西哥湾环流（Loop Current）延伸的可预测性。使用岭回归、多层感知器预测和稀疏非线性动力学识别（SINDy）学习延迟演化映射，发现30-90天超前时间的预报技能持续超过持续性预报，且仅需少量延迟坐标。结果支持将Loop Current延伸视为有效低维延迟动力系统上的可观测变量。
Motivation: Loop Current延伸表现出显著的变异性，但其是否允许低维动力学描述尚不清楚。现有研究缺乏对可预测性来源和延迟动力学结构的系统分析。
Method: 从卫星高度计观测构建延迟坐标表示，应用岭回归、多层感知器（MLP）和稀疏非线性动力学识别（SINDy）学习延迟演化映射；比较不同方法的预报技能，并分析延迟状态维度饱和效应和物理诊断量的独立预报信息。
Result: 岭回归在30-90天超前时间预报技能持续超过持续性预报；延迟状态维度饱和表明大部分预报信息包含在紧凑表示中；神经网络仅提供适度改进；延迟SINDy识别出涉及两周到几个月季节内记忆尺度的稀疏演化映射，在递归迭代下保持稳定。
Conclusion: Loop Current延伸的可预测变异性可用少量延迟观测重构，并通过紧凑延迟演化映射表示，支持其作为有效低维延迟动力系统的解释。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Characterize Then Distill: Mechanistic Reasoning in Large Output Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Modern reasoning models offer surprisingly strong zero-shot performance on challenging multi-label tasks that require selecting a small set of relevant options from hundreds of thousands to millions of candidate labels. We investigate how they achieve this mechanistically. We characterize reasoning as a two-phase process: A broad "shortlisting" of candidates followed by fine-grained reasoning over the resulting set. We provide evidence across a range of datasets that these steps can be isolated and are complementary. Using this characterization, we develop a mechanistic distillation strategy that consistently outperforms standard distillation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究现代推理模型如何在大型输出空间中实现零样本多标签分类。作者将推理表征为两阶段过程：先广泛“短名单”候选，再对结果集进行细粒度推理。基于此提出机械蒸馏策略，在多个数据集上始终优于标准蒸馏。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏对推理模型在大型输出空间中实现零样本多标签分类的机制理解。
Method: 通过实验分析，提出两阶段推理框架：短名单生成（broad shortlisting）和细粒度推理（fine-grained reasoning）。基于此设计机械蒸馏策略。
Result: 摘要报告提出机械蒸馏策略在多个数据集上一致优于标准蒸馏。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一种机械性理解，并利用该理解改进了蒸馏方法。

papers.title: LLM Agent-Assisted Reverse Engineering with Quantitative Readability Metrics
papers.abstract_en: Automatic decompilers produce functionally correct but often unreadable C code. This paper addresses one stage of the reverse engineering workflow: improving the readability of decompiled code using LLM agents guided by quantitative metrics. We present a three-phase research evolution. Phase 1 (tool-driven steering via Ghidra MCP) suffered from incomplete coverage and inconsistent improvements due to lack of quantitative guidance. Phase 2 (structural similarity validation alone) revealed that agents optimize for metrics in unintended ways, producing structurally equivalent but less readable code. Our contribution is the Quantitative Readability Score (QRS) framework, a composite metric combining a structural similarity gate with three independent readability sub-metrics (Lexical Surprisal, Structural Simplicity, and Idiomatic Quality). We demonstrate that QRS-guided refinement enables LLM agents to make targeted readability improvements without sacrificing correctness. We provide a discussion of the broader reverse engineering workflow (binary lifting, decompilation cleanup, and achieving functional equivalence) as context, however, it remains out of scope.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究使用 LLM 代理辅助逆向工程中的反编译代码可读性提升，提出定量可读性评分（QRS）框架，结合结构相似性门控与三个独立可读性子指标（词汇惊异度、结构简单性、惯用质量），指导 LLM 代理进行针对性改进，同时保证正确性。
Motivation: 现有反编译器生成的 C 代码功能正确但可读性差，缺乏定量指标指导的 LLM 代理改进可能导致意外退化。
Method: 提出 QRS 框架，包括结构相似性门控和三个可读性子指标（Lexical Surprisal、Structural Simplicity、Idiomatic Quality），指导 LLM 代理迭代优化反编译代码。
Result: QRS 引导的 LLM 代理能够在保持正确性的前提下提升反编译代码的可读性，克服了先前阶段缺乏定量指导的缺陷。
Conclusion: 论文认为 QRS 框架有效改善了反编译代码的可读性，但未涉及整个逆向工程工作流中的功能性等价验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SEAM: Shortcut-Aware Real-Time Detection of Scripted vs. Spontaneous Speech for Interview Guardrails
papers.abstract_en: Scripted vs spontaneous speech detection is appealing for interview guardrails, but benchmark performance can be inflated by shortcuts tied to corpus identity, channel conditions, and recording artifacts rather than speaking style itself. We present SEAM, a shortcut-aware framework for real-time scriptedness detection that combines uniform preprocessing, seam-aware sampling, non-speech augmentation, and a compact DistilHuBERT backbone. With 8s windows, the model achieves 0.971 +- 0.004 ROC-AUC on an external interview-domain evaluation set. Removing the shortcut-prevention components improves internal held-out metrics but sharply reduces external performance, indicating shortcut learning. Post-training quantization reduces the model footprint to 41.8MB with little loss in external performance. The results demonstrate that robust real-time scriptedness detection depends not only on the backbone, but on shortcut-aware data design and evaluation. We release code and model checkpoints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SEAM框架，用于实时检测面试场景中的脚本化与自发性语音，通过统一预处理、接缝感知采样、非语音增强和紧凑的DistilHuBERT骨干网络，在外部面试领域评估集上达到0.971 ROC-AUC。实验表明，去除捷径预防组件会降低外部性能，后训练量化可将模型大小减至41.8MB且性能损失很小。
Motivation: 脚本化与自发性语音检测在面试护栏中很有用，但现有基准性能可能因语料库身份、信道条件和录音伪影等捷径而虚高，而非反映说话风格本身。
Method: 提出SEAM框架，结合统一预处理、接缝感知采样（seam-aware sampling）、非语音增强（non-speech augmentation）和紧凑的DistilHuBERT骨干网络，并采用8秒窗口。
Result: 在外部面试领域评估集上达到0.971 ± 0.004 ROC-AUC；后训练量化将模型体积压缩至41.8MB，外部性能损失很小。
Conclusion: 稳健的实时脚本化检测不仅依赖于骨干网络，还依赖于捷径感知的数据设计和评估。

papers.title: Think Like a Pilot: Fine-Grained Long-Horizon UAV Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Language-guided UAV agents must execute long-horizon semantic instructions while producing smooth, physically feasible continuous flight commands, yet existing Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) benchmarks typically use discrete or coarse actions and existing UAV Vision-Language-Action (VLA) tasks focus on short, atomic maneuvers. To address this gap in UAV task settings, we introduce \textbf{FLIGHT}, a \textbf{F}ine-grained \textbf{L}ong-horizon \textbf{I}nstruction-\textbf{G}uided benchmark for \textbf{H}ybrid UAV navigation and reasoning \textbf{T}asks, which combines multi-stage instructions with dense 6-DoF trajectory annotations across two dataset splits: Fine-grained VLN and Long-horizon Flow. To endow the UAV agent with the capability of real-time in-flight reasoning over task execution status and mission planning, while simultaneously accommodating high-frequency, real-time precise control, we further propose \textbf{FLIGHT VLA}, an asynchronous architecture that decouples a low-frequency Streaming Pilot Vision-Language Model (VLM) for task-state reasoning from a high-frequency diffusion action model for continuous control, supervised by explicit \textbf{Pilot Reasoning} texts that summarize the current flight state and anticipate the next subgoal. In closed-loop evaluation, FLIGHT VLA consistently surpasses representative VLN and VLA baselines on our FLIGHT benchmarks, achieving stronger multi-stage completion, subgoal adherence, and terminal control. Its trained Streaming Pilot Reasoning VLM further improves UAV video reasoning, validating the effectiveness of our design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无人机（UAV）在语言引导下的长时域精细导航任务，提出了FLIGHT基准，包含细粒度视觉语言导航（Fine-grained VLN）和长时域流（Long-horizon Flow）两个子集，提供多阶段指令和密集6-DoF轨迹标注。同时提出FLIGHT VLA异步架构，将低频的流式飞行员视觉语言模型（Streaming Pilot VLM）用于任务状态推理与规划，与高频扩散动作模型用于连续控制解耦，并利用显式的飞行员推理文本（Pilot Reasoning texts）监督模型。在闭环评估中，FLIGHT VLA在FLIGHT基准上优于代表性的VLN和VLA基线，并在无人机视频推理任务上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有语言引导无人机导航任务多使用离散或粗糙动作，且视觉-语言-动作（VLA）任务局限于短时原子操作，缺乏支持长时域精细指令和连续飞行控制的统一基准。
Method: 提出FLIGHT基准和FLIGHT VLA架构。FLIGHT包含两个数据集：Fine-grained VLN和Long-horizon Flow，提供多阶段指令与6-DoF轨迹。FLIGHT VLA采用异步双模块设计：低频Streaming Pilot VLM负责任务状态推理与子目标规划，高频扩散动作模型负责实时连续控制，并利用Pilot Reasoning文本监督。
Result: 在FLIGHT基准上，FLIGHT VLA在多阶段完成率、子目标遵循度和末端控制方面持续优于代表性VLN和VLA基线。训练后的Streaming Pilot Reasoning VLM还提升了无人机视频推理能力。

papers.title: Hearing the Unspoken: Language Model Priors for Acoustic Adversarial Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) systems operating in real-time settings must process acoustic input under strict temporal constraints, where transcription decisions are inherently made on incomplete information. This causal constraint serves as an information bottleneck on attackers, significantly limiting attack performance. Our new Semantic Gambit attack breaks this causal limitation by augmenting the adversary with predictive context derived from a Large Language Model in real-time. Our experiments show that this form of augmentation can elevate the corpus-level Word Error Rate to 35.6% -- a three-fold increase over the current state-of-the-art. Ultimately, this work reveals how common, low-latency LLM tooling can be exploited to systematically subvert real-time ASR pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Semantic Gambit 攻击，通过在实时 ASR 系统中利用大语言模型（LLM）提供预测上下文，突破因果约束对攻击者的信息瓶颈，显著提升对抗攻击效果。实验表明，该方法将语料级词错误率（WER）提升至 35.6%，是目前最先进方法的约三倍。
Motivation: 实时 ASR 系统在严格时间约束下处理声学输入，因果关系限制了攻击者可用的信息，导致现有攻击性能不佳。
Method: 通过实时向攻击者注入来自大语言模型的预测上下文，增强其生成对抗样本的能力，突破因果信息瓶颈。
Result: 在实时 ASR 任务上，Semantic Gambit 攻击将词错误率提升至 35.6%，相比当前最优方法提高了约三倍。
Conclusion: 该工作揭示了常见低延迟 LLM 工具可能被系统性地利用来颠覆实时 ASR 流水线。

papers.title: Learning Fair Demand Models
papers.abstract_en: Data-driven pricing is increasingly prevalent in sectors such as airlines, lending, insurance, and retail. By learning demand models from customer features and setting prices accordingly, these systems may generate discriminatory outcomes that raise fairness concerns. This leads to fundamental questions - how and where should systems incorporate fairness considerations in the pricing pipeline, and how does it ultimately affect societal outcomes? To answer these, we study a stylized model where a seller has a two-stage decision pipeline comprising linear demand model estimation followed by price optimization. The seller considers fairness notions in training loss, price, and demand, under both parity-wise and Rawlsian perspectives. We show that equalizing training loss across consumer groups leads to multiple solutions, which in turn can result in undesirable outcomes despite being a standard approach in fair machine learning. Focusing instead on fairness applied directly to prices or demand, we compare two strategies that enforce fairness in either the demand estimation stage or the price optimization stage. For parity-wise fairness, we characterize when each strategy yields higher social welfare under small fairness levels. We show that when market sizes and prices in the dataset are similar, imposing price fairness in the estimation stage is more beneficial to consumers, whereas imposing demand fairness in the optimization stage yields better consumer outcomes. For Rawlsian fairness, the two strategies coincide exactly. Lastly, we extend our model to alternate demand functions and conduct a case study using real-world vaccine pricing data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究数据驱动定价中的公平性问题，通过一个包含线性需求模型估计和价格优化的两阶段决策流程，分析不同公平约束（训练损失公平、价格公平、需求公平）对社会福利和消费者结果的影响。作者证明训练损失公平会导致多个解且可能产生不良后果，而直接针对价格或需求的公平策略在特定条件下有不同效果。
Motivation: 数据驱动定价系统可能产生歧视性结果，引发公平担忧，需要明确在定价流程中何处以及如何引入公平考量，并理解其对社会的最终影响。
Method: 建立卖家的两阶段决策模型（线性需求估计+价格优化），比较在需求估计阶段或价格优化阶段施加公平约束的策略，涵盖均等主义（parity-wise）和罗尔斯主义（Rawlsian）两种公平观。
Result: 当市场大小和价格相似时，在估计阶段施加价格公平对消费者更有利，而在优化阶段施加需求公平能带来更好的消费者结果；罗尔斯公平下两种策略等价。
Conclusion: 摘要指出训练损失公平不是好策略，直接的价格或需求公平更有效，且策略选择取决于市场条件；通过实际疫苗定价数据验证了部分结论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AdaGRPO: A Capability-Aware Adaptive Enhancement for Flow-based GRPO
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has demonstrated remarkable success in aligning text-to-image (T2I) flow models with human preferences. However, we have identified that the learning loop of current flow-based GRPO is fundamentally decoupled from the learner's current capability, suffering from critical blind spots at both prompt selection and advantage estimation: (i) Existing methods sample prompts randomly, overlooking the substantial impact of data selection on reinforcement learning (RL) efficacy--a factor proven crucial in GRPO for large language models; (ii) They evaluate sample quality solely relying on intra-group statistics, lacking a global perspective to accurately measure true policy improvement. To address these issues, we propose Adaptive GRPO (AdaGRPO), a novel capability-aware RL algorithm tailored for flow models. Specifically, AdaGRPO consists of two principal components: (i) Online Curriculum Filtering Strategy: Dynamically tracks the model's proficiency and adaptively selects prompts that best match its current learning boundary; (ii) Cross-Level Advantage Fusion: Synergistically integrates fine-grained intra-group advantages with macro-level global advantages, providing a comprehensive and unbiased policy evaluation. As a lightweight, plug-and-play module, AdaGRPO can be seamlessly integrated with existing frameworks such as Flow-GRPO, DanceGRPO, and Flow-CPS. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AdaGRPO consistently drives performance gains while significantly stabilizes GRPO training for flow models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对当前 flow-based GRPO 在学习过程中与模型当前能力脱节的问题，提出 AdaGRPO，包含在线课程过滤策略和跨级别优势融合两个组件。该方法作为轻量级即插即用模块，可集成到现有框架中，在文本到图像生成任务上持续提升性能并稳定训练。
Motivation: 现有 flow-based GRPO 的提示选择随机，忽略数据选择对强化学习效果的影响，且优势评估仅依赖组内统计，缺乏全局视角，导致学习循环与模型能力脱节。
Method: AdaGRPO 包含两个关键组件：(i) 在线课程过滤策略，动态追踪模型熟练度并自适应选择匹配当前学习边界的提示；(ii) 跨级别优势融合，协同整合细粒度组内优势与宏观全局优势，提供全面无偏的策略评估。
Result: 实验表明 AdaGRPO 作为即插即用模块，集成至 Flow-GRPO、DanceGRPO 等框架后，持续提升生成性能并显著稳定训练过程。
Conclusion: AdaGRPO 通过能力感知的自适应增强，解决了 flow-based GRPO 中的学习盲点，实现了更有效的偏好对齐。

papers.title: Architecture Shapes Transfer Specificity in Implicit Neural Representations
papers.abstract_en: Transfer in coordinate networks is often measured by warm-start gain, but whether that gain reflects source-specific structure or generic weight reuse is less clear. We study this question across three implicit neural representation (INR) families, SIREN, ReLU MLPs, and Fourier-feature MLPs, using controlled analytic tests, a 2D lid-driven-cavity Navier--Stokes benchmark, and 1D PDE reference-solution suites for heat, viscous Burgers, and focusing cubic NLS. The analytic tests use independent-seed random controls, while the PDE benchmarks use alternate same-family source controls and auxiliary ablations. Across settings, transfer magnitude and transfer specificity separate clearly. In a 10-seed controlled 1D geometric test, Fourier Features show the largest structured transfer ($33.1\times$), followed by SIREN ($23.0\times$) and ReLU ($10.7\times$), but ReLU is far more selective: random-control transfer is $0.41\times$ for ReLU versus $14.24\times$ for SIREN. On a controlled two-parameter 1D family, the ranking changes: ReLU gives the clearest structured-versus-control separation at default settings, whereas Fourier Features improve only after bandwidth retuning. In Navier--Stokes and the broader 1D PDE suite, no single architecture dominates every equation, yet the same pattern remains: SIREN often reuses weights broadly, whereas ReLU and, in some equations, Fourier Features are more source-selective. Static diagnostics remain weak, and the heuristic scaling law $A_{\text{transfer}} \propto 1/Δt^2$ is rejected in the implemented 1D audit. These results position transfer specificity as a useful diagnostic for coordinate networks and suggest that architecture selection in scientific machine learning should be evaluated under explicit control conditions, not by transfer magnitude alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过控制实验和PDE基准测试，研究了三种隐式神经表示家族（SIREN、ReLU MLP、Fourier-feature MLP）在迁移学习中的特异性。结果表明，迁移幅度和迁移特异性显著分离：Fourier Features在几何测试中迁移幅度最大（33.1倍），但ReLU更具选择性（随机控制迁移仅0.41倍）。在Navier-Stokes和1D PDE套件中，没有单一架构在所有方程上占优，但SIREN通常广泛复用权重，而ReLU和Fourier Features更具源选择性。静态诊断较弱，且启发式缩放律被拒绝。这些结果将迁移特异性定位为坐标网络的有用诊断指标，并建议在科学机器学习中评估架构选择时应考虑显式控制条件。
Motivation: 现有研究常以热启动增益衡量坐标网络的迁移能力，但这种增益反映的是源特定结构还是通用权重复用仍不明确。
Method: 通过控制随机种子的分析测试、2D lid-driven-cavity Navier-Stokes基准和1D PDE参考解套件（热方程、粘性Burgers方程、聚焦立方NLS），对比SIREN、ReLU MLP和Fourier-feature MLP的迁移行为。
Result: Fourier Features在1D几何测试中显示最大结构化迁移（33.1倍），SIREN为23.0倍，ReLU为10.7倍，但ReLU的选择性最强（随机控制迁移仅0.41倍）。在PDE套件中，无单一架构主导所有方程，但SIREN常广泛复用权重，而ReLU和Fourier Features更具源选择性。
Conclusion: 迁移特异性作为坐标网络的有用诊断指标，且架构选择应在显式控制条件下评估，而非仅依赖迁移幅度。

papers.title: Progress-SQL: Improving Reinforcement Learning for Text-to-SQL via Progressive Rewards
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has recently shown promise in improving large language models for Text-to-SQL generation, yet existing methods typically optimize one-shot rewards defined over a single SQL state. Such rewards provide limited guidance for iterative SQL correction and are insufficient to capture the improvement of multi-turn SQL refinement. In this paper, we propose Progress-SQL, a multi-turn reinforcement learning framework with progressive rewards for Text-to-SQL. Our approach introduces an Oracle-guided Diagnostic Tree (ODT), which abstracts SQL queries into clause-level structural profiles and produces diagnostic feedback for next-turn refinement. To provide dense and robust reward signals, we combine ODT-based structural alignment with lexical alignment and define a progressive reward that measures the improvement from the initial SQL to the final SQL. We further incorporate a progression latency reward that favors earlier correctness and an execution status reward that encourages recovery from the invalid SQL. Experiments on BIRD, Spider, and Spider robustness variants demonstrate that our method consistently improves Text-to-SQL performance across both primary and robustness evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Progress-SQL，一种用于Text-to-SQL的多轮强化学习框架，通过渐进式奖励改进大语言模型的SQL生成。核心是Oracle-guided Diagnostic Tree (ODT)，它将SQL查询抽象为子句级结构概要并提供诊断反馈，同时结合词汇对齐、渐进奖励、延迟奖励和执行状态奖励。在BIRD、Spider及其鲁棒性变体上，该方法一致提升了性能。
Motivation: 现有强化学习方法针对Text-to-SQL通常优化单轮奖励，对迭代SQL校正的指导有限，无法捕捉多轮细化的改进。
Method: 提出多轮强化学习框架Progress-SQL，引入Oracle-guided Diagnostic Tree (ODT) 抽象SQL结构并提供诊断反馈；定义渐进奖励衡量从初始SQL到最终SQL的改进，结合词汇对齐和结构对齐；加入进展延迟奖励（鼓励更早正确）和执行状态奖励（鼓励从无效SQL恢复）。
Result: 在BIRD、Spider及其鲁棒性变体上，实验一致提升了Text-to-SQL性能，包括主要评估和鲁棒性评估。
Conclusion: 通过渐进式奖励和多轮细化，该框架有效改善了Text-to-SQL生成，实验验证了其有效性。

summary_sections.method: 提出多轮强化学习框架Progress-SQL，引入Oracle-guided Diagnostic Tree (ODT) 抽象SQL结构并提供诊断反馈；定义渐进奖励衡量从初始SQL到最终SQL的改进，结合词汇对齐和结构对齐；加入进展延迟奖励（鼓励更早正确）和执行状态奖励（鼓励从无效SQL恢复）。
summary_sections.result: 在BIRD、Spider及其鲁棒性变体上，实验一致提升了Text-to-SQL性能，包括主要评估和鲁棒性评估。
summary_sections.conclusion: 通过渐进式奖励和多轮细化，该框架有效改善了Text-to-SQL生成，实验验证了其有效性。

papers.title: PandaAI: A Practical Agent CQ2 for Neuro-symbolic Data Analysis And Integrated Decision-Making in Quantitative Finance
papers.abstract_en: While deep learning has excelled in various domains, its application to sequential decision-making in finance remains challenging due to the low Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) and non-stationarity of financial data. Leveraging the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs), we propose \textbf{PandaAI}, a closed-loop neuro-symbolic LLM agent with market regime modeling and constrained alpha generation, which bridges general LLM reasoning with financial rigor and suppresses the financial toxicity of LLM-generated outputs. To bridge the gap between general linguistic capability and financial rigor, we fine-tune a domain-specific LLM. Furthermore, we integrate this LLM into a modular architecture and form a closed-loop system. Unlike traditional models that optimize isolated prediction metrics, \textbf{PandaAI} is designed as a neuro-symbolic agent that navigates the complex, real-world financial environment with explicit risk awareness. Extensive experiments on CSI 300 stock data show that \textbf{PandaAI} achieves a $18.2\%$ higher Rank IC and $25.7\%$ lower maximum drawdown than state-of-the-art time-series models. Our constrained LLM generation and dual-channel adaptation method provide a general paradigm for LLM deployment in high-stakes sequential decision-making scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PandaAI，一个用于量化金融的神经符号LLM代理，结合市场体制建模和约束alpha生成，在CSI 300股票数据上相比现有时间序列模型实现Rank IC提升18.2%、最大回撤降低25.7%。
Motivation: 金融数据信噪比低且非平稳，传统深度学习在序列决策中面临挑战；LLM的推理能力虽强，但直接应用会产生金融毒性，需加以约束。
Method: 微调领域特定LLM并将其集成到模块化闭环架构中，采用约束LLM生成和双通道适应方法，实现神经符号数据分析与集成决策。
Result: 在CSI 300股票数据上，Rank IC提升18.2%，最大回撤降低25.7%。
Conclusion: 该方法为LLM在高风险序列决策场景中的部署提供了通用范式。

papers.title: SCALE: Scalable Cross-Attention Learning with Extrapolation for Agentic Workflow Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: Agentic Large Language Model (LLM) systems decompose complex tasks into workflow Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) whose primitives must be scheduled on heterogeneous clusters. Existing deep reinforcement learning (DRL) schedulers are tied to a fixed cluster size and require retraining whenever the number of servers changes. We propose SCALE (Scalable Cross-Attention Learning with Extrapolation), a DRL scheduler that generalizes to unseen cluster scales without fine-tuning. SCALE employs a cross-attention pointer network where task features query against server features, so the architecture accepts any number of servers by construction. We observe, however, that permutation-invariant architecture alone does not guarantee good performance at new scales - the attention feature undergoes distribution shift as the server count grows. To counter this, we introduce Structured Representation Regularization (SRR): a decorrelation loss combined with a KL penalty toward the standard normal, which keeps feature statistics stable regardless of input size. Trained on 16 nodes and tested directly on 32 and 48 nodes, SCALE reduces average response time by 8.9% at N=48 relative to the same architecture without SRR, confirming that explicit regularization is necessary to close the scale-generalization gap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SCALE，一种基于深度强化学习的可扩展调度器，用于智能体工作流DAG在异构集群上的调度。SCALE使用交叉注意力指针网络，天然支持任意数量服务器，并引入结构化表示正则化（SRR）以稳定特征分布，避免因服务器数量变化导致的分布偏移。在16节点上训练后，直接泛化到32和48节点，平均响应时间降低8.9%。
Motivation: 现有DRL调度器固定于特定集群规模，当服务器数量变化时需要重新训练，缺乏泛化能力。
Method: 提出交叉注意力指针网络，任务特征作为查询、服务器特征作为键值，架构可接受任意服务器数；并引入结构化表示正则化（SRR），包含去相关损失和向标准正态分布的KL散度，保持特征统计量稳定。
Result: 在16节点训练，直接测试32和48节点，相比无SRR的相同架构，平均响应时间在N=48时降低8.9%。
Conclusion: 显式正则化对于缩小规模泛化差距是必要的。

papers.title: VideoSEG-O3: A Multi-turn Reinforcement Learning Framework for Reasoning Video Object Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning Video Object Segmentation (RVOS) demands a sophisticated integration of temporal dynamics, spatial details, and linguistic reasoning to achieve precise pixel-level localization. Existing methods are limited to reasoning over fixed initial inputs and lack the capacity to actively acquire further visual evidence, which is often essential for resolving complex references in long or intricate videos. To address this, we propose \textbf{VideoSEG-O3}, the first multi-turn reinforcement learning framework for RVOS that emulates the human \textit{``coarse-to-fine''} cognitive process. It employs a \textit{multi-turn temporal-spatial chain-of-thought} to capture fine-grained details by iteratively pinpointing critical intervals and keyframes. Additionally, to enable the policy to perceive segmentation quality beyond mere text probability of \texttt{[SEG]} during the RL stage, we introduce \textit{SEG-aware logit calibration}, which integrates pixel-wise segmentation feedback directly into the token-level logits. Furthermore, we design a \textit{decoupled thinking trace} to hierarchically decompose the reasoning process into temporal, spatial, and linguistic dimensions, and construct \textbf{VTS-CoT}, a specialized cold-start dataset featuring comprehensive reasoning trajectories. The code and models will be released at https://github.com/Dmmm1997/VideoSEG-O3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出VideoSEG-O3，首个用于推理视频对象分割（RVOS）的多轮强化学习框架，模仿人类“由粗到细”的认知过程。通过多轮时空思维链迭代定位关键区间和关键帧，并引入SEG-aware logit校准将像素级分割反馈整合到token级logits中。同时设计了分离的思考轨迹来分层分解推理过程，并构建了VTS-CoT冷启动数据集。
Motivation: 现有RVOS方法仅基于固定初始输入进行推理，缺乏主动获取视觉证据的能力，难以解决长视频或复杂视频中的复杂引用。
Method: 提出多轮强化学习框架，包含多轮时空思维链、SEG-aware logit校准（利用像素级分割反馈调整token logits）以及解耦思考轨迹（将推理过程分解为时间、空间和语言三个维度），并构建VTS-CoT冷启动数据集。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但声称该方法在长或复杂视频的复杂引用场景中有效提升分割精度。
Conclusion: VideoSEG-O3通过模仿人类认知过程和多轮交互，为推理视频对象分割提供了新范式，代码和模型将开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Terastal: Layer-Variant-based Scheduling for Real-Time Multi-DNN Workloads on Heterogeneous Accelerators
papers.abstract_en: Heterogeneous DNN accelerators improve soft real-time multi-DNN execution by mapping each layer to its preferred accelerator to reduce latency. However, under skewed workloads, large layer-latency differences across accelerators limit scheduling flexibility and increase deadline misses. To address this challenge, we introduce layer variants, customized layer implementations that reduce latency gaps on non-preferred accelerators. We then present Terastal, a soft real-time framework for layer-variant design and scheduling on heterogeneous DNN accelerators. Terastal combines offline heterogeneity-aware virtual budget assignment and layer-variant design, and online scheduling to jointly optimize accelerator mapping and variant selection under timing and accuracy constraints. Experimental results show that Terastal reduces deadline miss rate per model by 40.58%, 30.53%, and 36.27% compared with FCFS, EDF, and DREAM, respectively, while incurring only 2.24% average normalized accuracy loss across models with variants.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Accepted by RTCSA 2026. Author accepted manuscript
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Terastal，一个针对异构 DNN 加速器上实时多 DNN 工作负载的软实时调度框架。通过引入层变体（layer variants）来缩小非首选加速器上的延迟差距，并结合离线虚拟预算分配与在线调度，在时序和精度约束下优化加速器映射和变体选择。实验表明，与 FCFS、EDF 和 DREAM 相比，Terastal 将每模型截止时间错过率分别降低 40.58%、30.53% 和 36.27%，同时平均归一化精度损失仅 2.24%。
Motivation: 异构 DNN 加速器在软实时多 DNN 执行中，由于倾斜工作负载下跨加速器的层延迟差异大，导致调度灵活性受限且截止时间错过率增加。
Method: 提出层变体（layer variants）概念，即定制的层实现以减少非首选加速器上的延迟差距；并设计 Terastal 框架，结合离线异构感知虚拟预算分配和层变体设计，以及在线调度，联合优化加速器映射和变体选择。
Result: 在实验中将每模型截止时间错过率降低 40.58%（对比 FCFS）、30.53%（对比 EDF）、36.27%（对比 DREAM），平均归一化精度损失仅 2.24%。
Conclusion: Terastal 通过层变体和联合调度有效改善了异构加速器上实时多 DNN 工作负载的截止时间满足率，同时保持可接受的精度损失。

papers.title: AMD-FCG: An Enhanced Function Call Graph Dataset with Integrated Topological Features for Malware Detection and Classification
papers.abstract_en: As malware illustrates a complex structure and behavior, detection of these has been a significant challenge in the domain of cybersecurity along with related services in daily life. So, it becomes crucial to have a reliable and adaptive solution to address the issue. Among the several detection methods developed over the years, one of the most reliable ones is studying and analyzing the structural and behavioral patterns of malware. These patterns of sophisticated malware can be obtained with the help of Function Call Graphs (FCGs). However, to effectively cover numerous groups of families of malware, it is required to have a sufficiently large dataset for the system to operate on. In order to ensure accuracy and robustness of the system, the dataset should comprise samples of different malwares and a benign application for secure execution of the detection process. This paper introduces AMD-FCG, an enhanced Function Call Graph dataset integrated with topological features of malwares. The framework enhances the detection procedure, streamlining the workflow for cybersecurity professionals and also eliminating the need for dynamic analysis and extensive processing. Therefore, it can be used to develop and deploy more efficient and innovative malware detection systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了 AMD-FCG，一个增强的函数调用图数据集，集成了恶意软件的拓扑特征，用于恶意软件检测与分类。该数据集无需动态分析和大量处理即可提高检测准确性，旨在帮助网络安全专业人员开发更高效的恶意软件检测系统。
Motivation: 恶意软件检测是网络安全领域的重大挑战，现有方法需要可靠的自适应解决方案。研究函数调用图（FCG）的结构和行为模式是一种可靠途径，但需要大规模数据集覆盖多种恶意软件家族。
Method: 提出了 AMD-FCG 数据集，该数据集通过整合函数调用图（FCG）与拓扑特征来增强恶意软件检测，无需动态分析和大量预处理。
Result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果，但声称该数据集能够提升检测流程效率，简化安全专业人员的工作流。
Conclusion: 该数据集可用于开发和部署更高效和创新的恶意软件检测系统。

papers.title: The Effect of Training Task Diversity on In-Context Learning through the Lens of Low-Dimensional Subspaces
papers.abstract_en: The transformer's emergent ability to perform in-context learning (ICL) has sparked a wide range of studies designed to understand its underlying mechanisms. Existing works often study how training task diversity, defined either as the number of ICL training task vectors or as the number of function classes from which the task vectors are drawn, shapes both the learning dynamics and generalization capabilities of ICL. While both definitions have uncovered many interesting phenomena, many observations under the latter definition remain theoretically unexplained. This paper presents a minimal analytical model under which these phenomena provably emerge from the properties of the training data. By modeling the training task vectors as a mixture of low-rank Gaussians, we show how training task diversity, defined by the number of non-overlapping columns between subspaces that parameterize the covariance matrices, improves both the generalization and optimization trajectory of ICL with linear attention. In particular, we show that our model can explain (i) why training with task diversity shortens the ICL plateau and (ii) why ICL appears to achieve out-of-distribution generalization. We conclude by empirically demonstrating how our results extend to nonlinear transformers and nonlinear function classes. Overall, our work presents a tractable framework to unify existing observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过低秩高斯混合模型分析了训练任务多样性（定义为子空间非重叠列的数量）如何影响线性注意力下的上下文学习（ICL）的泛化和优化轨迹。研究表明，任务多样性可以缩短ICL的收敛平台期并解释其分布外泛化能力。实验结果部分验证了结论对非线性Transformer和函数类的适用性。
Motivation: 现有研究对训练任务多样性（尤其是从多个函数类中采样任务向量）的许多现象缺乏理论解释，本文旨在提供一个最小化的解析模型来证明这些现象与数据属性的关系。
Method: 将训练任务向量建模为低秩高斯混合，通过子空间非重叠列的数量定义任务多样性；在线性注意力框架下分析泛化和优化动力学。
Result: 理论证明任务多样性缩短了ICL的训练平台期，并解释了ICL的分布外泛化能力；实验扩展至非线性Transformer和非线性函数类。
Conclusion: 该工作为统一现有ICL经验观察提供了可解析的理论框架。
