summary_sections.result: 理论证明任务多样性缩短了ICL的训练平台期，并解释了ICL的分布外泛化能力；实验扩展至非线性Transformer和非线性函数类。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作为统一现有ICL经验观察提供了可解析的理论框架。

papers.title: Breaking the Lock-in: Diversifying Text-to-Image Generation via Representation Modulation
papers.abstract_en: Recent text-to-image models built on large-scale Transformer backbones and flow-based objectives deliver strong text-image alignment and high visual quality, yet often produce overly similar samples under a fixed prompt. Existing diversity-enhancement methods alleviate this issue, but typically require expensive sampling or auxiliary optimization, incurring non-trivial overhead. To investigate the root cause of this homogeneity, we examine intermediate Transformer features and observe that the zero-frequency spatial average (DC) component rapidly converges across seeds early in generation, causing early trajectory lock-in that limits downstream variation. Building on this observation, we propose DC Attenuation for diVersity Enhancement (DAVE), a training-free representation-level intervention that selectively attenuates this component in the early regime. DAVE preserves the sampling pipeline with negligible overhead, improving prompt-consistent diversity while maintaining competitive image quality.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026. Code is available at: https://github.com/daheekwon/DAVE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本到图像生成模型中同一提示下样本同质化的问题，通过分析Transformer中间特征发现零频空间平均（DC）分量早期快速收敛导致轨迹锁定。据此提出DAVE（DC衰减多样性增强）方法，一种无需训练的表示层干预，选择性衰减早期DC分量，以极低开销提升提示一致多样性并保持图像质量。
Motivation: 现有文本到图像模型虽质量高但固定提示下生成样本过于相似，现有多样性增强方法需昂贵采样或辅助优化，开销大。
Method: DAVE：基于对Transformer中间特征的分析，在生成早期选择性衰减零频空间平均（DC）分量，是一种训练自由的表示层干预。
Result: 摘要声称DAVE在保持竞争性图像质量的同时，以可忽略的开销提升了提示一致的多样性。
Conclusion: 本文通过识别DC分量早期锁定为同质化根源，提出一种轻量级无需训练的方法，为提升生成多样性提供了新视角。

papers.title: Lane Change Trajectory Planning for Personalized Driving Comfort and Mobility Efficiency
papers.abstract_en: Lane changing entails simultaneous longitudinal and lateral motions that affect driving comfort and mobility efficiency. Because these motions are tightly coupled and subject to substantial inter-vehicle variability, trajectory planning for lane-change maneuvers is characterized by a highly personalized nature. This study proposes a neural network-driven planner that integrates a third-order polynomial trajectory generator with a learning module that infers optimal trajectory parameters across diverse driving conditions. Using a shared backbone with dual heads, one head ensures all-condition operational guarantees, while the other captures driver-specific preferences for comfort or mobility efficiency. A head-gated switching mechanism, realized through a statistical gate based on error-winner logistic regression, adaptively selects the appropriate head under varying driving conditions, which enables context-aware lane-change trajectory planning. Representative cases and Monte Carlo simulations show that the proposed planner achieves personalized comfort and mobility during lane changes, while the baseline ensures feasible trajectories under driving conditions where personalized data are insufficient or inaccessible.
papers.comment: Accepted by the IEEE Intelligent Vehicles Symposium (IEEE IV 2026), Detroit, MI, United States, June 22_25, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对车道变换中纵向与横向运动耦合、个体差异大的问题，提出一种神经网络驱动的轨迹规划器。该方法融合三阶多项式轨迹生成器与学习模块，通过共享主干和双头架构分别保证全工况可行性与个性化舒适/效率偏好，并利用基于错误胜者逻辑回归的统计门控实现自适应切换。蒙特卡洛模拟表明该方法能在个性化数据不足时仍保证基础轨迹可行性。
Motivation: 现有车道变换轨迹规划未充分考虑纵向与横向运动的强耦合性及驾驶员间显著的个体差异，难以同时满足个性化舒适度与交通流效率。
Method: 提出双头神经网络规划器：共享骨干网络提取特征，一个头基于三阶多项式生成保证全工况可行的基线轨迹，另一个头通过学习历史数据捕捉驾驶员对舒适/效率的个性化偏好；通过错误胜者逻辑回归门控机制根据驾驶条件自适应选择激活的头。
Result: 代表性案例与蒙特卡洛模拟表明，所提规划器在个性化数据充足时实现个性化舒适与效率，在数据不足时基线头仍能保证可行轨迹。
Conclusion: 本文验证了通过门控双头架构可有效兼顾车道变换轨迹规划的个性化与鲁棒性，为自动驾驶中的人机共驾提供了可解释的规划方案。

papers.title: Interpreting Learning Under Competing Models: Joint and Stepwise Approaches for Dynamic Cognitive Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Digital learning environments record learners' responses to individual items, making it possible to study the development of specific skills rather than overall scores. Drawing conclusions about learning from these data requires a model that links responses to latent skills and tracks how mastery changes over time. When the skills measured by each item are unknown, the analyst must decide whether to estimate this structure, the Q-matrix, jointly with the learning process, or to establish it first and study learning afterwards. We show that this decision can change substantive conclusions about how learners develop. Using dynamic cognitive diagnostic models, we analyse data from two reading games measuring vocabulary and comprehension from Grade 2 to Grade 3, with item-text embeddings providing prior information for the unknown Q-matrix. A joint analysis and a bias-corrected stepwise analysis agree that most learners move toward mastering both skills, but disagree about how many remain only partially proficient at Grade 3, changing how reading progress would be reported. A simulation study identifies when the two analyses diverge and shows that joint analysis is more reliable when the item-skill structure is uncertain and the item pool changes between grades. We provide R code for both analyses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了联合估计Q矩阵和学习过程的联合分析法与先估计Q矩阵再分析学习的逐步分析法在动态认知诊断中的差异。基于二年级至三年级的阅读游戏数据（词汇和理解技能）以及模拟研究，发现两种方法对学习进度的结论不一致：联合分析和偏差校正的逐步分析都认为大多数学生掌握了两种技能，但对三年级时仍部分熟练的学生比例有分歧。模拟表明，当项目-技能结构不确定且项目池跨年级变化时，联合分析更可靠。
Motivation: 在数字学习环境中，分析技能发展需要将响应与潜在技能关联的模型。当每个项目测量的技能（Q矩阵）未知时，分析者需要决定是联合估计Q矩阵与学习过程，还是先确定Q矩阵再研究学习。这一决策可能改变对学习者发展的实质性结论。
Method: 使用动态认知诊断模型，对二年级至三年级的两个阅读游戏数据进行分析，利用项目文本嵌入提供Q矩阵的先验信息。比较了联合分析法和偏差校正的逐步分析法，并通过模拟研究识别两者分歧的条件。
Result: 联合分析和偏差校正的逐步分析都显示大多数学生向掌握两种技能发展，但对三年级时仍部分熟练的学生比例结论不一致。模拟表明，当项目-技能结构不确定且项目池跨年级变化时，联合分析更可靠。
Conclusion: 摘要强调了在动态认知诊断中选择分析方法的实际重要性，并建议在不确定的条件下优先使用联合分析。提供了两种分析的R代码。

papers.title: Exploring Reinforcement Learning for Fluid Transitions Between Clinical Mental Healthcare and Everyday Wellness Support
papers.abstract_en: Mental health struggles wax and wane, yet clinical and wellness interventions typically operate separately, causing frequent breakdowns at care transitions. We explore reinforcement learning (RL) as a means to build digital health systems that deliver clinical and wellness interventions proactively, as part of a coherent care journey. We ask: what complexities does designing such a system involve? We built a contextual bandit that dynamically selects journaling prompts from clinical and wellness repertoires to optimize for an overarching health goal (sustained journaling) and deployed it in a four-week exploratory study (N=38). We found that, first, many benefits of RL-optimized intervention sequences appeared only after interventions ended, raising the question: Should systems that offer coherent clinical-wellness care journeys include stepping-back periods? If so, when and how? Second, participants most engaged with RL-generated interventions deepened their engagement over time, while those most engaged with a constant intervention tended to burn out and drop out later. It raises the question: When should a system blending clinical and wellness interventions reduce intensity to prevent burnout in versus sustain it to maximize treatment gains?
papers.journal_ref: Healthcare Beyond Reaction: Harnessing AI and Sensing for Proactive Care, Workshop at ACM Interactive Health 2026 (IH '26), July 05--08, 2026, Porto, Portugal
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索使用强化学习（RL）构建数字健康系统，以在临床心理健康护理和日常健康支持之间实现流畅过渡。通过上下文老虎机动态选择日志提示，优化持续性日志行为，并在四周探索性研究（N=38）中发现RL优化的干预序列的益处常在干预结束后才显现，且高度参与的参与者有不同表现。
Motivation: 心理健康问题波动起伏，但临床干预和健康干预通常分开运行，导致护理过渡频繁中断。需要一种系统来主动提供临床和健康干预，形成连贯的护理旅程。
Method: 构建了一个上下文老虎机，从临床和健康日志提示库中动态选择提示，以优化整体健康目标（持续日志行为）。进行了四周探索性研究。
Result: RL优化的干预序列的益处常在干预结束后才显现；高度参与RL生成干预的参与者随时间加深参与，而高度参与恒定干预的参与者倾向于倦怠并退出。
Conclusion: 提出设计问题：系统是否应包括“退后期”？何时以及如何？系统何时应减少强度以防止倦怠，何时应维持强度以最大化治疗效果？该研究为设计连贯的临床-健康护理旅程提供了初步见解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning All-Terrain Locomotion for a Planetary Rover with Actively Articulated Suspension
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents ERNEST, a four-wheeled planetary rover concept equipped with a two-degree-of-freedom Active Gimbal Suspension that combines yaw and roll actuation to enable wheel reconfiguration, steering, and active load redistribution. A single neural network controller, trained to track a desired path across challenging terrain, fully unlocks the capabilities of this actuated suspension system for autonomous obstacle negotiation. A reinforcement learning framework is developed using the high-fidelity DARTS simulation engine, which combines rigid-contact dynamics and Bekker-Wong terramechanics, enabling the emergence of locomotion strategies adapted to loose-soil conditions. To obtain a single unified controller across heterogeneous terrains, a policy consolidation strategy merges the experience of terrain-specialized agents into one neural network, eliminating the need for explicit terrain classification and controller switching. The resulting controller operates on a combination of proprioceptive and exteroceptive feedback, including sparse stereo-derived terrain elevation, chassis attitude, joint states, and force-torque measurements. Zero-shot transfer to the physical rover is achieved through domain randomization, sensor noise injection, and model-to-real system identification. Experimental results demonstrate autonomous traversal of rock fields, a bump trap, a wheel-high step, sand ripples, and sandy slopes. On a 20° sandy slope, the learned controller reduces the cost of transport by 37% on dry sand despite the additional actuation, and achieves superior performance on wet sand where the passive suspension becomes completely immobilized.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ERNEST，一种四轮行星漫游车概念，配备两自由度主动框架悬挂（Active Gimbal Suspension），通过强化学习训练单一神经网络控制器，实现复杂地形的自主障碍协商。使用高保真DARTS仿真引擎和Bekker-Wong地面力学，通过策略整合合并多地形的专家经验，无需显式地形分类。通过域随机化和传感器噪声注入实现零样本迁移至实体漫游车。实验表明，控制器能自主穿越岩石场、颠簸陷阱、轮高台阶、沙波纹和沙坡，在20°干沙坡上比被动悬挂降低37%运输成本，并在湿沙上表现更优。
Motivation: 现有行星漫游车被动悬挂在复杂地形（如松散土壤、陡坡）上存在局限性，而主动悬挂的控制策略通常依赖显式地形分类和切换，缺乏统一适应多种地形的自主控制器。
Method: 采用强化学习框架，在DARTS仿真中结合刚性接触动力学和Bekker-Wong地面力学，训练单一神经网络控制器。通过策略整合（policy consolidation）合并多个地形特化智能体的经验，利用域随机化、传感器噪声注入和系统辨识实现零样本迁移。控制器融合本体感知和外感反馈，包括稀疏立体地形高程、底盘姿态、关节状态和力-扭矩测量。
Result: 实验显示，控制器能在岩石场、颠簸陷阱、轮高台阶、沙波纹和20°沙坡上自主穿越。在20°干沙坡上，运输成本比被动悬挂降低37%；在湿沙上被动悬挂完全瘫痪，而主动悬挂仍能工作。
Conclusion: 主动悬挂结合强化学习可生成统一的地形适应控制策略，无需显式地形分类，在极端松散土壤条件下显著优于被动悬挂。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 采用强化学习框架，在DARTS仿真中结合刚性接触动力学和Bekker-Wong地面力学，训练单一神经网络控制器。通过策略整合（policy consolidation）合并多个地形特化智能体的经验，利用域随机化、传感器噪声注入和系统辨识实现零样本迁移。控制器融合本体感知和外感反馈，包括稀疏立体地形高程、底盘姿态、关节状态和力-扭矩测量。
summary_sections.result: 实验显示，控制器能在岩石场、颠簸陷阱、轮高台阶、沙波纹和20°沙坡上自主穿越。在20°干沙坡上，运输成本比被动悬挂降低37%；在湿沙上被动悬挂完全瘫痪，而主动悬挂仍能工作。
summary_sections.conclusion: 主动悬挂结合强化学习可生成统一的地形适应控制策略，无需显式地形分类，在极端松散土壤条件下显著优于被动悬挂。

papers.title: AdMem: Advanced Memory for Task-solving Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise as tool-using agents but remain limited in long-horizon tasks that require remembering, organizing, and reusing knowledge. Prior memory approaches aim to resolve the situation, but mainly focus on storing factual information. Recent work on procedural memory improves task reuse, yet often reduces to replaying past successes without addressing failure cases or online scalability. We introduce a unified and automatic memory framework that integrates semantic, episodic, and procedural memory in a bi-level design combining short-term and long-term stores. A multi-agent architecture with actor, memory, and critic agents enables automatic memory generation, reward annotation, and adaptive retrieval. Long-term memory is managed through reward-based evaluation, merging, and pruning, ensuring scalability and continual improvement. Experiments across various environments show that our approach improves robustness and success on long multi-turn tasks compared to existing baselines. This work highlights the importance of comprehensive, adaptive memory for advancing LLM-based agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AdMem，一个统一的自动记忆框架，整合语义、情景和程序记忆，采用短期与长期存储的双层设计及多智能体架构（actor、memory、critic），实现自动记忆生成、奖励标注和自适应检索。实验表明，该方法在长期多轮任务上比现有基线更鲁棒和成功。
Motivation: 现有LLM代理在长时任务中难以记住、组织和重用知识；先前记忆方法主要存储事实信息，而程序记忆方法偏向回放成功案例，未处理失败案例且缺乏在线可扩展性。
Method: 提出统一自动记忆框架，融合三种记忆类型，采用双层存储（短期+长期）和多智能体架构，通过基于奖励的评估、合并与剪枝管理长期记忆，支持自动记忆生成与自适应检索。
Result: 在各种环境中，该方法在长期多轮任务上相比现有基线提升了鲁棒性和成功率。
Conclusion: 该工作强调全面、自适应的记忆对于推进基于LLM的代理的重要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Federated Foundation Models over Vehicular Networks
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a forward-looking vision for integrating the emerging multi-modal multi-task federated foundation models (M3T FedFMs) into vehicular networks, with the goal of unifying the expressive power of multi-modal multi-task foundation models (M3T FMs) with the privacy-preserving and distributed learning capabilities of federated learning (FL). Given the largely underexplored nature of this research direction, we first introduce the fundamental training/fine-tuning principles of M3T FedFMs. We then discuss a range of their representative use cases in vehicular networks, illustrating the significant potential of M3T FedFMs to enable next-generation vehicular intelligence. Afterwards, we identify key constraints inherent to vehicular environments that challenge the practical deployment of M3T FedFMs, and articulate a set of forward-looking research directions to address these challenges. Furthermore, through a case study conducted on a real-world vehicular dataset (i.e., Waymo Open Dataset), we demonstrate the promise of M3T FedFMs for vehicular networks and release our implementation to facilitate reproducibility and stimulate research in this emerging area (repository: https://github.com/KasraBorazjani/vehicular-fedfm)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将多模态多任务联邦基础模型（M3T FedFMs）集成到车辆网络中的前瞻性愿景，旨在统一基础模型的表达能力和联邦学习的隐私保护分布式学习能力。论文介绍了M3T FedFMs的训练/微调原理，讨论了车辆网络中的代表性用例，识别了实际部署中的关键约束，并提出了未来研究方向。通过在Waymo开放数据集上的案例研究，展示了其潜力并开源了实现代码。
Motivation: 车辆网络中需要统一多模态多任务基础模型的强大表达能力和联邦学习的隐私保护分布式学习能力，而这一方向尚未被充分探索。
Method: 首先引入M3T FedFMs的基本训练/微调原理，然后讨论其在车辆网络中的代表性用例，随后识别实际部署中的关键约束并提出研究方向，最后通过Waymo数据集案例研究验证。
Result: 在Waymo开放数据集上的案例研究展示了M3T FedFMs在车辆网络中的潜力，并开源了实现代码以促进可重复性和研究。
Conclusion: 论文强调了M3T FedFMs在车辆网络中的巨大潜力，并指出了未来需要解决的关键挑战，如车辆环境固有的约束。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Empirical Transfer Operators and Finite-Sample Change Detection for Noisy Expanding Interval Maps
papers.abstract_en: We study finite-sample change detection for one-dimensional noisy dynamical systems using partition-based empirical approximations of stationary behaviour. Given observations from an interval-valued process, we partition the state space, estimate a finite transition matrix from observed transitions between partition elements, and apply a small Doeblin-type regularisation to ensure a unique stationary distribution. From an initial reference segment, we compute a baseline empirical stationary distribution \(\widehatπ_{0,ρ}\). For each later sliding window, we compute \(\widehatπ_{t,ρ}\) and define the score \[ S_t=\|\widehatπ_{t,ρ}-\widehatπ_{0,ρ}\|_1. \] Large values of \(S_t\) indicate a change in stationary behaviour relative to the baseline. The statistic detects changes in invariant density or stationary law, but not all possible changes in transition dynamics. Under explicit assumptions on empirical transition concentration, finite-state stationary distribution stability, partition approximation, regularisation bias, and noise stability, we derive a finite-sample bound for the empirical stationary density. The bound separates sampling error, regularisation bias, partition approximation error, and noise bias. We then obtain a single-window false-alarm guarantee and a sufficient detection condition when the invariant density changes by more than the estimation error. We illustrate the method on synthetic noisy beta-map change-point experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一维含噪动力系统的有限样本变化检测问题，通过分区经验近似平稳行为，估计转移矩阵并应用Doeblin正则化得到平稳分布，定义基于L1距离的检测统计量，给出了有限样本界和误报保证，并用含噪beta-map实验验证。
Motivation: 现有变化检测方法多假设独立同分布或已知动力学模型，而实际观测常来自含噪动力系统，需要从数据中直接估计平稳行为并检测其变化。
Method: 提出一种基于分区经验转移算子的变化检测方法：将状态空间分区，估计经验转移矩阵并加Doeblin正则化确保唯一平稳分布，比较基线窗口与滑动窗口的经验平稳分布的L1距离。
Result: 推导了经验平稳分布的有限样本误差界（分离抽样、正则化、分区近似和噪声偏差），给出了单窗口误报保证和足够检测条件，在含噪beta-map合成实验中验证了有效性。
Conclusion: 该方法能检测不变密度或平稳定律的变化，但不能检测所有可能的转移动力学变化；理论保证依赖经验转移集中性等假设。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: What Your Posts Reveal: A Benchmark and Agentic Framework for User-Level Privacy Leakage on Social Media
papers.abstract_en: Public social media posts can reveal private information through weak cues scattered across text, images, or metadata. Such leakage is often cumulative and cross-post: cues that appear harmless in isolation may jointly expose a user's home, workplace, or routine. However, current research lacks a unified benchmark for user-level multimodal privacy leakage and an evaluation metric that captures exposure severity beyond binary accuracy. To address these gaps, we propose SopriBench, a synthetic benchmark guided by leakage patterns abstracted from a private reference corpus of Rednote and Instagram accounts, covering 50 user profiles and 1,569 images with attributes, contextual sensitivity, granularity, leakage type, inference difficulty, and supporting evidence. We further introduce the Privacy Exposure Score (PES), which weights value granularity by contextual sensitivity. Inspired by abductive reasoning, we introduce Argus, a training-free agentic framework for cumulative leakage inference. Argus forms hypotheses from accumulated evidence, verifies supporting evidence, and aggregates cross-post cues into privacy profiles, achieving 0.55 PES, a 25% improvement over the strongest baseline, with the largest gain on cross-post leakage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对社交媒体用户级隐私泄露缺乏统一基准和评估指标的问题，提出了SopriBench合成基准，涵盖50个用户画像和1569张图片，并引入隐私暴露评分（PES）。同时提出Argus，一种基于溯因推理的无训练主体框架，通过跨帖子线索聚合进行隐私推理，在PES上达到0.55，较最强基线提升25%。
Motivation: 现有研究缺乏统一的用户级多模态隐私泄露基准和能够量化暴露严重程度的评估指标（仅依赖二元准确率）。
Method: 构建SopriBench合成基准，基于Rednote和Instagram的隐私泄露模式设计；提出PES评分，通过上下文敏感性加权属性粒度；提出Argus框架，利用溯因推理形成假设、验证证据并聚合跨帖子线索。
Result: Argus在PES上达到0.55，比最强基线提升25%，最大改进来自跨帖子泄露场景。
Conclusion: 该工作填补了用户级隐私泄露评估的空白，但摘要未明确提及局限性。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning from Rich Feedback with Distributional DAgger
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning models have advanced rapidly, but the dominant reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) recipe remains surprisingly narrow: sample many responses and reward each with a single bit indicating whether the final answer is correct. Yet many settings provide rich feedback, including execution traces, tool outputs, expert corrections, and model self-evaluations. We study how to use such feedback through a distributional variant of the classic imitation learning algorithm DAgger, where the learner has local access to an expert distribution on states visited by the current policy. This yields a simple forward cross-entropy objective that admits a blackbox expert and whose sequence-level gradient {conduct rich credit assignment by propagating} future expert-student disagreement back to earlier decisions. We show that prior RL with self-distillation objectives based on reverse KL or Jensen-Shannon fail to guarantee monotonic policy improvement: even when the expert has higher reward, their updates may increase probability on worse actions. In contrast, we show that forward cross-entropy admits monotonic policy improvement and enjoys guarantees on regret. We further show that our objective optimizes a lower bound on teacher-weighted likelihood of success, leading to improved Pass@N. Empirically, our approach, DistIL, improves over RLVR and RL with self-distillation baselines across a variety of domains: scientific reasoning, coding, and solving hard mathematical problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对当前强化学习仅使用单一正确位奖励的局限，提出通过分布性DAgger算法利用丰富反馈（执行轨迹、工具输出、专家修正等）。方法基于前向交叉熵目标，理论上保证单调策略改进和后悔界，并优化教师加权成功似然的下界。实验在科学推理、编码和数学解题等任务上超越RLVR和自蒸馏基线。
Motivation: 现有RLVR仅使用最终答案是否正确这一单一比特信号，忽略了执行轨迹、工具输出等丰富反馈信息，限制了复杂推理任务的性能。
Method: 提出分布性DAgger（DistIL），将经典DAgger的专家分布变为局部可访问的分布，采用前向交叉熵目标，利用序列级梯度将未来专家与学生的不一致传播回早期决策，实现信用分配。
Result: 实验表明，DistIL在科学推理、编码和数学解题等任务上，Pass@N等指标优于RLVR和基于自蒸馏的强化学习方法。理论证明前向交叉熵能保证单调策略改进和后悔界。
Conclusion: 本文表明利用丰富反馈的分布性DAgger方法能有效提升推理模型性能，且理论性质优于反向KL或JS散度目标。

papers.title: Scenario Generation for Risk-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Probably Approximately Safe Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Guaranteeing safety is critical to the deployment of reinforcement learning (RL) agents in the real-world, especially as policies learned using deep RL may demonstrate susceptibility to transition perturbations that result in unknown or unsafe behaviour. A method of policy verification is to construct probabilistic barrier-certificates by sampling policy trajectories with respect to safety constraints, thereby demarcating known safe behaviour from unknown behaviour. Obtaining tight upper and lower bounds on the probability of violation of these constraints may be difficult if the policy is susceptible to transition uncertainty or perturbation that places the agent in insufficiently explored states. To address this, we approximate the distribution of the encountered state-space using a variational autoencoder (VAE) and construct upper and lower-bound barrier-certificates using latent characteristics of states to optimize for regions of known, safe behaviour with high confidence. We frame this in our work as a dual optimization problem where the lower-bound barrier-certificate presents a more conservative estimate of the safe region than the upper-bound barrier-certificate. Sampling states that lie within the set difference of the two during training, i.e. the non-robust region, allows us to tighten the upper and lower bounds to provide sharper probabilistic guarantees on safety. Within our study, we describe the guarantees placed and demonstrate the tightness of our bounds experimentally.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于变分自编码器（VAE）的场景生成方法，用于风险感知强化学习中的安全验证。通过构建概率屏障证书的上界和下界，并利用非鲁棒区域的采样来收紧安全概率边界，提供更紧的'大概正确安全'（Probably Approximately Safe）保证。
Motivation: 强化学习策略在部署时可能因转移扰动而出现未知或不安全行为，传统方法难以获得紧的安全违反概率边界，尤其是在状态空间探索不充分的情况下。
Method: 使用VAE近似状态空间分布，构建基于潜在特征的上下界屏障证书，并定义为对偶优化问题。训练过程中采样位于上下界之间的非鲁棒区域状态，以收紧边界。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但声称实验展示了边界的紧性。
Conclusion: 该方法通过收紧上下界屏障证书提供更精确的概率安全保证，提升了安全验证的可靠性。

papers.title: GENEB: Why Genomic Models Are Hard to Compare
papers.abstract_en: Progress in genomic foundation models is difficult to assess due to fragmented benchmarks, incompatible evaluation protocols, and task-specific reporting. As a result, claims of superiority or generality across models are often not directly comparable. We introduce GENEB, a large-scale diagnostic benchmark that evaluates frozen representations from 40 genomic foundation models across 100 tasks spanning 13 functional categories under a unified probing-based protocol, including few-shot regimes. GENEB enables controlled comparison across model scale, architecture, tokenization, and pretraining data while explicitly exposing task-level trade-offs. Our analysis shows that aggregate leaderboards are unstable: model rankings vary sharply across task categories, scale provides only modest and inconsistent gains, and architectural and pretraining alignment frequently outweigh parameter count. These results highlight limitations of current evaluation practices and position GENEB as a reference framework for principled comparison and category-aware model selection in genomic machine learning.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GENEB基准，对40个基因组基础模型在100个任务上进行统一评估，发现聚合排行榜不稳定，模型排名随任务类别、规模、架构等变化。
Motivation: 基因组基础模型的进展难以评估，因为基准碎片化、评估协议不兼容、报告方式不统一，导致模型优越性或通用性的声明无法直接比较。
Method: GENEB是一个大规模诊断基准，采用统一的探测（probing）协议，评估40个基因组基础模型的冻结表征，涵盖100个任务（13个功能类别），包括少样本设置。
Result: 聚合排行榜不稳定：模型排名在不同任务类别中差异很大；规模带来的增益有限且不一致；架构和预训练对齐通常比参数数量更重要。
Conclusion: 当前评估实践存在局限性，GENEB可作为基因组机器学习中原则性比较和类别感知模型选择的参考框架。

papers.title: Selective Coupling of Decoupled Informative Regions: Masked Attention Alignment for Data-Free Quantization of Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Data-Free Quantization (DFQ) addresses data security concerns by synthesizing samples, without accessing real data. It has garnered increasing attention in the context of Vision Transformers (ViTs), owing to the superiority of the self-attention mechanism compared to classical convolutional operation. However, previous DFQ arts for ViTs often suffer from a distribution mismatch between synthetic samples and input distribution expected by quantized models Q, resulting in the suboptimal performance. In this paper, we propose a novel Masked Attention Alignment approach for Data-Free Quantization of ViTs, named MaskAQ, revealing that: 1) the semantics in the self-attention mechanism is predominantly localized to a sparse subset of patches, called informative regions; 2) the informative regions dominate the mutual information between synthetic samples and Q's outputs. To these ends, we incorporate differential entropy maximum over patch similarity of synthetic samples, to decouple informative regions from noisy background. To couple with varied Q, the informative regions are selected to align full-precision models with Q via a masked attention alignment objective, thus yielding high-quality synthetic samples. Furthermore, a periodic sample refreshing strategy comes up to endow MaskAQ with the capacity to continually adapt to the evolving state of Q throughout the training process, to preserve desirable mutual information with synthetic samples. Extensive experiments verify the merits of MaskAQ over state-of-the-art approaches across multiple backbones and downstream tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/hfutqian/MaskAQ.
papers.comment: Accepted to appear at ICML 2026, Seoul, Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉 Transformer (ViT) 的无数据量化 (DFQ) 问题，提出 Masked Attention Alignment 方法 (MaskAQ)。方法发现自注意力中的语义主要集中在下采样区域（informative regions），通过解耦这些区域并使用掩码注意力对齐目标来生成高质量合成样本，以缓解分布不匹配问题。实验表明 MaskAQ 在多个骨干网络和下游任务上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有 ViT 的无数据量化方法常因合成样本与量化模型期望的输入分布之间存在分布不匹配而导致性能欠佳。
Method: 提出 MaskAQ，利用合成样本的块相似性微分熵最大化解耦信息区域，并通过掩码注意力对齐目标将全精度模型与量化模型对齐，同时引入周期性样本刷新策略以适应量化模型的演化状态。
Result: 摘要报告在多个骨干网络和下游任务上优于现有方法，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Conclusion: 本文提出的解耦信息区域和掩码注意力对齐能够提升无数据量化下 ViT 的性能，方法具有泛化性。

papers.title: MorphoQuant: Modality-Aware Quantization for Omni-modal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Conventional Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) methods struggle with 4-bit Omni-modal Large Language Models (OLLMs) due to the extreme distribution heterogeneity and disparate outlier patterns across modalities. To address this, we propose MorphoQuant, a modality-aware PTQ framework engineered to preserve cross-modal morphology and mitigate outlier loss. Specifically, we introduce Distribution-Aware Bias Compensation (DABC), which selectively absorbs long-tailed outliers into channel-wise biases. This mechanism safeguards outlier magnitudes while maintaining high-precision discretization for dense inliers, thereby preserving accurate discretization across diverse modal distribution. Complementing this, we propose Morphology-Directed Quantization Function Optimization (MDQFO) to co-optimize the quantization grid with the bias mask, ensuring fine-grained alignment across modalities. Extensive evaluations on Qwen2.5-Omni across benchmarks like MMMU and Video-MME demonstrate our approach's superiority. Notably, our W4A4 model achieves 76.63% on ScienceQA, significantly outperforming SOTA W4A4 methods and surprisingly surpassing the W4A16 baseline, which fully demonstrates the exceptional accuracy-efficiency trade-off of our framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MorphoQuant，一种面向全模态大语言模型（OLLM）的模态感知后训练量化（PTQ）框架。通过分布感知偏置补偿（DABC）和形态引导量化函数优化（MDQFO），解决跨模态分布异构和异常值模式差异问题。在 Qwen2.5-Omni 上的实验表明，W4A4 量化模型在 ScienceQA 上达到 76.63%，优于现有 W4A4 方法甚至 W4A16 基线。
Motivation: 传统 PTQ 方法在处理 4-bit 全模态大语言模型时，因模态间分布异构和异常值模式差异而表现不佳。
Method: 提出 MorphoQuant 框架，包含两个模块：分布感知偏置补偿（DABC）选择性地将长尾异常值吸收为通道偏置，保护异常值幅值同时保持高精度离散化；形态引导量化函数优化（MDQFO）联合优化量化网格与偏置掩码，实现跨模态细粒度对齐。
Result: 在 Qwen2.5-Omni 上，W4A4 模型在 ScienceQA 上取得 76.63% 准确率，超越所有现有 W4A4 方法，并意外超过 W4A16 基线，展示了优异的精度-效率权衡。
Conclusion: MorphoQuant 通过模态感知的量化策略，有效缓解了全模态大模型量化中的分布异构问题，无需额外数据或复杂训练即可实现低比特高水平性能。

papers.title: The Role of Source Geometry and Atmospheric Propagation in Global Bolide Infrasound Detectability
papers.abstract_en: Global infrasound monitoring provides a persistent means of detecting energetic bolide atmospheric entries, complementing optical observations and extending coverage over remote regions. We present a global assessment of the physical factors governing bolide infrasound detectability by correlating 623 bolide events reported by the Center for Near-Earth Object Studies between 2007 and 2025 with waveform data from the International Monitoring System. We identify 311 events with confirmed infrasound detections, corresponding to a detection rate of approximately 50%, substantially higher than inferred from earlier surveys, reflecting both the maturation of the global infrasound network and advances in automated, multi-frequency array processing. Analysis of flight parameters shows that infrasound detectability is selective rather than uniform across the bolide population. Detected events are preferentially associated with steeper entry angles and lower-altitude energy deposition, while shallow, high-altitude trajectories are less consistently observed. Very high-energy events remain detectable regardless of geometry, but for the more common lower-energy regime, observability depends on specific combinations of entry parameters and propagation conditions. This geometric dependence persists across comparable energy ranges and atmospheric conditions, indicating that entry angle exerts a primary control on detectability, with energy and propagation acting as secondary modulating factors. These results provide new physical constraints on bolide-atmosphere interactions and improve interpretation of global infrasound observations for planetary defense and atmospheric-entry studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过分析2007-2025年间623个陨石事件与国际监测系统（IMS）的次声波数据，发现约50%的探测率，远高于以往估计。结果表明，次声波可探测性与进入角度和能量沉积高度等几何因素密切相关：高能量事件始终可探测，而低能量事件的可探测性依赖于入口参数的特定组合。
Motivation: 理解全球陨石次声波可探测性的物理因素，以弥补光学观测的不足并扩展对偏远区域的覆盖，为行星防御和大气进入研究提供更准确的全球次声波数据解释。
Method: 将623个CNEOS报告的陨石事件与IMS次声波波形数据关联，统计确认311次探测（约50%探测率），并分析飞行参数（进入角度、能量沉积高度等）与探测率的关系。
Result: 探测事件优先对应陡峭进入角度和低空能量沉积；浅层高空轨迹的陨石更难以探测。高能量事件不受几何限制，但较低能量事件的可探测性取决于入口参数和传播条件的特定组合。
Conclusion: 进入角度是探测性的主要控制因素，能量和传播条件是次要调节因素；该研究为全球次声波观测的解释提供了新的物理约束，有助于改进陨石-大气相互作用模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UltraEP: Unleash MoE Training and Inference on Rack-Scale Nodes with Near-Optimal Load Balancing
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale expert parallelism (EP) is becoming pivotal for training and serving frontier MoE models, but it also amplifies device-level expert load imbalance into compute stragglers, token all-to-all bottlenecks, and activation-memory spikes. Existing balancers redistribute experts periodically based on historical load, which becomes unreliable for production deployments with non-stationary load patterns. We present UltraEP, the first exact-load, real-time balancer for large-EP MoE training and serving prefill on rack-scale nodes (RSNs). Built upon the extended scale-up connectivity of RSNs, UltraEP rebalances every microbatch and layer on critical paths, which requires nontrivial co-design of plan solving and expert replication communication to minimize exposed overhead. To this end, UltraEP eagerly reacts to post-gating load with efficient quota-driven planning, and executes the resulting irregular expert-state transfers with RSN-native persistent tile streaming and relay-based fan-out mitigation. Averaged across MoE models from 106B to 671B parameters in training and prefill, UltraEP achieves 94.3% of the force-balanced ideal throughput, delivering 1.49$\times$ improvement over non-balancing, while reducing the final inter-rank imbalance from 1.30$-$4.01 to 1.01$-$1.04. Additionally, we validate UltraEP's scalability and robustness in production MoE training with 2560 GPUs.
papers.comment: The authors have identified issues related to information disclosure in the current version of the manuscript and therefore request its withdrawal. A revised version may be prepared at a later date
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出UltraEP，首个面向大规模专家并行（EP）MoE训练和推理预填充阶段的精确负载实时均衡器。利用机架级节点（RSN）的扩展性，在每个微批次和每层进行再均衡，通过配额驱动规划与专家复制通信协同设计实现近最优负载均衡。实验表明，在106B至671B参数的MoE模型上达到94.3%的理想吞吐量，比无均衡提升1.49倍，最终跨节点不均衡从1.30-4.01降至1.01-1.04，并在2560 GPU规模的生产环境中验证了可扩展性。
Motivation: 现有基于历史负载的均衡器在非平稳负载模式下不可靠，导致计算拖尾、all-to-all瓶颈和激活内存尖峰，亟需适用于生产环境的实时精确均衡方案。
Method: 基于RSN的扩展连接，实现每个微批次和每层的实时再均衡。采用配额驱动规划快速响应门控后负载，并通过RSN原生持久块流传输和基于中继的扇出缓解机制执行非规则专家状态迁移。
Result: 在训练和预填充场景下，平均达到力平衡理想吞吐量的94.3%，相比无均衡提升1.49倍，最终跨等级不均衡从1.30-4.01降至1.01-1.04。在2560 GPU生产MoE训练中验证可扩展性和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: UltraEP通过精确实时均衡解决了大规模MoE负载不均衡问题，接近理论最优吞吐量，适用于生产级部署。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: UltraEP通过精确实时均衡解决了大规模MoE负载不均衡问题，接近理论最优吞吐量，适用于生产级部署。

papers.title: Spectral Scaling Laws of Muon
papers.abstract_en: Orthonormalized update rules have rapidly become a leading choice of optimizer for training large language models, with recent open-source state-of-the-art models adopting Muon. To keep these updates tractable, Muon performs the orthonormalization with the Newton--Schulz (NS) iteration. Since NS is only approximate, directions with small singular values fail to be orthonormalized. In Muon, NS is applied to the momentum matrix at every step, yet little is known about how the singular value spectrum of these momentum matrices behaves during training, or how that behavior changes with model size. We present the first systematic study of this question. Tracking singular value quantiles of the momentum buffer across layers in models ranging from 77M to 2.8B parameters, we observe a consistent picture: after a short burn-in, the quantiles stabilize at a value determined by the layer type and model size. These stabilization values follow remarkably clean power laws in model size, with layer-dependent exponents. Layers up to mid-late depth scale very mildly with model size $M$ (around $M^{-0.25}$), so the standard 5-step NS configuration used at academic scale will continue to orthonormalize them at much larger scales. Some of the late layers, however, scale much more aggressively (up to $M^{-0.96}$) and will fall into the NS failure regime at frontier scale unless one uses more NS iterations or better-tuned coefficients. NS iterations are computationally expensive at scale; our laws give practitioners a principled, layer-aware recipe for choosing the minimum NS configuration that still orthonormalizes the directions that matter -- avoiding unnecessary computation without sacrificing update quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究Muon优化器中动量矩阵的奇异值谱随模型规模变化的规律。在77M到2.8B参数的模型上，奇异值分位数经短时预热后稳定，稳定值随模型大小呈幂律衰减，且不同层指数不同：中浅层指数约-0.25，晚期层指数可达-0.96。该发现揭示了在更大规模下使用Newton-Schulz迭代时可能失效的问题，并为选择最小迭代次数提供了理论指导。
Motivation: Muon优化器使用Newton-Schulz近似进行正交归一化，但小奇异值方向无法被正确归一化，且缺乏对动量矩阵谱行为随模型规模变化的理解。
Method: 跟踪不同规模（77M至2.8B参数）模型各层动量缓冲的奇异值分位数，观察其稳定值并拟合出与模型大小的幂律关系。
Result: 奇异值稳定值随模型大小呈幂律衰减：中浅层指数约-0.25（变化平缓），部分晚期层指数高达-0.96（变化剧烈），后者在前沿规模下将进入NS失效区域。
Conclusion: 根据层类型和模型大小，可按幂律规律选择最小Newton-Schulz迭代配置，避免不必要的计算而不牺牲更新质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Analytical Evaluation of DCA Convergence Properties for Minimizing Prediction Functions of Gaussian RBF Support Vector Regression
papers.abstract_en: For nonconvex optimization problems whose objective is the prediction function of a trained Support Vector Regression (SVR) model with the Gaussian radial basis function (RBF) kernel (RBF-SVR), we present a framework that applies the difference of convex functions (DC) algorithm (DCA) by exploiting the analytical structure of the RBF kernel to construct an explicit DC decomposition. Specifically, we derive in closed form both the lower bound $μ$ of the strong convexity parameter of the DC components and the upper bound $L$ of the gradient Lipschitz constant of the subproblem. Both $μ$ and $L$ are determined solely by the post-training dual-coefficient sum $C_α$ and the RBF kernel parameter $γ$, together with the DC decomposition parameter $ρ$, and they share a common leading term $C_αρ$. Through numerical experiments on six benchmark functions, we show that $C_αρ$ is the primary single quantity characterizing both the convergence properties and the initial-point dependence of DCA, and further demonstrate that it decomposes into two independent pathways, $C \to C_α$ and $γ\to ρ$, with its primary variation governed by the SVR hyperparameters $(C, γ)$. Together, these results allow the convergence properties of DCA on RBF-SVR to be assessed in advance through the single scalar quantity $C_αρ$: approximately from $(C, γ)$ before training, and exactly in closed form after training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对以高斯RBF核SVR预测函数为目标函数的非凸优化问题，提出了应用差分凸函数算法（DCA）的框架，通过分析RBF核的解析结构构造显式DC分解。推导了DC分量的强凸性参数下界μ和子问题的梯度Lipschitz常数上界L，它们仅由训练后对偶系数和C_α、RBF核参数γ及DC分解参数ρ决定，共享共同主导项C_αρ。数值实验表明C_αρ是刻画DCA收敛性和初值依赖性的主要单一量，并可分解为两条独立路径，其变化主要由SVR超参数(C,γ)控制。
Motivation: 非凸优化问题（RBF-SVR预测函数）的DCA收敛性质缺乏先验分析，现有方法未能利用RBF核的结构提供显式界。
Method: 提出利用RBF核的解析结构构造显式DC分解，推导出闭式的强凸性参数下界和Lipschitz常数上界，并通过数值实验验证C_αρ作为关键量的作用。
Result: 实验表明C_αρ是决定DCA收敛性能和初值依赖性的主要单一标量，且可分解为独立路径，其变化主要由SVR超参数(C,γ)支配。
Conclusion: 该框架允许在训练前通过(C,γ)近似估计DCA收敛性质，训练后可通过闭式精确计算，为实际应用提供先验指导。

papers.title: Optimizing Explicit Unit-Distance Lower-Bound Certificates
papers.abstract_en: The 2026 disproof of Erdős's unit-distance conjecture and Sawin's quantitative refinement show that the maximum number $u(n)$ of unit distances among $n$ planar points can exceed $n^{1+\varepsilon}$ for a fixed positive $\varepsilon$. Sawin's explicit bound gives more than $n^{1.014}$ unit distances for arbitrarily large $n$ and exposes integer parameters whose choice is not fully optimized. This report starts from Sawin's nonlinear integer optimization problem and develops an open-source Python optimization and verification pipeline, first validating it by reproducing Sawin's parameters and then applying it to improved certificates. We optimize and verify certificates involving prime sets $T$ and $S_Q$, integer multiplicities $k(p)$, and a rationally encoded real parameter $R$. The implementation is lean and lightweight, so all results can be replicated on standard hardware and the procedures extended. We propose a deterministic greedy construction heuristic, a tailored integer evolution strategy with geometric mutation and repair operators to maintain number-theoretic feasibility, and an optional two-parent recombination variant. Four certificate levels are compared: Sawin's example with $δ=0.014114\ldots$, a greedy certificate with $δ=0.015172\ldots$, an evolution-strategy certificate with $R=6672416/100000$ and $δ=0.015262\ldots$, and a recombination variant, again with this $R$, with $δ=0.015263\ldots$. Consequently, the best reported certificate supports the cautious clean statement $u(n)>n^{1.0152}$ for arbitrarily large $n$ using the same set $T$ as in Sawin 2026, and a further improvement found with this framework hints at $u(n)>n^{1.031}$ for extended ramified prime ranges. Beyond this application, the work illustrates how randomized optimization heuristics can explore and improve explicit certificates in pure mathematics and combinatorial geometry.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 9 figures We mention a new result that was achieved with the framework by a communication with Francesco Cordella on 4 June 2026. But for verification we will provide a new report
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对Sawin关于Erdős单位距离猜想的下界证书中的整数参数优化问题，开发了一套开源Python优化与验证流水线。通过贪婪启发式、整数进化策略和重组变体等方法，将下界从Sawin的n^{1.014}改进到n^{1.0152}，并暗示可能达到n^{1.031}。
Motivation: Sawin的显式下界n^{1.014}中的整数参数未完全优化，存在进一步提升空间，且需要可复现的验证工具。
Method: 提出确定性贪婪构造启发式、带几何变异和修复算子的整数进化策略、以及可选的双亲重组变体，用于优化素数集T和S_Q、整数重数k(p)及有理参数R。
Result: 获得四个证书级别：Sawin原始δ=0.014114，贪婪δ=0.015172，进化策略δ=0.015262，重组变体δ=0.015263。最佳证书支持u(n)>n^{1.0152}，进一步改进暗示u(n)>n^{1.031}。
Conclusion: 展示了随机优化启发式可用于探索和改进纯数学中的显式证书，所有结果可在标准硬件上复现。

papers.title: A Negative Result on Cross-Model Activation Transfer in a Pythia Multi-Hop Setting
papers.abstract_en: Recent work shows that language models can transmit behavioural traits through hidden signals in generated data during training. We ask whether a different activation-mediated channel is viable: can one language model communicate a useful intermediate reasoning state to another at inference time through a post-hoc linear activation bridge, rather than through a textual or structured-token relay? We test this question in a controlled Pythia-160M to Pythia-410M multi-hop reasoning setting. A linear translation layer learns a strong normalized-space map between sender and receiver hidden states, with normalized cosine similarity near 0.97 across seeds. However, when the translated activations are injected into the receiver at inference time, they do not improve downstream answering. Low-strength additive injection remains near the no-injection baseline, with confidence intervals that cross zero. Replacement-style injection is consistently destructive, and rescaling translated vectors to the receiver hidden-state norm does not rescue performance. The result is therefore a scoped negative result: in this setting, offline representational alignment is not sufficient for useful causal communication inside the receiver.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探究语言模型之间能否通过后验线性激活桥传递中间推理状态。在Pythia-160M到Pythia-410M的多跳推理实验中，线性翻译层能学习到隐藏状态间的强映射（归一化余弦相似度接近0.97），但注入翻译后的激活不能提升下游回答性能。低强度加法注入无改善，替换式注入破坏性能，重新缩放也不起作用。这是一个有范围的负结果。
Motivation: 现有工作表明语言模型可通过训练数据中的隐藏信号传递行为特征，本文研究另一种激活介导通道：一个语言模型能否在推理时通过后验线性激活桥向另一个模型传递有用的中间推理状态。
Method: 在受控的Pythia-160M到Pythia-410M多跳推理设置中，训练线性翻译层学习发送者和接收者隐藏状态间的归一化空间映射，然后将翻译激活注入接收者，尝试低强度加法注入、替换式注入和重新缩放。
Result: 线性翻译层能实现强映射（归一化余弦相似度接近0.97），但注入翻译激活不能改善下游回答。低强度加法注入基线无变化（置信区间包含零），替换式注入始终破坏性能，重新缩放也无效果。
Conclusion: 在该设置下，离线表示对齐不足以实现有用的因果通信，这是一个有范围的负结果。

papers.title: OpenAgenet / OAN Yellow Paper: Technical Architecture for Trust-Governed Resource Identity and Discovery
papers.abstract_en: This yellow paper describes the technical architecture of OpenAgenet / OAN. OAN is a protocol-neutral trust layer for open Agent interconnection and discoverable AI resource products. It specifies the role architecture, \texttt{did:oan} identity objects, registration workflow, governance-backed Root lifecycle enforcement, Root-verified package model, authorization-aware Discovery, Root-issued infrastructure authorization VCs, signed trusted invocation, verification requirements, state transitions, security properties, implementation boundaries, and deployment considerations. The design is intended to support heterogeneous Agent frameworks and interaction protocols, including MCP, A2A, ANP-like systems, domain-specific Agent protocols, Skills, MCP Servers, and Tool/API resources. OAN does not define the entire business conversation among Agents or the native protocol of every resource; it defines how resource identities become admissible, discoverable, verifiable, and safe to approach before protocol-specific interaction begins.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该黄皮书描述了OpenAgenet / OAN的技术架构，OAN是一个协议无关的信任层，用于开放Agent互联和可发现的AI资源产品。详细说明了角色架构、did:oan身份对象、注册工作流、治理支持的生命周期执行、Root验证的包模型、授权感知的发现、Root签发的授权VC、签名可信调用、验证要求、状态转换、安全属性、实现边界和部署考虑。设计旨在支持异构Agent框架和交互协议，包括MCP、A2A、ANP类系统、领域特定Agent协议、技能、MCP服务器和工具/API资源。OAN不定义Agent间的完整业务对话或每个资源的原生协议，而是定义资源身份在协议特定交互之前如何变得可接受、可发现、可验证和安全。
Motivation: 现有Agent交互缺乏统一的信任和发现机制，导致异构框架和协议间资源身份不可信、不可验证，难以安全互操作。
Method: 提出OAN技术架构，包括did:oan身份对象、注册工作流、治理生命周期执行、Root验证的包模型、授权感知发现、Root签发的授权VC和签名可信调用，通过分层信任模型实现资源身份的可信管理。
Result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果或性能数据，仅描述架构设计。
Conclusion: OAN为Agent互联提供信任基础设施，不定义业务对话，而关注身份的可接受性、可发现性、可验证性和安全性，支持多种协议和框架。

papers.title: OpenAgenet / OAN White Paper: Open Infrastructure for Trusted Agent Interconnection
papers.abstract_en: OpenAgenet, abbreviated as OAN, is an open infrastructure project for trusted Agent interconnection. It addresses a problem that becomes visible when Agents move from isolated applications into open, multi-operator networks: before an Agent can safely discover, select, and invoke another Agent, it needs a way to verify identity provenance, governance state, discovery authorization, freshness, and pre-connection trust evidence. OAN is designed as a protocol-neutral trust layer. It does not replace Agent interaction protocols, tool protocols, model orchestration frameworks, or application-level workflows. Instead, it provides \texttt{did:oan}-based resource identity, governance-backed admission, Registrar-assisted onboarding, Root-verified package publication, authorization-aware Discovery, Root-issued infrastructure authorization VCs, and signed trusted invocation. The architectural center of OAN is the combination of federated governance, resource identity, and trusted Discovery, rather than a single directory or naming service. This white paper explains the motivation, architecture, roles, governance model, relationship with MCP, A2A, and ANP, deployment patterns, cooperation model, on-chain governance layer, prototype status, performance profile, and roadmap of OAN.

papers.title: Physics-Informed Residuals for Adaptive Mesh Refinement in Finite-Difference PDE Solvers
papers.abstract_en: Classical finite-difference solvers remain reliable tools for partial differential equations, but their efficiency depends on where mesh resolution is placed. Uniform refinement can waste degrees of freedom when solution difficulty is localised near sharp gradients, fronts, oscillations, or constraint-sensitive regions. This paper studies a hybrid strategy in which a physics-informed neural network (PINN) is used not as the final solver, but as an off-grid residual probe for adaptive mesh refinement. The PINN residual is sampled over the domain, converted into cellwise indicators, and used to guide refinement before the final approximation is computed by a finite-difference solver. The method is evaluated on three benchmarks. The main full-solver validation uses the one-dimensional viscous Burgers equation with a nonuniform finite-difference solve on the adapted meshes. PINN-threshold refinement attains final relative $L^2$ error $0.021067$ with $60$ degrees of freedom, compared with $0.022617$ for uniform refinement with $192$ degrees of freedom. At matched mesh size, PINN-threshold reduces the error by about $67.5\%$. PINN-Dörfler refinement gives similar performance, with error $0.021264$ using $58$ degrees of freedom. A gradient indicator remains slightly more accurate, so the result supports usefulness rather than universal superiority. Manufactured 2D and 3D proxy tests, based on a nonlinear Schrödinger equation and an incompressible Navier--Stokes system, show that PINN residuals can organise structured refinement and improve over random refinement, although they do not consistently outperform gradient or uniform baselines. The results support PINN-guided AMR as a residual-indicator strategy for transferring physics-informed diagnostic information into finite-difference mesh adaptation while preserving the classical solver as the final approximation engine.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将物理信息神经网络（PINN）作为离线残差探针，用于有限差分PDE求解器中的自适应网格细化（AMR）。PINN残差在全域采样后转换为单元指示器，指导网格细化，最终由有限差分求解器计算近似解。在一维粘性Burgers方程上，PINN阈值细化在60自由度下达到0.021067的相对L²误差，而均匀细化在192自由度下为0.022617；在匹配网格大小时误差降低约67.5%。二维和三维代理测试（非线性Schrödinger方程和不可压Navier-Stokes系统）显示PINN残差可组织结构化细化，但并非始终优于梯度或均匀基线。
Motivation: 经典有限差分求解器依赖网格分辨率放置，均匀细化在解局部困难区域（如尖锐梯度、振荡、约束敏感区域）时浪费自由度，需要高效的网格自适应策略。
Method: 使用PINN作为离线残差探针，在全域采样PINN残差，转换为单元级指示器，据此指导自适应网格细化，最终由有限差分求解器完成最终逼近。
Result: 一维Burgers方程上，PINN阈值细化（60自由度）误差0.021067，优于均匀细化（192自由度）的0.022617；匹配网格大小时误差降低67.5%。PINN-Dörfler细化（58自由度）误差0.021264。二维和三维代理测试中，PINN残差可改善随机细化，但未持续优于梯度或均匀基线。
Conclusion: PINN引导的AMR可作为残差指示器策略，将物理信息诊断信息迁移到有限差分网格自适应中，同时保留经典求解器作为最终逼近引擎。该方法在简单问题上有效，但在更复杂问题上未显示普遍优越性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Reason-Then-Retrieve for CoVR-R with Structured Edit Prompts and Dense-Sparse Fusion
papers.abstract_en: CoVR-R studies reason-aware composed video retrieval: given a reference video and an edit instruction, the system must retrieve the target video that satisfies the edit. The main difficulty is that the target is not described directly; it must be inferred from fine-grained changes in object identity, action order, final state, hand interaction, and scene transition. We build a zero-shot reason-then-retrieve pipeline around Qwen3.5-27B. For each gallery video, the model generates a retrieval-oriented structured description and a dense embedding by pooling generated-token hidden states with token-dependent weights. For each query, the model first performs edit reasoning over the reference video and instruction, then generates a target-video description whose hidden states serve as the query embedding. We complement dense retrieval with a TF-IDF branch over the generated texts and fuse the two rankings with split-specific weights. On validation, the current best submission reaches 80.81 at R@1, 94.86 at R@5, 97.11 at R@10, and 98.59 at R@50. On the blind test split, it reaches 89.73 at R@1, 95.79 at R@5, 96.63 at R@10, and 97.98 at R@50.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种零样本的推理-检索流水线（reason-then-retrieve pipeline），用于组合视频检索（CoVR-R）任务：给定参考视频和编辑指令，检索满足编辑的目标视频。该方法基于 Qwen3.5-27B 生成结构化描述和密集嵌入，并融合 TF-IDF 稀疏检索，在验证集和测试集上取得较高 R@K 指标。
Motivation: 组合视频检索中目标视频并非直接描述，需从细粒度变化（如物体身份、动作顺序、最终状态、手部交互、场景转换）推断，现有方法难以处理此类推理需求。
Method: 构建零样本 reason-then-retrieve 流水线：对每个图库视频生成检索导向的结构化描述，并通过池化 token 隐藏状态（带 token 依赖权重）得到密集嵌入；对查询，先对参考视频和指令进行编辑推理，再生成目标视频描述，将隐藏状态作为查询嵌入；最后融合密集检索与基于生成文本的 TF-IDF 稀疏检索分支，用分割特定权重合并排序。
Result: 在验证集上 R@1=80.81, R@5=94.86, R@10=97.11, R@50=98.59；在盲测集上 R@1=89.73, R@5=95.79, R@10=96.63, R@50=97.98。
Conclusion: 当前最佳提交结果验证了所提流水线的有效性，尤其在高召回率指标上表现突出。

papers.title: MOSS-Audio Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: MOSS-Audio is a unified audio-language model for speech, environmental sound, and music understanding, supporting audio captioning, time-aware question answering, timestamped transcription, and audio-grounded reasoning. MOSS-Audio couples a dedicated audio encoder with a modality adapter and a large language model: the encoder produces 12.5 Hz temporal representations, the adapter projects them into the decoder space, and the decoder generates autoregressive text outputs. Two design choices are central to the system: DeepStack cross-layer feature injection, which exposes the decoder to acoustic information from multiple encoder depths, and time markers, which provide explicit temporal cues by inserting timestamp markers into the audio-token stream. At the data level, we design an event-preserving audio annotation pipeline that segments raw audio at coherent event boundaries, applies branch-specific annotation to speech, music, and general audio, and merges the results into unified captions for pretraining. The intermediate branch-specific captions are further retained to support the construction of task-oriented SFT data. The model is pretrained on large-scale audio-language data, with time-aware objectives incorporated to support temporal grounding, and then undergoes multi-stage post-training to enhance instruction following and audio-grounded reasoning. We release 4B and 8B variants in both Instruct and Thinking configurations. MOSS-Audio achieves strong performance across general audio understanding, speech captioning, ASR, and timestamped ASR, positioning it as a promising understanding foundation for future voice agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MOSS-Audio 是一个统一的音频-语言模型，支持语音、环境音和音乐的理解，包括音频描述、时间感知问答、带时间戳的转录和基于音频的推理。模型采用DeepStack跨层特征注入和时间标记机制，通过事件保留的音频标注流水线进行预训练，并经过多阶段训练以提升指令遵循和推理能力。发布了4B和8B的Instruct和Thinking变体，在通用音频理解、语音描述、ASR和带时间戳ASR上表现强劲。
Motivation: 当前音频-语言模型在统一处理语音、环境音和音乐方面仍有不足，特别是在时间感知和细粒度推理任务上。
Method: 模型由音频编码器（12.5Hz时间表示）、模态适配器和大型语言模型组成。关键设计包括DeepStack跨层特征注入和时间标记（插入时间戳到音频token流）。数据层面设计了事件保留的注释流水线，先分割音频事件边界，再分别处理语音、音乐和通用音频，最后合并为统一描述用于预训练，并保留分支特定描述用于构建任务导向的SFT数据。
Result: 在通用音频理解、语音描述、ASR和带时间戳ASR任务上取得强性能。
Conclusion: MOSS-Audio作为未来语音代理的理解基础具有潜力，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: An Algebraic View of the Expressivity of Recurrent Language Models
papers.abstract_en: What formal languages can a recurrent neural language model recognize? Formal results in the literature conflict: some authors report Turing-completeness, while others show equivalence to regular languages. The reason for this discrepancy is that the underlying arithmetic model differs. The paper develops a unified algebraic account of the expressivity of recurrent neural networks, starting with a formal account of various arithmetic models. This account reduces expressivity to an algebraic question, e.g., whether a network's syntactic monoid divides a certain wreath product. As a case study, the paper revisits diagonal state-space models: the same architecture cannot implement an even-modulus counter once floating-point recurrences are enforced, yet realizes every even-modulus counter under unsigned-integer quantization.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 2 figures, to be published at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对递归神经网络语言模型能识别何种形式语言的问题，发现现有结论矛盾（图灵完备 vs 等价于正则语言）源于底层算术模型不同。作者开发了一个统一的代数框架，将表达能力归结为句法幺半群是否整除某个包积的代数问题。以对角状态空间模型为例，展示了浮点递归下无法实现偶模计数器，而无符号整数量化下可以。
Motivation: 现有研究对递归语言模型表达能力结论矛盾，需要统一框架解释原因。
Method: 从形式化描述不同算术模型出发，将表达能力简化为代数问题，考察句法幺半群是否整除某个包积。
Result: 以对角状态空间模型为案例，发现浮点递归下无法实现偶模计数器，而无符号整数量化下可以实现。
Conclusion: 该代数框架统一了不同算术假设下的表达能力结果，为递归语言模型的形式语言识别提供了清晰图景。

papers.title: Towards Optimal Robustness in Learning-Augmented Paging
papers.abstract_en: Learning-augmented paging has been extensively studied in recent years. A key advantage over naive ML-based approaches is \emph{bounded robustness}, which guarantees worst-case performance even when predictions are inaccurate, making these algorithms valuable for real-world systems. Prior work achieves robustness bounds of $2H_k + O(1)$ in the randomized setting, leaving a gap to the optimal competitive ratio $H_k$. In this paper, we study how to close this gap. We begin by reviewing online optimality and proving a new property of the latest $H_k$-competitive algorithm, which facilitates our analysis in the learning-augmented setting. Then, we review existing learning-augmented paging algorithms and introduce a unifying primitive, the \emph{relative prediction budget}, which captures the essence of establishing robustness and reveals that prior algorithms either overuse or underutilize predictions. Guided by the above analysis, we develop a new framework that achieves the best-possible robustness up to an additive constant for learning-augmented paging: $H_k + O(1)$. Experiments further demonstrate strong practical performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究学习增强页面调度（learning-augmented paging）的最优鲁棒性，现有随机化方法达到 2H_k+O(1) 的鲁棒比，与最优竞争比 H_k 存在差距。作者证明新性质并提出相对预测预算统一框架，实现 H_k+O(1) 的最优鲁棒性，实验验证效果。
Motivation: 现有学习增强页面调度算法的鲁棒比（worst-case guarantee）与理论最优竞争比 H_k 之间存在差距，需要在利用预测提升性能的同时保证最坏情况下的性能上限。
Method: 通过回顾在线最优性证明最新 H_k-竞争算法的新性质，引入统一原语“相对预测预算”（relative prediction budget），并基于此设计新框架，实现最优鲁棒比 H_k+O(1)。
Result: 摘要报告理论实现 H_k+O(1) 的鲁棒比，实验表明实际性能良好。
Conclusion: 该框架实现了学习增强页面调度中可能的最优鲁棒性（至多 additive constant），并展现了实际效果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Diagnosing LLM Arbitration Behavior over Pre-evidence Epistemic States in RAG-based Fact-Checking
papers.abstract_en: In RAG-based fact-checking, LLMs are increasingly used as verifiers to check given claims against retrieved evidence. Their parametric knowledge can induce pre-evidence tendencies that may conflict with the retrieved context, yet existing evaluation frameworks do not characterize such prior-context discrepancy or measure how verifiers arbitrate between parametric and contextual signals. We introduce \textsc{PAVE} (\emph{Prior-Aware Verifier Evaluation}), a diagnostic testbed that stratifies an LLM verifier into four epistemic states based on the correctness and confidence of its pre-evidence prior and evaluates its arbitration behavior on this new benchmark, i.e., whether it persists in correct prior under misleading evidence, and whether it corrects wrong prior when accurate evidence is provided. Experiments across seven LLMs reveal unreliable and highly model-dependent prior-context arbitration, highlighting the importance of verifier selection for real-world RAG-based fact-checking applications. Based on these findings, we propose a lightweight JSD-based test-time arbitration method that improves factual reliability without modifying the underlying model, achieving competitive performance across diverse LLM families.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PAVE 诊断框架，在基于检索增强生成（RAG）的事实核查中，将 LLM 验证器在获取证据前的先验知识状态分为四种认知状态，并评估其仲裁行为（即在误导性证据下坚持正确先验，或在准确证据下纠正错误先验）。实验发现七种 LLM 的先验-上下文仲裁不可靠且高度依赖模型，并据此提出一种轻量级的基于 JSD 的测试时仲裁方法，在不修改底层模型的情况下提高事实可靠性。
Motivation: 现有 RAG 事实核查评估框架未刻画 LLM 参数性知识（先验）与检索到的上下文证据之间的不一致性，也未衡量验证器如何在两者之间进行仲裁。
Method: 引入 PAVE 诊断测试平台，根据 LLM 在获取证据前的先验正确性和置信度将其分为四种认知状态，并在新基准上评估其仲裁行为。基于发现提出轻量级 JSD 测试时仲裁方法。
Result: 实验表明 LLM 的先验-上下文仲裁不可靠且高度依赖模型；提出的 JSD 方法在多种 LLM 系列上实现了有竞争力的性能，提升了事实可靠性。
Conclusion: 该工作强调了在真实 RAG 事实核查应用中选择合适验证器的重要性，并提供了无需修改模型就能改善仲裁的实用方法。

papers.title: Expanding Spatial and Temporal Context for Robotic Imitation Learning With Scene Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Imitation learning enables robots to learn how to execute tasks via observation. However, real-world environments like homes and offices are often severely partially observed due to their large spatial scales. In addition, many tasks involve executing a series of subtasks requiring autonomous robots to reason over extended time horizons. To address these challenges, we propose using scene graphs as an explicit and structured memory mechanism in imitation learning. By maintaining a dynamic scene graph that captures object-centric relationships and their evolution over time, our method allows the agent to retain relevant historical context during task execution to efficiently reason over incrementally accrued scene information. Our experiments on simulated mobile manipulation and real-world tabletop manipulation demonstrate that our approach substantially improves policy performance, particularly in settings that demand long-term reasoning and robust generalization under partial observability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用场景图（scene graph）作为模仿学习中的显式结构化记忆机制，以解决大规模部分观测环境中的长期推理和泛化问题。通过维护动态场景图捕捉物体中心关系及其随时间演化，智能体可以在任务执行中保留历史上下文，高效累加场景信息。在模拟移动操作和真实桌面操作实验上，该方法显著提升了策略性能，特别是在需要长期推理和部分观测下鲁棒泛化的场景中。
Motivation: 现实环境（如家庭、办公室）因空间尺度大而严重部分观测，且许多任务需要自主机器人在长时间跨度内推理，现有模仿学习方法缺乏有效的记忆机制来应对这些挑战。
Method: 提出使用动态场景图作为显式结构化记忆，记录物体中心关系及其时间演化，使智能体在任务执行过程中能够保留和推理历史上下文信息。
Result: 在模拟移动操作和真实桌面操作实验中，该方法在需要长期推理和部分观测下鲁棒泛化的场景中显著提升了策略性能。
Conclusion: 场景图作为结构化记忆机制能有效提升模仿学习在部分观测、长时延任务中的表现。

papers.title: From "Weak" Signals to Strong Models: Preference Delta Aggregation with LoRA Merging
papers.abstract_en: Training strong large language models (LLMs) requires high-quality supervision, which is often scarce. Recent work shows that paired preference data from weak-weaker model pairs (e.g., Qwen3 4B over 1.7B), despite the limited quality of individual responses, can provide an effective supervision signal through relative quality deltas, which we term a "weak" signal. This motivates a key research question: can multiple "weak" signals be constructively aggregated for improving strong models (e.g., Qwen3 8B)? To this end, we propose Preference Delta Aggregation (PDA), the first framework that derives a preference delta from each weak-weaker model pair, instantiates it as a LoRA adapter learned through preference optimization, and aggregates the resulting deltas via LoRA merging. To further mitigate directional interference during LoRA merging, we introduce Geometric Alignment Merging (GAM), a geometry-aware merging method that aligns adapter subspaces before aggregation, enabling more robust composition of diverse deltas. Evaluations on knowledge reasoning and agentic search benchmarks show that aggregating multiple "weak" signals pushes performance beyond any single signal, with further gains as additional signals are incorporated. Correspondingly, PDA with GAM improves the strong model by 6.8 and 7.3 points on average for knowledge reasoning and agentic search, respectively. It outperforms all single-delta and multi-delta baselines, exceeding the best single-delta baseline by 2.1 and 4.3 points. Further analysis attributes these gains to the effective composition of complementary capabilities encoded across distinct preference deltas.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出偏好增量聚合（PDA）框架，利用弱-更弱模型对（如Qwen3 4B优于1.7B）的相对质量增量作为弱监督信号，通过偏好优化实例化为LoRA适配器，再通过LoRA合并聚合多个增量。进一步提出几何对齐合并（GAM），在合并前对齐适配器子空间以减少方向干扰。实验表明，聚合多个弱信号可持续提升强模型（如Qwen3 8B）的性能，在知识推理和agentic search基准上平均提升6.8和7.3个百分点，优于所有单增量和多增量基线。
Motivation: 训练强LLM需要高质量监督，但高质量数据稀缺。弱-更弱模型对的偏好数据虽个体质量有限，但其相对质量增量可提供有效信号。问题在于如何将多个这样的弱信号有效聚合以提升强模型。
Method: 提出PDA框架：从每个弱-更弱模型对推导偏好增量，通过偏好优化将其实例化为LoRA适配器，并通过LoRA合并聚合多个增量。进一步提出GAM，一种几何感知的合并方法，在聚合前对齐适配器子空间，减少方向干扰。
Result: 在知识推理和agentic search基准上，PDA+GAM分别平均提升强模型6.8和7.3个百分点，超过最佳单增量基线2.1和4.3个百分点，且随着信号数量增加性能持续提升。
Conclusion: 论文表明多个弱信号可以通过LoRA合并有效聚合，GAM通过子空间对齐提升组合鲁棒性。性能增益归因于互补能力的有效组合。

papers.title: Bit-Exact AI Inference Verification Without Performance Tradeoffs
papers.abstract_en: Verifying claims about AI workloads is a prerequisite for credible AI governance of covert adversaries (who comply with monitoring only when detection likelihood is high), yet the apparent non-determinism of GPU floating-point arithmetic forces auditors to accept approximate output matches. Covert adversaries can exploit unverifiable degrees of freedom in monitored computation. Attack vectors include steganography, unreported modification of inference software, and covert computation via unreported batch elements. Empirically, we analyze how modern inference engines (vLLM, HF transformers) produce deterministic but non-invariant outputs, without needing to set performance-compromising determinism flags, if the right information is available for re-computation and no atomic functions are called in the backend. We demonstrate that such bitwise-precise re-computation does not require access to identical hardware, via a software-only emulation of LLM inference across multiple NVIDIA GPU variants. Thus, accumulated rounding errors can be an auditable signature of the software and hardware setup used for inference, instead of a constraint on verifiability.
papers.comment: Best paper award, ICML 2026 TAIGR workshop. Code can be found at https://github.com/NaciCankaya/hardware_rounding_error_predictor
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI工作负载验证中由于GPU浮点运算非确定性导致的近似输出问题，提出无需性能折衷的比特精确验证方法。分析了现代推理引擎（vLLM, HF transformers）在提供正确重算信息且不调用原子函数时，能够产生确定但非不变的输出。通过纯软件仿真多款NVIDIA GPU变体上的LLM推理，证明比特级精确重算无需相同硬件，从而将累积舍入误差转化为可审计的软硬件签名。
Motivation: 在AI治理中，隐蔽对手可能利用GPU浮点运算的明显非确定性来逃避监测，现有审计只能接受近似输出匹配，存在可被利用的自由度。
Method: 分析现代推理引擎如何在不设置性能折衷的确定性标志下产生确定性但非不变的输出；通过纯软件仿真在多种NVIDIA GPU变体上实现LLM推理的比特级精确重算。
Result: 实证表明比特精确重算不需要相同硬件，且舍入误差可作为软硬件设置的审计签名。
Conclusion: 论文指出累积舍入误差不再是可验证性的约束，反而成为审计签名。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Linear Ordering Problem: Time for a Change
papers.abstract_en: The Linear Ordering Problem (LOP) is a fundamental combinatorial optimization problem with important applications in areas such as economics, social choice, and machine learning. Its most prominent use is the triangulation of economic input-output tables, which helps identify critical industries in an economy. Most existing algorithms have been evaluated on benchmarks derived from outdated macroeconomic data, which no longer reflect the structure of contemporary economies. Furthermore, LOP instances often exhibit many distinct global optima that can differ substantially from one another, creating challenges for applications that rely on a single solution. To address these limitations, we introduce a novel benchmark suite derived from up-to-date real-world economic data and an algorithmic scheme that leverages state-of-the-art LOP metaheuristics to generate diverse sets of high-quality solutions, together with metrics for assessing both quality and diversity. Experiments were conducted to report results on the proposed benchmark suite under both the traditional single-solution setting and the newly introduced multi-solution scenario
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at PPSN 2026 - Conference on Parallel Problem Solving
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对线性排序问题（LOP）现有基准基于过时宏观经济数据的局限，引入基于最新经济数据的基准套件，并提出一种利用现有LOP元启发式生成多样高质量解集的算法方案，同时给出评估解质量和多样性的指标。实验在新基准上展示了传统单解和多解场景的结果。
Motivation: 现有LOP算法评估基于过时的宏观经济数据，无法反映当代经济结构；且LOP实例常存在多个差异显著的全局最优解，依赖单一解的应用面临挑战。
Method: 提出基于最新真实世界经济数据的基准套件，并设计一个算法方案，利用现有LOP元启发式生成多样高质量解集，辅以质量和多样性评估指标。
Result: 在新基准上进行了实验，报告了传统单解设置和新引入的多解场景下的结果。
Conclusion: 论文强调更新基准和考虑解多样性对LOP应用的重要性，所提方案和指标有助于应对现实经济数据中的多解挑战。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning effective models from network dynamics data with multiple initial conditions using weak form SINDy
papers.abstract_en: Social systems consist of networks of individuals who influence one another through social interactions. Studying how processes evolve on these networks can help us better understand patterns of social behavior. We study a system that couples online and offline social activity and investigate how to learn effective models directly from data using Weak Form Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics (WSINDy), a method for discovering governing equations. We assess learning performance using data generated by a mean-field approximation model of a stochastic interaction process on networks and test how accurately the system can be recovered under different noise levels. Our results show that using more trajectories improves accuracy when noise is high, but only a small number of additional trajectories is needed to gain most of the benefit, with little improvement beyond that. We also learn effective ODE models from averaged stochastic data on networks. When traditional mean-field approximations fail, identifying continuum ODEs directly from stochastic processes yields efficient models that better match the data and provide deeper insight into the underlying dynamics.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 14 figures, 1 table. Code available at https://github.com/Moyi-Tian/WSINDy-NetworkDynamics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究使用弱形式SINDy（WSINDy）从网络动力学数据中学习有效模型，特别是耦合在线和离线社交活动的随机交互过程。实验基于平均场近似模型的模拟数据，评估不同噪声水平下的恢复精度，发现增加轨迹数在高噪声下提升准确率，但仅需少量额外轨迹即可获得大部分收益。此外，从平均随机数据直接学习ODE模型，在传统平均场近似失效时能提供更准确的拟合和深入洞察。
Motivation: 传统平均场近似在某些网络随机过程中失效，需要直接从数据中发现更有效的连续ODE模型。
Method: 采用弱形式稀疏辨识非线性动力学（WSINDy）方法，从多个初始条件的网络动力学数据中识别控制方程。
Result: 高噪声下增加轨迹数显著提升恢复精度，但边际收益递减；从随机过程直接学习的ODE模型比平均场近似更好地匹配数据。
Conclusion: WSINDy能有效学习网络动力学有效模型，尤其在平均场近似不准确时提供更优的替代方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evolving Features vs Evolving Entire Trees with GP for Interpretable Survival Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Survival analysis concerns the task of predicting the time until an event occurs. Often used in the medical field, survival analysis deals with incomplete (i.e., censored) data, for instance, from patients who did not experience the event during the duration of the study. For practical use, both accuracy and interpretability are important. Survival trees are easy-to-follow survival models that split the patient cohort recursively into discrete patient groups. Whilst survival trees can capture complex relationships, they typically need to grow large, threatening interpretability. Moreover, survival trees are often built using greedy approaches that may overlook globally optimal split combinations, limiting predictive performance. Shallow survival trees require expressive, higher-order feature combinations to achieve competitive accuracy. We therefore use genetic programming to multi-objectively evolve inherently inspectable feature sets and study how they interact with different tree induction strategies. We further introduce an evolutionary approach that jointly optimises the survival tree structure and the non-linear split logic. Our findings demonstrate that evolutionary feature construction improves predictive performance across different tree induction strategies on two real-world datasets and two different survival tree depths. Given its speed and flexible presentation, the multi-objective evolution of entire trees likely holds the most future promise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究使用遗传规划（GP）进行可解释生存分析，对比了进化特征与进化完整树两种策略。实验表明，进化特征构造能提升不同树归纳方法在两个真实世界数据集上的预测性能，而多目标进化完整树在速度和灵活性上更有前景。
Motivation: 生存树需要足够大才能捕捉复杂关系，但会丧失可解释性；贪心构建方法可能错过全局最优分裂，限制预测性能。
Method: 使用遗传规划多目标进化可检测的特征集，并引入一种同时优化生存树结构和非线性分裂逻辑的进化方法。
Result: 在两个真实世界数据集上，进化特征构造提升了不同树深度和归纳策略下的预测性能；多目标进化完整树在速度和表示灵活性上更具优势。
Conclusion: 多目标进化完整树由于速度和灵活表现，最有可能成为未来有前景的方向。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Inferring the Size of Large Language Models From Popular Text Memorization
papers.abstract_en: The parameter counts of the most widely used large language models (LLMs) are often withheld by their developers, leaving model size -- a primary reference point for interpreting capabilities and costs -- largely undisclosed. We propose a black-box method to infer conservative lower bounds on LLM size from generated text outputs alone, requiring nothing beyond the ability to submit text fragments and observe next-token predictions. Our approach is grounded in a key observation: popular, widely-circulated texts -- such as classical literature, religious texts, and foundational documents -- are present in virtually every large-scale pretraining corpus, and how accurately a model predicts the next word across text fragments of varying length is a reliable signal of how much it has memorized them, which in turn is fundamentally limited by its total parameter count. We aggregate this memorization signal across a diverse corpus of texts and fragment lengths into a single accuracy profile vector per model, and build two complementary inference methods on top of it: a pairwise statistical test that determines which of two models is larger, and a scaling-law estimator that extracts a one-dimensional latent index from these vectors via Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to map the aggregated signal to a parameter count. Validated on a broad set of open-weight models, both methods produce accurate and reliable lower bounds. When applied to popular closed-weight models, our framework recovers internal product hierarchies and reveals a clear divergence in industry scaling strategies: while some developers yield significantly higher bounds indicative of large generational parameter growth, others operate under strict parameter ceilings, demonstrating that hidden design choices can be systematically probed even under strict API limitations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种仅基于模型生成文本的黑盒方法，推断大型语言模型参数数量的保守下界。方法利用模型对流行文本（如经典文学、宗教文本）的预测准确性作为记忆信号，构建准确性轮廓向量，进而通过配对统计检验和基于主成分分析的标度律估计器推断参数量。在开放权重模型上验证有效，并成功恢复了闭源模型的内部产品层级，揭示了不同开发商的规模策略差异。
Motivation: 广泛使用的LLM参数数量常被开发者隐瞒，而模型规模是解释其能力和成本的关键参考点，现有方法难以在仅能访问文本输出的黑盒场景下推断参数量。
Method: 基于流行文本记忆信号：对文本片段长度变化的下一词预测准确性进行聚合，形成每个模型的准确性轮廓向量；再构建两种互补方法：配对统计检验比较两个模型大小，以及主成分分析提取潜在索引并映射到参数数量的标度律估计器。
Result: 在开放权重模型上取得准确可靠的下界估计；应用于闭源模型时，恢复了内部产品层级，并揭示了不同开发商的规模策略差异（如显著参数增长与严格参数上限两种模式）。
Conclusion: 该框架能在仅限API访问的条件下系统地探查隐藏设计选择，但对参数量仅给出下界，且依赖流行文本的普遍存在性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CORE: Contrastive Reflection Enables Rapid Improvements in Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Language models can use verifiable rewards to improve at a wide variety of reasoning tasks. However, both parametric (e.g. RLVR) and non-parametric (e.g. prompt optimization) approaches to doing so typically require hundreds of training samples and thousands of model rollouts, making them expensive in the best case and intractable in the worst. To address this challenge, we introduce Contrastive Reflection (CORE), a non-parametric learning algorithm that compares past reasoning traces to generate insights: short natural-language descriptions of reasoning strategies and constraints that capture differences between successful and unsuccessful problem attempts. Across four reasoning tasks, we demonstrate that CORE enables more rapid improvement than both parametric (GRPO) and non-parametric (GEPA, episodic RAG, and MemRL) methods, while using fewer rollouts. Under fixed rollout budgets with as few as five training samples, CORE achieves the strongest performance in most task-data regimes. Finally, we highlight how CORE is substantially more context-efficient than non-parametric baselines, requiring fewer prompt tokens while storing learned knowledge as compact, interpretable natural-language insights. Our results therefore suggest that distilling contrasts between successful and unsuccessful reasoning traces into abstract and useful insights can provide a more efficient and interpretable route to model self-improvement than weight updates, prompt optimization, or direct reuse of stored reasoning traces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Contrastive Reflection (CORE)，一种非参数学习算法，通过对比成功与失败的推理轨迹生成自然语言洞察（如推理策略和约束），从而实现语言模型在推理任务上的快速改进。实验表明，CORE 在四个推理任务上比参数化方法（如 GRPO）和非参数化方法（如 GEPA、episodic RAG、MemRL）使用更少的模型 rollout 且改进更快，甚至在固定少量样本（如5个）下达到最佳性能。此外，CORE 生成的洞察紧凑且可解释，显著节省提示 tokens。
Motivation: 现有的基于可验证奖励改进推理的方法（如 RLVR 和提示优化）通常需要数百个训练样本和数千次模型 rollout，成本高昂甚至不可行。本文旨在开发一种更高效且可解释的非参数学习方法，仅需少量样本即可快速提升推理能力。
Method: CORE 通过对比成功与失败推理轨迹，自动生成简短的自然语言洞察，这些洞察捕捉了推理策略和约束的差异。该算法是非参数的，不更新模型权重，而是将学习到的知识以可读文本形式存储。
Result: 在四个推理任务上，CORE 比 GRPO、GEPA、episodic RAG 和 MemRL 等基线实现了更快速的改进，且在固定 rollout 预算（低至5个训练样本）下在大多数任务-数据组合中达到最强性能。CORE 还显著优于非参数基线在上下文效率方面的表现，所需提示 tokens 更少。
Conclusion: 将成功与失败推理轨迹之间的对比提炼为抽象且有用的洞察，为模型自我改进提供了一条比权重更新、提示优化或直接重用轨迹更高效且更可解释的途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do Language Models Need Sleep? Offline Recurrence for Improved Online Inference
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based large language models are increasingly used for long-horizon tasks; however, their attention mechanism scales poorly with context length. To handle this, we study a sleep-like consolidation mechanism in which a model periodically converts recent context into persistent fast weights before clearing its key-value cache. During sleep, the model performs $N$ offline recurrent passes over the accumulated context and updates the fast weights in its state-space model (SSM) blocks through a learned local rule. During inference, this shifts extra computation to sleep while preserving the latency of wake-time prediction. We test our method on controlled synthetic tasks, including cellular automata and multi-hop graph retrieval, as well as a realistic math reasoning task, on which a regular transformer as well as SSM-attention hybrid models fail. We then show that increasing sleep duration $N$ for our models improves performance, with the largest gains on examples that require deeper reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种模拟睡眠的离线巩固机制，让大型语言模型周期性地将近期上下文编码为持久快速权重（fast weights）并清空键值缓存。在睡眠阶段，模型对累积上下文执行N次离线循环，通过局部学习规则更新状态空间模型（SSM）块中的快速权重；在线推理时，额外计算被转移到睡眠阶段，从而保持唤醒时的低延迟。在细胞自动机、多跳图检索和数学推理等受控任务上，增加睡眠时长N能提升性能，尤其在需要深层推理的样本上改善最为显著。
Motivation: Transformer注意力机制在长上下文任务中随序列长度平方扩展，导致推理效率低下。
Method: 提出睡眠-唤醒两阶段框架：唤醒阶段累积上下文并定期触发睡眠；睡眠阶段对累积数据执行N次离线循环，通过局部学习规则更新SSM块的快速权重，然后清除缓存。
Result: 在细胞自动机、多跳图检索和数学推理任务上，该方法使常规Transformer和SSM-注意力混合模型成功解决此前失败的任务，且增大睡眠时长N带来一致性能提升，深层推理样本获益最大。
Conclusion: 离线循环巩固机制能有效将长上下文计算从在线推理迁移到离线阶段，改善模型在需要多步推理任务上的表现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An Analysis Focused on Womens Safety: Can VAD Models Be Enhanced by a Multi-modal Dataset?
papers.abstract_en: Women's safety and security are paramount for a modern society. Crimes against women occur in daylight as well as in low-light conditions. Often, such events are captured through real-world surveillance cameras that operate at lower resolutions. Despite substantial progress in CV-related research, video anomaly detection (VAD) focused on women's safety has not yet been adequately addressed. Existing video anomaly datasets contain well-lit, high-resolution, close-shot videos, and fail to represent women-centric anomalies such as chain snatching, stalking, inappropriate touch, and other subtle forms of crime against women. To address these problems, we propose the ExtrAnom dataset, a new multi-modal benchmark containing 1001 videos with textual descriptions, 500 normal and 501 anomalous, classified into 5 different types of women-centric crimes. The dataset comprises low-light (8%), low-resolution videos (13%), long-shot (15%), along with daylight (64%) anomalous videos. And it covers anomalous events like stalking (3.9%), chain snatching (17.6%), kidnapping (7.3%), assassinations (2.3%), harassment (18.9%), and normal (50%). Each video is supplemented with 4 textual annotations, including one human-generated and three LLM-generated descriptions, enabling cross-modal and VLM-based validations. The aim of creating a women-centric dataset is to accurately detect the women-centric anomaly patterns, which are possible to observe visually. The dataset supplements the VLMs to accurately generate video-level descriptions. ExtrAnom has been benchmarked against popular unimodal and multi-modal VAD datasets (e.g., XD-Violence, UCF-Crime, and UCA) and SOTA methods. Experiments reveal that the existing datasets are insufficient to train models for detecting women-centric anomalies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对女性安全问题，提出ExtrAnom多模态数据集，包含1001个视频（500正常、501异常）和文本描述，涵盖6类女性犯罪异常，如跟踪、抢链、骚扰等。数据集包含低光照、低分辨率、远景等真实场景，并补充了人工和LLM生成的文本注释。实验表明现有数据集和SOTA方法不足以检测女性中心异常。
Motivation: 现有视频异常检测数据集主要关注高分辨率、良好光照、近景视频，缺乏针对女性安全的异常类型（如链抢夺、跟踪等），且未能反映真实监控场景的低质量条件。
Method: 构建ExtrAnom数据集，包含1001个视频（含500正常和501异常），覆盖5类女性犯罪异常，视频包含低光照(8%)、低分辨率(13%)、远景(15%)等条件。每个视频有4条文本描述（1条人工、3条LLM生成），支持跨模态和视觉语言模型验证。
Result: 在ExtrAnom上对XD-Violence、UCF-Crime、UCA等基准和SOTA方法进行评估，发现现有数据集不足以训练检测女性中心异常的模型。

papers.title: Fine-Tuning and Serving Gemma 4 31B on Google Cloud TPU: A Technical Comparison with GPU Baselines
papers.abstract_en: We present the first end-to-end demonstration of fine-tuning and serving Google's Gemma 4 31B model on TPU hardware, providing an empirical comparison of TPU and GPU platforms for large language model adaptation. Using LoRA on a Google TPU v5p-8 for training and TPU v6e-8 (Trillium) for inference, we document the full set of code-level adaptations required to port a GPU-native training recipe - built on PyTorch, HuggingFace TRL, and FSDP - to the JAX + Tunix/Qwix stack. These adaptations span mesh configuration, LoRA module naming conventions, sharding annotation corrections, gradient checkpoint, data pipeline restructuring, and a custom Orbax-to-safetensor checkpoint merging procedure. For inference, we detail the vLLM-TPU Docker setup necessary to serve Gemma 4 on v6e-8 and characterize the resulting latency and throughput profile. Compared with a similar-costing 2xH100 GPU baseline under identical hyperparameters, TPU training completes 1.61x faster at 2.12x lower cost. For inference, we cover the vLLM-TPU Docker setup required to serve Gemma 4 on v6e-8 and explain the observed latency and throughput characteristics across a QPS sweep spanning 512 to 16k input tokens. Across both workloads we compare performance and cost against a 2xH100 GPU baseline running identical hyperparameters. The TPU completes training 1.61x faster at 2.12x lower cost. For inference, TPU v6e-8 matches GPU at short context (<=2048 tokens) and decisively outperforms at long context: 66% higher throughput and 23.6x faster TTFT at 4096-token inputs (61 ms vs 1,443 ms at QPS=4). Our work removes a critical gap in the open tooling ecosystem and provides practitioners with a recipe for Gemma 4 Dense 31B deployment on the TPU infrastructure.
