papers.title: Privacy Implies Stability: Information-Theoretic Generalization Bounds for Quantum Learning
papers.abstract_en: We develop an information-theoretic framework connecting stability, privacy, and generalization for quantum learning algorithms. Learning procedures are modeled as quantum instruments with classical-quantum outputs, and losses are represented by observables. We prove that under a classical-quantum sub-Gaussian condition, an information-theoretic stability measure controls the expected generalization error. Furthermore, we establish a high-probability generalization bound using quantum Rényi divergences to manage higher-order dependencies under non-commutativity. In the trusted Data Processor setting, quantum differential privacy (QDP) provides a mechanism for stability. We show that one-neighbor QDP strictly bounds the information leaked by the classical-quantum output. Combining this with our stability theorem yields a direct privacy-to-generalization guarantee. We also explore an untrusted Data Processor setting. Here, output privacy alone is insufficient since an adversarial processor could perform a highly informative procedure before applying noisy post-processing. To combat this, we introduce Information-Theoretic Admissibility (ITA), a certification condition ensuring the prescribed procedure is not just a degraded version of a strictly more informative, physically allowed operation on the encoded ensemble. We prove a fundamental separation: while admissibility and privacy are in strong tension in classical models, quantum non-orthogonality makes them compatible. A quantum measurement can be ITA - exhausting all relevant accessible information - without perfectly recovering the classical dataset. We illustrate this separation through a concrete quantum ITA example.
papers.comment: 36 pages, 3 figures; The introduction has been substantially rewritten to provide better context, and certain proofs have been relocated from the appendices to the main body of the paper; The core mathematical framework and technical results remain unchanged
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为量子学习算法建立了连接稳定性、隐私和泛化能力的信息论框架。学习过程被建模为经典-量子输出的量子仪器，损失表示为可观测量。在经典-量子亚高斯条件下，信息论稳定性度量控制期望泛化误差；通过量子Rényi散度得到高概率泛化界。在可信数据处理者设置中，量子差分隐私(QDP)提供稳定性机制；在不可信设置中，引入信息论可容许性(ITA)条件，证明量子非正交性使可容许性与隐私兼容。
Motivation: 量子学习算法的泛化保证缺乏统一的信息论理解，特别是隐私与稳定性之间的关系在量子环境中尚未被充分探索。
Method: 提出信息论框架，利用经典-量子亚高斯条件和量子Rényi散度推导泛化界；引入量子差分隐私和ITA条件分别处理可信与不可信数据处理者场景。
Result: 建立了隐私到泛化的直接保证；证明在经典模型中可容许性与隐私存在强烈冲突，但量子非正交性使两者兼容，并通过具体量子ITA例子说明了这一分离。
Conclusion: 该框架为量子学习中的隐私、稳定性和泛化提供了统一的信息论视角，展示了量子非正交性带来的独特优势。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MCERF: Advancing Multimodal LLM Evaluation of Engineering Documentation with Enhanced Retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Engineering rulebooks and technical standards contain multimodal information like dense text, tables, and illustrations that are challenging for retrieval augmented generation (RAG) systems. Building upon the DesignQA framework [1], which relied on full-text ingestion and text-based retrieval, this work establishes a Multimodal ColPali Enhanced Retrieval and Reasoning Framework (MCERF), a system that couples a multimodal retriever with large language model reasoning for accurate and efficient question answering from engineering documents. The system employs the ColPali, which retrieves both textual and visual information, and multiple retrieval and reasoning strategies: (i) Hybrid Lookup mode for explicit rule mentions, (ii) Vision to Text fusion for figure and table guided queries, (iii) High Reasoning LLM mode for complex multi modal questions, and (iv) SelfConsistency decision to stabilize responses. The modular framework design provides a reusable template for future multimodal systems regardless of underlying model architecture. Furthermore, this work establishes and compares two routing approaches: a single case routing approach and a multi-agent system, both of which dynamically allocate queries to optimal pipelines. Evaluation on the DesignQA benchmark illustrates that this system improves average accuracy across all tasks with a relative gain of +41.1% from baseline RAG best results, which is a significant improvement in multimodal and reasoning-intensive tasks without complete rulebook ingestion. This shows how vision language retrieval, modular reasoning, and adaptive routing enable scalable document comprehension in engineering use cases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MCERF框架，结合多模态检索器ColPali与大语言模型推理，用于工程文档（含密集文本、表格和插图）的问答。系统集成混合查找、视觉-文本融合、高推理LLM和自一致性决策策略，并对比单一路由与多智能体路由。在DesignQA基准上，相比基线RAG提升平均准确率41.1%。
Motivation: 工程规则手册和技术标准包含多模态信息，现有RAG系统难以高效处理图文混合内容。
Method: 构建MCERF框架，采用ColPali进行多模态检索，设计四种推理策略（混合查找、视觉-文本融合、高推理LLM、自一致性），并比较单一路由与多智能体路由两种查询分配方法。
Result: 在DesignQA基准上，系统平均准确率相对最佳基线RAG提升41.1%，尤其在多模态和推理密集型任务上表现显著。
Conclusion: 视觉语言检索、模块化推理和自适应路由相结合，可在不完整规则库情况下实现可扩展的工程文档理解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: One Loss to Rule Them All: Marked Time-to-Event for Structured EHR Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Clinical events captured in Electronic Health Records (EHR) are irregularly sampled and may consist of a mixture of discrete events and numerical measurements, such as laboratory values or treatment dosages. The sequential nature of EHR, analogous to natural language, has motivated the use of next-token prediction to train prior EHR Foundation Models (FMs) over events. However, this training fails to capture the full structure of EHR. When a given event occurs must be captured, but the event value (abnormal lab) also modulates the likelihood of other clinical events. Most existing EHR FMs do not jointly model this likelihood and are unable to capture the full observation process, impacting downstream capabilities. We propose ORA, a marked time-to-event pretraining objective that jointly models event timing and associated measurements. Across multiple datasets, downstream tasks, and model backbones, this objective consistently yields more generalizable representations than next-token prediction and pretraining losses that ignore continuous measurements. Importantly, the proposed objective yields improvements beyond traditional classification evaluation, including better regression and time-to-event prediction. Beyond introducing a new family of FMs, our ablations suggest a broader takeaway: pretraining objectives that account for EHR structure are critical for expanding downstream capabilities and generalizability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ORA，一种标记时间-事件预训练目标，用于电子健康记录（EHR）基础模型，同时建模事件发生时间及其关联测量值。实验表明，与下一词预测等损失相比，ORA在多个数据集、下游任务和模型骨干上产生更泛化的表示，并提升回归和时间-事件预测性能。消融实验强调，考虑EHR结构的预训练目标对提升下游能力和泛化性至关重要。
Motivation: 现有EHR基础模型通常使用下一词预测训练，但无法捕捉事件时间间隔和连续测量值（如实验室值）对事件可能性的影响，限制了模型对完整观测过程的建模能力和下游性能。
Method: 提出ORA（marked time-to-event）预训练目标，联合建模事件时间点和关联的连续测量值，以替代传统下一词预测损失。
Result: 在多个EHR数据集和下游任务（分类、回归、时间-事件预测）上，ORA相比下一词预测和忽略连续测量的损失，始终产生更泛化的表示，并提升回归和时间-事件预测性能。
Conclusion: 预训练目标需结构化建模EHR的观测过程（时间与测量值），这对基础模型的下游能力与泛化性至关重要；ORA是一个有效的通用目标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dual Latent Memory for Visual Multi-agent System
papers.abstract_en: While Visual Multi-Agent Systems (VMAS) promise to enhance comprehensive abilities through inter-agent collaboration, empirical evidence reveals a counter-intuitive "scaling wall": increasing agent turns often degrades performance while exponentially inflating token costs. We attribute this failure to the information bottleneck inherent in text-centric communication, where converting perceptual and thinking trajectories into discrete natural language inevitably induces semantic loss. To this end, we propose \textbf{L}$\mathbf{^{2}}$\textbf{-VMAS}, a novel model-agnostic framework that enables inter-agent collaboration with dual latent memories. Furthermore, we decouple the perception and thinking while dynamically synthesizing dual latent memories. Additionally, we introduce an entropy-driven proactive triggering that replaces passive information transmission with efficient, on-demand memory access. Extensive experiments among backbones, sizes, and multi-agent structures demonstrate that our method effectively breaks the "scaling wall" with superb scalability, improving average accuracy by 2.7-5.4% while reducing token usage by 21.3-44.8%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉多智能体系统（VMAS）中存在的“缩放墙”问题，即增加智能体轮次反而降低性能并增加token成本。作者提出L²-VMAS框架，通过双潜在记忆（dual latent memories）实现智能体间协作，解耦感知与思考，并引入熵驱动的主动触发机制。实验表明该方法在多种骨干网络和结构上有效突破了缩放墙，平均准确率提升2.7-5.4%，token使用减少21.3-44.8%。
Motivation: 现有的VMAS中，基于文本的通信存在信息瓶颈，将感知和思考轨迹转换为离散自然语言会导致语义损失，从而导致增加智能体轮次时性能下降和成本增加。
Method: 提出L²-VMAS框架，这是一个模型无关的方法，包含双潜在记忆（dual latent memories），并解耦感知与思考，动态合成双潜在记忆。同时引入熵驱动的主动触发机制，实现按需内存访问，取代被动信息传输。
Result: 在多种骨干网络、规模和多智能体结构上的实验表明，该方法平均准确率提升2.7-5.4%，token使用量减少21.3-44.8%，有效突破了缩放墙。
Conclusion: 该工作表明通过双潜在记忆和熵驱动触发可以解决VMAS中的缩放墙问题，具有良好的可扩展性。

papers.title: Learning to Execute Graph Algorithms Exactly with Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Understanding what graph neural networks can learn, especially their ability to learn to execute algorithms, remains a central theoretical challenge. In this work, we prove exact learnability results for graph algorithms under bounded-degree and finite-precision constraints. Our approach follows a two-step process. First, we train an ensemble of multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) to execute the local instructions of a single node. Second, during inference, we use the trained MLP ensemble as the update function within a graph neural network (GNN). Leveraging Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) theory, we show that local instructions can be learned from a small training set, enabling the complete graph algorithm to be executed during inference without error and with high probability. To illustrate the learning power of our setting, we establish a rigorous learnability result for the LOCAL model of distributed computation. We further demonstrate positive learnability results for widely studied algorithms such as message flooding, breadth-first and depth-first search, and Bellman-Ford.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从理论上证明了在有限度和有限精度约束下，图神经网络可以精确学习图算法。作者使用多层感知机（MLP）集成学习局部节点指令，然后在推理阶段将其作为图神经网络的更新函数，利用神经正切核（NTK）理论保证从少量训练集学习后，推理时无误差执行整个图算法。论文还展示了LOCAL分布式计算模型的可学习性，以及消息洪泛、广度优先搜索、深度优先搜索和Bellman-Ford等算法的可学习性。
Motivation: 理解图神经网络能够学习什么，特别是能否学习执行算法，是核心的理论挑战。现有理论缺乏对精确执行算法的保证。
Method: 提出两阶段方法：首先训练一个MLP集成来执行单个节点的局部指令；然后在推理阶段，将训练的MLP集成作为图神经网络的更新函数。利用NTK理论证明局部指令可以从少量训练集中学习，从而高概率地无误差执行整个图算法。
Result: 建立了LOCAL分布式计算模型的严格可学习性结果，并证明了消息洪泛、BFS、DFS和Bellman-Ford等常见算法的正向可学习性。
Conclusion: 论文强调了在有限度和有限精度条件下的精确可学习性，但未提及其他限制或未来工作。

papers.title: TSAQA: Time Series Analysis Question And Answering Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: Time series data are integral to critical applications across domains such as finance, healthcare, transportation, and environmental science. While recent work has begun to explore multi-task time series question answering (QA), current benchmarks remain limited to forecasting and anomaly detection tasks. We introduce TSAQA, a novel unified benchmark designed to broaden task coverage and evaluate diverse temporal analysis capabilities. TSAQA integrates six diverse tasks under a single framework ranging from conventional analysis, including anomaly detection and classification, to advanced analysis, such as characterization, comparison, data transformation, and temporal relationship analysis. Spanning 210k samples across 13 domains, the dataset employs diverse formats, including true-or-false (TF), multiple-choice (MC), and a novel puzzling (PZ), to comprehensively assess time series analysis. Zero-shot evaluation demonstrates that these tasks are challenging for current Large Language Models (LLMs): the best-performing commercial LLM, Gemini-2.5-Flash, achieves an average score of only 65.08. Although instruction tuning boosts open-source performance: the best-performing open-source model, LLaMA-3.1-8B, shows significant room for improvement, highlighting the complexity of temporal analysis for LLMs.
papers.comment: Comments: 35 pages, 7 figures. Accepted to the GEM Workshop at ACL 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TSAQA，一个统一的时间序列问答基准，涵盖异常检测、分类、特征描述、比较、数据变换和时序关系分析等六类任务，包含 21 万样本和 13 个领域。零样本评估表明当前大语言模型在此基准上表现不佳，最佳商业模型 Gemini-2.5-Flash 平均得分仅 65.08，开源模型 LLaMA-3.1-8B 通过指令微调后仍有较大提升空间。
Motivation: 现有时间序列问答基准仅覆盖预测和异常检测任务，缺乏对更广泛时序分析能力的统一评估框架。
Method: 构建包含六类任务（异常检测、分类、特征描述、比较、数据变换、时序关系分析）的基准数据集，采用是非题、多选题和新颖的拼图题形式，涵盖 13 个领域共 21 万样本。
Result: 零样本评估显示商业模型 Gemini-2.5-Flash 平均得分 65.08，开源模型 LLaMA-3.1-8B 在指令微调后性能仍有显著提升空间。
Conclusion: TSAQA 揭示了当前大语言模型在多样化时序分析任务上的不足，为未来模型改进提供了基准。

papers.title: Enhancing Video Representations with Spatiotemporal-Semantic Residual to Mitigate Hallucinations in Video Large Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Although Video Large Multimodal Models have achieved strong performance in video understanding, they still suffer from hallucination. Existing inference-time intervention methods usually modify videos under the contrastive decoding framework, but their heuristic designs bring limited improvements and increase inference latency. To address these issues, we propose ViSSRes, an inference-time intervention method that enhances video representations through a lightweight MLP-style network. Specifically, we use a contrastive random walk approach to characterize the spatiotemporal consistency of video representations, and introduce conditional mutual information to associate video representations with the model's semantic understanding. With the model backbone kept frozen, ViSSRes learns residuals for video representations and optimizes them from both spatiotemporal and semantic consistency perspectives. During inference, ViSSRes requires only a single forward pass and introduces no substantial additional inference cost. Experiments show that ViSSRes reduces the hallucination rate of LLaVA-NeXT-Video on EventHallusion by 40.69% and improves video understanding on MMVU by 18.36% under the CoT setting, demonstrating its effectiveness in mitigating hallucinations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ViSSRes，一种用于视频大语言模型的推理时干预方法，通过轻量 MLP 网络学习视频表示的残差，结合对比随机游走和条件互信息增强时空与语义一致性，在冻结主干的情况下仅需单次前向即可减少幻觉。实验表明在 EventHallusion 上幻觉率降低 40.69%，在 MMVU（CoT 设置）上视频理解提升 18.36%。
Motivation: 视频大语言模型存在幻觉问题，现有推理时干预方法设计启发式且增加延迟，亟需高效且有效的缓解方案。
Method: 提出 ViSSRes，使用对比随机游走刻画视频表示的时空一致性，引入条件互信息关联表示与模型语义理解，通过轻量 MLP 学习残差以优化表示，推理时无需额外计算。
Result: 在 LLaVA-NeXT-Video 上，EventHallusion 幻觉率降低 40.69%，MMVU 在思维链设置下视频理解提升 18.36%。
Conclusion: ViSSRes 能有效缓解视频大模型中的幻觉，且推理成本低，为推理时干预提供了新思路。

papers.title: Just-In-Time Reinforcement Learning: Continual Learning in LLM Agents Without Gradient Updates
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Model (LLM) agents excel at general tasks, they inherently struggle with continual adaptation due to the frozen weights after deployment. Conventional reinforcement learning (RL) offers a solution but incurs prohibitive computational costs and the risk of catastrophic forgetting. We introduce Just-In-Time Reinforcement Learning (JitRL), a training-free framework that enables test-time policy optimization without any gradient updates. JitRL maintains a dynamic, non-parametric memory of experiences and retrieves relevant trajectories to estimate action advantages on-the-fly. These estimates are then used to directly modulate the LLM's output logits. We theoretically prove that this additive update rule is the exact closed-form solution to the KL-constrained policy optimization objective. Extensive experiments on WebArena and Jericho demonstrate that JitRL establishes a new state-of-the-art among training-free methods. Crucially, JitRL outperforms the performance of computationally expensive fine-tuning methods (e.g., WebRL) while reducing monetary costs by over 30 times, offering a scalable path for continual learning agents. The code is available at https://github.com/liushiliushi/JitRL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Just-In-Time Reinforcement Learning (JitRL)，一种无需梯度更新的持续学习框架，使 LLM 代理在测试时通过动态记忆和在线优势估计直接调整输出 logits，理论上证明是 KL 约束策略优化的闭式解。在 WebArena 和 Jericho 基准上，JitRL 在训练无关方法中达到最优，并超越需要微调的方法（如 WebRL），同时将货币成本降低 30 倍以上。
Motivation: LLM 代理部署后权重冻结，无法持续适应新任务；传统强化学习计算成本高且易发生灾难性遗忘，缺乏高效的持续学习方案。
Method: JitRL 维护动态非参数化经验记忆，检索相关轨迹在线估计动作优势，并用该估计值直接调制 LLM 输出 logits，该加法更新规则是 KL 约束策略优化目标的精确闭式解。
Result: 在 WebArena 和 Jericho 上，JitRL 在训练无关方法中取得最先进性能，超越需要梯度微调的方法（如 WebRL），同时降低货币成本超过 30 倍。
Conclusion: JitRL 提供了一种可扩展、无梯度的持续学习路径，证明测试时策略优化可以高效实现，为 LLM 代理的持续适应提供了新方向。

papers.title: E2Former-V2: On-the-Fly Equivariant Attention with Linear Activation Memory
papers.abstract_en: Equivariant Graph Neural Networks (EGNNs) have become a widely used approach for modeling 3D atomistic systems. However, mainstream architectures face critical scalability bottlenecks due to the explicit construction of geometric features or dense tensor products on \textit{every} edge. To overcome this, we introduce \textbf{E2Former-V2}, a scalable architecture that integrates algebraic sparsity with hardware-aware execution. We first propose \textbf{E}quivariant \textbf{A}xis-\textbf{A}ligned \textbf{S}parsification (EAAS). EAAS builds on Wigner-$6j$ convolution by exploiting an $\mathrm{SO}(3) \rightarrow \mathrm{SO}(2)$ change of basis to transform computationally expensive dense tensor contractions into efficient, sparse parity re-indexing operations. Building on this representation, we introduce \textbf{On-the-Fly Equivariant Attention}, a fully node-centric mechanism implemented via a custom fused Triton kernel. By eliminating materialized edge tensors and maximizing SRAM utilization, our kernel achieves a \textbf{20$\times$ improvement in TFLOPS} compared to standard implementations. Extensive experiments on the SPICE and OMol25 datasets demonstrate that E2Former-V2 maintains comparable predictive performance while notably accelerating inference. This work demonstrates that large equivariant transformers can be trained efficiently using widely accessible GPU platforms. The code is avalible at https://github.com/IQuestLab/UBio-MolFM/tree/e2formerv2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出E2Former-V2，一种可扩展的等变图神经网络架构，通过代数稀疏性和硬件感知执行解决EGNNs的可扩展性瓶颈。核心创新包括Equivariant Axis-Aligned Sparsification (EAAS)和On-the-Fly Equivariant Attention，后者通过自定义融合Triton kernel实现，显著提升计算效率。在SPICE和OMol25数据集上，该方法在保持预测性能的同时实现推理加速，展示了大等变transformer在常用GPU上的高效训练。
Motivation: 现有等变图神经网络在每条边上显式构建几何特征或稠密张量积，导致严重的可扩展性瓶颈，难以处理大规模3D原子系统。
Method: 提出EAAS，利用SO(3)→SO(2)基变换将稠密张量收缩转化为高效的稀疏奇偶重索引操作。在此基础上，设计On-the-Fly Equivariant Attention，一种完全节点中心的机制，通过自定义Triton kernel实现，消除边张量的物化并最大化SRAM利用率。
Result: 在SPICE和OMol25数据集上，E2Former-V2保持与现有方法相当的预测性能，同时实现推理加速，其中Triton kernel相比标准实现实现20倍TFLOPS提升。
Conclusion: 本文证明了大等变transformer可以在常用GPU平台上高效训练，为可扩展的3D分子建模提供了新方向。
Relevance: 10

summary_sections.conclusion: 本文证明了大等变transformer可以在常用GPU平台上高效训练，为可扩展的3D分子建模提供了新方向。

papers.title: Autonomous computational catalysis through an agentic research system
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous agents are beginning to transform scientific research from tool-assisted workflows toward self-sustaining discovery processes. Computational catalysis provides a representative challenge, as catalyst discovery requires high-level questions to be translated into coordinated model construction, atomistic simulation, mechanistic analysis, and iterative design across multiple scales. Here we introduce CatMaster, a catalysis-native agentic research system that recasts computational catalysis as a low-barrier virtual ecosystem for autonomous research. CatMaster maintains an evolving research state and extends capabilities through self-feedback across model construction, calculation, critique and catalyst-design decisions within one extensible environment. Across progressively challenging tasks, CatMaster converts natural-language requests into concrete computational studies, from essential atomistic modelling and standard calculations to mechanism exploration and closed-loop catalyst design. It showed robust execution in representative computational-catalysis scenarios and near-leading performance across selected MatBench tasks, with phonons scenario demonstrating its modelling self-evolution capability. In the independent CO2-to-CO catalyst design case, CatMaster used iterative self-critique and evidence refinement to identify competitive B-CoN4 and NiN3B/N-NiN3B motifs. These results establish a virtual-ecosystem paradigm in which AI agents move beyond simulation execution toward end-to-end computational research, providing a foundation for autonomous discovery in catalysis and materials science.

papers.title: LiQSS: Post-Transformer Linear Quantum-Inspired State-Space Tensor Networks for Real-Time 6G
papers.abstract_en: Proactive and agentic control in Sixth-Generation (6G) Open Radio Access Networks (O-RAN) requires control-grade prediction under stringent Near-Real-Time (Near-RT) latency and computational constraints. While Transformer-based models are effective for sequence modeling, their quadratic complexity limits scalability in Near-RT RAN Intelligent Controller (RIC) analytics. This paper investigates a post-Transformer design paradigm for efficient radio telemetry forecasting. We propose a quantum-inspired many-body state-space tensor network that replaces self-attention with stable structured state-space dynamics kernels, enabling linear-time sequence modeling. Tensor-network factorizations in the form of Tensor Train (TT) / Matrix Product State (MPS) representations are employed to reduce parameterization and data movement in both input projections and prediction heads, while lightweight channel gating and mixing layers capture non-stationary cross-Key Performance Indicator (KPI) dependencies. The proposed model is instantiated as an agentic perceive-predict xApp and evaluated on a bespoke O-RAN KPI time-series dataset comprising 59,441 sliding windows across 13 KPIs, using Reference Signal Received Power (RSRP) forecasting as a representative use case. Our proposed Linear Quantum-Inspired State-Space (LiQSS) model is 10.8x-15.8x smaller and approximately 1.4x faster than prior structured state-space baselines. Relative to Transformer-based models, LiQSS achieves up to a 155x reduction in parameter count and up to 2.74x faster inference, without sacrificing forecasting accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种后Transformer设计范式LiQSS，利用量子启发的张量网络（Tensor Train/Matrix Product State）替换自注意力机制，实现线性复杂度的序列建模，用于6G O-RAN中近实时无线遥测预测。模型在包含13个KPI的59,441个滑动窗口数据集上评估，相比Transformer模型参数减少高达155倍，推理速度提升2.74倍且不损失精度。
Motivation: 6G O-RAN近实时控制需要低延迟、低计算复杂度的预测，但Transformer的二次复杂度限制了可扩展性，现有结构化状态空间模型仍有改进空间。
Method: 提出线性量子启发状态空间（LiQSS）模型，采用量子多体状态空间张量网络替换自注意力，通过Tensor Train/Matrix Product State分解减少参数量和数移动，并引入轻量通道门控和混合层捕获跨KPI依赖。
Result: LiQSS模型大小仅为先前结构化状态空间基线的1/15.8到1/10.8，推理速度快约1.4倍；相比Transformer模型参数减少155倍，推理速度提升2.74倍，且精度相当。
Conclusion: 后Transformer设计结合张量网络分解能显著降低模型复杂度和推理延迟，适用于资源受限的6G近实时场景。

papers.title: COMPOSE: Hypergraph Cover Optimization for Multi-view 3D Human Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: 3D human pose estimation from sparse multi-view camera rigs is an essential task for numerous applications, including action recognition, sports analysis, and human-robot interaction. While learned methods dominate the field on benchmarks, they require large annotated datasets; training-free optimization-based methods remain promising as they circumvent 3D supervision by solving a correspondence problem across views from 2D detections. Existing combinatorial formulations rely on pairwise associations to model this correspondence problem and enforce global consistency across views only as a downstream constraint. However, reconciling locally plausible pairwise matches becomes brittle under occlusion and noisy detections, where local errors propagate globally. We propose COMPOSE, which recasts multi-view 3D human pose estimation as a weighted exact-cover optimization over a hypergraph of person hypotheses. Our formulation replaces pairwise association and post-hoc consistency enforcement with a single global combinatorial objective. To address the exponentially large candidate space, we introduce a geometric pruning strategy alongside two complementary solvers: an exact Integer Linear Programming formulation and a scalable relaxation via Belief Propagation. Without any 3D supervision, COMPOSE improves average precision by up to 31 points over the best optimization-based method and 13 points over self-supervised learned methods, demonstrating the effectiveness of higher-order combinatorial association for training-free multi-view 3D human pose estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出COMPOSE，将多视图3D人体姿态估计重新表述为超图上的加权精确覆盖优化问题，无需3D监督即可从2D检测求解。该方法通过几何剪枝和两个互补求解器（精确整数线性规划和置信传播松弛）处理指数级候选空间。在基准上，COMPOSE相比最佳无训练方法平均精度提升31点，相比自监督学习方法提升13点。

Method: 将多视图人体姿态估计建模为超图上的加权精确覆盖优化，使用几何剪枝策略减少候选空间，并设计整数线性规划精确求解器和置信传播可扩展松弛求解器。
Result: 无任何3D监督下，COMPOSE在基准上平均精度比最佳优化方法高31点，比自监督学习方法高13点。
Conclusion: 高阶组合关联在无需训练的多视图3D人体姿态估计中有效，优于低阶逐对关联方法。

papers.title: AdaJudge: Adaptive Multi-Perspective Judging for Reward Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Reward modeling is essential for aligning large language models with human preferences, yet predominant architectures rely on a static pooling strategy to condense sequences into scalar scores. This paradigm, however, suffers from two key limitations: a static inductive bias that misaligns with task-dependent preference signals, and a representational mismatch, as the backbone's optimization for generation leaves its representations ill-suited to fine-grained discrimination. To address this, we propose AdaJudge, a unified framework that jointly adapts representation and aggregation. AdaJudge first improves backbone representations into a discrimination-oriented space via gated refinement blocks. It then replaces the static readout with an adaptive multi-view pooling module, which dynamically routes and combines evidence. Extensive experiments on RM-Bench and JudgeBench show that AdaJudge outperforms strong off-the-shelf reward models and traditional pooling baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AdaJudge，一种用于奖励建模的自适应多视角判断框架，通过门控细化块改进骨干表示，并用自适应多视角池化模块动态聚合证据，解决了静态池化策略的归纳偏差和表示不匹配问题。在 RM-Bench 和 JudgeBench 上，AdaJudge 超越现有奖励模型和基线。
Motivation: 现有奖励模型依赖静态池化策略，存在与任务相关的偏好信号不匹配的静态归纳偏差，以及骨干网络优化目标（生成）与判别任务间的表示不匹配问题。
Method: 提出 AdaJudge 框架：首先使用门控细化块将骨干表示转换到判别导向空间，然后以自适应多视角池化模块替代静态读出头，动态路由并组合证据。
Result: 在 RM-Bench 和 JudgeBench 上，AdaJudge 优于强基线奖励模型和传统池化方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 AdaJudge 通过联合调整表示和聚合，有效克服了静态池化的局限。

papers.title: Analysing Differences in Persuasive Language in LLM-Generated Text: Uncovering Stereotypical Gender Patterns
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for everyday communication tasks, including drafting interpersonal messages intended to influence and persuade. Prior work has shown that LLMs can successfully persuade humans and amplify persuasive language. It is therefore essential to understand how user instructions affect the generation of persuasive language, and to understand whether the generated persuasive language differs, for example, when targeting different groups. In this work, we propose a framework for evaluating how persuasive language generation is affected by recipient gender, sender intent, or output language. We evaluate 13 LLMs and 16 languages using pairwise prompt instructions. We evaluate model responses on 19 categories of persuasive language using an LLM-as-judge setup grounded in social psychology and communication science. Our results reveal significant gender differences in the persuasive language generated across all models. These patterns reflect biases consistent with gender-stereotypical linguistic tendencies documented in social psychology and sociolinguistics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个评估框架，用于分析大型语言模型（LLM）生成的说服性语言中的性别差异。通过13个模型、16种语言和19类说服性语言标签的成对提示实验，发现所有模型均存在显著的性别刻板印象模式，与社会心理学记录一致。
Motivation: LLM被广泛用于人际沟通中的说服性任务，但用户指令如何影响不同目标群体的说服性语言生成尚不清楚，需要系统性评估。
Method: 基于社会心理学和传播学，设计LLM-as-judge评估流程，采用成对提示指令，对13个模型和16种语言生成的文本进行19类说服性语言分类。
Result: 所有模型生成的说服性语言均表现出与性别刻板印象一致的显著差异，例如对女性目标使用更温和或情感化的语言。
Conclusion: 研究揭示了LLM中系统性的性别偏见模式，强调需在部署前注意模型生成语言中的刻板印象风险。

papers.title: CHDP: Cooperative Hybrid Diffusion Policies for Reinforcement Learning in Parameterized Action Space
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid action space, which combines discrete choices and continuous parameters, is prevalent in domains such as robot control and game AI. However, efficiently modeling and optimizing hybrid discrete-continuous action space remains a fundamental challenge, mainly due to limited policy expressiveness and poor scalability in high-dimensional settings. To address this challenge, we view the hybrid action space problem as a fully cooperative game and propose a \textbf{Cooperative Hybrid Diffusion Policies (CHDP)} framework to solve it. CHDP employs two cooperative agents that leverage a discrete and a continuous diffusion policy, respectively. The continuous policy is conditioned on the discrete action's representation, explicitly modeling the dependency between them. This cooperative design allows the diffusion policies to leverage their expressiveness to capture complex distributions in their respective action spaces. To mitigate the update conflicts arising from simultaneous policy updates in this cooperative setting, we employ a sequential update scheme that fosters co-adaptation. Moreover, to improve scalability when learning in high-dimensional discrete action space, we construct a codebook that embeds the action space into a low-dimensional latent space. This mapping enables the discrete policy to learn in a compact, structured space. Finally, we design a Q-function-based guidance mechanism to align the codebook's embeddings with the discrete policy's representation during training. On challenging hybrid action benchmarks, CHDP outperforms the state-of-the-art method by up to $19.3\%$ in success rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对混合动作空间（离散选择+连续参数）的强化学习问题，提出合作混合扩散策略（CHDP）框架。CHDP使用两个合作智能体，分别基于离散扩散策略和连续扩散策略，连续策略以离散动作表示为条件，显式建模依赖关系。采用顺序更新机制缓解共适应中的更新冲突，并通过码书将高维离散动作空间嵌入低维潜在空间提升可扩展性。在混合动作基准上，CHDP相比最先进方法成功率提升高达19.3%。
Motivation: 混合动作空间在机器人控制和游戏AI中普遍存在，但现有策略表达有限且在高维设置下可扩展性差，难以有效建模和优化混合离散-连续动作空间。
Method: 将混合动作空间问题视为完全合作博弈，提出CHDP框架，包括两个分别处理离散和连续动作的扩散策略智能体，连续策略以离散动作表示为条件；采用顺序更新机制和码书嵌入离散动作空间，并设计基于Q函数的引导机制对齐码书嵌入与离散策略表示。
Result: 在挑战性混合动作基准上，CHDP相比最先进方法成功率提升高达19.3%。
Conclusion: CHDP通过合作扩散策略有效解决了混合动作空间的建模和优化问题，在多个基准上取得显著性能提升。

summary_sections.conclusion: CHDP通过合作扩散策略有效解决了混合动作空间的建模和优化问题，在多个基准上取得显著性能提升。

papers.title: Measurement-Consistent Langevin Corrector for Stabilizing Latent Diffusion Inverse Problem Solvers
papers.abstract_en: While latent diffusion models (LDMs) have emerged as powerful priors for inverse problems, existing LDM-based solvers frequently suffer from instability. In this work, we first identify the instability as a discrepancy between the solver dynamics and stable reverse diffusion dynamics learned by the diffusion model, and show that reducing this gap stabilizes the solver. Building on this, we introduce \textit{Measurement-Consistent Langevin Corrector (MCLC)}, a theoretically grounded plug-and-play stabilization module that remedies the LDM-based inverse problem solvers through measurement-consistent Langevin updates. Compared to prior approaches that rely on linear manifold assumptions, which often fail to hold in latent space, MCLC provides a principled stabilization mechanism, leading to more stable and reliable behavior in latent space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首先识别潜在扩散模型 (LDM) 逆问题求解器的不稳定性源于求解器动力学与扩散模型学习的稳定反向扩散动力学之间的差异，并证明缩小该差距可稳定求解器。基于此，提出测量一致朗之万校正器 (MCLC)，一种理论支持的即插即用稳定模块，通过测量一致的朗之万更新来修正基于 LDM 的逆问题求解器。与依赖线性流形假设（在潜在空间中常不成立）的先前方法相比，MCLC 提供了原则性的稳定机制，在潜在空间中带来更稳定可靠的行为。
Motivation: 现有基于潜在扩散模型的逆问题求解器常出现不稳定性，文章首先将不稳定性归因于求解器动力学与稳定反向扩散动力学之间的差异，并指出缩小这一差距是关键。
Method: 提出 Measurement-Consistent Langevin Corrector (MCLC)，一种理论支持的即插即用稳定模块，通过测量一致的朗之万更新来修正 LDM 逆问题求解器，避免了线性流形假设在潜在空间中的失效问题。
Result: 文章表明 MCLC 相比于依赖线性流形假设的方法能提供更稳定可靠的行为，但具体数值结果在摘要中未提及。
Conclusion: MCLC 是一种原则性的稳定机制，可有效改善 LDM 逆问题求解器在潜在空间中的稳定性。

papers.title: Agentic Physical AI toward a Domain-Specific Foundation Model for Energy Systems: A Case Study on Nuclear Reactor Control
papers.abstract_en: The prevailing paradigm in AI for physical systems: scaling general-purpose foundation models toward universal multimodal reasoning, confronts a barrier at the control interface. Frontier vision-language models achieve only 50-53% accuracy on basic quantitative physics tasks, behaving as approximate guessers that preserve semantic plausibility while violating physical constraints. Safety-critical control demands outcome-space guarantees over executed actions, not parameter-space imitation. Here we present a pathway toward domain-specific foundation models through compact language models operating as Agentic Physical AI: policy optimization driven by physics-based simulator validation rather than perceptual inference. We train a 360M-parameter model on synthetic nuclear reactor scenarios scaled from 10^3 to 10^5 examples. Scaling produces strong, regime-dependent reliability gains under nominal simulated conditions, with variance collapse of approximately 500x and elimination of >10% terminal-power excursions on the sampled distribution. Despite balanced exposure to four actuation families, the model concentrates 95% of runtime execution on a single-bank strategy, without reinforcement learning or reward engineering. Representations transfer across simulators without architectural change. We position the system as a candidate decision component within a verification, monitoring, and defense-in-depth architecture, not as a stand-alone safety solution: the demonstrated behavior speaks to closed-loop reliability on a single-step task in simulation and does not yet address off-nominal operation, sensor faults, or uncertainty quantification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用于能源系统的领域专用基础模型路径，通过紧凑语言模型作为Agentic Physical AI，在核反应堆控制任务上用合成数据训练360M参数模型，实现闭环可靠性，但仅限模拟中单步任务。
Motivation: 通用基础模型在控制界面上表现不佳，如视觉语言模型在基本物理任务上准确率仅50-53%，违反物理约束，而安全关键控制需要结果空间保证。
Method: 使用基于物理模拟器验证的策略优化训练紧凑语言模型，无需强化学习或奖励工程；在核反应堆合成数据上从10^3到10^5规模缩放训练360M参数模型。
Result: 缩放产生强且依赖机制的可靠性增益，方差降低约500倍，消除>10%的终端功率偏移；模型将95%运行时执行集中于单一策略族。
Conclusion: 该模型作为验证、监控和深度防御架构中的候选决策组件，而非独立安全方案；当前演示仅限模拟中单步任务闭环可靠性，未涉及非标称运行、传感器故障或不确定性量化。

papers.title: Generalization of Diffusion Models Arises with a Balanced Representation Space
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models excel at generating high-quality, diverse samples, yet they risk memorizing training data when overfit to the training objective. We analyze the distinctions between memorization and generalization in diffusion models through the lens of representation learning. By investigating a two-layer ReLU denoising autoencoder (DAE), we prove that (i) memorization corresponds to the model storing raw training samples in the learned weights for encoding and decoding, yielding localized spiky representations, whereas (ii) generalization arises when the model captures local data statistics, producing balanced representations. Furthermore, we validate these theoretical findings on real-world unconditional and text-to-image diffusion models, demonstrating that the same representation structures emerge in deep generative models with significant practical implications. Building on these insights, we propose a representation-based method for detecting memorization and a training-free editing technique that allows precise control via representation steering. Together, our results highlight that learning good representations is central to novel and meaningful generative modeling.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026. 40 pages, 19 figures. The first two authors contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从表示学习角度分析扩散模型中的记忆与泛化。证明了在两层ReLU去噪自编码器中，记忆对应存储原始训练样本，产生局部尖峰表示；泛化对应捕获局部数据统计，产生平衡表示。在真实世界无条件/文生图扩散模型上验证了这些发现，并提出了基于表示的检测记忆方法和无需训练的编辑技术。
Motivation: 扩散模型可能记忆训练数据，但如何区分记忆与泛化并控制它们尚缺乏理论理解。
Method: 通过分析两层ReLU去噪自编码器的表示空间，提出记忆产生局部尖峰表示而泛化产生平衡表示的理论，并据此设计基于表示的检测记忆方法和表示导向的编辑技术。
Result: 在两层DAE理论分析中证明记忆与泛化的表示差异，并在真实世界扩散模型中验证了相同结构；提出的检测和编辑方法有效。
Conclusion: 好的表示学习对于新颖且有意义的生成建模至关重要。

papers.title: RePo: Language Models with Context Re-Positioning
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning is fundamental to modern Large Language Models (LLMs); however, prevailing architectures impose a rigid and fixed contextual structure by assigning linear or constant positional indices. The rigid position information poses the full burden of organizing the input structure to attention layers, thus reducing the amount of attention that could be allocated for more critical information. To address this, we propose RePo, a novel mechanism that alleviates the burden for attention layers via context re-positioning. Unlike conventional approaches, RePo utilizes a differentiable module, $f_φ$, to assign token positions that capture contextual dependencies, rather than replying on pre-defined order. By continually pre-training on the OLMo-2 1B \& 7B models, we demonstrate that RePo consistently enhances performance on tasks involving noisy contexts, structured data, and longer context length, while maintaining competitive performance on general short-context tasks. Analysis reveals that RePo successfully allocates more attention mass to distant but relevant information, assigns positions in a dense and non-linear space, and captures the intrinsic structure of the input context. Our code is at https://github.com/SakanaAI/repo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RePo，一种通过可微模块重分配token位置以捕捉上下文依赖的机制，替代传统的固定位置编码。在OLMo-2 1B/7B上持续预训练后，模型在噪声上下文、结构化数据和长上下文任务上表现提升，同时保持短上下文任务的竞争力。分析表明RePo能将更多注意力聚焦于远处但相关的信息，并在非线性的密集空间中分配位置。
Motivation: 现有LLM架构使用线性或固定位置索引，迫使注意力层承担过多输入结构组织负担，限制了关键信息的注意力分配。
Method: RePo引入可微模块f_φ，为每个token动态分配位置以反映上下文依赖，而非依赖预定义顺序。
Result: 在OLMo-2 1B和7B模型上持续预训练，RePo在噪声上下文、结构化数据和长上下文任务上一致提升性能，且短上下文任务上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: RePo通过重定位上下文位置，有效将注意力导向远处相关信息，并在密集非线性空间中编码位置，从而捕捉输入的内在结构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AutoTool: Dynamic Tool Selection and Integration for Agentic Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Agentic reinforcement learning has advanced large language models (LLMs) to reason through long chain-of-thought trajectories while interleaving external tool use. Existing approaches assume a fixed inventory of tools, which limits the adaptability of LLM agents to new or evolving toolsets. We present AutoTool, a training framework that equips LLM agents with dynamic tool-selection capabilities throughout their reasoning trajectories. AutoTool employs a dual-phase optimization pipeline: (i) SFT and RL-based trajectory stabilization for coherent reasoning, and (ii) KL-regularized Plackett-Luce Ranking to refine consistent multi-step tool selection. We further build a 200k dataset with explicit tool-selection rationales across 1,000+ tools and 100+ tasks spanning mathematics, science, code generation, and multimodal reasoning. Across ten diverse benchmarks, we train two base models, Qwen3-8B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B, with AutoTool. With fewer parameters, AutoTool consistently outperforms advanced LLM agents and tool-integration methods, yielding average gains of 6.4% in math & science reasoning, 4.5% in search-based QA, 7.7% in code generation, and 6.9% in multimodal understanding. In addition, AutoTool exhibits stronger generalization by dynamically leveraging unseen tools from evolving toolsets during inference.
papers.comment: ICML2026; Best Paper Award at ICCV 2025 Workshop on Multi-Modal Reasoning for Agentic Intelligence
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AutoTool，一种训练框架，使大语言模型（LLM）代理在推理过程中能够动态选择工具，而非依赖固定工具库。通过双阶段优化：先以监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）稳定轨迹，再用KL正则化Plackett-Luce排序优化一致的多步工具选择。构建了包含200k样本、跨越1000多个工具和100多个任务的数据集。在10个基准上，基于Qwen3-8B和Qwen2.5-VL-7B训练的AutoTool以更少参数超越了先进代理和工具集成方法，在数学与科学推理、搜索式QA、代码生成和多模态理解上分别平均提升6.4%、4.5%、7.7%和6.9%，并能动态利用未见过的工具。
Motivation: 现有方法假设固定工具库，限制了LLM代理对新工具或演化中工具集的适应能力。
Method: 提出双阶段优化流水线：(i) 基于SFT和RL的轨迹稳定化以生成连贯推理；(ii) KL正则化的Plackett-Luce排序以精炼一致的多步工具选择。同时构建了200k样本的数据集，包含显式工具选择理由。
Result: 在10个基准上，AutoTool训练的Qwen3-8B和Qwen2.5-VL-7B在数学与科学推理、搜索式QA、代码生成和多模态理解上分别平均提升6.4%、4.5%、7.7%和6.9%；且能泛化到推理过程中未见过的新工具。
Conclusion: 动态工具选择能力可提升LLM代理的适应性和性能，尤其在工具集演化场景下展现出强泛化性。

papers.title: Calibrating Uncertainty for Zero-Shot Adversarial CLIP
papers.abstract_en: CLIP delivers strong zero-shot classification but remains highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Prior adversarial fine-tuning work primarily matches predicted logits between clean and adversarial examples, which overlooks uncertainty calibration and may degrade the zero-shot generalization. A common expectation in reliable uncertainty estimation is that predictive uncertainty should increase as inputs become more difficult or shift away from the training distribution. However, we frequently observe the opposite in the adversarial setting: perturbations not only degrade accuracy but also suppress uncertainty, leading to severe miscalibration and over-confidence. This reveals a critical reliability gap beyond robustness. To bridge this gap, we propose an adversarial fine-tuning objective for CLIP considering both accuracy and uncertainty. By reparameterizing CLIP outputs as the concentration parameters of a Dirichlet distribution, we propose a unified representation that captures relative semantic structure and confidence magnitude. This enables holistic distribution alignment under perturbations, moving beyond single-logit anchoring and restoring calibrated uncertainty. Experiments across multiple zero-shot benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly improves uncertainty calibration and achieves competitive adversarial robustness while preserving clean accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对CLIP模型在零样本分类中对抗攻击导致的不确定性校准缺失问题，提出基于狄利克雷分布重参数化的对抗微调方法，同时考虑准确性和不确定性。实验表明该方法在多个零样本基准上显著改善不确定性校准，并保持有竞争力的对抗鲁棒性和干净精度。
Motivation: 现有对抗微调主要对齐对抗样本与干净样本的logits，忽略不确定性校准，且扰动常导致模型过度自信、校准恶化，存在鲁棒性之外的可靠性缺口。
Method: 将CLIP输出重参数化为狄利克雷分布的浓度参数，统一表示相对语义结构和置信度大小，从而实现整体分布对齐，避免单一logit锚定，恢复校准不确定性。
Result: 在多个零样本分类基准上，该方法显著改善了不确定性校准，在保持干净精度的同时实现了有竞争力的对抗鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 该方法填补了CLIP对抗鲁棒性中可靠性的空白，同时兼顾了校准不确定性和鲁棒性。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有对抗微调主要对齐对抗样本与干净样本的logits，忽略不确定性校准，且扰动常导致模型过度自信、校准恶化，存在鲁棒性之外的可靠性缺口。
summary_sections.method: 将CLIP输出重参数化为狄利克雷分布的浓度参数，统一表示相对语义结构和置信度大小，从而实现整体分布对齐，避免单一logit锚定，恢复校准不确定性。
summary_sections.result: 在多个零样本分类基准上，该方法显著改善了不确定性校准，在保持干净精度的同时实现了有竞争力的对抗鲁棒性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法填补了CLIP对抗鲁棒性中可靠性的空白，同时兼顾了校准不确定性和鲁棒性。

papers.title: GS-KAN: Parameter-Efficient Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks via Sprecher-Type Shared Basis Functions
papers.abstract_en: The Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem offers a theoretical alternative to Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) by placing learnable univariate functions on edges rather than nodes. While recent implementations such as Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) demonstrate high approximation capabilities, they suffer from significant parameter inefficiency due to the requirement of maintaining unique parameterizations for every network edge. In this work, we propose GS-KAN (Generalized Sprecher-KAN), a lightweight architecture inspired by David Sprecher's refinement of the superposition theorem. GS-KAN constructs unique edge functions by applying learnable linear transformations to a single learnable, shared parent function per layer. We evaluate GS-KAN against existing KAN architectures and MLPs across synthetic function approximation, tabular data regression and image classification tasks. Our results demonstrate that GS-KAN outperforms both MLPs and standard KAN baselines on continuous function approximation tasks while maintaining superior parameter efficiency. Additionally, GS-KAN achieves competitive performance with existing KAN architectures on tabular regression and outperforms MLPs on high-dimensional classification tasks. Crucially, the proposed architecture enables the deployment of KAN-based architectures in high-dimensional regimes under strict parameter constraints, a setting where standard implementations are typically infeasible due to parameter explosion. The source code is available at https://github.com/rambamn48/gs-impl.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GS-KAN，一种参数高效的Kolmogorov-Arnold网络变体，通过每层使用单个可学习的共享父函数，并对每条边应用可学习线性变换来生成独特边函数，从而避免标准KAN中大量独立参数化导致的参数爆炸。在连续函数逼近、表格回归和图像分类任务上，GS-KAN在保持参数效率的同时，性能优于或媲美MLP和标准KAN。
Motivation: 标准KAN需要为每条网络边维护独立的参数化，导致参数效率低下，在高维场景下参数爆炸，限制了其实际部署。
Method: 借鉴David Sprecher对叠加定理的改进，每层仅定义一个可学习的共享父函数，然后通过可学习线性变换为每个边构造独特的激活函数，大幅减少参数量。
Result: 在连续函数逼近任务上，GS-KAN优于MLP和标准KAN；在表格回归任务中与现有KAN架构性能相当；在高维图像分类任务上优于MLP，并实现了显著更高的参数效率。
Conclusion: GS-KAN使得在严格参数约束的高维场景下部署KAN架构变得可行，克服了标准KAN的参数爆炸问题。

papers.title: SHAP-Guided Kernel Actor-Critic for Explainable Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Actor-critic (AC) methods are a cornerstone of reinforcement learning (RL) but offer limited interpretability. Current explainable RL methods seldom use state attributions to assist training. Rather, they treat all state features equally, thereby neglecting the heterogeneous impacts of individual state dimensions on the reward. We propose RKHS-SHAP-based Advanced Actor-Critic (RSA2C), an attribution-aware, kernelized, two-timescale AC algorithm, including Actor, Value Critic, and Advantage Critic. The Actor is instantiated in a vector-valued reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) with a Mahalanobis-weighted operator-valued kernel, while the Value Critic and Advantage Critic reside in scalar RKHSs. These RKHS-enhanced components use sparsified dictionaries: the Value Critic maintains its own dictionary, while the Actor and Advantage Critic share one. State attributions, computed from the Value Critic via RKHS-SHAP (kernel mean embedding for on-manifold and conditional mean embedding for off-manifold expectations), are converted into Mahalanobis-gated weights that modulate Actor gradients and Advantage Critic targets. We derive a global, non-asymptotic convergence bound under state perturbations, showing stability through the perturbation-error term and efficiency through the convergence-error term. Empirical results on three continuous-control environments show that RSA2C achieves efficiency, stability, and interpretability. Our code is available at https://github.com/Na-Li66/RSA2C.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于RKHS-SHAP归因的可解释强化学习算法RSA2C，在actor-critic框架中引入状态特征重要性权重以指导训练。该方法使用向量值再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）实现actor，用标量RKHS实现value critic和advantage critic，并通过稀疏字典和Mahalanobis门控权重整合状态归因。理论推导了非渐近收敛界，在三个连续控制环境中验证了效率、稳定性和可解释性。
Motivation: 现有actor-critic方法缺乏可解释性，且大多数可解释RL方法未利用状态归因来辅助训练，而是平等对待所有状态特征，忽视了各维度对奖励的异质性影响。
Method: 提出RSA2C，包括一个向量值RKHS中的actor（带有马氏加权算子值核），以及标量RKHS中的value critic和advantage critic。通过RKHS-SHAP从value critic计算状态归因，转换为马氏门控权重，用于调制actor梯度和advantage critic目标。
Result: 在三个连续控制环境中，RSA2C实现了效率、稳定性和可解释性。理论证明在状态扰动下具有非渐近收敛界。
Conclusion: 该方法为可解释强化学习提供了一种归因感知的核化双时间尺度AC算法，兼顾性能与解释性。

papers.title: Directed evolution algorithm drives neural prediction
papers.abstract_en: Neural prediction offers a promising approach to forecasting the individual variability of neurocognitive functions and disorders and providing prognostic indicators for personalized invention. However, it is challenging to translate neural predictive models into medical artificial intelligent applications due to the limitations of domain shift and label scarcity. Here, we propose the directed evolution model (DEM), a novel computational model that mimics the trial-and-error processes of biological directed evolution to approximate optimal solutions for predictive modeling tasks. We demonstrated that the directed evolution algorithm is an effective strategy for uncertainty exploration, enhancing generalization in reinforcement learning. Furthermore, by incorporating replay buffer and continual backpropagate methods into DEM, we provide evidence of achieving better trade-off between exploitation and exploration in continuous learning settings. We conducted experiments on four different datasets for children with cochlear implants whose spoken language developmental outcomes vary considerably on the individual-child level. Preoperative neural MRI data has shown to accurately predict the post-operative outcome of these children within but not across datasets. Our results show that DEM can efficiently improve the performance of cross-domain pre-implantation neural predictions while addressing the challenge of label scarcity in target domain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对神经预测模型在医疗AI应用中面临的域偏移和标签稀缺问题，提出定向进化模型（DEM），该模型模拟生物定向进化的试错过程，结合回放缓冲区和连续反向传播来优化探索-利用平衡。在四个儿童人工耳蜗植入者数据集上，术前神经MRI数据能准确预测术后语言发展结果，但跨域预测困难。实验表明，DEM能有效提升跨域预测性能，同时缓解目标域标签稀缺问题。
Motivation: 神经预测模型在医疗AI应用中因域偏移和标签稀缺而难以泛化，限制了其临床转化。
Method: 提出定向进化模型（DEM），模拟生物定向进化的试错过程，并结合回放缓冲区和连续反向传播方法，实现探索与利用的更好平衡。
Result: 在四个儿童人工耳蜗植入者数据集上，术前神经MRI数据能准确预测术后语言发展结果，但跨域预测困难。DEM有效提升跨域性能，并在标签稀缺条件下表现良好。
Conclusion: 摘要强调DEM是一种有效的策略，可用于不确定性探索，增强强化学习的泛化能力，并在持续学习中取得更好的权衡。

papers.title: Audio-Visual World Models: Grounding Multisensory Imagination for Embodied Agents
papers.abstract_en: World models simulate environmental dynamics to enable agents to plan and reason about future states. While existing approaches have primarily focused on visual observations, real-world perception inherently involves multiple sensory modalities. Audio provides crucial spatial and temporal cues such as sound source localization and acoustic scene properties, yet its integration into world models remains relatively underexplored. Prior work has not established a commonly adopted formulation for audio-visual world modeling under low-level action control or clarified how to jointly capture physically grounded binaural audio and visual dynamics. This work presents a unified formulation of Audio-Visual World Models (AVWM), casting multimodal environment simulation as a partially observable Markov decision process with synchronized audio-visual observations. As a foundational step toward this problem, we construct AVW-4k, a controlled benchmark comprising 30 hours of binaural audio-visual trajectories with action annotations across 76 indoor environments. We propose AV-CDiT, an Audio-Visual Conditional Diffusion Transformer with a novel modality expert architecture that balances visual and auditory learning, optimized through a three-stage training strategy for effective multimodal integration. Extensive experiments on this benchmark demonstrate that AV-CDiT achieves high-fidelity multimodal prediction across visual and auditory modalities. Furthermore, we validate its practical utility in embodied navigation, demonstrating that AVWM improves a vision-language-model-guided agent in continuous audio-visual navigation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出音频-视觉世界模型（AVWM）的统一框架，将多模态环境模拟建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，并构建包含30小时双耳音频-视觉轨迹的基准AVW-4k。提出AV-CDiT（音频-视觉条件扩散Transformer），通过模态专家架构和三阶段训练策略实现高保真视听预测，并验证其在连续音频-视觉导航任务中的实用性。
Motivation: 现有世界模型主要依赖视觉，但真实感知涉及多模态；音频提供空间和时空线索（如声源定位、声学场景），其整合到世界模型中尚未被充分探索，且缺乏统一公式和基准。
Method: 提出AVWM的POMDP公式；构建AVW-4k基准（30小时双耳音频-视觉轨迹，76个室内场景，含动作标注）；提出AV-CDiT，基于条件扩散Transformer和模态专家架构，通过三阶段训练策略平衡视觉与音频学习。
Result: 在AVW-4k基准上，AV-CDiT实现高保真多模态预测；在连续音频-视觉导航中，AVWM提升视觉-语言模型引导的agent的导航性能。
Conclusion: 多感官世界模型（尤其是音频-视觉融合）可增强具身智能体的想象和规划能力；本文提供的公式、基准和方法为后续研究奠定基础。

papers.title: Enhancing Conformal Prediction via Class Similarity
papers.abstract_en: Conformal Prediction (CP) has emerged as a powerful statistical framework for high-stakes classification applications. Instead of predicting a single class, CP generates a prediction set, guaranteed to include the true label with a pre-specified probability. The performance of different CP methods is typically assessed by their average prediction set size. In setups where the classes can be partitioned into semantic groups, e.g., diseases that require similar treatment, users can benefit from prediction sets that are not only small on average, but also contain a small number of semantically different groups. This paper begins by addressing this problem and ultimately offers a widely applicable tool for boosting any CP method on any dataset. First, given a class partition, we propose augmenting the CP score function with a term that penalizes predictions with out-of-group errors. We theoretically analyze this strategy and prove its advantages for group-related metrics. Surprisingly, we show mathematically that, for common class partitions, it can also reduce the average set size of any CP score function. Our analysis reveals the class-similarity factors behind this improvement and motivates a variant that can further reduce prediction set size by leveraging the model's embeddings, without requiring any human semantic partition. Finally, we present an extensive empirical study, encompassing prominent CP methods, multiple models, and several datasets, which demonstrates that our class-similarity-based approach consistently enhances CP methods.
papers.comment: ICML 2026 (camera-ready). Code is available at: https://github.com/ariel361/CP_via_CS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对共形预测（CP）中预测集不仅需要平均尺寸小，还需包含的语义组数量少这一问题，提出利用类相似性增强CP的方法。首先，在给定类别分组时，通过在CP得分函数中引入惩罚项来减少组外错误，理论分析证明该方法能改善组相关指标，并可能降低平均预测集大小。进一步，通过利用模型嵌入自动捕捉类相似性，无需人工分组。大量实验表明该方法能持续提升多种CP方法。
Motivation: 共形预测在分类任务中生成保证覆盖率的预测集，但现有方法仅关注平均集大小，未考虑预测集内类别的语义多样性。在高风险应用中（如疾病诊疗），用户希望预测集不仅小，而且包含的语义组（如类似治疗的疾病）数量少。
Method: 首先，在给定类别分组的条件下，在CP得分函数中增加一个惩罚项，对包含多个组外类别的预测集施加惩罚。理论分析证明该策略能改善组相关指标，并可降低平均集大小。其次，基于类嵌入矩阵的奇异值，提出无需人工分组的变体，自动利用模型嵌入中的类相似性信息。
Result: 经验研究在多个数据集、多种模型和主流CP方法上，表明基于类相似性的方法持续提高CP性能（预测集更小、组多样性更低）。
Conclusion: 本文提出的类相似性增强方法可作为一种通用工具，适用于任何CP方法和数据集，无需修改基础分类器，能同时提升平均集大小和组内一致性。

papers.title: MIST: Mutual Information Estimation Via Supervised Training
papers.abstract_en: We propose a fully data-driven approach to designing mutual information (MI) estimators. Since any MI estimator is a function of the observed sample from two random variables, we parameterize this function with a neural network (MIST) and train it end-to-end to predict MI values. Training is performed on a large meta-dataset of 625,000 synthetic joint distributions with known ground-truth MI. To handle variable sample sizes and dimensions, we employ a two-dimensional attention scheme ensuring permutation invariance across input samples. To quantify uncertainty, we optimize a quantile regression loss, enabling the estimator to approximate the sampling distribution of MI rather than return a single point estimate. This research program departs from prior work by taking a fully empirical route, trading universal theoretical guarantees for flexibility and efficiency. Empirically, the learned estimators largely outperform classical baselines across sample sizes and dimensions, including on joint distributions unseen during training. The resulting quantile-based intervals are well-calibrated and more reliable than bootstrap-based confidence intervals, while inference is orders of magnitude faster than existing neural baselines. Beyond immediate empirical gains, this framework yields trainable, fully differentiable estimators that can be embedded into larger learning pipelines. Moreover, exploiting MI's invariance to invertible transformations, meta-datasets can be adapted to arbitrary data modalities via normalizing flows, enabling flexible training for diverse target meta-distributions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于监督训练的互信息（MI）估计方法（MIST），通过在大规模合成联合分布数据集上训练神经网络来端到端预测MI值，并采用二维注意力机制处理可变样本量和维度，使用分位数回归损失估计采样分布而非单一点估计。实验表明，学习到的估计器在样本量和维度上优于经典基线，分位数区间比bootstrap置信区间更可靠，推理速度远快于现有神经基线。
Motivation: 传统互信息估计方法依赖于理论假设或复杂的推导，缺乏灵活性和效率；本文旨在通过数据驱动的方式，设计一个可训练、完全可微的MI估计器，能够适应不同样本量和维度，并提供不确定性量化。
Method: 使用神经网络参数化MI估计函数（MIST），在包含625,000个合成联合分布的大规模元数据集上端到端训练，以预测真实MI值；采用二维注意力机制保证对输入样本的置换不变性，优化分位数回归损失以近似MI的采样分布。
Result: 学习到的估计器在多种样本量和维度下显著优于经典基线，即使在未见过的联合分布上也有良好表现；分位数区间校准良好且比bootstrap置信区间更可靠，推理速度比现有神经基线快数个数量级。
Conclusion: MIST框架提供了灵活、高效且可微的MI估计方法，可嵌入更大学习流程；通过可逆变换的MI不变性，元数据集可适配到任意数据模态，实现多样化目标元分布的灵活训练。

papers.title: RISE: Single Static Radar-based Indoor Scene Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Robust and privacy-preserving indoor scene understanding remains a fundamental open problem. While optical sensors such as RGB and LiDAR offer high spatial fidelity, they suffer from severe occlusions and introduce privacy risks in indoor environments. In contrast, millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar preserves privacy and penetrates obstacles, but its inherently low spatial resolution makes reliable geometric reasoning difficult. We introduce RISE, the first benchmark and system for single-static-radar indoor scene understanding, jointly targeting layout reconstruction and object detection. RISE is built upon the key insight that multipath reflections-traditionally treated as noise-encode rich geometric cues. To exploit this, we propose a Bi-Angular Multipath Enhancement that explicitly models Angle-of-Arrival and Angle-of-Departure to recover secondary (ghost) reflections and reveal invisible structures. On top of these enhanced observations, a simulation-to-reality Hierarchical Diffusion framework transforms fragmented radar responses into complete layout reconstruction and object detection. Our benchmark contains 50,000 frames collected across 100 real indoor trajectories, forming the first large-scale dataset dedicated to single, static, radar-based indoor scene understanding. Extensive experiments show that RISE reduces the Chamfer Distance by 60% (down to 16 cm) compared to the state of the art in mmWave layout reconstruction, and delivers the first mmWave-based object detection, achieving 58% IoU. These results establish RISE as a new foundation for geometry-aware and privacy-preserving indoor scene understanding using a single static radar. Our website and code are available at https://rise-cvpr.github.io.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RISE，首个基于单静态毫米波雷达的室内场景理解基准与系统，联合完成布局重建和目标检测。核心是利用多径反射（传统视为噪声）的几何信息，通过双角度多径增强（Bi-Angular Multipath Enhancement）显式建模到达角和离开角，恢复二次（鬼影）反射；再通过模拟到真实的分层扩散（Hierarchical Diffusion）框架将碎片化雷达响应转化为完整布局和检测结果。在100条真实室内轨迹的5万帧数据集上，布局重建的Chamfer距离比现有最优降低60%（至16 cm），目标检测首次实现58% IoU。
Motivation: 光学传感器（RGB、LiDAR）在室内存在严重遮挡和隐私风险，而毫米波雷达虽可穿透障碍且保护隐私，但其低空间分辨率使几何推理困难。现有工作缺乏单静态雷达室内场景理解的基准和系统。
Method: 提出双角度多径增强，显式建模到达角与离开角以恢复二次反射（鬼影），并设计模拟到真实的分层扩散框架，将增强后的雷达响应转化为布局重建和物体检测。
Result: 在自建的5万帧真实数据集上，布局重建的Chamfer距离降至16 cm（比最佳方法降低60%），目标检测首次实现58% IoU。
Conclusion: RISE为单静态雷达实现隐私保护且几何感知的室内场景理解建立了新基础，但当前仅适用于静态场景，动态场景和更细粒度分类是未来方向。

papers.title: AIDEN: Design and Pilot Study of an AI Assistant for the Visually Impaired
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents AIDEN, an artificial intelligence-based assistant designed to enhance the autonomy and daily quality of life of visually impaired individuals, who often struggle with object identification, text reading, and navigation in unfamiliar environments. Existing solutions such as screen readers or audio-based assistants facilitate access to information but frequently lead to auditory overload and raise privacy concerns in open environments. AIDEN addresses these limitations with a hybrid architecture that integrates You Only Look Once (YOLO) for real-time object detection and a Large Language and Vision Assistant (LLaVA) for scene description and Optical Character Recognition (OCR). A key novelty of the system is a continuous haptic guidance mechanism based on a Geiger-counter metaphor, which supports object centering without occupying the auditory channel, while privacy is preserved by ensuring that no personal data are stored. Empirical evaluations with visually impaired participants assessed perceived ease of use and acceptance using the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM). Results indicate high user satisfaction, particularly regarding intuitiveness and perceived autonomy. Moreover, the ``Find an Object'' achieved effective real-time performance. These findings provide promising evidence that multimodal haptic-visual feedback can improve daily usability and independence compared to traditional audio-centric methods, motivating larger-scale clinical validations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍AIDEN，一个基于AI的视觉障碍辅助系统，集成YOLO实时物体检测和LLaVA场景描述与OCR，并引入基于盖革计数器隐喻的连续触觉导引机制。在视障参与者上的TAM评估显示高用户满意度和感知自主性，其中“找物体”功能实现了有效实时性能。摘要认为多模态触觉-视觉反馈比传统音频方法更具可用性。
Motivation: 现有屏幕阅读器或音频助手存在听觉过载和隐私问题，视障人群在物体识别、文字阅读和陌生环境导航方面仍面临困难。
Method: 采用YOLO实时物体检测、LLaVA进行场景描述与OCR，并提出基于盖革计数器隐喻的连续触觉导引机制，不占用听觉通道，且不存储个人数据保护隐私。
Result: 在视障参与者上的TAM评估表明高用户满意度，特别是直观性和感知自主性；“找物体”功能实现了有效实时性能。
Conclusion: 多模态触觉-视觉反馈有望提高日常可用性和独立性，优于传统音频中心方法，需要更大规模临床验证。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Polygon Matching with Pre-trained Models for Pose Estimation and Polygon Cloud from Challenging Stereo
papers.abstract_en: While stereo matching has achieved maturity for 0D point and 1D line primitives, establishing correspondences for 2D polygons remains largely unexplored due to challenges including disparity discontinuity, scale variation, training dependency, and poor generalization, limiting downstream tasks such as pose estimation and 3D reconstruction. To address these issues, we are the first to propose a Zero-shot Polygon Matching paradigm with Pre-trained Models (i.e., Z(PM)2), which combines learned features and handcrafted geometric constraints through plug-and-play modules, extending matching from 0D/1D primitives to 2D polygons. The pipeline comprises three core stages: Firstly, detector leverages the pre-trained segment anything model to vectorize segmentation masks into graph-structured polygons integrating geometry and texture; Secondly, global matcher uses bidirectional-pyramid and multi-geometric constraints to handle viewpoint variation; Thirdly, local matcher leverages local-holistic bipartite graph optimization to resolve disparity discontinuity and topological inconsistency. Moreover, we develop polygon-matching-guided pose estimation using correspondences to obtain well-distributed, low-redundancy homologous points, and pioneer the polygon cloud concept with an optimal surface generation method, producing structurally complete and semantically rich 3D representations beyond point and line clouds. Since no polygon matching methods from stereo imagery are available for direct comparison, we selected state-of-the-art (SoTA) methods close to this task as baselines. Extensive experiments on five challenging datasets (ISPRS, KITTI, ScanNet, SceneFlow, DTU) show Z(PM)2 achieves a 68.60% matching area score, outperforming MESA by approximately 32% and ranking first in area-level pose estimation, with competitive speed and strong zero-shot generalization without any training requirement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次提出零样本多边形匹配范式Z(PM)2，利用预训练模型（SAM）与手工几何约束，通过即插即用模块将匹配从0D/1D基元扩展到2D多边形。系统包含检测器（基于SAM将分割掩码向量化为图结构多边形）、全局匹配器（双向金字塔与多几何约束处理视角变化）和局部匹配器（局部-全局二分图优化解决视差不连续和拓扑不一致）。在五个挑战性数据集上，匹配区域分数达68.60%，超越MESA约32%，在区域级姿态估计中排名第一，且无需训练即可零样本泛化。
Motivation: 立体匹配在0D点和1D线基元上已成熟，但2D多边形的对应关系因视差不连续、尺度变化、训练依赖和泛化性差而少有探索，限制了姿态估计和3D重建等下游任务。
Method: 提出Z(PM)2零样本多边形匹配范式，包含三个核心阶段：1）检测器使用预训练SAM将分割掩码向量化为集成几何与纹理的图结构多边形；2）全局匹配器采用双向金字塔与多几何约束应对视角变化；3）局部匹配器通过局部-全局二分图优化解决视差不连续和拓扑不一致。还开发了多边形匹配引导的姿态估计和首次提出多边形云概念及最优表面生成方法。
Result: 在ISPRS、KITTI、ScanNet、SceneFlow、DTU五个数据集上，Z(PM)2匹配区域分数达68.60%，比MESA提升约32%，在区域级姿态估计中排名第一，且速度有竞争力且零样本泛化。
Conclusion: Z(PM)2是首个零样本多边形匹配方法，无需训练即可泛化，为姿态估计和3D表示提供了新途径，但当前未讨论其局限性。

papers.title: Agentic World Modeling for 6G: Near-Real-Time Generative State-Space Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We argue that sixth-generation (6G) intelligence is not fluent token prediction but the capacity to imagine and choose -- to simulate future scenarios, weigh trade-offs, and act with calibrated uncertainty. We reframe open radio access network (O-RAN) near-real-time (Near-RT) control via counterfactual dynamics and a world modeling (WM) paradigm that learns an action-conditioned generative state space. This enables quantitative "what-if" forecasting beyond large language models (LLMs) as the primary modeling primitive. Actions such as physical resource blocks (PRBs) are treated as first-class control inputs in a causal world model, and both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty are modeled for prediction and what-if analysis. An agentic, model predictive control (MPC)-based cross-entropy method (CEM) planner operates over short horizons, using prior-mean rollouts within data-driven PRB bounds to maximize a deterministic reward. The model couples multi-scale structured state-space mixtures (MS3M) with a compact stochastic latent to form WM-MS3M, summarizing key performance indicators (KPIs) histories and predicting next-step KPIs under hypothetical PRB sequences. On realistic O-RAN traces, WM-MS3M cuts mean absolute error (MAE) by 1.69% versus MS3M with 32% fewer parameters and similar latency, and achieves 35-80% lower root mean squared error (RMSE) than attention/hybrid baselines with 2.3-4.1x faster inference, enabling rare-event simulation and offline policy screening.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向6G开放无线接入网（O-RAN）近实时控制的智能世界建模框架WM-MS3M，它将动作（如物理资源块分配）作为因果世界模型的输入，结合多尺度结构化状态空间混合（MS3M）与紧凑随机潜变量，实现反事实预测与基于模型预测控制（MPC）的规划。在真实O-RAN轨迹上，WM-MS3M相比MS3M以32%更少参数将均绝对误差（MAE）降低1.69%，相比注意力/混合基线将均方根误差（RMSE）降低35-80%且推理速度提升2.3-4.1倍，支持罕见事件模拟与离线策略筛选。
Motivation: 现有6G智能多依赖大语言模型（LLM）的流畅令牌预测，缺乏模拟未来场景、权衡取舍与量化不确定性的能力。作者认为6G智能应具备想象与选择的能力，因此需要一种基于动作条件生成状态空间的世界模型来实现近实时反事实推理。
Method: 提出WM-MS3M框架，耦合多尺度结构化状态空间混合（MS3M）与紧凑随机潜变量，学习动作条件生成状态空间；利用基于MPC的交叉熵方法（CEM）规划器在短视界内优化确定性奖励，并在数据驱动的PRB约束下使用先验均值滚动。
Result: 在真实O-RAN轨迹上，WM-MS3M相比MS3M以32%更少参数将MAE降低1.69%；相比注意力/混合基线将RMSE降低35-80%，推理速度提升2.3-4.1倍。

papers.title: Towards Iterative End-to-End Software Development: A Feature-Driven Multi-Agent Framework
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language model agents offer the promise of automating end-to-end software development from natural language requirements. However, existing approaches largely adopt linear, waterfall-style pipelines, which oversimplify the iterative nature of real-world development and struggle with complex, large-scale projects. To address these limitations, we propose EvoDev, an iterative software development framework inspired by feature-driven development. EvoDev decomposes user requirements into a set of user-valued features and constructs a Feature Map, a directed acyclic graph that explicitly models dependencies between features. Each feature node in the feature map maintains multi-layer contexts, including business logic, software design, and code implementation, which are propagated along dependencies to provide context for subsequent development iterations. We evaluate EvoDev on challenging Android development tasks and show that it outperforms the best-performing baseline, Claude Code, by 57.3%, while improving single-agent performance by 16.0%-58.5% across different base LLMs, highlighting the importance of feature decomposition, dependency modeling, context propagation, and workflow-aware agent design for end-to-end software development. Moreover, our work summarizes practical insights for designing iterative, LLM-driven development frameworks and informs future training of base LLMs to better support iterative software development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EvoDev，一个基于特征驱动的迭代式端到端软件开发框架，将用户需求分解为特征依赖图，并在迭代中维护业务逻辑、软件设计和代码实现的多层上下文。在 Android 开发任务上，EvoDev 相比最强基线 Claude Code 提升 57.3%，并能在不同基座大语言模型上提升单智能体性能 16.0%-58.5%。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型驱动的端到端软件开发方法多采用线性瀑布式流水线，无法模拟真实开发的迭代性，难以应对复杂大型项目。
Method: EvoDev 将用户需求分解为用户价值特征，构建有向无环图特征图（Feature Map），每个特征节点维护业务逻辑、软件设计和代码实现的多层上下文，并沿依赖关系传播，为后续迭代提供上下文。
Result: 在 Android 开发任务上，EvoDev 比最强基线 Claude Code 提升 57.3%，并在不同基座大语言模型上提升单智能体性能 16.0%-58.5%。
Conclusion: 特征分解、依赖建模、上下文传播和工作流感知的智能体设计对端到端软件开发至关重要，并为设计迭代式大语言模型驱动框架及未来基座大语言模型训练提供了实用见解。

papers.title: On the importance of multiple training seeds for evaluating machine unlearning
papers.abstract_en: Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of certain data points from a trained model without costly retraining. Most practical unlearning algorithms are only approximate and their performance can only be assessed empirically. Common practice is to run unlearning algorithms multiple times independently (i.e., using multiple unlearning seeds) starting from the same trained model (i.e., using only a single training seed ). In image-classification experiments, this practice can give non-representative results as unlearning performance can be sensitive to the choice of training seed. This is particularly relevant for deterministic unlearning methods which always produce the same result when started from the same trained model. Further experiments on federated learning-to-rank, and large language models confirm that this issue extends beyond image classification. We also explain why increasing the number of unlearning seeds cannot generally compensate for the lack of multiple training seeds. Finally, we give guidance on how to select the number of training and unlearning seeds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究机器学习卸载评估中训练种子数的影响，发现仅用单一训练种子多次独立卸载（不同卸载种子）可能产生非代表性结果。实验涵盖图像分类、联邦学习排序和大语言模型，表明该问题普遍存在，且增加卸载种子数不能弥补训练种子数不足。
Motivation: 现有卸载算法评估通常只用单一训练种子，但卸载性能可能对训练种子敏感，导致评估不具代表性。
Method: 通过多领域实验（图像分类、联邦学习排序、大语言模型）对比不同训练种子和卸载种子数下的卸载性能，并理论分析为什么增加卸载种子无法替代训练种子。
Result: 实验表明，确定性卸载方法在相同训练种子下结果相同，不同训练种子间性能差异显著；增加卸载种子数不能消除这种依赖。
Conclusion: 评估卸载算法时应使用多个训练种子，并给出了选择训练和卸载种子数的指导建议。

papers.title: LoRA-DA: Data-Aware Initialization for Low-Rank Adaptation via Asymptotic Analysis
papers.abstract_en: LoRA has become a widely adopted method for PEFT, and its initialization methods have attracted increasing attention. However, existing methods have notable limitations: many methods do not incorporate target-domain data, while gradient-based methods exploit data only at a shallow level by relying on one-step gradient decomposition. In this paper, we establish a theoretical framework for data-aware LoRA initialization. Starting from minimizing the expectation of the parameter discrepancy between the fine-tuned and target models, we derive an optimization problem with two components: a bias term, which is related to the parameter distance between the fine-tuned and target models, and is approximated using a Fisher-gradient formulation to preserve anisotropy; and a variance term, which accounts for the uncertainty introduced by sampling stochasticity through the Fisher information. Solving this problem yields an optimal initialization strategy for LoRA, based on which we develop an efficient algorithm, LoRA-DA. Empirical results across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that LoRA-DA consistently improves final accuracy over existing initialization methods. Additional studies show faster, more stable convergence, robustness across ranks, and only a small initialization overhead for LoRA-DA. The source code is available at https://github.com/zqy0126/LoRA-DA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LoRA初始化方法的数据感知问题，建立理论框架，从最小化微调模型与目标模型参数差异期望出发，推导出包含偏差项（Fisher梯度近似保持各向异性）和方差项（Fisher信息刻画采样随机性）的优化问题，进而提出最优初始化策略LoRA-DA。实验表明，该方法在多个基准上持续提升最终准确率，收敛更快更稳定，对秩具有鲁棒性，且初始化开销小。
Motivation: 现有LoRA初始化方法未充分利用目标域数据，或仅通过一步梯度分解浅层利用数据，存在局限性。
Method: 建立数据感知LoRA初始化的理论框架，通过最小化参数差异期望，得到包含偏差项（Fisher梯度近似保持各向异性）和方差项（Fisher信息刻画采样随机性）的优化问题，进而提出最优初始化策略LoRA-DA。
Result: 多个基准实验表明，LoRA-DA相较于现有方法持续提升最终准确率，收敛更快更稳定，对秩具有鲁棒性，且初始化开销小。
Conclusion: 本文提出的数据感知初始化方法能够有效提升LoRA微调性能，理论分析和实验验证了其有效性。

papers.title: ReclAIm: A Multi-Agent Framework for Monitoring and Correcting Performance Decline in Medical Imaging AI
papers.abstract_en: Purpose: To develop and evaluate a multi-agent framework (ReclAIm) for automated monitoring, detection, and correction of performance decline in medical image classification models. Materials and Methods: ReclAIm is a large language model-based multi-agent system that operates through natural language interaction. A master agent coordinating three task-specific agents performed performance evaluation and triggered fine-tuning when substantial performance declines were detected. The fine-tuning workflow incorporated data augmentation, class imbalance handling, and a parameter-anchoring regularization strategy to limit catastrophic forgetting. The system was benchmarked using multiple imaging datasets, including brain MRI, chest CT, and chest radiography, partitioned into model development, inference (performance monitoring), and fine-tuning subsets (60%:20%:20%). Results: ReclAIm successfully orchestrated training, evaluation, and performance monitoring across all datasets. Performance discrepancies between test and inference data were detected in 8 of 18 models, prompting fine-tuning workflows that reduced performance gaps. In cases with declines of up to 40.6% (cardiomegaly dataset, InceptionV3), fine-tuning restored performance metrics to within 2% of baseline values. Conclusion: ReclAIm provides a prototype framework for automated monitoring and targeted fine-tuning of medical image classification models, with a natural language interface designed to support accessibility in research and potential clinical applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个名为ReclAIm的多智能体框架，用于自动监控和纠正医学影像分类模型的性能下降。该系统基于大语言模型，通过自然语言交互协调三个专用智能体，在检测到性能显著下降时触发微调流程，包括数据增强、类别不平衡处理和参数锚定正则化策略。在脑MRI、胸部CT和胸部X光等多个数据集上测试，成功检测到18个模型中的8个出现性能差异，并通过微调将性能恢复到基线值的2%以内。
Motivation: 医学影像AI模型在部署后可能因数据分布变化等原因出现性能下降，需要自动化监控和纠正机制，以减少人工干预和提高模型可靠性。
Method: 提出ReclAIm框架，基于大语言模型的多智能体系统，包含一个主智能体和三个任务专用智能体，通过自然语言交互进行性能评估和微调触发。微调流程包括数据增强、类别不平衡处理和参数锚定正则化以防止灾难性遗忘。
Result: 在多个医学影像数据集上验证，18个模型中有8个检测到性能下降，微调后性能差距缩小；在心胸增大数据集（InceptionV3）上，性能下降高达40.6%，微调后恢复至基线值的2%以内。
Conclusion: ReclAIm为医学影像分类模型的自动化监控和针对性微调提供了原型框架，其自然语言接口有助于研究和潜在临床应用的可及性。

papers.title: Fast spectral separation method for kinetic equation with anisotropic non-stationary collision operator retaining micro-model fidelity
papers.abstract_en: We present a generalized, data-driven collisional operator for one-component plasmas, learned from molecular dynamics simulations, to extend the collisional kinetic model beyond the weakly coupled regime. The proposed operator features an anisotropic, non-stationary collision kernel that accounts for particle correlations typically neglected in classical Landau formulations. To enable efficient numerical evaluation, we develop a fast spectral separation method that represents the kernel as a low-rank tensor product of univariate basis functions. This formulation admits an $O(N \log N)$ algorithm via fast Fourier transforms and preserves key physical properties, including discrete conservation laws and the H-theorem, through a structure-preserving central difference discretization. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed model accurately captures plasma dynamics in the moderately coupled regime beyond the standard Landau model while maintaining high computational efficiency and structure-preserving properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种数据驱动的广义碰撞算子，用于单组分等离子体，通过学习分子动力学模拟拓展碰撞动力学模型到弱耦合区域之外。该算子具有各向异性、非平稳的碰撞核，并开发了快速谱分离方法，实现 O(N log N) 算法，保持离散守恒律和 H 定理。数值实验表明该模型在中度耦合区域准确捕捉等离子体动力学。
Motivation: 经典 Landau 公式在弱耦合区域外失效，需要能够包含粒子关联效应的碰撞模型。
Method: 从分子动力学模拟学习各向异性非平稳碰撞核，利用低秩张量积表示和快速傅里叶变换实现 O(N log N) 算法，并采用保持结构的中心差分离散化。
Result: 数值实验表明，该模型在中度耦合区域比标准 Landau 模型更准确，同时保持高计算效率和结构保持特性。
Conclusion: 所提出的数据驱动方法成功扩展了碰撞动力学模型的适用范围，且计算高效、物理性质保持。

papers.title: A Conformation-Centric Generative Foundation Model for Linear Polymer Modeling and Design
papers.abstract_en: Linear polymers, macromolecules formed from monomers covalently bonded into continuous chains, underpin countless technologies and are indispensable to modern life. While deep learning is advancing polymer science, existing methods typically represent the whole linear polymer solely through monomer-level descriptors, overlooking the global structural information inherent in polymer conformations, which ultimately limits their practical performance. Moreover, this important field still lacks a dedicated foundation model that can effectively support diverse downstream tasks, thereby severely constraining progress. To address these challenges, we introduce PolyConFM, a foundation model tailored for modeling and designing linear polymers through conformation-centric generative pretraining. Recognizing that each linear polymer is essentially a continuous chain whose conformation can be naturally decomposed into a sequence of local conformations (i.e., those of its repeating units), we pretrain PolyConFM under the conditional generation paradigm, reconstructing these local conformations via masked autoregressive (MAR) modeling and further generating their orientation transformations to recover the corresponding polymer conformation. Meanwhile, we construct a linear polymer conformation dataset via molecular dynamics simulations to mitigate data sparsity, thereby enabling conformation-centric pretraining. Experiments demonstrate that PolyConFM consistently outperforms representative task-specific methods across diverse downstream tasks, thereby equipping polymer science with a powerful tool targeting linear polymers.

TL;DR: PolyConFM 是一个面向线性聚合物的构象中心生成式基础模型，通过掩码自回归建模和方向变换生成来预训练，旨在克服现有方法仅依赖单体级描述符而忽略全局构象信息的局限。实验表明该模型在多种下游任务中一致优于专用方法。

Method: 提出 PolyConFM，基于条件生成范式进行预训练：将线性聚合物连续链分解为局部构象序列，通过掩码自回归建模重构局部构象，并生成其方向变换以恢复完整聚合物构象；同时利用分子动力学模拟构建构象数据集缓解数据稀疏。
Result: 在多项下游任务中，PolyConFM 一致优于代表性的任务专用方法。
Conclusion: PolyConFM 为线性聚合物科学提供了一个强大的基础模型工具，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: MatterDoor: Sampling Zero-shot Spatio-semantic Priors using Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous robots often view rooms only partially, through a doorway, where the walls and scene structure hide the geometry and task-relevant semantics needed for safe navigation and goal-directed action. We ask whether off-the-shelf pretrained generative vision models can derive this missing structure as zero-shot offline priors for robot reasoning. Such priors should support spatio-semantic queries over unobserved structure, estimating the target object likelihood in hidden regions and the probability that those regions are occupied. Given an egocentric RGB observation and target query, our pipeline uses VLM-guided outpainting, monocular depth estimation, and semantic segmentation to sample semantically labeled 3D point cloud hypotheses of the hidden room. We introduce MatterDoor, a Matterport3D-derived benchmark of doorway-occluded indoor scenes, and evaluate the resulting priors with generative metrics and simulated Stretch robot object-reaching tasks. Our results suggest that useful spatio-semantic priors for planning can be derived without problem-specific fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MatterDoor方法，利用预训练的生成视觉模型（如VLM引导的outpainting、单目深度估计和语义分割）为零样本推理被门遮挡的室内空间生成时空语义先验。基于Matterport3D构建的基准测试表明，该方法能估计隐藏区域的目标物体似然和占据概率，并用于模拟Stretch机器人的物体抓取任务。
Motivation: 自主机器人常只能通过门缝部分观察房间，遮挡导致几何和语义信息缺失，影响导航和任务执行。
Method: 给定第一人称RGB图像和查询目标，通过VLM引导的outpainting、单目深度估计和语义分割，采样出带有语义标签的3D点云假设，从而推断隐藏房间的结构。
Result: 在Matterport3D衍生的门遮挡室内场景基准上，生成指标和模拟机器人任务表明，无需问题特定微调即可获得有用的时空语义先验。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法为规划提供了有用的先验，但未提及局限性或未来工作。
