papers.title: Reactivity-Informed Machine Learning for Performance Prediction and Design Space Exploration of Alkali-Activated Slag
papers.abstract_en: Establishing quantitative relationships among mix design, raw material properties, curing conditions, and performance remains a long-standing challenge in cementitious materials, particularly for alkali-activated materials with variable precursor and activator chemistry. Here, we curated the largest literature-derived alkali-activated slag (AAS) dataset to date, comprising over 3100 compressive strength records, 155 chemically distinct ground granulated blast-furnace slags (GGBSs), and 24 attributes incorporating precursor chemistry, fineness, and reactivity. Multiple machine learning (ML) algorithms were benchmarked across progressively enriched feature scenarios, demonstrating that integrating GGBS compositions, fineness, curing conditions, and specimen geometry improves predictive performance. The average metal oxide dissociation energy (AMODE), a physically interpretable representation of precursor reactivity, provides a compact alternative descriptor to explicit oxide compositions while enabling comparable predictive performance. Model interpretation revealed physically consistent trends from heterogeneous data, including non-monotonic effects of Na2O dosage and silicate modulus, reduced predicted strength at higher water content and larger specimen size, and coupled oxide-level effects more coherently represented by AMODE than by individual oxide contents. Statistically constrained design space exploration reveals reactivity-dependent trade-offs among strength, embodied CO2 emissions, and cost. The design maps identify high-strength regions with substantially lower CO2 emissions than OPC-based references at similar cost. Overall, this work demonstrates how reactivity-informed ML can extract physically meaningful trends from heterogeneous AAS data and guide source-dependent binder design. The curated dataset is publicly accessible to support advances in cement and concrete research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了最大的碱激发矿渣（AAS）抗压强度数据集（超过3100条记录），并应用多种机器学习算法进行性能预测。通过整合矿渣成分、细度、养护条件和试件几何形状等特征，提升了预测性能。提出平均金属氧化物解离能（AMODE）作为前驱体反应活性的紧凑描述符，实现了与显式氧化物组成相当的性能。模型解释揭示了物理一致的趋势，并用于统计约束的设计空间探索，指导低碳高强度的胶凝材料设计。
Motivation: 水泥基材料中，建立配合比、原材料性能、养护条件与性能之间的定量关系长期面临挑战，尤其是对于具有可变前驱体和活化剂化学性质的碱激发材料。
Method: 从文献中整理了最大的碱激发矿渣（AAS）数据集（超过3100条记录），包含155种化学不同的矿渣和24个属性。测试了多种机器学习算法，在不同特征场景下进行基准测试。引入了平均金属氧化物解离能（AMODE）作为前驱体反应活性的物理可解释表征。进行了模型解释和设计空间探索。
Result: 整合矿渣成分、细度、养护条件和试件几何形状可提升预测性能。AMODE可作为紧凑替代描述符，预测性能与显式氧化物组成相当。模型揭示了非单调效应（如Na2O用量和硅酸盐模数），以及高含水量和大试件尺寸下强度降低的趋势。设计空间探索揭示了强度、碳排放和成本之间的反应活性依赖性权衡，识别出比普通硅酸盐水泥参考更低碳排放的高强度区域。
Conclusion: 本工作展示了反应活性感知的机器学习能从异构AAS数据中提取物理有意义的趋势，并指导源依赖性胶凝材料设计。数据集公开可用。

papers.title: Optimal Rates for Generalization of Gradient Descent Methods with Deep Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Recent progress has been made in understanding the statistical generalization performance of gradient descent methods for overparameterized neural networks within the neural tangent kernel (NTK) regime. However, most of the existing work on regression problems is limited to shallow network architectures, leaving a notable gap in the theory of deep neural networks. This paper addresses this gap by presenting a comprehensive generalization analysis for deep ReLU networks trained using gradient descent (GD) and stochastic gradient descent (SGD). Specifically, we establish the first known minimax-optimal rates of excess population risk for both GD and SGD with deep ReLU networks, under the assumption that the network width scales polynomially with respect to the network depth and training sample size. Our results demonstrate that with sufficient width, gradient descent methods for deep ReLU networks can achieve optimal generalization rates on par with kernel methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度ReLU网络使用梯度下降（GD）和随机梯度下降（SGD）训练时的统计泛化性能，首次建立了在神经正切核（NTK）机制下的极小化最优过剩风险率。结果表明，当网络宽度随深度和样本量多项式增长时，深度ReLU网络可达到与核方法相当的最优泛化速率。
Motivation: 现有关于梯度下降方法泛化性的理论工作大多局限于浅层网络，缺乏对深度神经网络（deep neural networks）的系统分析，本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
Method: 在NTK机制下，假设网络宽度关于深度和训练样本量呈多项式增长，对深度ReLU网络分别分析GD和SGD的过剩风险，并给出其泛化误差的上界。
Result: 首次为GD和SGD下的深度ReLU网络建立了极小化最优的过剩风险率（minimax-optimal rates），证明在足够宽度下可达到与核方法相同的泛化最优速率。
Conclusion: 本文为深度神经网络的梯度下降算法提供了最优的泛化界，从理论上支持了深度网络在过参数化场景下仍能有效泛化。

papers.title: AxisGuide: Grounding Robot Action Coordinate System in RGB Observations for Robust Visuomotor Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Visuomotor manipulation policies trained via large-scale behavior cloning have achieved strong semantic scene understanding, yet often fail to reliably execute correct low-level actions under distribution shifts. For example, even in a simple pickup task with identical scene layouts, camera viewpoints, and illumination, performance can degrade substantially when the object is placed at unseen locations. We argue that this gap arises from insufficient action understanding, namely the inability to interpret the robot's base-frame action coordinate system in image space. To address this issue, we introduce AxisGuide, a lightweight guidance method that bridges semantic scene understanding and action-coordinate interpretation. Using camera parameters and end-effector poses, AxisGuide renders the robot base-frame axes in each camera view and augments RGB observations with a small set of cue channels that explicitly visualize the meaning of the +x, +y, and +z motions in image space. Extensive evaluations in both the LIBERO simulation and real-world environments demonstrate that AxisGuide yields substantial performance gains and improved generalization, highlighting the effectiveness of explicit action-coordinate cues for learning reliable and transferable generalist visuomotor policies.
papers.comment: Accepted to Robotics: Science and Systems (RSS) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AxisGuide，一种轻量级引导方法，通过在 RGB 观测中显式渲染机器人基坐标系坐标轴，增强机器人动作理解能力，提升分布偏移下的操作策略鲁棒性。在 LIBERO 仿真和实物环境中验证了性能提升。
Motivation: 现有行为克隆策略在语义场景理解上表现良好，但在分布偏移下低层动作执行不可靠，根本原因是缺乏对机器人基坐标系在图像空间中含义的解读能力。
Method: 利用相机参数和末端执行器位姿，在每帧 RGB 图像中渲染基坐标系轴线，并叠加少量提示通道，显式展示 +x、+y、+z 方向运动在图像空间中的对应。
Result: 在 LIBERO 仿真和实物实验中，AxisGuide 在多种任务上带来显著性能提升和泛化改善。
Conclusion: 显式的动作坐标提示有助于学习可靠且可迁移的通用视觉运动策略，是简单有效的改进方向。

papers.title: MedSIGHT: Towards Grounded Visual Comprehension in Medical Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Medical large vision-language models (Med-LVLMs) have recently achieved remarkable progress in vision-language comprehension and medical image segmentation. However, existing models still struggle to unify these two capabilities, which is essential for achieving clinically reasoning that connects visual findings with semantic interpretation. We present MedSIGHT, a unified framework that equips Med-LVLMs with structured, pixel-level understanding for grounded visual comprehension. MedSIGHT introduces a novel Region Perceiver module that produces region-centric tokens, encoding spatial information directly into representation space of the language model. We further propose a medical region codebook into the LLM vocabulary, allowing the model to generate discrete region codes as symbolic representations of anatomical and pathological regions. These codes are decoded through the Region Perceiver to reconstruct segmentation mask, achieving end-to-end spatial grounding. Lastly, MedSIGHT combines Region Perceiver, Codebook and LLM using our proposed progressive training strategy to gradually aligns these modules stably. Trained on only 72K multimodal instruction pairs, MedSIGHT achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse imaging modalities on both medical comprehension and segmentation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedSIGHT，一个统一框架，使医学大视觉语言模型（Med-LVLM）具备结构化的像素级理解能力，实现接地气的视觉理解。MedSIGHT 引入 Region Perceiver 模块产生区域中心 token，将空间信息直接编码到语言模型表示空间；并设计医学区域码本（medical region codebook）加入 LLM 词汇表，生成离散区域码作为解剖和病理区域的符号表示，通过 Region Perceiver 解码重建分割掩码，实现端到端空间定位。采用渐进训练策略逐步稳定对齐各模块。在仅 72K 多模态指令对训练后，MedSIGHT 在多种成像模态的医学理解和分割任务上取得最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有医学大视觉语言模型难以统一视觉语言理解和医学图像分割，无法实现连接视觉发现与语义解释的临床推理。
Method: 提出 MedSIGHT 框架，包含 Region Perceiver 模块将空间信息编码为区域中心 token，医学区域码本将离散区域码加入 LLM 词汇表，以及渐进训练策略逐步对齐 Region Perceiver、码本和 LLM。
Result: 在仅 72K 多模态指令对上训练，MedSIGHT 在多种成像模态的医学理解和分割任务上达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: 该框架实现了结构化的像素级理解，提供了一种统一医学视觉语言模型能力的方法，有望改善临床推理。

papers.title: Evidence Graph Consistency in Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Model-Dependent Analysis of Hallucination Detection
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) reduces but does not eliminate hallucination in large language models. Existing detection methods rely on flat similarity between generated answers and retrieved passages, ignoring structural relationships among evidence pieces and answer claims. We propose Evidence Graph Consistency (EGC), a framework that constructs a local evidence graph per response and computes five structural consistency measures as hallucination indicators. Evaluated on the full question answering split of RAGTruth across six LLMs (5,767 responses), EGC reveals a consistent model-family split: graph consistency features show the expected diagnostic direction for hallucinations in Llama-2 models but exhibit systematic reversal in GPT-4, GPT-3.5, and Mistral-7B. This reversal suggests qualitatively different hallucination patterns across model families and indicates that embedding-based graph consistency cannot serve as a model-independent hallucination detection signal.
papers.comment: Accepted at the International Conference on Advanced Machine Learning and Data Science; to appear in the IEEE Xplore proceedings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出证据图一致性（EGC）框架，为每个回答构建局部证据图并计算五个结构一致性指标作为幻觉检测信号。在RAGTruth数据集的问答子集上评估六个大语言模型（5,767条回答），发现这些特征在Llama-2模型上表现符合预期诊断方向，但在GPT-4、GPT-3.5和Mistral-7B上系统性反转，表明不同模型族存在定性不同的幻觉模式，且嵌入级图一致性无法作为模型无关的检测信号。
Motivation: 现有RAG幻觉检测方法依赖生成答案与检索片段之间的扁平相似性，忽略了证据片段与答案声明之间的结构关系。
Method: 提出EGC框架，为每个回答构建局部证据图，并计算五个结构一致性指标作为幻觉指示器。
Result: 在RAGTruth的QA子集上评估6个LLM（5,767条回答），发现图一致性特征在Llama-2模型上方向正确，但在GPT-4、GPT-3.5和Mistral-7B上系统性反转。
Conclusion: 嵌入级图一致性不能作为模型无关的幻觉检测信号，因为不同模型族存在定性不同的幻觉模式。

papers.title: Performance Variation in Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms often suffer from low run-to-run robustness, manifesting as significant performance variation across independent runs of identically configured agents. Although this issue poses a spectrum of challenges across research and practice, relatively few studies develop methods to evaluate it; RL research instead often reports uncertainty in the estimated mean performance. In this paper, we outline the limitations of conventional uncertainty and variation estimates, particularly their misalignment with purpose and the risk of underreporting. We then propose an alternative percentile-based statistic and visualization method, min-max IPR and run-wise percentile highlighting, respectively. These percentile-based tools are easy to interpret and rely on standard properties of sample percentiles, providing rich information about run-to-run performance variation. We demonstrate this through three case studies. First, we show that LayerNorm and penultimate-layer normalizations narrow performance variation in PPO, whereas the variation is mostly unchanged in SAC. Second, we compare PPO, SAC, TD-MPC, and TD-MPC2, and show TD-MPC exhibits the least variation while being the most data efficient among the four. Finally, in a comparison of DQN and Rainbow on five Atari environments, we show that both algorithms exhibit similar levels of performance variation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度强化学习算法跨运行性能变异（run-to-run performance variation）这一普遍问题，指出现有不确定性估计方法的局限，提出了基于百分位数的统计量 min-max IPR（inter-percentile range）和运行级百分位高亮（run-wise percentile highlighting）的可视化方法。通过三个案例研究展示了该方法在不同算法和环境下评估性能变异的能力。
Motivation: 深度强化学习算法常出现显著的性能变异，但缺乏系统评估该差异的方法；传统不确定性估计与评估目的不一致且易漏报。
Method: 提出基于样本百分位数的统计量 min-max IPR 和可视化方法 run-wise percentile highlighting，利用样本百分位数的标准性质提供丰富的性能变异信息。
Result: 案例研究发现：LayerNorm 和倒数第二层归一化在 PPO 中缩小性能变异，在 SAC 中变化不大；TD-MPC 在四种算法（PPO、SAC、TD-MPC、TD-MPC2）中变异最小且数据效率最高；在五个 Atari 环境中 DQN 和 Rainbow 表现出相似水平的性能变异。
Conclusion: 该百分位数工具易于解释，能有效评估跨运行性能变异，有助于更全面地报告强化学习算法的稳健性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learn to Match: Two-Sided Matching with Temporally Extended Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Two-sided matching markets often involve information that unfolds over time through interviews, repeated interaction, learning, and separation. Existing matching models typically reduce this process to immediate sub-Gaussian feedback about fixed preferences, missing settings where payoff-relevant information is revealed gradually and changes future matching decisions. We introduce a framework with temporally extended feedback, that formulates two-sided matching as a partially observable Markov game with costly pre-match screening, noisy post-match observations, evolving latent profiles, and endogenous continuation or dissolution. We instantiate this framework in Learn2Match, a multi-agent reinforcement-learning benchmark for dynamic matching markets. Learn2Match supports decentralized decision making over whom to interview, whom to match with, and when to dissolve a match, while evaluating policies using regret, social welfare, and an information-friction loss that measures the welfare gap caused by incomplete revelation of latent preferences. We find that independent PPO achieves higher cumulative social welfare and lower cumulative regret than the bandit-style CA-ETC baseline under temporally extended feedback, demonstrating the promise of MARL for dynamic matching markets. However, PPO still incurs higher information-friction loss, revealing that end-to-end MARL does not yet provide the coordinated exploration structure of matching-bandit methods. These results position Learn2Match as a benchmark for developing the next generation of matching-market algorithms: methods that are adaptive like RL agents, statistically disciplined like bandit algorithms, and structurally aware like stable-matching mechanisms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对双边匹配市场中信息随时间展开（如面试、互动、学习）的动态场景，提出一个具有时间扩展反馈的框架，将双边匹配建模为部分可观测马尔可夫博弈，并构建了Learn2Match基准。实验表明，独立PPO在累计社会福利和累计遗憾上优于基于bandit的CA-ETC基线，但信息摩擦损失更高，说明端到端MARL仍需改进协调探索。
Motivation: 现有匹配模型通常将匹配过程简化为固定偏好的即时子高斯反馈，忽略了支付相关信息逐渐揭示并影响未来匹配决策的实际场景。
Method: 提出时间扩展反馈框架，将双边匹配建模为部分可观测马尔可夫博弈，包含昂贵的匹配前筛选、带噪的匹配后观察、演化的潜在特征以及内生延续或解散。基于此构建Learn2Bench多智能体强化学习基准。
Result: 独立PPO在时间扩展反馈下实现比bandit风格CA-ETC基线更高的累计社会福利和更低的累计遗憾，但PPO的信息摩擦损失更高，表明缺乏匹配bandit方法的协调探索结构。
Conclusion: Learn2Match为开发下一代匹配市场算法提供了基准，这些算法需要同时具备RL的适应性、bandit的统计纪律性和稳定匹配机制的结构感知能力。

papers.title: HybridCodec: Fast Dual-Stream, Semantically Enhanced Neural Audio Codec
papers.abstract_en: The popularity of neural audio codecs as speech tokenizers has surged with the advent of Multimodal Large Language Models. New codec architectures with semantic and acoustic disentanglement have emerged. There are two main approaches to introduce semantic information into codec models: one distills semantic information from SSL representations into the first RVQ layer, while the other maintains separate streams for semantic and acoustic features. We propose HybridCodec, a unified architecture that combines both paradigms. It employs separate semantic and acoustic branches while distilling SSL representations into the semantic stream. This design ensures strong disentanglement without requiring an SSL model during inference. HybridCodec shows superior semantic specialization (RVQ-1) on in-domain test set and competitive reconstruction (RVQ-all). We demonstrate its robustness in out-of-domain and zero-shot cross-lingual settings, achieving a 3x speedup over existing dual-stream models.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 5 tables, 1 figure, Accepted at Interspeech 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HybridCodec 是一种结合语义与声学分离流的神经音频编码器，通过从 SSL 表示中蒸馏语义信息到语义流，实现强解耦且推理时不需要 SSL 模型。在域内测试集上语义专化表现优越，重建性能有竞争力，并在跨语言零样本场景下实现 3 倍加速。
Motivation: 现有神经音频编码器在引入语义信息时有两种范式：蒸馏到第一 RVQ 层或维护独立流。HybridCodec 旨在统一两者，在保证强解耦的同时提高推理效率。
Method: 提出统一架构，包含独立的语义流和声学流，并将 SSL 表示蒸馏到语义流中，使得推理时无需 SSL 模型即可获得语义信息。
Result: 在域内测试集上语义专化（RVQ-1）表现优越，重建质量（RVQ-all）有竞争力；在跨语言零样本场景下鲁棒，并获得 3 倍速度提升。
Conclusion: HybridCodec 通过双流架构和语义蒸馏实现了高效的语义-声学解耦，适用于多模态大语言模型中的语音分词任务。

papers.title: TorchKM: A GPU-Oriented Library for Kernel Learning and Model Selection
papers.abstract_en: TorchKM is an open-source library for kernel machines, including support vector machines, kernel logistic regression, and kernel quantile regression, with GPU acceleration. The library features a scikit-learn-style API and is designed to exploit GPU-friendly linear algebra, accelerating the full training and model-selection pipeline through intelligent reuse of matrix operations. Benchmarks show competitive predictive performance together with substantial speedups over standard baselines. Code and documentation are available at https://github.com/YikaiZhang95/torchkm, and the package can be easily installed via PyPI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TorchKM 是一个基于 GPU 加速的核机器学习开源库，支持支持向量机、核逻辑回归和核分位数回归，采用 scikit-learn 风格的 API 并通过智能矩阵运算重用加速训练和模型选择流程。基准测试表明其预测性能具有竞争力，并显著优于标准基线。
Motivation: 现有的核机器学习实现通常缺乏 GPU 加速和高效的模型选择，导致大规模任务训练缓慢。
Method: 提出 TorchKM 库，利用 GPU 友好的线性代数加速全训练和模型选择，通过重用矩阵运算减少计算冗余。
Result: 基准测试显示 TorchKM 实现了与标准基线相当的预测性能，并带来了显著的速度提升。
Conclusion: TorchKM 提供了一个高效、易用的核机器学习 GPU 加速工具，代码和文档开源，可通过 PyPI 安装。

papers.title: OpenSkill: Open-World Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving agents requires adaptation after deployment, but existing approaches assume a usable learning loop, such as curated skills, successful trajectories, or verifier signals. Real open-world deployments may provide none of these, offering only a task prompt. In this work, we study open-world self-evolution, where an agent must build both its skills and its own verification signals from scratch, using open-world resources but no target-task supervision. We propose OpenSkill, a framework that bootstraps this loop: it acquires grounded knowledge and verification anchors from documentation, repositories, and the web, synthesizes them into transferable skills, and refines those skills against self-built virtual tasks grounded in the anchors rather than in target answers. The open world thus supplies both the knowledge to be learned and a supervision-independent practice environment, with target-task supervision reserved for final evaluation. Across three benchmarks and two target agents, OpenSkill attains the best automated pass rate while satisfying the no-supervision constraint. Analysis shows its skills transfer across models without model-specific adaptation, and its self-built verifier aligns with ground-truth outcomes despite never accessing them.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 4 figures and 8 tables. Code is avalable at https://github.com/OpenLAIR/OpenSkill
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究LLM代理在开放世界中的自我演化问题，现有方法假设存在可用的学习循环（如策划的技能或成功轨迹），但实际部署中可能只有任务提示。提出OpenSkill框架，从文档、代码库和网络中获取知识并合成可转移技能，通过自建的虚拟任务进行精炼，全程无需目标任务监督。在三个基准和两个代理上取得最佳自动化通过率，技能可跨模型转移且自建验证器与真实标签对齐。
Motivation: 现有自我演化方法依赖预定义的技能库、成功轨迹或验证信号，不适用于仅给出任务提示的开放世界部署。需要一种无需目标监督的自我演化方法。
Method: 提出OpenSkill框架，从开放世界资源（文档、代码库、网页）中获取基础知识和验证锚点，将其合成为可转移技能，并在基于这些锚点构建的虚拟任务上优化技能，不使用目标答案。
Result: 在三个基准和两个目标代理上，OpenSkill在满足无监督约束下达到最佳自动化通过率，技能可转移至不同模型且无需特定适应，自建验证器与真实结果一致。
Conclusion: 开放世界既提供学习知识又提供无监督的练习环境，目标任务监督仅用于最终评估，实现了从零开始的自我演化。

papers.title: Multilingual Multi-Speaker Unit Vocoders: A Systematic Analysis of Discrete Speech Representations
papers.abstract_en: Discrete speech units obtained via k-means clustering of self supervised embeddings entangle phonetic, speaker, and language information, causing speaker mixing and cross-lingual interference in multilingual multi-speaker speech generation. Despite growing use in Audio LLMs and speech to speech systems, unit vocoders remain underexplored. We analyze a BigVGAN based unit vocoder, across four Indian languages. We study the interaction between cluster size and conditioning strategies using WER, speaker similarity, and unit level metrics. Results show that cluster size governs intelligibility by improving phonetic discriminability, while explicit speaker conditioning is indispensable for preventing identity collapse. Language supervision yields further gains mainly at lower cluster sizes where units remain ambiguous. Our analysis shows similar phonemes across languages collapse to the same cluster IDs at smaller inventories, with larger clusters progressively separating them.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统分析了基于BigVGAN的单元声码器在多语言多说话人语音生成中的表现，研究了聚类大小和条件策略对可懂度、说话人相似度和单元级指标的影响。结果显示聚类大小通过改善音素可辨别性决定可懂度，显式说话人条件对于防止身份崩溃不可或缺，语言监督在较低聚类大小下效果更明显。
Motivation: 离散语音单元在音频LLM和语音到语音系统中应用日益广泛，但单元声码器在多语言多说话人场景下的性能尚未被充分探索，存在说话人混合和跨语言干扰问题。
Method: 采用基于BigVGAN的单元声码器，在四种印度语言上系统分析聚类大小和不同条件策略（如显式说话人条件、语言监督）的影响，使用WER、说话人相似度和单元级指标进行评估。
Result: 聚类大小通过改善音素可辨别性主导可懂度；显式说话人条件对于防止身份崩溃不可或缺；语言监督主要在较低聚类大小（单元模糊）时提供额外收益。不同语言的相似音素在小聚类中塌缩到相同簇ID，大聚类逐渐分离它们。
Conclusion: 论文强调了聚类大小和显式说话人条件在单元声码器中的关键作用，并指出语言监督在特定条件下的辅助价值。

papers.title: A Geometric Account of Activation Steering through Angle-Norm Decomposition
papers.abstract_en: Linear activation steering has gained popularity as a simple and empirically effective way to control language model behavior. More recently, spherical steering paradigms have been proposed to address limitations of additive interventions, often motivated by the assumption that hidden-state norm does not carry concept-relevant information. In this work, we revisit this assumption through a controlled empirical study designed to disentangle the roles of angular and radial components. We show that steering methods differ mainly in how they couple two geometric effects: changing a token's angular alignment with a concept direction and changing its hidden-state norm. Across seven language models, we find that concepts are represented primarily in angular structure, supporting the motivation for spherical methods, but that norm remains important for the stability and downstream effects of steering. Our results explain why interventions with similar concept-level effects can behave differently, and suggest that activation steering should be parameterized by interpretable angular and radial components of the intervention, rather than by a single additive coefficient that entangles these two effects.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过角度-范数分解，实证研究了线性激活转向中隐藏状态范数与角度分量的作用，发现概念主要编码在角度结构中，但范数对转向的稳定性和下游效果仍然重要。
Motivation: 现有激活转向方法（球面转向）假设隐藏状态范数不携带概念相关信息，本文通过控制实验重新审视这一假设，旨在解耦角度和径向分量在转向中的作用。
Method: 设计受控实验，将激活转向分解为角度对齐变化和范数变化两个几何效应，在七个语言模型上对比不同转向方法。
Result: 概念主要表示在角度结构中，支持球面方法的动机；但范数对转向稳定性和下游效果仍有影响，解释了具有相似概念效果的不同转向行为差异。
Conclusion: 建议激活转向应由可解释的角度和径向分量参数化，而非单一的加法系数。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Compute-Optimal Network Design for Echocardiography Myocardial Segmentation and Perfusion Quantification using Neural Scaling Laws
papers.abstract_en: Myocardial perfusion quantification using contrast-enhanced ultrasound offers a bedside non-ionizing alternative to nuclear imaging modalities. However, its clinical adoption is hindered by time-consuming manual labelling. Automated segmentation has proved challenging due to a paucity of in-domain training data. Adapting strategies currently used to optimise large language models for large datasets, we apply neural scaling laws to predict network performance for myocardial segmentation. We extrapolate performance on subsets of the data to determine optimal network size on the CAMUS echocardiography dataset and a 25-patient contrast-enhanced ultrasound (CEUS) dataset. Finally, we validate the clinical utility of our models by comparing the final myocardial perfusion parameters with those obtained by a senior cardiologist. Extrapolation based on the scaling law is predictive of test loss at the full dataset size, allowing us to select two networks that obtained state-of-the-art performance on CAMUS with a 240-fold reduction in parameter count. We observe the gradient of the scaling law transfers from CAMUS to the CEUS dataset with a bias in the predicted losses. The automatically segmented masks perform equivalently to a senior cardiologist in myocardial perfusion quantification. These results establish neural scaling laws as a practical tool for data-driven compute-optimal model design for small imaging datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文应用神经缩放定律（neural scaling laws）于超声心动图心肌分割任务，通过数据子集外推预测全数据集下的最优网络规模，并在CAMUS和25例患者的对比增强超声（CEUS）数据集上验证。结果表明，在CAMUS上以240倍参数减少获得SOTA性能，且缩放定律梯度可迁移至CEUS，自动分割在心肌灌注量化中与资深心脏病专家等效。
Motivation: 手动标注心肌灌注分割耗时，临床采用受限于小规模训练数据，现有自动化方法因数据匮乏而效果不佳。
Method: 借鉴大语言模型优化策略，将神经缩放定律应用于小规模医学图像集，基于子集性能外推预测最优网络尺寸。
Result: 在CAMUS数据集上以240倍参数减少达到SOTA；缩放定律损失梯度从CAMUS迁移至CEUS时存在预测偏差；自动分割掩膜在心肌灌注量化上等效于资深心脏病专家。
Conclusion: 神经缩放定律可作为小成像数据集的实用工具，指导数据驱动的计算最优模型设计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Synthics: Synthetic Physics-like Datasets for Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Representative data is fundamental in machine learning, as limited data hinders generalisation. Collecting sufficient real-world samples is often infeasible. Synthetic data generation offers a practical solution, but only if the generated data faithfully reflects the structure of real observations. In this paper, a method for generating synthetic regression datasets that structurally resemble physics equations from a given equation corpus is presented. The approach uses a Bayesian Probabilistic Context-Free Grammar to capture the underlying algebraic structure of the corpus, from which novel equations are sampled. To ensure the generated inputs lie within a physically meaningful domain, the applicability domain is characterised for each equation through non-intrusive probing, also recovering inter-variable constraints. Input sampling further mimics realistic experimental conditions by drawing from random sub-ranges of the valid domain with mixed uniform and truncated normal distributions. The generated data is statistically validated against the Feynman equation corpus using Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests. The generated equations match the corpus on all of the eight studied structural features, compared to only two for an unsmoothed purely probabilistic grammar, demonstrating that the Bayesian prior is essential for structural fidelity given the size of the corpus. In a downstream hyperparameter-tuning task, a gradient-boosted regressor tuned on the synthetic data picks, on average, the 6th-best configuration out of 20 on real data, matching the result of tuning on real data itself and substantially outperforming random expression trees (10th) and noise (19th).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种生成合成回归数据集的方法，这些数据集在结构上类似于给定方程语料库中的物理方程。方法使用贝叶斯概率上下文无关文法捕获代数结构，通过非侵入式探测确定适用域，并模拟真实实验条件采样输入。统计验证表明生成数据在结构特征上与Feynman方程语料库匹配，下游超参数调优任务中基于合成数据的调优效果与真实数据相当。
Motivation: 收集足够真实样本常不可行，合成数据生成需忠实反映真实观测结构。
Method: 使用贝叶斯概率上下文无关文法从方程语料库学习代数结构并采样新方程；通过非侵入式探测表征每个方程的适用域和变量间约束；输入采样采用混合均匀分布和截断正态分布模拟真实实验条件。
Result: 生成方程在八项结构特征上均匹配Feynman语料库，而未经平滑的纯概率文法仅匹配两项。下游超参数调优中，基于合成数据调优的梯度提升回归器在真实数据上平均选出20个配置中的第6优，与基于真实数据调优结果相同，显著优于随机表达式树（第10）和噪声（第19）。
Conclusion: 贝叶斯先验对于在给定语料库规模下实现结构保真度至关重要，合成数据在替代真实数据用于下游任务方面具有潜力。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Flatland: The Adventures of Gradient Descent with Large Step Sizes
papers.abstract_en: The training of neural networks often entails objective functions that are not globally $L$-smooth. For these functions, it is both theoretically and practically difficult to reply to the question: what is the largest possible step size that ensures the convergence of gradient descent (GD)? We address this longstanding open question in deep learning by providing a unifying definition of "large" step sizes that requires only local Lipschitz (or even Hölder) continuity of the gradient. We design first-order adaptive methods that provably yield large step sizes and show that they operate at the edge of stability (EoS) right from the start of the training. In particular, the loss decreases nonmonotonically and the product between the step size and sharpness, i.e., the largest eigenvalue of the Hessian, stays above the EoS threshold of 2 throughout training. Using our method, we are also able to minimize the sharpness all the way down to its global minimum. Contrary to expectation, we find that encountering globally-flat regions too early in the training may both slow down convergence and jeopardize the generalization ability of the network. Exploiting a self-stabilization argument, we allow GD to enter slightly sharper valleys and turn unsuccessful training runs into very successful ones.
papers.comment: Accepted for the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对神经网络训练中非全局L-光滑的目标函数，研究了梯度下降（GD）在“大”步长下的行为。作者提出了一个统一的“大”步长定义，仅需梯度的局部Lipschitz（或Hölder）连续性，并设计了自适应的first-order方法，证明其能从训练一开始就产生大步长并运行在稳定性边缘（EoS）。该方法允许损失非单调下降，且步长与Hessian最大特征值的乘积始终保持在EoS阈值2以上，同时能够将sharpness最小化至全局最小值。实验发现，过早遇到全局平坦区域可能减慢收敛并损害泛化能力，而利用自稳定化论点让GD进入稍尖锐的谷底可以将不成功的训练转为非常成功。
Motivation: 神经网络训练的目标函数通常不是全局L-光滑的，因此难以从理论和实践上回答“保证GD收敛的最大步长是多少”这一长期未解决的问题。
Method: 提出一个统一的“大”步长定义，只要求梯度的局部Lipschitz（或Hölder）连续性；设计自适应的first-order方法，使其从训练伊始就运行在稳定性边缘（EoS），并利用自稳定化论点允许GD进入稍尖锐的谷底。
Result: 该方法使损失非单调下降，步长与sharpness的乘积始终高于EoS阈值2，并能够将sharpness最小化至全局最小值。实验表明过早进入全局平坦区域会减慢收敛并损害泛化。
Conclusion: 通过自稳定化论点，让GD在稍尖锐的谷底中训练可以将原本不成功的训练转化为非常成功，提示了EoS现象在优化中的积极作用和过早平坦化的风险。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SCOUT: Semantic scene COverage via Uncertainty-guided Traversal
papers.abstract_en: Robots that operate over extended periods should not merely visit space; they should progressively understand it. Yet most 3D scene graph pipelines treat perception as a post-processing stage over a fixed dataset, decoupling scene representation from the decisions that determine what is observed in the first place. We present SCOUT, an online semantic exploration framework that closes this loop by coupling active traversal with probabilistic scene graph construction. Given a prior 2D occupancy map and posed RGB-D observations, SCOUT incrementally builds an uncertainty-aware 3D scene graph whose nodes maintain fused geometry and posterior beliefs over open-vocabulary object labels, while edges encode structural relations such as on, inside, belong, and next to. These beliefs are fed back to an uncertainty-guided traversal planner, which selects viewpoints by balancing expected semantic certainty gain, geometric coverage gain, and travel cost. In this way, the robot revisits ambiguous objects when additional evidence matters and expands into unseen free space when the scene remains incomplete. The resulting system treats semantic scene completeness as an operational objective rather than a passive by-product of semantic mapping, moving toward autonomous agents that can patrol, update, and reason about evolving indoor environments with minimal human intervention.
papers.comment: 2026 ICRA Workshop on Uncertainty in Open World Robotics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SCOUT，一种在线语义探索框架，将主动遍历与概率场景图构建相结合，使机器人能在操作过程中逐步理解环境。系统利用不确定性引导的遍历规划器选择视点，平衡语义确信增益、几何覆盖增益和移动成本，从而将语义场景完整性作为操作目标。
Motivation: 现有3D场景图流水线通常将感知视为固定数据集的后处理阶段，解耦了场景表示与观察决策，导致机器人无法在长时间操作中主动理解环境。
Method: SCOUT基于先验2D占用地图和带位姿的RGB-D观测，增量构建不确定性感知的3D场景图，节点维护融合几何和开放词汇对象标签的后验信念，边缘编码结构关系。信念反馈给不确定性引导的遍历规划器，该规划器通过平衡预期语义确信增益、几何覆盖增益和移动成本来选择视点。
Result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果，但声称系统使机器人能在证据需要时重新访问模糊对象，并在场景不完整时探索未知自由空间，实现自主巡逻、更新和推理。
Conclusion: 论文主张将语义场景完整性作为操作目标而非被动副产品，推动自主智能体在最少人工干预下理解动态室内环境。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出SCOUT，一种在线语义探索框架，将主动遍历与概率场景图构建相结合，使机器人能在操作过程中逐步理解环境。系统利用不确定性引导的遍历规划器选择视点，平衡语义确信增益、几何覆盖增益和移动成本，从而将语义场景完整性作为操作目标。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有3D场景图流水线通常将感知视为固定数据集的后处理阶段，解耦了场景表示与观察决策，导致机器人无法在长时间操作中主动理解环境。
summary_sections.method: SCOUT基于先验2D占用地图和带位姿的RGB-D观测，增量构建不确定性感知的3D场景图，节点维护融合几何和开放词汇对象标签的后验信念，边缘编码结构关系。信念反馈给不确定性引导的遍历规划器，该规划器通过平衡预期语义确信增益、几何覆盖增益和移动成本来选择视点。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果，但声称系统使机器人能在证据需要时重新访问模糊对象，并在场景不完整时探索未知自由空间，实现自主巡逻、更新和推理。
summary_sections.conclusion: 论文主张将语义场景完整性作为操作目标而非被动副产品，推动自主智能体在最少人工干预下理解动态室内环境。

papers.title: MSAIC-Net: A Multi-Scale Attention and Imbalance-Aware Contrastive Network for ECG-Based Myocardial Substrate Abnormality Detection
papers.abstract_en: Myocardial substrate abnormalities, such as myocardial scar and myocardial infarction (MI), are associated with adverse cardiovascular outcomes. Electrocardiography (ECG) provides a low-cost and widely available tool for detecting these abnormalities, but ECG-based detection remains challenging due to heterogeneous lead-dependent manifestations, high-dimensional multi-lead signals, class imbalance, and the limited interpretability of deep learning models. We propose a multi-scale attention-enhanced convolutional network (MSAIC-Net) for ECG-based myocardial substrate abnormality detection. MSAIC-Net employs parallel atrous convolutional branches to extract ECG features across multiple temporal receptive fields. %, enabling the model to capture both local and longer-range temporal patterns. Channel attention is then used to adaptively reweight informative lead-wise and feature-channel representations. To address class imbalance and improve feature separability, we introduce a novel imbalance-aware supervised contrastive learning strategy that encourages samples from the same class to form compact representations while increasing separation between abnormal and normal samples. Lead-wise permutation importance is further incorporated to quantify the contribution of each ECG lead and improve model interpretability. The proposed method was evaluated on two complementary datasets: a low-data institutional cohort from the University of Virginia (UVA) Health System for myocardial scar classification and the large-scale public PTB-XL dataset from PhysioNet for MI identification. Experimental results show that MSAIC-Net outperforms baseline models, with particularly pronounced improvements in the low-data UVA cohort. Overall, the proposed framework provides an effective and interpretable approach for ECG-based detection of myocardial substrate abnormalities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MSAIC-Net是一个多尺度注意力增强的卷积网络，用于基于心电图（ECG）的心肌基质异常（心肌瘢痕和心肌梗死）检测。它采用并行空洞卷积分支提取多个时间感受野的特征，通过通道注意力自适应重加权导联和特征通道表示，并引入不平衡感知的监督对比学习策略以缓解类别不平衡并增强特征可分性。在UVA低数据队列和PTB-XL数据集上的实验表明，该方法优于基线模型，尤其在低数据场景下提升显著。
Motivation: 心电图检测心肌基质异常面临导联表现异质性、高维多导联信号、类别不平衡以及深度学习模型可解释性不足等挑战。
Method: 提出MSAIC-Net，包含并行空洞卷积分支、通道注意力机制，以及不平衡感知的监督对比学习策略，并通过导联级置换重要性量化每个导联的贡献以提升可解释性。
Result: 在UVA心肌瘢痕分类低数据队列和PTB-XL心肌梗死识别数据集上，MSAIC-Net均优于基线模型，尤其在UVA低数据队列中改进更为显著。
Conclusion: 该框架为基于心电图的心肌基质异常检测提供了有效且可解释的方案。

papers.title: ShallowBench: Benchmarking Generative Drug Design Models on Shallow-Pocket Targets
papers.abstract_en: While generative AI models have demonstrated remarkable success in structure-based drug design, they predominantly rely on deep binding pockets and struggle to sample effective ligands for challenging low-pocketability targets, such as the historically "undruggable" oncology targets KRAS and MYC. To address this gap, we introduce ShallowBench, a strictly curated benchmark of 5,780 shallow-pocket targets extracted from CrossDocked2020. By computing the difference between an Alpha Shape "lid" volume and the underlying protein atom voxel volume, we successfully isolated targets with low concavity while ensuring sufficient surface area for binding. Evaluating various state-of-the-art generative models reveals weaker predicted binding affinity on these low-concavity interfaces. ShallowBench therefore provides a rigorous benchmark for generative biology models and highlights the necessity of new architectural innovations or loss functions capable of navigating these challenging targets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生成式药物设计模型在浅口袋靶标上性能不足的问题，构建了 ShallowBench 基准，包含从 CrossDocked2020 提取的 5780 个浅口袋靶标，通过 Alpha Shape 'lid' 体积与蛋白原子体素体积之差量化口袋凹度。评估多个 SOTA 生成模型发现它们在低凹度界面上的预测结合亲和力较弱，表明需要设计新的架构或损失函数来应对此类挑战。
Motivation: 现有基于结构的药物设计模型主要依赖深口袋，难以有效作用于低口袋性靶标（如 KRAS、MYC），而缺乏专门针对浅口袋靶标的基准。
Method: 从 CrossDocked2020 提取 5780 个浅口袋靶标，定义并计算 Alpha Shape 'lid' 体积与蛋白原子体素体积之差，以隔离具有低凹度但足够结合表面积的靶标，构成 ShallowBench 基准。
Result: 评估多种 SOTA 生成模型（未具体列出）在 ShallowBench 上显示预测结合亲和力较弱，证实了现有模型在浅口袋靶标上的性能瓶颈。
Conclusion: ShallowBench 为生成式生物学模型提供严格基准，并凸显了开发适应低凹度靶标的新型架构或损失函数的必要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Does Topic Sentiment Cause Perceived Ideology? Comparing Human and LLM Annotations in Political News Articles
papers.abstract_en: We ask whether topic sentiment has a causal effect on perceived political ideology, and whether the answer depends on who assigns the ideology label. Using articles from AllSides, paired with shared sentiment annotations from Llama-3.3-70b-versatile, we compare ideology labels from expert human annotators, GPT-4o-mini (baseline and finetuned), and Llama-3.3-70B. We apply Double Machine Learning (DML) and community-level mediation analysis across all four annotation paradigms. Human annotations yield no significant causal effects at the community level. Fine-tuned GPT-4o-mini achieves the highest classification accuracy (F1=72.48) and is the only annotator paradigm that produces significant community-level treatment effects and significant natural direct effects (NDEs) in mediation. We interpret this as evidence of shortcut learning: fine-tuning on ideology-labeled data causes the model to internalise a spurious sentiment--ideology coupling not operative in human judgment for this task. This coupling is structurally invisible to F1-based evaluation, with implications for the use of LLM annotations as silver labels and as proxies for human judgment in downstream causal analyses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究主题情感对政治新闻意识形态感知的因果效应，并比较人类专家、GPT-4o-mini和Llama-3.3-70B的标注。使用AllSides文章和Llama情感标注，通过双重机器学习（DML）和社区级中介分析发现，人类标注无显著因果效应，而微调后的GPT-4o-mini（F1=72.48）产生显著效应，解释为捷径学习导致的虚假情感-意识形态耦合。
Motivation: 探究主题情感是否因果影响感知意识形态，以及标注者（人类 vs LLM）不同是否导致结论差异，揭示LLM标注作为银标签时潜在的虚假关联问题。
Method: 采用双重机器学习（DML）和社区级中介分析，对比四种标注范式：人类专家、GPT-4o-mini（基线及微调）、Llama-3.3-70B，使用AllSides文章和Llama共享情感标注。
Result: 人类标注在社区级无显著因果效应；微调GPT-4o-mini分类准确率最高（F1=72.48），且唯一产生显著社区级处理效应和自然直接效应（NDEs），表明存在捷径学习。
Conclusion: 微调LLM可能内化虚假情感-意识形态耦合，该耦合在F1评估中不可见，警示利用LLM标注作为银标签或人类判断代理进行下游因果分析的风险。

papers.title: Anchored, Not Graded: Vision-Language Models Fail at Slant-from-Texture Perception
papers.abstract_en: Human perception of surface slant from texture exhibits systematic, graded biases that emerge reliably in psychophysical experiments. Prior work showed that unsupervised CNNs reproduce several human-like biases, while supervised CNNs do not. Do Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit similar competences? Across multiple VLM families and model scales, zero-shot and in-context prompting both produce distinctive failures: slant is predicted at only a small set of anchors (e.g., 0\degree, $\pm$25\degree, $\pm$45\degree) with little dependence on stimulus field of view, optical slant, or surface curvature. Supervised fine-tuning partially remediates the failure, but residual anchoring persists. While success in high-level vision-language benchmarks might not require sensitivity to low-level geometric cues, we interpret anchoring as a failure at the representation-to-output language interface: Not necessarily an absence of geometric encoding, but a failure to express it in a graded form.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）在纹理倾斜感知中的表现，发现VLM在零样本和上下文提示下仅能预测少数锚点角度（如0°、±25°、±45°），几乎不依赖刺激视场、光学倾斜或表面曲率，存在系统性锚定失败。监督微调可部分缓解，但残留锚定仍然存在。作者将失败归因于表示到输出的语言接口问题，而非完全的几何编码缺失。
Motivation: 人类对纹理倾斜的感知具有系统性的分级偏差，早期工作发现无监督CNN能复现人类偏差而监督CNN不能，但VLM是否具备类似能力尚不明确。
Method: 在多个VLM家族和模型尺度上，测试零样本和上下文提示下的纹理倾斜预测，并对比监督微调的效果。
Result: VLM仅输出少量离散锚点角度，缺乏对刺激参数（视场、光学倾斜、曲率）的依赖；监督微调部分修复但锚定现象残留。
Conclusion: VLM在高层次视觉语言任务上的成功可能不依赖对低级几何线索的敏感度，锚定失败表明表示到输出的语言接口存在缺陷，而非几何编码本身缺失。

papers.title: Data-Efficient Autoregressive-to-Diffusion Language Models via On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: We study the transformation of autoregressive models (ARLMs) into diffusion language models (DLMs). Rather than pretraining from scratch, prior work replaces the causal attention in ARLMs with bidirectional attention and then trains the resulting model using a DLM objective. However, these approaches incur two distribution shifts. First, transitioning from a next-token prediction objective to a DLM objective can discard knowledge acquired by the ARLM during training. Second, standard DLMs suffer from a train-inference mismatch, as the training loss is defined on randomly masked sequences rather than the trajectories encountered at inference produced by confidence-based decoding. To address both challenges, we introduce an On-Policy Diffusion Language Model (OPDLM) in which On-Policy Distillation (OPD) is employed for ARLM-to-DLM transformation. Specifically, OPDLM is trained via self-OPD, where the student, an ARLM with bidirectional attention, generates its own trajectories, and the teacher, the original frozen ARLM, distills its knowledge by providing target logits on these trajectories. By training directly in an on-policy manner, OPDLM eliminates the train-inference mismatch in DLMs, while distillation from the original model enhances knowledge retention from the ARLM. Empirical results demonstrate that OPDLM requires 15x to 7,000x fewer training tokens with strong performance across a wide variety of tasks. OPDLM avoids the prohibitive cost of DLM pretraining and positions DLM transformation as a form of ARLM post-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OPDLM，通过在线策略蒸馏（On-Policy Distillation）将自回归语言模型（ARLM）高效转化为扩散语言模型（DLM），仅需原始训练token的15x到7000x分之一即可达到强性能。
Motivation: 现有ARLM-to-DLM转换存在两种分布偏移：训练目标切换导致知识丢失，以及标准DLM训练与推理的不匹配。
Method: OPDLM使用自在线策略蒸馏：学生模型（双向注意力的ARLM）生成自身轨迹，教师模型（冻结的原始ARLM）在这些轨迹上提供目标logits，从而消除训练-推理不匹配并保留原模型知识。
Result: OPDLM在多种任务上仅需15倍到7000倍更少的训练token即可取得强性能，避免DLM预训练的高成本。
Conclusion: 本文表明DLM转换可作为ARLM的后训练步骤，而非从头预训练，显著降低计算开销。

papers.title: USU-Corn-WeedDB: A UAV RGB Image Dataset for Multi-Species Weed Detection in Forage Corn
papers.abstract_en: Weed pressure in forage corn production causes yield losses of up to 31.5%, yet site-specific weed management (SSWM) systems built on UAV imagery and deep learning remain constrained by the scarcity of field-representative training datasets. We present USU-Corn-WeedDB, a publicly available UAV RGB image dataset collected from a commercial forage corn field in Cache Valley, Utah, designed to support multi-class weed detection under both supervised and semi-supervised learning frameworks. RGB imagery was acquired on 27 June 2025 using an Autel EVO II Dual 640T V2 drone at ~10m above ground level, yielding a ground sampling distance of approximately 0.48 cm/pixel. A total of 366 full-resolution images were tiled into 8,800 patches at 640 x 640-pixel resolution. Of these, 800 images were manually annotated for three weed species; common lambsquarters (Chenopodium album), redroot pigweed (Amaranthus retroflexus), and green foxtail (Setaria viridis) comprising 10,539 bounding-box instances, with the remaining 8,000 tiles retained as an unlabeled pool for semi-supervised experiments. This dataset reflects a natural class imbalance where redroot pigweed constitutes 53.86% of annotated instances, which was preserved intentionally to mirror real field conditions. To validate dataset utility, we trained 28 object detection models spanning five architecture families including YOLOv8, YOLOv9, YOLOv10, YOLO11, YOLO26, and RT-DETR under identical conditions without hyperparameter tuning. Test set mAP@0.5 ranged from 0.773 to 0.840, with lightweight models achieving competitive performance relevant to edge-deployed UAV systems. USU-Corn-WeedDB is publicly available at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20044178.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个用于饲料玉米中多物种杂草检测的无人机RGB图像数据集USU-Corn-WeedDB，包含366张全分辨率图像及其对应的800张标注图像（共10,539个边界框），以及8,000张未标注图像。数据集反映了自然的类别不平衡（红根藜占53.86%）。作者使用YOLO系列和RT-DETR等28个目标检测模型进行了验证，在测试集上mAP@0.5达到0.773-0.840，表明轻量模型在边缘部署中具有竞争力。
Motivation: 杂草导致饲料玉米产量损失高达31.5%，但基于无人机图像和深度学习的SSWM系统因缺乏代表性训练数据集而受限。
Method: 在犹他州Cache Valley的商业玉米田使用Autel EVO II Dual 640T V2无人机于约10米高度采集RGB图像，地面采样距离约0.48 cm/像素。将366张全分辨率图像切分为8,800个640×640像素的图块，其中800张人工标注了三种杂草（普通藜、红根藜、绿狗尾草），其余8,000张作为未标注池用于半监督学习。训练了28个目标检测模型（YOLOv8/9/10/11/26及RT-DETR）。
Result: 测试集mAP@0.5范围为0.773至0.840，轻量模型性能与边缘部署需求相匹配。
Conclusion: 该数据集有助于推动多类别杂草检测的监督和半监督学习研究，并已在Zenodo公开。

papers.title: RECAP: Regression Evaluation for Continual Adaptation of Prompts
papers.abstract_en: Production agentic systems routinely face evolving constraints and must comply from the very next interaction. Scenarios like a tool-call notification changing a compliance threshold or a policy update adding disclosure requirements fit this criteria, having close to no room for errors in production. This proactive adaptation setting is common in deployment, but absent from current benchmarks, which assume either static constraint sets or reactive protocols with evaluation feedback. We introduce RECAP, a benchmark that measures continual-learning phenomena (forgetting, regression, forward transfer) at the constraint level under a strictly proactive adapt-then-test protocol: prompt optimization methods receive only the constraint specification and must generalize before seeing any test data. Evaluating six methods across four LLMs and three schedules with evolving constraints, we find that these methods show no significant improvement in performance, even after incurring a higher latency. These methods, designed for offline or reactive settings, are inadequate for the proactive paradigm. Our work emphasizes the growing need for designing proactive prompt adaptation methods, where the models must remain robust to evolving needs in deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RECAP基准，用于评估在严格主动适应协议下提示优化方法的持续学习能力（遗忘、回归、前向迁移）。在四种LLM和三种演化约束调度上测试六种方法，发现它们没有显著性能提升，甚至以更高延迟为代价。现有方法不适合主动适应场景。
Motivation: 生产环境中的智能体系统经常面临演化的约束，需要从下一次交互开始立即遵守，但现有基准仅假设静态约束或反应式协议，缺乏对主动适应设置的评估。
Method: 构建RECAP基准，采用主动适应-然后测试协议：提示优化方法仅接收约束规范，必须在看到任何测试数据之前泛化。评估六种方法在四种LLM和三种约束演化调度上的表现。
Result: 六种方法在性能上没有显著提升，甚至引入了更高延迟，表明现有为离线或反应式设置设计的方法在主动适应范式下不足。
Conclusion: 强调需要设计主动提示适应方法，使模型在部署中对演化需求保持鲁棒。

papers.title: MMBU: A Massive Multi-modal Biomedical Understanding Benchmark to Probe the Perception Capabilities of Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision and language models (VLMs) hold immense promise to transform biomedical imaging workflows, from detecting lesions in chest X-rays to profiling cellular features in microscopy. Realizing this potential, however, requires robust and fine-grained visual perception. Models need to correctly interpret subtle features in images, and they must do so across diverse biomedical modalities, scales, and contexts. Nevertheless, current benchmarks remain limited. To address these gaps, we introduce the Massive Multimodal Biomedical Understanding (MMBU) benchmark. It is the largest biomedical vision and language benchmark to date, covering 35 submodalities with rich structured metadata. It includes both open and closed versions of ungrounded classification, grounded classification, and object detection, enabling systematic evaluation of model performance across biological scales, clinical settings, and imaging modalities. Evaluating 15 open-weight and 2 frontier VLMs, we find that while medical adaptation provides measurable gains for some models, the high accuracy often reported on established benchmarks can mask deficiencies in visual perception and domain generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了MMBU（大规模多模态生物医学理解基准），这是目前最大的生物医学视觉语言基准，涵盖35个子模态，包括未接地分类、接地分类和物体检测的开放与封闭版本。通过评估15个开源和2个前沿视觉语言模型，发现虽然医学适应性带来了一定收益，但模型在现有基准上的高准确率可能掩盖了其在视觉感知和领域泛化方面的不足。
Motivation: 当前生物医学领域的视觉语言模型基准有限，无法充分评估模型在多样模态、尺度和上下文中的细粒度视觉感知能力，因此需要更全面和系统的基准。
Method: 构建MMBU基准，覆盖35个生物医学子模态，提供丰富的结构化元数据，并设计未接地分类、接地分类和物体检测三种任务类型的开放与封闭版本，以系统评估模型的感知和泛化能力。
Result: 对15个开源和2个前沿视觉语言模型的评估表明，医学适应性训练在一定程度上提升了性能，但模型在现有基准上的高准确率可能掩盖了其在视觉感知和领域泛化上的缺陷。
Conclusion: MMBU基准揭示了现有视觉语言模型在生物医学应用中视觉感知和领域泛化的不足，为未来模型改进提供了评估工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: S23DR 2026 Winning Solution
papers.abstract_en: This text presents the winning solution to the S23DR 2026 challenge for structured 3D wireframe reconstruction from sparse SfM, fitted depth, and semantic segmentations. The method treats vertices as a conditional set and denoises 64 vertex tokens with a flow-matching DiT conditioned on Perceiver-style scene tokens. A global pass predicts the coarse structure, a hull-cropped second pass refines it, and a small multi-sample consensus step keeps the stochastic sampler well behaved. The final system ranked first on the private leaderboard, achievingHSS = 0.654.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了S23DR 2026挑战赛的获胜方案，用于从稀疏SfM、拟合深度和语义分割中进行结构化3D线框重建。方法将顶点视为条件集，使用流匹配DiT对64个顶点标记去噪，并通过全局粗预测、船体裁剪的细化传递以及小多样本共识步骤完成。在私人排行榜上达到HSS=0.654，排名第一。
Motivation: 针对稀疏SfM和语义分割条件下的结构化3D线框重建挑战，现有方法在精度和鲁棒性上不足。
Method: 将顶点作为条件集，采用流匹配DiT，以Perceiver风格场景标记为条件，对64个顶点标记进行去噪。先进行全局传递预测粗结构，再通过船体裁剪的第二传递细化，并辅以小多样本共识步骤稳定采样。
Result: 在S23DR 2026挑战赛私人排行榜上排名第一，定性指标HSS达到0.654。
Conclusion: 该方案通过双阶段处理和共识步骤有效提升了结构化3D线框重建的质量，但在泛化性和计算效率上仍需进一步验证。

papers.title: The Geography of Algorithmic Judgment: LLM Intermediaries, Place Identity, and Racial Steering in Housing Search
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly assuming an intermediary role in housing search through the integration of listing platforms within conversational interfaces, mediating access to information, search, and recommendations within urban settings. We expand on prior work on racial steering in LLMs by conducting a behavioral audit of seven open-weight and closed-source LLMs across four U.S. cities, testing location recommendations across three iterative prompting conditions that progressively add lifestyle preference context and reflect fair housing paired-testing methodologies. We find that steering is an emergent behavior of the model's interpretive license rather than primarily a static property. Steering results from the interaction of a user's identity, preference articulation, and the spatial logic that a model has internalized about learned representations of place, preference, and opportunity in a given city, and how different types of users relate to it. While steering was present, it was not uniform in direction or magnitude across evaluated conditions. Preference-conditioned testing often increased or reconfigured the number of models that exhibited steering behaviors relative to baseline conditions, suggesting that LLMs may interpret what the same housing preference means differently depending on the racial identity of the user. Our findings also demonstrate that the city is not a neutral testing unit for LLM evaluation in place-based sectors, and results from one local market cannot be assumed to generalize to another. Local and domain expertise will be required in the housing sector to ensure that legal and institutional commitments to fair housing are not undermined while adopting AI tools that mediate spatial access.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对七种开源和闭源大语言模型（LLM）在四个美国城市的住房搜索推荐中进行了行为审计，发现种族导向（racial steering）是模型解释用户身份和偏好时涌现的行为，而非静态属性。偏好条件测试增加了表现出导向行为的模型数量，且结果在不同城市间不可泛化。
Motivation: LLM正作为住房搜索的中介，可能通过推荐系统传播种族歧视，但现有研究未充分理解导向行为的机制及其与用户身份和偏好的交互。
Method: 采用公平住房配对测试方法，对七种LLM在四个城市进行行为审计，通过三种迭代提示条件逐步增加生活方式偏好背景，测试位置推荐。
Result: 导向行为并非均匀存在，其方向和幅度因条件而异；偏好条件测试常增加或重新配置表现出导向行为的模型数量；不同城市的结果不可泛化。
Conclusion: LLM在住房领域的中介作用可能削弱公平住房的法律承诺，需要本地和领域专业知识来确保AI工具的采用不损害公平住房。

papers.title: RPC-GS: Gaussian Splatting with native RPC Rendering for Satellite Imagery
papers.abstract_en: We present RPC-GS, the first Gaussian Splatting framework for satellite imagery that operates natively with Rational Polynomial Camera (RPC) models. The RPC model is the de facto standard for representing the complex imaging geometry of modern pushbroom satellite sensors. To simplify rendering, prior satellite Gaussian Splatting methods replace the RPC model with perspective or affine camera approximations, leading to geometric errors during reconstruction. RPC-GS avoids these approximations by projecting Gaussian means and covariances directly through the RPC model during the splatting process. We embed the RPC model in a chain of carefully selected geo-coordinate transformations representing a mapping from splatting-suitable scene coordinates to image coordinates. To map the Gaussian covariance matrices, we derive a numerically robust Jacobian-based covariance projection for the (partially nonlinear) coordinate transformations. Since RPCs lack an explicit notion of camera depth, we integrate a metric ray-based depth formulation. We benchmark RPC, perspective, and affine camera models in a unified framework, with our native RPC renderer consistently achieving the lowest reconstruction error on leading satellite benchmark datasets, improving mean altitude error over perspective and affine approximations by 29.6% and 63.8% on DFC2019, and by 9.9% and 37.9% on IARPA2016. We release our code to support future research of Gaussian Splatting in the satellite imaging domain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RPC-GS，首个原生支持有理多项式相机（RPC）模型的卫星影像高斯溅射（Gaussian Splatting）框架。通过直接投影高斯均值和协方差，避免了以往方法使用透视或仿射近似带来的几何误差，并推导了雅可比协方差投影。在DFC2019和IARPA2016卫星基准数据集上，相比透视和仿射近似，平均高度误差分别降低29.6%/63.8%和9.9%/37.9%。
Motivation: 现有卫星高斯溅射方法用透视或仿射相机近似代替RPC模型，导致重建几何误差。RPC模型是推扫式卫星传感器的标准模型，需要原生支持以提高精度。
Method: 在溅射过程中直接通过RPC模型投影高斯均值和协方差，嵌入地理坐标变换链，并推导数值鲁棒的雅可比协方差投影。针对RPC缺乏显式深度，集成度量射线深度公式。
Result: 在DFC2019上，相比透视和仿射近似，平均高度误差降低29.6%和63.8%；在IARPA2016上降低9.9%和37.9%。
Conclusion: RPC-GS避免了近似误差，实现了更准确的卫星影像重建，代码已开源。

papers.title: Towards Serverless Semi-Decentralized Federated Learning with Heterogeneous Optimizers
papers.abstract_en: We investigate cluster formation, involving the number and composition of clusters, in decentralized federated learning (FL) with heterogeneous machine learning (ML) optimizers. While clustering in centralized FL has enabled scalability and resource savings, its value and development in fully decentralized environments have yet to be explored. Optimizing cluster formation in such environments is challenging, especially due to the complex coupling between network graph structures, local data heterogeneity, and different local ML model optimizers. To address these challenges, we propose serverless semi-decentralized FL (SSD-FL), a methodology requiring no persistent server infrastructure. In SSD-FL, cluster formation occurs via a lightweight, one-time device-to-device (D2D) initialization phase, after which actual ML model training (alongside consensus and convergence processes) is fully serverless. Functionally, SSD-FL segments global rounds into intra-cluster and inter-cluster regimes, ensuring global convergence and consensus through novel "effective loss functions" that integrate device-specific ML optimizers with network graph-based regularization. Next, SSD-FL leverages the consensus gap via the Cheeger inequality to develop an iterative clustering algorithm evaluated against our derived convergence and consensus bounds, which incorporate a unique scoring metric to quantify data and optimizer heterogeneity across devices. Finally, experimental evaluation against three categories of decentralized FL methodologies validate that SSD-FL improves both convergence speeds and communication efficiency across various network graphs, datasets, and local optimizer regimes.

papers.title: RigPAPR: Rig-Based Animation of Static Neural Point Clouds from a Fixed-Viewpoint Video
papers.abstract_en: Static neural point reconstructions capture a subject at high fidelity from posed images. Given such a reconstruction, we aim to animate it to follow a monocular fixed-viewpoint driving video of the subject, whether captured or produced by image-to-video (I2V) generation, and to recover a rigged, re-posable 3D asset. Existing methods deform Gaussian splats through direct linear blend skinning (LBS) or mesh proxies, both of which are prone to joint-boundary artifacts under articulation, even with per-primitive corrections. We trace the artifact to the representation: each splat carries an individual shape calibrated in the canonical pose to tile with its neighbours. Under rigid LBS, each splat moves with its bone but cannot bend, so the canonical tiling breaks at joint boundaries into gaps and spikes. Proximity attention point rendering (PAPR) instead carries no per-primitive shape; each pixel is recomposed at render time from the deformed primitives' positions, so the surface re-forms naturally with the articulation. We present RigPAPR, which auto-rigs a static PAPR cloud and drives it under direct LBS from a single fixed-viewpoint video, without mesh proxy, pose-dependent correction, or category template. On synthetic subjects, RigPAPR matches the strongest baseline at the supervised view and exceeds mesh-based and Gaussian-splatting baselines at novel views by 3+dB PSNR, with cleaner joint-boundary renderings of both synthetic and real subjects.
papers.comment: An overview video is available at https://youtu.be/up3BwRHYWG8
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出RigPAPR方法，利用固定视角视频驱动静态神经点云（PAPR）动画，无需网格代理或类别模板。通过直接线性混合蒙皮（LBS）和PAPR的逐像素重组合成，避免关节处伪影，在合成数据上监督视角匹配最优基线，新视角PSNR提升3+dB，并展示更干净的关节渲染。
Motivation: 现有高斯溅射或网格代理方法在关节处产生间隙和尖刺伪影，原因是每个图元在规范姿态下校准形状后无法弯曲。PAPR无逐图元形状，可通过变形后位置逐像素重组自然形成表面，本文旨在利用该特性实现自动绑定和动画。
Method: 自动对静态PAPR点云进行骨架绑定，然后使用直接LBS从单目固定视角视频驱动，无需网格代理、姿态相关修正或类别模板。
Result: 在合成数据上，RigPAPR在监督视角下与最强基线相当，在新视角下PSNR比网格和高斯基线高3+dB，对合成和真实数据均获得更干净的关节边界渲染。
Conclusion: 摘要表明PAPR表示结合直接LBS可以避免关节伪影，实现高质量的动画，无需额外修正或模板。

papers.title: Adaptive Band Selection for Hyperspectral Classification with Spatially Disjoint Evaluation
authors: Alejandro Mousist (2) ((1) International University of Rabat
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral band selection methods based on differentiable selectors can be sensitive to initialization and to extracting a final discrete subset, while prescribed band counts limit flexibility. We propose SGBR-HC (Spectral-Group Band Ranking with Hard-Concrete initialization), a two-stage method that uses a supervised spectral ranking to initialize trainable sparse gates rather than treating ranking as a fixed selection rule, letting the number of selected bands be determined by training. Stage-1 scores candidate bands from training pixels by class discriminability and spectral diversity; this ranking seeds the gate logits for Stage-2, which trains the sparse gates jointly with a spatial classifier. Under spatially disjoint evaluation on Pavia University and Houston 2013, verified by retraining a fresh classifier on the selected bands, SGBR-HC achieves the highest mean overall accuracy and Cohen's kappa with approximately twenty bands. Bypassing Stage-1 degrades OA by 8.84 pp on Pavia University and 22.15 pp on Houston 2013, confirming the ranking prior's role. Random pixel splits inflate OA on Pavia University by 30.56 pp, underscoring spatial leakage as a critical evaluation confound.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高光谱分类中基于可微选择器的波段选择方法对初始化敏感且预设波段数缺乏灵活性的问题，提出SGBR-HC（Spectral-Group Band Ranking with Hard-Concrete initialization）。该方法分为两阶段：第一阶段利用监督光谱排序初始化可训练稀疏门，第二阶段联合训练稀疏门与空间分类器，使所选波段数由训练自适应决定。在Pavia University和Houston 2013数据集上采用空间分离评估，以约20个波段取得最高平均总体精度和Cohen's Kappa。消融实验表明去除第一阶段导致OA分别下降8.84和22.15个百分点，而随机像素分割使OA虚高30.56个百分点，凸显了空间泄漏作为评估混淆因子的关键性。
Motivation: 现有可微高光谱波段选择方法对初始化和离散子集提取敏感，且预设波段数缺乏灵活性；随机像素分割导致的评估泄漏使结果不可靠。
Method: 提出SGBR-HC两阶段方法：Stage-1通过训练像素的类别可区分性和光谱多样性对候选波段排序，以此初始化Stage-2的门logits；Stage-2结合空间分类器联合训练硬混凝土稀疏门（hard-concrete gates），自动确定波段数量。
Result: 在空间分离评估下，SGBR-HC以约20个波段在Pavia University和Houston 2013上取得最高平均总体精度和Cohen's Kappa；去除Stage-1导致OA分别下降8.84和22.15个百分点；随机像素分割使OA虚高30.56个百分点。
Conclusion: 基于光谱排序的初始化先验和空间分离评估对高光谱波段选择至关重要，随机像素分割会引入严重的评估偏差。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Imputation with Graph-Informed Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Missing data is a common challenge in spatiotemporal systems, arising in applications such as air quality monitoring and urban traffic management. Traditional machine learning approaches, like recurrent and graph neural networks, rely on iterative propagation, which tends to accumulate errors over time and space. Recent diffusion-based methods mitigate error propagation but require iterative sampling and often depend on problem-agnostic Gaussian priors, limiting both efficiency and effectiveness. To address these limitations, we propose GiFlow, a Graph-Informed Flow Matching framework for spatiotemporal imputation. GiFlow replaces the typical Gaussian prior with a graph-informed prior constructed via spatiotemporal filtering of observable signals, which better aligns the source distribution to the target and thereby simplifies the generation trajectory. The flow field is parameterized by a hybrid vector field model that integrates spatial attention, temporal attention, and spatiotemporal propagation, enabling joint modeling of spatial and temporal dependencies. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed GiFlow outperforms the state-of-the-art approaches in spatiotemporal imputation. The code is available at https://github.com/zepengzhang/GiFlow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GiFlow，一种基于图信息流匹配的时空插补框架，通过图信息先验替代高斯先验简化生成轨迹，并用混合向量场模型联合建模时空依赖。实验表明在合成和真实数据集上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有时空插补方法（如循环和图神经网络）依赖迭代传播，易累积误差；扩散方法需迭代采样且依赖问题无关的高斯先验，效率与效果受限。
Method: 提出GiFlow，使用通过时空滤波构建的图信息先验替代高斯先验，简化生成轨迹；流场由混合向量场模型参数化，集成空间注意力、时间注意力和时空传播。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上的大量实验表明，GiFlow在时空插补任务上优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: GiFlow通过图信息先验和混合向量场模型提升了时空插补的性能，代码已开源。

papers.title: HKJudge: A Legal Discourse-Annotated Corpus for Interpreting What Courts Find, How They Reason, and What They Rule
papers.abstract_en: Court judgments are central to legal practice and jurisprudence, yet discourse analysis of Hong Kong judgments has received limited attention, owing largely to the absence of expert-annotated corpora. We introduce the Hong Kong Judgment Discourse Dataset (HKJudge), the first sentence-level expert-annotated legal discourse corpus. HKJudge includes criminal judgments across all five levels of HK's court hierarchy, comprising $\sim$290k sentences and $\sim$6.5 million tokens, fully annotated by legal linguistics experts. We design a two-tier discourse schema that captures what facts a court finds, how it reasons, and what it rules. At the sentence level, each sentence is assigned one of 26 rhetorical roles. At the span level, sentences are further annotated with three sentencing elements (charge, imprisonment term, fine). Ten legal linguistics annotators produced the annotations with an inter-annotator agreement of $κ= 0.8$. We formulate two tasks on HKJudge, termed rhetorical role classification and legal element extraction, and provide the first benchmark evaluation of four BERT-based models, two open-source LLMs under zero-shot and fine-tuning settings, and four commercial LLMs on both tasks. Our work demonstrates the value of sentence-level discourse annotation for modeling the structure of HK judgments and provides a rich data foundation for future work on legal judgment prediction. The HKJudge dataset and code are available at https://github.com/xuanxixi/HKJudge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍HKJudge，首个句子级专家标注的法律话语语料库，包含香港各级法院的刑事判决书，约29万句、650万词。语料库采用双层话语标注模式：句子级标注26种修辞角色，跨度级标注三项量刑要素。基于该语料，作者评估了多种BERT模型和LLM在修辞角色分类与法律要素提取任务上的表现。
Motivation: 香港判决书的语篇分析因缺乏专家标注语料而受到限制，现有资源不足以支撑深入的话语结构研究。
Method: 构建HKJudge语料库，由10位法律语言学专家标注，采用双层标注体系：句子级26种修辞角色和跨度级量刑要素（指控、监禁期限、罚款）。基于该语料，设计修辞角色分类和法律要素提取两个任务，并评估BERT、开源LLM和商业LLM的性能。
Result: 语料标注达到Kappa=0.8的较高一致率；基准测试显示不同模型在两项任务上的表现，为后续研究提供参考。
Conclusion: 句子级话语标注对于建模香港判决书结构具有价值，该语料库为法律判决预测等未来工作提供了丰富的数据基础。

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware LLM-Guided Policy Shaping for Sparse-Reward Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Sparse rewards and heterogeneous task sequences remain persistent challenges in Reinforcement Learning (RL), often resulting in slow convergence, weak generalization, and inefficient exploration. We propose Uncertainty-Aware LLM-Guided Policy Shaping (ULPS), a novel framework that integrates a calibrated Large Language Model (LLM) into the RL training loop to provide structured, uncertainty-modulated behavioral guidance. ULPS employs an A*-based oracle to synthesize optimal symbolic trajectories, which are used to fine-tune a BERT-based language model. During training, this model supplies action suggestions whose influence is conditioned on epistemic uncertainty estimated via Monte Carlo (MC) dropout. An entropy-based blending mechanism adaptively balances LLM guidance and the learned policy (via Proximal Policy Optimization, PPO), allowing the agent to prioritize reliable priors while preserving adaptability. We evaluate ULPS on the MiniGridUnlockPickup benchmark and observe consistent improvements in success rate, reward efficiency, and sample complexity over unguided, uncalibrated, and standard RL baselines. ULPS achieves more than 9% improvement in execution accuracy after fine-tuning, requires fewer environment interactions, and yields higher reward AUC. Our results demonstrate that integrating symbolic A* trajectories, pretrained language priors, and uncertainty-aware control offers a principled and effective approach to multi-task reinforcement learning in sparse-reward domains, with potential extensibility to partially observable and multi-agent settings.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IEEE CAI). 6 pages, 3 figures. Code available at: https://github.com/USD-AI-ResearchLab/uncertainty-aware-llm-rl
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出不确定性感知的LLM引导策略塑形(ULPS)框架，用于解决稀疏奖励强化学习中的收敛慢和探索效率低问题。该方法利用A* oracle合成最优符号轨迹微调BERT模型，在训练中通过MC dropout估计认知不确定性，基于熵的混合机制自适应平衡LLM引导和PPO学习策略。在MiniGridUnlockPickup基准上，ULPS在成功率、奖励效率和样本复杂度上均优于未引导、未校准和标准RL基线。
Motivation: 稀疏奖励和异构任务序列导致RL收敛慢、泛化弱、探索低效，现有方法缺乏结构化、不确定性调制的引导。

papers.title: JA-SIREN: Deterministic Initialization for Sinusoidal Networks via Spectral Matching
papers.abstract_en: Existing implicit neural representation (INR) approaches suffer from stochastic initialization that does not guarantee consistent or high-quality performance across runs, with variations reaching more than 2.5 dB (78%) in image regression. This variation is problematic for scientific computing and simulation, where result reproducibility is crucial. To address this problem, we present Jacobi-Anger Sinusoidal Representation Network (JA-SIREN), a deterministic initialization scheme for sinusoidal networks grounded in classical spectral analysis. By computing the Discrete Sine Transform (DST) of the target signal and leveraging the Jacobi-Anger expansion, we derive closed-form weights for a two-layer sinusoidal MLP that analytically match the network's initial spectral response to the target signal, requiring no random seed or additional hyperparameter tuning. On the Kodak dataset, JA-SIREN achieves a mean PSNR of 67.18 dB, a 21.30 dB improvement over the best baseline. This is achieved with zero run-to-run variance, confirming that spectrally-informed initialization is a more effective and reproducible alternative to stochastic initialization for sinusoidal INRs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对正弦网络（sinusoidal networks）随机初始化导致性能不稳定（图像回归PSNR变化>2.5 dB）的问题，提出JA-SIREN确定性初始化方案。通过离散正弦变换（DST）与Jacobi-Anger展开，为两层正弦MLP导出闭式权重，使网络初始谱响应与目标信号匹配。在Kodak数据集上，PSNR达67.18 dB，比最佳基线提升21.30 dB，且方差为零。
Motivation: 现有隐式神经表示（INR）方法依赖随机初始化，导致多次运行结果不一致，在科学计算与仿真中缺乏可重复性，图像回归PSNR波动可达78%。
Method: 提出Jacobi-Anger正弦表示网络（JA-SIREN），基于经典谱分析：计算目标信号的离散正弦变换（DST），利用Jacobi-Anger展开推导两层正弦MLP的闭式初始权重，无需随机种子或超参数调优。
Result: 在Kodak数据集上，JA-SIREN平均PSNR为67.18 dB，较最佳基线提升21.30 dB，且所有运行结果完全一致（零方差）。
Conclusion: 谱信息初始化是正弦INR中随机初始化的更有效、可重现替代方案，尤其适用于需结果一致性的科学计算场景。

papers.title: Architecture-Adaptive Uncertainty Fusion for Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: Deepfake detection systems achieve near-perfect accuracy on benchmarks, yet forensic deployment demands reliable prediction uncertainty. Existing uncertainty quantification (UQ) methods rely on single sources and ignore that optimal uncertainty composition varies across architectures. We propose Correlation-Optimized Fusion (COF), an architecture-adaptive framework that fuses five complementary uncertainty sources -- epistemic, aleatoric, calibration, conformal, and distributional -- by maximizing Pearson correlation between fused uncertainty scores and prediction errors via constrained optimization on the probability simplex. COF requires no model modifications and only 42 s of weight optimization, compared to 20--45 h for a 5-model Deep Ensemble. Evaluation across eleven architectures on FaceForensics++ reveals a fundamental trade-off: under matched train/evaluation protocol, non-linear methods achieve approximately 5--6% higher in-domain correlation than COF (mean r = 0.438), but this reverses under distribution shift. On CelebDF, COF outperforms Random Forest in 9/11 architectures with up to 7.3x higher correlation (MaxViT-B: r = 0.249 vs. 0.034); RF degrades 85% cross-domain to r = 0.071, whereas COF retains substantially more signal (74% drop to r = 0.116). Cross-dataset evaluation on CelebDF and DFDC reveals catastrophic generalization failure across all methods: in-domain correlations of 0.41--0.47 collapse to near-zero externally (mean degradation 90.7%), with seven of eleven architectures exhibiting uncertainty inversion. These results establish COF as a practical, interpretable framework for controlled-distribution deployment and identify domain-adaptive UQ as the central open challenge for forensic deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Correlation-Optimized Fusion (COF)，一种架构自适应的不确定性融合框架，用于深度伪造检测。COF通过最大化融合不确定性分数与预测错误之间的皮尔逊相关性，在概率单纯形上约束优化，融合五种互补的不确定性来源。实验表明，在分布匹配设置下非线性方法更好，但在分布偏移下COF表现更优，同时揭示了跨数据集泛化失败的问题。
Motivation: 现有不确定性量化方法依赖单一来源，且忽略最优不确定性组合随架构变化；实际法医部署需要可靠的不确定性估计。
Method: 提出COF框架，通过约束优化（最大化皮尔逊相关）在概率单纯形上融合五种不确定性来源（epistemic, aleatoric, calibration, conformal, distributional），无需修改模型，权重优化仅需42秒。
Result: 在FaceForensics++上，分布匹配下非线性方法比COF高5-6%相关性，但分布偏移下COF优于随机森林（在9/11架构上，最高7.3x相关）。跨数据集评估显示所有方法在域外相关性崩溃至近乎零（平均退化90.7%）。
Conclusion: COF为受控分布部署提供了实用可解释框架，并指出域自适应UQ是法医部署的核心挑战。

papers.title: Inside the Visual Mind: Neuroscience-Motivated Concept Circuits for Interpreting and Steering Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Despite high accuracy, Vision Transformer (ViT) predictions can be driven by spurious cues, raising the need to understand their inner workings before safe deployment. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) provide a promising lens for decomposing model representations into human-interpretable concepts, yet adapting SAE-based interpretation to ViTs remains challenging due to limited control over concept coverage and subjective, non-scalable feature interpretation. To fill the gaps, motivated by neuroscience-inspired principles, we propose ViSAE, a mechanistic interpretability toolbox for understanding ViT inner workings through concept circuits. ViSAE consists of three components: (1) A probing suite with 64K images and a 16K visually grounded concept vocabulary, improving concept coverage efficiency by 20x over ImageNet and interpretation accuracy by 28.7% over existing concept sets. (2) Top-down concept reading and Bottom-up circuit tracing algorithms that automatically recover ViT inner workings via concept circuits. (3) Applications for auditing and steering ViT behavior. Through concept editing, ViSAE improves the worst-group accuracy on WaterBirds by 48.2%, outperforming existing methods by 23.8%. Our data and code: https://github.com/deep-real/ViSAE.
papers.comment: In Proceedings of the International Conference on Machine Learning, 2026. (acceptance rate 26.6%)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文受神经科学原理启发，提出 ViSAE，一个用于理解 Vision Transformer (ViT) 内部机制的可解释性工具箱。通过构建包含 64K 图像和 16K 视觉概念的概念词典，以及自上而下的概念读取和自下而上的电路追踪算法，ViSAE 能够自动恢复 ViT 的概念电路，并通过概念编辑显著提升模型在分布外数据上的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 在解释 ViT 时面临概念覆盖有限、特征解释主观且不可扩展的问题。
Method: ViSAE 包含三个组件：1) 含 64K 图像和 16K 视觉概念的概念词典，提升概念覆盖效率和解释准确性；2) 自上而下的概念读取和自下而上的电路追踪算法；3) 用于审计和引导 ViT 行为的应用。
Result: 在 WaterBirds 数据集上，通过概念编辑将最差组准确率提升 48.2%，优于现有方法 23.8%。
Conclusion: ViSAE 提供了一套自动化的 ViT 概念电路解释与编辑框架，有助于理解模型内部机制并提升鲁棒性。

papers.title: Explainable Runtime Dependency Tracking for AI-RAN Conflict Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Future AI-integrated Radio Access Networks (AI-RAN) will combine open programmability with learning-enabled xApps, rApps, and control functions that act on shared parameters and key performance indicators (KPIs). For conflict monitoring, it is not enough to know which applications are deployed; the system must also know whether the parameter--KPI dependencies assumed by runtime diagnosis remain valid under the current operating regime. This paper studies a lightweight monitoring primitive for that purpose: tracking an interpretable dependency representation from streaming telemetry events. We represent active dependencies by a Boolean matrix and use Boolean matrix multiplication to check whether recent parameter-activity and KPI-response events are consistent with the current estimate. We propose a sliding-window inference procedure that reuses the estimate when it remains consistent and recomputes it when recent observations indicate structural change. The tracker is intended as an explainable signal for conflict diagnosis and slow-loop model refresh, not as an autonomous mitigation mechanism. Experiments on controlled Boolean event streams show efficient and accurate tracking under dependency changes and Boolean observation noise.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对AI-RAN中运行时依赖关系监控问题，本文提出一种轻量级可解释的跟踪方法。该方法用布尔矩阵表示活动依赖，并通过布尔矩阵乘法检验参数活动与KPI响应事件的一致性。采用滑动窗口推断，在一致时复用估计，不一致时重新计算。实验表明在依赖变化和布尔观测噪声下能高效准确跟踪。
Motivation: 未来AI-RAN中多个学习型应用共享参数和KPI，现有系统仅知道哪些应用部署，但无法判断运行时诊断所假设的参数-KPI依赖在当前运行状态下是否仍然有效。
Method: 提出基于布尔矩阵的依赖表示和滑动窗口推断过程：用布尔矩阵表示活跃依赖，通过布尔矩阵乘法检查最近事件与当前估计的一致性；若一致则复用估计，否则重新计算。
Result: 在受控布尔事件流上的实验表明，该方法能在依赖变化和布尔观测噪声下实现高效准确的跟踪。
Conclusion: 该方法旨在为冲突诊断和慢循环模型刷新提供可解释的信号，而非自主缓解机制。

papers.title: AEGIS: A Backup Reflex for Physical AI
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon robot manipulation tends to fail gradually: one bad step degrades the state, and the policy spirals into a basin from which it cannot recover. The failure is often visible before it happens. We introduce AEGIS (Activation-probe Early-warning, Gated Inference Switching), a selective escalation method that uses a lightweight probe on a weak policy's frozen activations to detect high-risk steps while there is still time to act. When the probe flags a step, control switches to a stronger separate policy, but only for the steps that need it. On LIBERO-Spatial, AEGIS recovers 10.1% of the trajectories the weak policy alone loses, versus 4.6% for budget-matched blind escalation and 5.1% for a random-trigger placebo. These gains are significant under one-sided exact paired McNemar tests with Holm-Bonferroni adjustment over three pre-registered contrasts: +5.4pp over blind escalation, p=8.5e-6; +5.0pp over random triggering, p=1.0e-4; paired-trajectory bootstrap CIs exclude zero. AEGIS activates the stronger policy on only 38% of steps, so the lever is timing rather than compute. The probe clears its precondition with an early-window AUROC of 0.764, 95% CI [0.70, 0.84], read from the weak-policy path over the first 30% of trajectory steps before any handoff. We pre-register the full analysis plan, including a conditional recovered-task-rate estimand and explicit kill criteria, and confirm the result on 700 common-random-number episodes per arm, with nA-fail=646.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AEGIS（Activation-probe Early-warning, Gated Inference Switching），一种针对长期机器人操作中渐进式故障的轻量级应急方法。通过在弱策略的冻结激活上设置探测门，在检测到高风险步骤时临时切换至更强策略，仅需在 38% 的步骤中调用强策略。在 LIBERO-Spatial 基准上，AEGIS 恢复了弱策略丢失轨迹中的 10.1%，显著优于预算匹配的盲目切换（4.6%）和随机触发（5.1%），且经过 Holm-Bonferroni 校正的 McNemar 检验确认显著。探测器的早窗 AUROC 为 0.764，表明在轨迹前 30% 即可识别风险。全文分析计划已预注册。
Motivation: 长期机器人操作中，一个不良步骤会逐渐恶化状态，导致策略无法恢复，而失败在发生前往往已可察觉。现有方法缺乏在早期识别并干预高风险步骤的轻量级机制。
Method: 提出 AEGIS，在弱策略的冻结激活上训练一个轻量级探测门（probe），当探测到高风险步骤时，将控制切换至更强的独立策略（仅针对该步骤）。探测门使用弱策略路径在前 30% 轨迹步骤上的激活进行早期预警。
Result: 在 LIBERO-Spatial 上，AEGIS 恢复弱策略丢失轨迹的 10.1%，优于 budget-matched 盲目切换（4.6%）和随机触发（5.1%）。McNemar 检验（Holm-Bonferroni 校正）显示：相比盲目切换 +5.4pp (p=8.5e-6)，相比随机触发 +5.0pp (p=1.0e-4)。探测器的早窗 AUROC 为 0.764，95% CI [0.70, 0.84]。共 700 个常见随机数每臂的测试，nA-fail=646。
Conclusion: AEGIS 证明通过 timing 而非额外计算资源即可有效恢复弱策略的失败轨迹，且预注册分析计划增强了结果的可信度。该方法适用于物理 AI 中的长期任务，但仅在 LIBERO-Spatial 单一环境验证，泛化性需进一步探索。

summary_sections.motivation: 长期机器人操作中，一个不良步骤会逐渐恶化状态，导致策略无法恢复，而失败在发生前往往已可察觉。现有方法缺乏在早期识别并干预高风险步骤的轻量级机制。
summary_sections.method: 提出 AEGIS，在弱策略的冻结激活上训练一个轻量级探测门（probe），当探测到高风险步骤时，将控制切换至更强的独立策略（仅针对该步骤）。探测门使用弱策略路径在前 30% 轨迹步骤上的激活进行早期预警。
summary_sections.result: 在 LIBERO-Spatial 上，AEGIS 恢复弱策略丢失轨迹的 10.1%，优于 budget-matched 盲目切换（4.6%）和随机触发（5.1%）。McNemar 检验（Holm-Bonferroni 校正）显示：相比盲目切换 +5.4pp (p=8.5e-6)，相比随机触发 +5.0pp (p=1.0e-4)。探测器的早窗 AUROC 为 0.764，95% CI [0.70, 0.84]。共 700 个常见随机数每臂的测试，nA-fail=646。
summary_sections.conclusion: AEGIS 证明通过 timing 而非额外计算资源即可有效恢复弱策略的失败轨迹，且预注册分析计划增强了结果的可信度。该方法适用于物理 AI 中的长期任务，但仅在 LIBERO-Spatial 单一环境验证，泛化性需进一步探索。

papers.title: Capturing non-Markovian dynamics in non-equilibrium stochastic systems using flow matching
papers.abstract_en: Hydrodynamic models of stochastic particle systems represented by coarse-grained stochastic partial differential equations (SPDE), such as the regularized Dean-Kawasaki (DK) equation, do not accurately capture the short-time system dynamics that is dominated by non-Markovian effects, and low particle density regimes where the distributions are highly non-Gaussian. We develop a generative flow matching method that directly models the probability distribution of fluxes from particle simulations that explicitly incorporates non-Markovian and non-Gaussian effects. As a demonstration, we use this method to simulate the Kramers first passage time problem for a system of non-interacting Brownian particles. We show the model accurately captures the short-time behavior and provides better predictions of the statistical moments of the number density when compared against the solution of the Markovian baseline, regularized DK equation.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, Accepted to 2026 Conference on Physics and AI (PAI26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对粗粒度随机偏微分方程（如正则化Dean-Kawasaki方程）无法准确捕捉短时间非马尔可夫效应和低密度非高斯分布的问题，提出了一种基于生成流匹配的方法，直接从粒子模拟中建模通量的概率分布。在非相互作用布朗粒子的Kramers首次通过时间问题中，该方法相比马尔可夫基线（正则化DK方程）更好地捕捉了短时间行为并提高了数密度统计矩的预测。
Motivation: 现有粗粒度随机偏微分方程（如正则化Dean-Kawasaki方程）无法准确描述短时间内的非马尔可夫动力学和低粒子密度下的非高斯分布，需要更精确的建模方法。
Method: 提出生成流匹配（flow matching）方法，直接从粒子模拟中学习通量的概率分布，显式纳入非马尔可夫和非高斯效应。
Result: 在非相互作用布朗粒子的Kramers首次通过时间问题中，模型准确捕捉短时间行为，并在数密度统计矩预测上优于马尔可夫基线（正则化DK方程）。
Conclusion: 生成流匹配能有效建模非马尔可夫和非高斯动力学，为随机粒子系统的粗粒度建模提供更准确的替代方案。

papers.title: A Study of Parallel Continuous Local Search
papers.abstract_en: We study parallel Continuous Local Search (CLS) as a solution approach for Boolean satisfiability problems with symmetric pseudo-Boolean (PB) constraints. Here, the $n$-variable PB-satisfiability problem is relaxed to a continuous optimisation problem with a differentiable objective function on an $n$-dimensional hypercube. For satisfiable instances, the global minimisers of this optimisation problem correspond to satisfying assignments of the SAT problem at hand. We present several novel findings via empirical experiments: (i) redundant constraints can inhibit rather than accelerate convergence; (ii) CLS shows promise as a sub-solver in hybridised settings, quickly completing partial assignments; and (iii) local search rapidly converges to a stable distribution of solution quality (i.e., degree of satisfaction), due to saddle-dense objectives where additional solver steps yield diminishing returns. Our findings inform practical uses of CLS for SAT on modern accelerator hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究并行连续局部搜索（CLS）在对称伪布尔（PB）约束下的布尔可满足性问题（SAT）中的应用。实验表明，冗余约束会抑制而不是加速收敛；CLS在混合设置中作为子求解器能快速完成部分赋值；局部搜索由于目标函数鞍点密集，会迅速收敛到解质量的稳定分布，即附加步骤的收益递减。这些发现为在现代加速器硬件上使用CLS求解SAT提供了实用指导。
Motivation: 连续局部搜索（CLS）在SAT求解中的应用潜力尚未被充分探索，特别是并行化及冗余约束的影响。
Method: 将n变量PB可满足性问题松弛为n维超立方体上的连续优化问题，目标函数可微，全局最小点对应SAT问题的可满足赋值，并采用并行CLS进行求解。
Result: 实验中观察到三个现象：冗余约束抑制收敛；CLS在混合设定中可作为有效的子求解器；局部搜索因鞍点密集而快速收敛至解质量的稳定分布。
Conclusion: 研究为在并行硬件上有效部署CLS求解SAT提供了经验指导，但未涉及完全替代传统SAT求解器的能力。
