papers.title: The Identity Trap in EEG Foundation Models: A Diagnostic Audit
papers.abstract_en: Objective. EEG foundation models (FMs) report strong accuracy on clinical resting-state EEG. However, high accuracy under subject-disjoint cross-validation remains ambiguous: it can reflect a genuine clinical biomarker, or subject-identity features that correlate with the label. We name this the Identity Trap and ask whether it can be diagnosed at the representation level before fine-tuning. Approach. We propose FMScope, a frozen-representation protocol packaging five diagnostics: variance decomposition, subject-axis erasure, aperiodic 1/f ablation, layer-wise label probing, and within-subject direction consistency. We apply it to three pretrained FMs (LaBraM, CBraMod, REVE) across four datasets in a 2x2 layout: subject relation of label x presence of a consensus cross-subject EEG marker. Main results. (i) The Identity Trap is universal: frozen subject-variance is 13-89x a random null in 12/12 pairs, rising in all 12 under fine-tuning (+10 to +63 pp). This dominance is a removable linear axis: erasing it improves label decoding where the label varies within subject (+6 to +12 pp in primary cells; +4 to +27 pp across external cohorts). (ii) Aperiodic 1/f is one subject carrier: removing it drops the subject probe by 9-19 pp on LaBraM and CBraMod. REVE saturates subject identity without measurable aperiodic dependence. (iii) Fine-tuning amplifies label-variance only in cells with a literature-established cross-subject marker. Significance. The Identity Trap is a physically-grounded instance of shortcut learning: the preferred cue has a measurable physiological component, and subject-disjoint splitting alone cannot rule it out. FMScope separates gains reflecting a biological marker from those reflecting subject identity.
papers.comment: 28 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Code available at https://github.com/Jimmy110101013/fmscope
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文诊断EEG基础模型中的身份陷阱（Identity Trap），即高分类准确率可能源于与标签相关的受试者身份特征而非临床生物标志物。提出FMScope协议，通过方差分解、受试者轴擦除、1/f节律消融、逐层标签探测和受试者内方向一致性五种诊断手段，在三个预训练FM（LaBraM, CBraMod, REVE）和四个数据集上验证。发现冻结表征中受试者方差主导（比随机零假设高13-89倍），微调后进一步放大；擦除该线性轴可在标签随受试者变化的场景下提升标签解码性能（+6至+12个百分点）。周期性1/f节律是受试者身份的一个载体。
Motivation: 现有EEG基础模型在受试者分离交叉验证下的高准确率无法区分真实临床生物标志物与受试者身份特征，导致评估歧义。需要一种在微调前即能诊断身份陷阱的表示级方法。
Method: 提出FMScope协议，包含五种冻结表征诊断方法：方差分解、受试者轴擦除、周期/非周期1/f节律消融、逐层线性标签探测和受试者内方向一致性。应用于LaBraM、CBraMod、REVE三个预训练模型及四个数据集。
Result: 身份陷阱普遍存在：冻结表征中受试者方差比随机零假设高13-89倍，微调后进一步增加10-63个百分点。擦除受试者线性轴使标签解码准确率在标签随受试者变化的场景下提升6-12个百分点（外部队列4-27个百分点）。消融1/f节律使LaBraM和CBraMod的受试者探测准确率下降9-19个百分点。
Conclusion: 身份陷阱是一种有物理基础的捷径学习，受试者分离交叉验证不足以排除它。FMScope能够区分反映生物标志物的增益与反映受试者身份的增益。

papers.title: CAF-Gen: A Multi-Agent System for Enriching Argumentation Structures
papers.abstract_en: Formalizing complex reasoning from natural text is one of the central challenges in computational linguistics. It requires systems to understand not just keywords but also the context and complex reasoning embedded in a text. Current Argument Mining (AM) techniques identify basic claims and premises, yet they often struggle to capture the richer structural information required by advanced schemas such as the Carneades Argumentation Framework (CAF), which incorporates features such as premise types, proof standards, and argument schemes. We address this limitation by introducing CAF-Gen, an automated multi-agent framework designed to enrich shallow argument structures into CAF-compliant argument models. By employing an iterative Creator-Reviewer pipeline, a creator agent's output is validated by a critical agent to ensure structural integrity. This multi-agent collaboration is crucial for mitigating the structural instability typical of single-pass generative models. Our experiments demonstrate that the iterative feedback loop improves the quality of the resulting data and achieves strong alignment with the original annotations, while producing structurally richer models. Our findings show that the multi-agent system can overcome the limitations of single-pass generation, providing a robust methodology for the automated modeling of formal argumentation.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of ICCCI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CAF-Gen多智能体框架，用于将浅层论证结构自动丰富为符合Carneades论证框架（CAF）的形式化模型。采用迭代的Creator-Reviewer流程，由创作智能体生成输出，再由批评智能体验证结构完整性，以缓解单次生成模型的结构不稳定性。实验表明，迭代反馈循环提高了数据质量，与原标注高度一致，并生成了结构更丰富的模型。
Motivation: 现有论证挖掘技术只能识别基本的主张和前提，难以捕获高级框架（如CAF）所需的丰富结构信息，如前提类型、证明标准和论证模式。
Method: 提出多智能体协作框架CAF-Gen，采用Creator-Reviewer迭代流水线，创作智能体生成候选结构，批评智能体审核并反馈，通过自动循环反复改进，最终生成符合CAF的论证模型。
Result: 实验证明迭代反馈循环能提升生成数据的质量，与原标注有很强的对齐，同时产生结构更丰富的模型，克服了单次生成模型的局限性。
Conclusion: 该多智能体系统为自动建模形式化论证提供了鲁棒的方法，并强调了迭代反馈在结构稳定性中的重要性。

papers.title: Accelerated Fourier SAT (AFSAT): Fully Realising a GPU-based Symmetric Pseudo-Boolean SAT Solver
papers.abstract_en: We present Accelerated Fourier SAT (AFSAT), a GPU-accelerated solver for pseudo-Boolean satisfiability based on continuous local search (CLS). AFSAT realises the proof-of-concept approach, FastFourierSAT, into a fully-engineered solver supporting any heterogeneous mixture of symmetric constraint types and lengths within a single problem instance. Using the JAX compiler, AFSAT leverages pure function composition, automatic vectorisation, automatic differentiation, and just-in-time (JIT) compilation to perform massively parallel CLS across batches of candidate assignments. We demonstrate substantially improved numerical stability, runtime performance, and memory efficiency over the proof-of-concept. We achieve this by way of identifying and addressing various limitations that arise from memory latency and floating-point representation, as well as leveraging automatic parallelisation and compact representations. The inherent representational and stability limitations of floating point are partially addressed by a tailored discrete Fourier transform implementation. We achieve near-linear throughput when scaling to multiple accelerators via JAX array sharding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AFSAT，一个基于GPU加速的伪布尔SAT求解器，它通过连续局部搜索（CLS）并在JAX框架下利用纯函数组合、自动向量化、自动微分和即时编译实现大规模并行。相比原型FastFourierSAT，AFSAT在数值稳定性、运行时性能和内存效率上有显著提升，支持单实例中任意异构混合的对称约束类型和长度。
Motivation: 原型FastFourierSAT受限于内存延迟和浮点数表示，在可扩展性和稳定性上存在不足，无法高效处理大规模异构伪布尔SAT问题。
Method: AFSAT基于JAX编译器，采用纯函数组合、自动向量化、自动微分和JIT编译，实现大量候选赋值的并行CLS；通过定制离散傅里叶变换部分解决浮点数的表示和稳定性问题，并利用JAX数组分片实现多加速器上的近线性吞吐。
Result: 在数值稳定性、运行时性能和内存效率上显著优于原型；多加速器扩展时达到近线性吞吐。
Conclusion: AFSAT将概念验证的FastFourierSAT发展为完整工程实现，证明了通过JAX自动并行和紧凑表示可有效解决伪布尔SAT问题。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出AFSAT，一个基于GPU加速的伪布尔SAT求解器，它通过连续局部搜索（CLS）并在JAX框架下利用纯函数组合、自动向量化、自动微分和即时编译实现大规模并行。相比原型FastFourierSAT，AFSAT在数值稳定性、运行时性能和内存效率上有显著提升，支持单实例中任意异构混合的对称约束类型和长度。
summary_sections.motivation: 原型FastFourierSAT受限于内存延迟和浮点数表示，在可扩展性和稳定性上存在不足，无法高效处理大规模异构伪布尔SAT问题。
summary_sections.method: AFSAT基于JAX编译器，采用纯函数组合、自动向量化、自动微分和JIT编译，实现大量候选赋值的并行CLS；通过定制离散傅里叶变换部分解决浮点数的表示和稳定性问题，并利用JAX数组分片实现多加速器上的近线性吞吐。
summary_sections.result: 在数值稳定性、运行时性能和内存效率上显著优于原型；多加速器扩展时达到近线性吞吐。
summary_sections.conclusion: AFSAT将概念验证的FastFourierSAT发展为完整工程实现，证明了通过JAX自动并行和紧凑表示可有效解决伪布尔SAT问题。

papers.title: How Language Models Fail: Token-Level Signatures of Committed and Persistent Reasoning Failures
papers.abstract_en: Failures in language model reasoning emerge through distinct processes that leave identifiable signatures in the reasoning trace. We characterize these failures using token-level uncertainty signals, finding they arise through two empirically distinguishable processes. The first is committed failure, in which a model locks onto an incorrect reasoning path early in its trace. A central diagnostic signature is the commitment point, beyond which considering additional tokens hurt rather than help failure detection. In the second, persistent uncertainty, uncertainty instead accumulates throughout, and the full trace is needed to best distinguish failing from successful completions. These signatures reproduce across 23 model-dataset configurations, with the framework's falsifiable predictions holding in 20 of 23 cases, well above chance across both failure modes. Finally, we demonstrate our failure mode framework has direct implications for self-consistency, identifying when uncertainty signals complement it and when it can be selectively skipped. These results offer a foundation for understanding when LLM reasoning failures become detectable and for adapting detection strategies accordingly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过token级不确定性信号，将语言模型推理失败区分为两种可经验区分的模式：承诺失败（committed failure）和持续不确定性（persistent uncertainty）。在承诺失败中，模型过早锁定错误推理路径，存在一个承诺点（commitment point），之后增加token反而损害失败检测；在持续不确定性中，不确定性持续累积，需要完整trace才能区分失败与成功。该框架在23个模型-数据集配置中验证，20个案例支持其可证伪预测。研究表明该框架对自我一致性（self-consistency）有直接影响，可识别不确定性信号何时补充、何时可跳过。
Motivation: 语言模型推理失败的原因和可检测性尚不明确，缺乏对失败过程的细粒度理解。
Method: 使用token级不确定性信号（如熵）分析推理trace，识别两种失败模式（承诺失败和持续不确定性），并通过跨模型-数据集实验验证框架的可证伪预测。
Result: 在23个模型-数据集配置中，框架的预测在20个案例中成立，显著高于随机水平；承诺失败中存在一个承诺点，之后更多token反而降低检测能力。
Conclusion: 该框架为理解LLM推理失败何时可检测以及如何自适应检测提供了基础，并对自我一致性策略有直接指导意义。

papers.title: From Pixels to Newtons: Predicting In Vivo Joint Contact Forces from Monocular Video
papers.abstract_en: Joint contact forces govern implant longevity, cartilage health, and rehabilitation outcomes, shaping who develops osteoarthritis, who recovers well from joint replacement, and who benefits from biomechanical interventions. Yet they remain measurable only invasively, in a few dozen patients with instrumented implants. I present a physics-free pipeline to predict instantaneous 3D hip and knee contact forces from an uncalibrated monocular video: no markers, force plates, electromyography, subject-specific imaging, or musculoskeletal model. Parametric body meshes are recovered per frame, encoded as kinematic features, and decoded into forces by a transformer whose pose stream is adaptively modulated at every layer by body shape, joint, side, activity text, and self-supervised video tokens (V-JEPA 2), unifying hip and knee in a single model. Under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation across 26 patients and 25 activity categories from the in vivo OrthoLoad database, the pipeline matches the accuracy of subject-specific musculoskeletal simulations ($0.32 \pm 0.08$ BW RMSE for hip; $0.23 \pm 0.03$ BW for knee) and resolves peak force changes smaller than those reported for gait retraining and osteoarthritis progression. Applied zero-shot to an independent instrumented cohort, it rivals or outperforms prior published methods. Even without curated activity labels, video features alone preserve accuracy and enable end-to-end inference on raw footage. Driven by the predictor, a generative motion prior produces biomechanically plausible variants with reduced peak loading, rediscovering strategies from the predictive simulation literature. This pipeline establishes uncalibrated monocular video as a viable modality for estimating joint loading, opening a path toward retrospective analysis of archived clinical recordings, primary-care screening, and at-home rehabilitation tracking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出无需物理模型的管线，从单目视频直接预测体内髋、膝关节接触力，替代传统侵入式测量。通过参数化人体网格、运动特征编码及自适应变换器，在26名患者数据集上达到与个体化肌肉骨骼仿真相当的精度，并可在零样本下迁移至独立队列。
Motivation: 关节接触力是植入物寿命、软骨健康和康复效果的关键指标，但目前仅能通过侵入式仪器在少数患者中测量，缺乏非侵入式估算手段。
Method: 从单目视频逐帧恢复参数化人体网格，提取运动特征，经变换器解码为三维关节力；变换器的姿态流每层由体型、关节、侧别、活动文本及自监督视频令牌（V-JEPA 2）自适应调制，统一预测髋和膝关节力。
Result: 在26名患者、25类活动的OrthoLoad数据库上，留一患者交叉验证的RMSE为髋0.32±0.08 BW、膝0.23±0.03 BW，与个体化肌肉骨骼仿真精度相当；能检测到比步态再训练和骨关节炎进展报告更小的峰值力变化。零样本迁移至独立仪器植入队列时，媲美或超越已有方法。
Conclusion: 该工作证明未标定的单目视频可作为估算关节负荷的有效模态，为回顾性临床记录分析、初级保健筛查和家庭康复跟踪开辟路径。

papers.title: What Matters When Cotraining Robot Manipulation Policies on Everyday Human Videos?
papers.abstract_en: Human video datasets used for cotraining robot manipulation policies largely consist of curated demonstrations where motions are orchestrated to resemble robot behavior and 3D hand poses are captured with specialized hardware. A more plentiful source of data is everyday Internet video, but it is an open question what factors enable transfer from such videos to robots. We investigate this using a new dataset of 532 human videos with 28 hours of high-quality triangulated hand labels and natural motions. We find that hand pose quality affects transfer, but even with accurate hands, the inherent motion gap hinders transfer unless the vision and policy networks specialize to each embodiment. Our cotraining recipe yields consistent improvements, with an absolute success rate gain of $29.7\%$ in the low-robot-data regime across six manipulation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何利用日常互联网人类视频共同训练机器人操作策略，发现手部姿态质量影响迁移，但运动差距需要网络专门化才能克服。在低机器人数据场景下，提出的共同训练方法在六个操作任务上取得29.7%的绝对成功率提升。
Motivation: 现有共同训练的人类视频数据集通常使用精心编排的演示和专业硬件，而日常互联网视频更丰富但迁移因素未知。本文旨在探究什么因素使得从日常人类视频迁移到机器人策略有效。
Method: 构建了包含532个高质量三角测量手部标签的人类视频数据集，并分析手部姿态质量和运动差距的影响，提出针对每种具身专门化的视觉和策略网络的共同训练配方。
Result: 所提出的共同训练方法在低机器人数据设置下，六个操作任务上取得了29.7%的绝对成功率提升。
Conclusion: 手部姿态质量对迁移至关重要，但仅靠准确手部不够；运动差距需要网络对每种具身专门化才能有效迁移。

papers.title: Principles and Practice of Deep Representation Learning: or a Mathematical Theory of Memory
papers.abstract_en: In the current era of deep learning and especially generative models, there is significant investment in training very large generative models. Thus far, such models have been "black boxes" that are difficult to understand in the sense that they have opaque internal mechanisms, leading to difficulties in interpretability, reliability, and control. Naturally, this lack of understanding has led to both hype and fear. This book is an attempt to "open the black box" and understand the mechanisms of large deep networks, through the perspective of representation learning, which is a major factor - arguably the single most important one - in the empirical power of deep learning models. A brief outline of this book is as follows. Chapter 1 will summarize the threads that underlie the whole text. Chapters 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 will explain the design principles of modern neural network architectures through optimization and information theory, reducing the process of architecture development (long having been described as a sort of "alchemy") to undergraduate-level linear algebra and calculus exercises once the underlying principles are introduced. Chapters 7 and 8 will discuss applications of these principles to solve problems in more paradigmatic ways, obtaining new methods and models which are efficient, interpretable, and controllable by design, and yet no less - sometimes even more - powerful than the black-box models they resemble. Chapter 9 will discuss potential future directions for deep learning, the role of representation learning, as well as some open problems.
papers.comment: version 2; TeX source and supplementary material at https://ma-lab-berkeley.github.io/deep-representation-learning-book/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本书从表示学习的视角试图打开深度学习黑箱，通过优化和信息论解释现代神经网络架构的设计原理，将架构开发过程简化为本科线性代数和微积分。书中还展示了这些原理在解决实际问题中的应用，声称所得到的方法和模型高效、可解释、可控，有时甚至比黑箱模型更强大。
Motivation: 当前深度学习模型是黑箱，内部机制不透明，导致可解释性、可靠性和控制困难。本书旨在通过表示学习理解大型深度网络的机制，以推动更可靠和可控的模型发展。
Method: 本书采用优化和信息论方法阐述神经网络架构的设计原理，将架构演化过程还原为线性代数和微积分练习。同时通过应用章节展示如何在典型问题中利用这些原理设计高效、可解释的模型。
Result: 摘要声称所提出的模型和方法在保持高效、可解释和可控的同时，有时甚至比黑箱模型更强大，但未报告具体实验数值。
Conclusion: 本书总结了深度学习表示学习的理论基础，并指出未来方向包括开放问题的探索，强调表示学习在推动深度学习发展中的关键作用。

papers.title: ChronoForest: Closed-Loop Multi-Tree Diffusion Planning for Efficient Bridge Search and Route Composition
papers.abstract_en: How can we plan long-horizon routes that reach designated goals, visit required waypoints, and remain short when only short-horizon offline trajectories are available? This problem matters in offline navigation because collecting sufficiently rich long-horizon data is difficult, yet real agents must still solve long-range tasks with route-level efficiency rather than mere feasibility. The difficulty is twofold: at the microscopic level, composing many short-horizon segments creates a trade-off between search cost and path quality, while at the macroscopic level, waypoint ordering requires comparing pairwise travel costs among start, goal, and waypoint anchors that are unknown before planning and increasingly unreliable when estimated only from long-range temporal distance. In this paper, we propose ChronoForest, a closed-loop planning system that couples local bridge search and online route re-solving through an anchor-chaining tree diffusion planner and an online multi-tree orchestrator. ChronoForest uses temporal distance for short-range guidance and node evaluation, while using search-time bridge evidence to validate long-range anchor connectivity and repeatedly re-solve the route. On OGBench AntMaze-Stitch, ChronoForest achieves 99.8%, 99.3%, and 99.5% success on the medium, large, and giant splits and improves giant-stitch success by up to 34.5 points over prior reported diffusion-based results. On Hamiltonian route-composition benchmarks, online re-solving corrects poor temporal orderings and improves route quality while remaining substantially cheaper than exhaustive planning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ChronoForest，一种闭环多树扩散规划系统，用于在仅有短程离线轨迹时高效规划长程路径并满足航点要求。系统通过局部桥搜索和在线路由重解，利用时间距离进行短程引导，搜索时桥证据验证长程锚点连通性。在OGBench AntMaze-Stitch基准上，中/大/巨型任务成功率分别达99.8%/99.3%/99.5%，巨型任务成功率提升最多34.5个点。
Motivation: 离线导航中长程数据难以收集，且长程路径规划需兼顾搜索代价与路径质量，同时航点排序依赖未知的长程时间距离估计，可靠性低。
Method: 提出ChronoForest，包含锚点链树扩散规划器和在线多树协调器，实现局部桥搜索与在线路由重解的闭环。短程使用时间距离引导和节点评估，搜索时通过桥证据验证长程锚点连通性并反复重解路径。
Result: 在OGBench AntMaze-Stitch上，中/大/巨型任务成功率分别为99.8%/99.3%/99.5%，巨型任务成功率比先前扩散方法提升34.5个点。在哈密顿路径组合基准上，在线重解纠正了时间排序错误并提升路径质量，同时比穷举规划成本更低。
Conclusion: 摘要强调闭环桥搜索与在线重解策略能有效利用短程数据解决长程路径规划问题，显著提升成功率和效率。

summary_sections.result: 在OGBench AntMaze-Stitch上，中/大/巨型任务成功率分别为99.8%/99.3%/99.5%，巨型任务成功率比先前扩散方法提升34.5个点。在哈密顿路径组合基准上，在线重解纠正了时间排序错误并提升路径质量，同时比穷举规划成本更低。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调闭环桥搜索与在线重解策略能有效利用短程数据解决长程路径规划问题，显著提升成功率和效率。

papers.title: FIGMA: Towards FIne-Grained Music retrievAl
papers.abstract_en: Retrieving music using natural language descriptions has improved with contrastive audio-text models such as CLAP, but current systems remain limited to coarse semantic queries. When descriptions specify fine-grained musical attributes such as tempo, key, chord progression, or rhythmic structure, existing models often fail to retrieve the correct audio. We show that this limitation stems from the contrastive learning objective itself: despite being trained on long captions, CLAP-based models effectively utilize only the first few tokens, discarding much of the information encoded in detailed prompts. Then, we propose FIGMA (FIne-Grained Music RetrievAl), a multi-view contrastive architecture that addresses this limitation by jointly optimizing global audio-text alignment and frame-level, token-wise alignment. This design enables FIGMA to capture both high-level semantic context and fine-grained musical attributes within a unified representation space. Moreover, we formalize the task of Fine-Grained Music Retrieval and construct Fine-Grained Music Caption dataset (FGMCaps), a large-scale dataset of 380K music-caption pairs for training along with a 10K test set, both annotated with tempo, key, chord progression, beat count, as well as genre and mood. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FIGMA consistently outperforms existing CLAP-based music retrieval models across multiple music retrieval benchmarks, including out-of-domain evaluations, with relative improvements of up to 73.3%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出现有基于CLAP的音频-文本对比学习模型在处理细粒度音乐属性（如速度、调性、和弦进行、节奏结构）的查询时表现不佳，原因是对比学习目标只利用了描述的前几个token。为此提出FIGMA，一种多视角对比架构，联合优化全局对齐和帧级、token级对齐，并构建了包含38万音乐-描述对的大规模FGMCaps数据集。实验表明FIGMA在多个音乐检索基准上相对提升最高达73.3%。
Motivation: 现有音乐检索系统局限于粗粒度的语义查询，无法处理包含具体音乐属性（速度、调性等）的细粒度描述，主要原因是对比学习目标只利用了描述的前几个token。
Method: 提出多视角对比架构FIGMA，联合优化全局音频-文本对齐和帧级、token级对齐，并构建大规模细粒度音乐描述数据集FGMCaps（38万训练对+1万测试集），标注了速度、调性、和弦进行、节拍数、流派和情绪。
Result: 在多个音乐检索基准（包括跨域评估）上，FIGMA一致优于现有CLAP模型，相对提升最高达73.3%。
Conclusion: FIGMA通过多视角对齐机制有效捕获细粒度音乐属性，为音乐检索中的精细语义理解提供了可行方案。

papers.title: Re-Centering Humans in LLM Personalization
papers.abstract_en: Despite growing interest, most evaluations of large language models' (LLMs') personalization abilities have relied on synthetic data. It remains unclear how well current personalization systems work for real users. In this paper, we study the gap in LLM personalization performance when using synthetic versus human data. We collect human conversations (550 conversations) and judgments across three stages of personalization: extracting user attributes from conversations (5,949 judgments), pairing relevant attributes with new prompts (11,919), and incorporating relevant attributes into a personalized response (1,101). Incorporating human data reveals system limitations at each stage. Models struggle to extract attributes from human conversations, disagree with human judgments on relevant attributes, and generate personalized responses that humans judge no better than generic responses (though that LLM judges widely rate as better). We introduce two lightweight training-based interventions that shift automated personalization evaluation closer to human data in our first two stages. However, in our third stage we find that learned reward models achieve only modest correlation with human ratings, suggesting that human-aligned personalization quality judgments are difficult to model directly. Our collected data provides a foundation for studying how models should extract, select, and incorporate user information in ways that humans find useful.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过收集人类对话和判断数据，评估了大型语言模型在个性化任务中合成数据与真实人类数据之间的性能差距。研究发现，模型在从人类对话中提取用户属性、判断相关属性以及生成个性化响应方面存在局限，并且人类对个性化响应的评价与模型自身的评估不一致。
Motivation: 现有LLM个性化能力的评估多依赖合成数据，难以反映真实用户场景中的效果，因此需要研究真实人类数据下的性能差距。
Method: 收集了550段人类对话及三个阶段的判断数据（属性提取5,949条、属性关联11,919条、个性化响应1,101条），并引入两种轻量级训练干预来缩小前两个阶段中的性能差距。
Result: 模型在人类对话上提取属性困难，与人类对相关属性的判断不一致，生成的个性化响应被人类评价为与通用响应无显著差异，而LLM自身却认为更好；学习到的奖励模型与人类评分的相关性较弱。
Conclusion: 研究表明当前LLM个性化系统在真实人类场景中表现不佳，且自动评估与人类判断存在差距，需要更关注人类对齐的评估方法。

papers.title: Direct 3D-Aware Object Insertion via Decomposed Visual Proxies
papers.abstract_en: Object insertion aims to seamlessly composite a reference object into a specified region of a background image. Recent diffusion-based methods achieve high visual quality but formulate insertion as a simple 2D inpainting task, providing no explicit control over the object's 3D pose and limiting their practical applicability. We propose DIRECT (Decomposed Injection for Reference Composition and Target-integration), a novel framework that integrates interactive pose manipulation with high-fidelity 2D image synthesis to enable pose-controllable object insertion. Our method decomposes the insertion conditions into three complementary components: appearance guidance capturing visual details from the reference object, geometry guidance derived from the user-adjusted 3D proxy, and context guidance from the target background. By injecting them through separate pathways, DIRECT avoids feature entanglement and simultaneously preserves reference appearance, follows the user-specified pose, and adapts the object to the target scene. We also introduce an automated data construction pipeline to improve the diversity and quality of training data. Experiments show that DIRECT outperforms previous methods in both geometric controllability and visual quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DIRECT框架，通过分解视觉代理（外观、几何、上下文引导）实现三维感知的物体插入，支持用户交互式姿态操控。实验表明，该方法在几何可控性和视觉质量上优于现有扩散方法。
Motivation: 现有扩散方法将物体插入视为2D修复任务，缺乏对物体3D姿态的显式控制，限制了实际应用。
Method: 将插入条件分解为三个互补组件：外观引导（从参考对象提取视觉细节）、几何引导（从用户调整的3D代理导出）、上下文引导（来自目标背景），通过分离路径注入避免特征纠缠。
Result: 在几何可控性和视觉质量上优于之前的方法。
Conclusion: DIRECT实现了高保真2D合成与交互式姿态操控的结合，提升了物体插入的实用性和灵活性。

papers.title: Gaussian Process Latent Factor Regression for Low-Data, High-Dimensional Output Problems
papers.abstract_en: In the sciences, regression tasks often require predicting high-dimensional outputs from few training examples. Multi-output Gaussian processes excel in low-data regimes but typically struggle with high-dimensional outputs. Compress-then-predict pipelines such as PCA-GP (principal component analysis plus Gaussian process regression) handle high dimensionality, but rely on bases optimized for reconstruction rather than prediction. To address this gap, we propose a model that represents each output as a linear-Gaussian decoding of a low-dimensional latent state drawn from a Gaussian process prior. By analytically marginalizing the decoder weights, we couple compression and prediction in a single objective that scales to high-dimensional outputs. We refer to this model as Gaussian process latent factor regression (GPLFR). We demonstrate GPLFR by building the first spatially resolved emulator of global climate models for rocky exoplanets.
papers.comment: 9 pages content + 22 pages appendix/references. Supporting code at https://github.com/edstevenson/GPLFR
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出高斯过程潜在因子回归（GPLFR）模型，用于解决低数据量下高维输出回归问题。该模型将每个输出表示为低维潜在状态的线性高斯解码，潜在状态服从高斯过程先验，并通过解析边缘化解码器权重，将压缩与预测统一到单个目标函数中。在岩石系外行星全球气候模型上，构建了首个空间分辨仿真器。
Motivation: 传统多输出高斯过程在低数据量时表现良好，但难以处理高维输出；PCA-GP等压缩-预测流水线虽能处理高维，但其基函数优化目标是重建而非预测，导致预测性能受限。
Method: 提出GPLFR模型，输出为低维潜在状态的线性高斯解码，潜在状态由高斯过程先验建模；通过解析边缘化解码器权重，实现压缩与预测的联合优化，并扩展到高维输出。
Result: 在岩石系外行星全球气候模型上构建了首个空间分辨仿真器，展示了GPLFR在低数据、高维输出回归任务中的有效性。
Conclusion: GPLFR通过联合优化压缩与预测，在低数据高维输出回归中优于传统方法，尤其适用于科学仿真中的空间分辨任务。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Skip a Layer or Loop It? Learning Program-of-Layers in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) perform inference by following a fixed depth and order, non-recurrent execution of all layers. We reveal the wide existence of training-free, flexible, dynamic program-of-layers (PoLar), where pretrained layers can be packed as modules and then skipped or looped to form a customized program for each input. For most inputs, substantially shorter program executions can achieve the same or better accuracy, while incorrect predictions of the original LLM can be corrected by alternative programs with fewer layers. These observations indicate that inference admits multiple valid latent computations beyond the standard forward pass. To efficiently achieve PoLar in practice, we propose a lightweight PoLar prediction network, which learns to generate execution programs that dynamically skip or repeat pretrained layers for each input. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that PoLar consistently improves accuracy over standard inference and prior dynamic-depth methods, often while executing fewer layers, and that these gains persist under out-of-distribution evaluation. Our results suggest that fixed-depth execution captures only a narrow subset of an LLM's latent reasoning capacity.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. Substantially extends arXiv:2507.07996. Code: https://github.com/tianyi-lab/PoLar
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现大型语言模型（LLM）中存在训练无关的动态程序层（PoLar），即预训练层可作为模块，针对每个输入跳过或循环执行，形成定制程序。大多数输入下，更短的程序执行即可达到相同或更高精度，且错误预测可通过更少层的替代程序纠正。为此提出轻量级PoLar预测网络，学习为每个输入生成动态跳过或重复预训练层的执行程序。在数学推理基准上，PoLar一致提升准确率，常以更少层数执行，且在分布外评估中仍保持优势。结果表明固定深度执行仅捕捉了LLM潜在推理能力的一小部分。
Motivation: 标准LLM推理按固定深度和顺序执行所有层，可能冗余或次优。本文揭示存在多个有效潜在计算路径，旨在利用预训练层作为可编程模块，通过动态跳过或循环提升效率与准确性。
Method: 提出PoLar（Program-of-Layers）：训练一个轻量级预测网络，为每个输入生成执行程序，决定哪些预训练层被跳过或重复。该方法无需额外训练预训练层本身。
Result: 在数学推理基准上，PoLar一致提升准确率，优于标准推理和先前动态深度方法，常以更少层数执行，且在分布外评估中仍保持优势。
Conclusion: 固定深度推理并非唯一有效方式；PoLar表明LLM中存在更丰富的潜在计算结构，动态程序执行可解锁更多推理能力。

papers.title: Multiscale POD of Transformer Attention Fields: Scale-Selective Analysis via Morlet Scalogram
papers.abstract_en: We introduce scale-selective Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD) for transformer attention fields, inspired by the use of POD for extracting energetically dominant modes from turbulent flow ensembles. The Morlet continuous wavelet transform identifies dominant temporal scales in the attention lag structure across a document ensemble; POD then extracts the energetically dominant modes at each scale from the ensemble of attention fields. The resulting modes reveal layer-dependent scale organisation, with early layers emphasising fine scales and later layers shifting toward coarser scales. We define a spectral concentration index from the POD eigenvalue decay rate and show empirically that it differentiates layers by their attention field complexity. By the classical POD optimality theorem, the extracted modes minimise the average L2 reconstruction error over the ensemble (Theorem 1), giving a data-driven effective rank for each layer. The method requires no architectural modification and no linguistic annotations: dominant attention patterns emerge from ensemble statistics alone. The turbulence analogy is structural rather than physical: we borrow ensemble covariance and modal analysis, not fluid dynamics itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文将湍流分析中的本征正交分解（POD）引入Transformer注意力场，通过Morlet连续小波变换识别注意力滞后结构中的主导时间尺度，并在每个尺度上提取能量主导模态。实验发现早期层强调精细尺度，后期层转向粗尺度，并定义了谱集中指数来区分各层的注意力场复杂度。该方法无需架构修改或语言标注，仅从集成统计中提取注意力模式。
Motivation: 现有Transformer注意力分析缺乏多尺度视角，而湍流中的POD方法能有效提取能量主导模态，本文旨在将这一思想迁移到注意力场以揭示其尺度组织。
Method: 使用Morlet连续小波变换对文档集成中注意力滞后结构进行时间尺度分解，然后在每个尺度上对注意力场集成进行POD，提取能量主导模态，并定义谱集中指数（基于POD特征值衰减率）来度量层复杂度。

papers.title: Generative Models Erode Human Temporal Learning Through Market Selection
papers.abstract_en: We argue that modern generative models create structural risks for knowledge and cultural production at current, sub-AGI capability levels. We define Human Temporal Learning (HTL) as path-dependent knowledge accumulation through sustained engagement with problems over time. Generative outputs increasingly resemble HTL-intensive work in surface features, so verifying whether a given output reflects genuine human learning grows costly relative to its expected benefit. Once verification loses economic justification, evaluators reward outputs regardless of production mode, and producers who invested years of learning compete on price against outputs that cost almost nothing to generate. We call this pathway value collapse and formalize it through a costly-inspection framework. Cross-domain evidence from academic publishing, legal practice, content platforms, and software security maps onto four stages of verification erosion. Alignment success is orthogonal. Better-aligned models narrow observable gaps between human and AI outputs, making source verification harder and intensifying competitive pressure against HTL-intensive work even when individual AI outputs improve.
papers.journal_ref: Forty-third International Conference on Machine Learning Position Paper Track (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证了当前生成模型（即使未达到AGI水平）通过市场选择机制对人类时间学习（HTL）造成结构性风险。作者提出价值崩溃（value collapse）概念，并基于昂贵检验（costly-inspection）框架进行形式化，展示了在学术出版、法律实践、内容平台和软件安全等领域的跨领域证据，指出对齐（alignment）的成功反而加剧了问题。
Motivation: 生成模型输出在表面特征上越来越像人类时间学习密集型工作，但验证其是否反映真实人类学习的成本高昂，导致经济上不值得验证，进而侵蚀人类长期知识积累的动力。
Method: 采用昂贵检验（costly-inspection）框架，通过市场选择模型形式化价值崩溃路径，并跨领域观察四个阶段的验证侵蚀。
Result: 跨领域证据（学术出版、法律实践、内容平台、软件安全）映射到验证侵蚀的四个阶段；对齐成功反而使来源验证更难，加剧了竞争压力。
Conclusion: 当前生成模型即便在子AGI水平也通过市场选择机制对人类时间学习产生结构性风险，且对齐的成功是正交的，无法缓解反而可能加剧问题。

papers.title: MalTree: Tracing Malware Evolution from Embeddings at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Malware detection remains largely reactive: machine learning models trained on known samples degrade as threats evolve. Understanding evolutionary relationships among malware families can inform proactive defense, but traditional reverse engineering can take months to years to uncover such lineage relationships. We propose MalTree, a framework that applies bioinformatics inspired phylogenetic techniques (UPGMA and Neighbor-Joining) at scale to model malware evolution automatically using structural, behavioral, and image-based features. We introduce temporal validation using VirusTotal timestamps to assess whether inferred trees reflect actual evolutionary order. MalTree achieves 87% temporal consistency, indicating that inferred evolutionary relationships closely align with real-world emergence timelines. Our analysis shows that some families mutate over 10 times faster than others, suggesting that detection strategies should be tailored to family-specific evolutionary tempos. Case studies, including the Mirai botnet, confirm that inferred relationships from our phylogenetic tree align with documented threat intelligence. Our framework provides a foundation for shifting malware analysis from sample-by-sample classification toward lineage-aware evolutionary modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出 MalTree 框架，将生物信息学的系统发育技术（UPGMA 和 Neighbor-Joining）应用于大规模恶意软件进化建模，通过结构、行为和图像特征自动推断家族间谱系关系。
Motivation: 传统恶意软件检测依赖已知样本训练模型，面对进化后的威胁性能下降；而逆向工程揭示进化关系耗时久，急需自动化方法。
Method: 采用 UPGMA 和 Neighbor-Joining 算法，基于恶意软件的结构、行为和图像嵌入特征构建系统发育树，并引入 VirusTotal 时间戳进行时间一致性验证。
Result: 推断的进化树与真实出现时间线的时间一致性达 87%，发现某些家族变异速度比其他家族快 10 倍以上。案例研究（如 Mirai 僵尸网络）与已知威胁情报吻合。
Conclusion: 该框架为从逐样本分类转向谱系感知的进化建模奠定了基础，支持针对家族特有进化速度定制检测策略。

papers.title: Are you sure? A Comprehensive and Comprehensible Survey of Uncertainty Quantification in Symbolic Regression
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression (SR) is a class of methods that systematically explore the space of mathematical functions to discover models that accurately capture the underlying relationships in a dataset. Despite recent advances in the field, a lack of support for uncertainty quantification (UQ) limits its adoption in real-world decision processes. In regression analysis, UQ provides important information about the model reliability, which can both help to avoid overfitting by accounting for uncertainty in the data, and provide insights for decision-making. This survey is the first to clearly address this issue, with the objective of introducing essential UQ concepts and reviewing the current literature on UQ in SR, which can be broadly organized into three research directions: frequentist, Bayesian, and model selection. Despite its importance, UQ in SR is still underexplored, which motivates further research into reliable UQ methods for SR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是首篇系统综述符号回归（Symbolic Regression, SR）中不确定性量化（Uncertainty Quantification, UQ）工作的论文。文章介绍了UQ的基本概念，并将现有SR UQ研究归纳为频率学派、贝叶斯学派和模型选择三个方向。作者指出尽管UQ对提升模型可靠性至关重要，但在SR领域仍探索不足，呼吁未来加强相关研究。
Motivation: 符号回归在现实决策中因缺乏不确定性量化支持而应用受限，现有综述未系统梳理该领域，阻碍了方法发展。
Method: 通过综述形式，梳理并分类符号回归中的不确定性量化方法，将其分为频率学派、贝叶斯学派和模型选择三大类。
Result: 发现UQ在SR中尚处于早期阶段，各方向方法均有待成熟，且缺乏统一评估基准。
Conclusion: 本调查为SR UQ提供了全面概览，明确了现有工作的不足，并呼吁开发更可靠的UQ方法以促进SR在风险敏感场景的应用。

papers.title: NTILC: Neural Tool Invocation via Learned Compression
papers.abstract_en: Agentic tool-calling language models depend on large registries of callable APIs, functions, and local actions. Placing full tool specifications directly in the prompt incurs a cost that scales linearly with the size of the tool registry, rapidly consuming the context budget. As the registry grows, this leads to higher latency and degrades selection accuracy, particularly due to interference from irrelevant tools. We overcome these limitations by introducing NTILC, a neural tool selection and invocation framework that replaces in-context registry look-up with learned latent retrieval. NTILC maps both user intent and tool specifications into a shared embedding space, enabling tool selection via external retrieval rather than in-context lookup. The language model is conditioned only on the selected tool schema, allowing for precise, constrained argument generation. Central to our approach is a signature-aware composite objective, which augments semantic similarity with constraints derived from tool signatures (e.g., argument schema, type compatibility, and return types). By combining Circle Loss with a Functional Margin Loss, the model enforces separation between tools that are semantically similar but incompatible under their execution signatures. We evaluate NTILC on public tool-selection and function-calling datasets and report context token usage, retrieval accuracy, and selection latency metrics. Across these settings, NTILC reduces context window consumption by over 95% and inference latency by up to 74% compared to long-context ICT baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: NTILC 是一种神经工具选择与调用框架，通过将工具规格映射到共享嵌入空间并利用外部检索代替上下文查找，显著减少上下文窗口消耗和推理延迟。在公共工具选择与函数调用数据集上，NTILC 相比长上下文 ICT 基线减少了超过 95% 的上下文窗口消耗和高达 74% 的推理延迟。
Motivation: 现有工具调用语言模型将完整工具规格放在提示中，导致上下文消耗随注册表大小线性增长，造成高延迟和选择精度下降。
Method: 提出 NTILC 框架，将用户意图和工具规格映射到共享嵌入空间，通过外部检索选择工具，并采用签名感知复合目标（Circle Loss + Functional Margin Loss）来增强语义相似性与工具签名约束。
Result: 在公共数据集上，NTILC 减少了超过 95% 的上下文窗口消耗和高达 74% 的推理延迟，同时保持或提升了选择准确率。
Conclusion: NTILC 通过将工具选择从上下文查找转移到潜在检索，有效解决了大规模工具注册表下的效率瓶颈。

papers.title: AI Level of Detail: Distance-Aware ML Model Precision Selection for Real-Time Human Motion Prediction in Games
papers.abstract_en: Modern game engines spend significant compute animating NPCs with learned motion models. This paper proposes AI Level of Detail (AI LOD), a framework in which machine learning inference precision is adapted based on the distance between each NPC and the player camera. The core idea mirrors classical geometry LOD: substitute a cheaper approximation where the difference is imperceptible. Here, the approximation is a lower-precision quantized machine learning model rather than a lower-polygon mesh. The contribution of this work is the AI LOD concept itself: that inference-time quantization can serve as the LOD axis for AI-driven character animation - and more broadly, for any AI-based runtime system where perceptual sensitivity varies with context. The convolutional sequence-to-sequence model of Li et al. is used as a representative example to demonstrate the concept, with its trained checkpoint exported into three ONNX Runtime variants (FP32, FP16, and INT8 per-tensor), intended to be routed by a distance-based selector at runtime. Evaluation on the CMU Mocap dataset provides initial evidence that each precision tier can be served at its assigned distance range with negligible perceptible degradation, supporting the broader premise that distance-aware ML model precision selection is a viable LOD strategy for AI-based character animation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AI Level of Detail (AI LOD) 框架，根据 NPC 与玩家摄像头的距离动态调整机器学习模型的推理精度（FP32、FP16、INT8），以节省游戏引擎计算资源。在 CMU Mocap 数据集上使用卷积序列到序列模型进行验证，结果表明各精度层在指定距离范围内可忽略感知退化。
Motivation: 现代游戏引擎在 NPC 动画中使用学习模型消耗大量计算，而传统几何 LOD 的降级思想在 AI 推理中尚未被系统利用。
Method: 借鉴几何 LOD 思想，将同一模型导出为 FP32、FP16、INT8 三个 ONNX Runtime 变体，基于距离选择器在运行时切换。以 Li 等人的卷积序列到序列模型作为示例。
Result: 在 CMU Mocap 数据集上的初步证据表明，每个精度层在分配的距离范围内表现可接受，感知退化极小。
Conclusion: 距离感知的 ML 模型精度选择是一种可行的 AI 动画 LOD 策略，并可推广到任何感知敏感性随上下文变化的 AI 运行时系统。

papers.title: WAV: Multi-Resolution Block Residual Routing for Deep Decoder-Only Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Residual connections are central to training deep Transformers, but standard PreNorm residual streams aggregate sublayer updates with fixed unit weights. Recent Attention Residuals replace this fixed accumulation with content-dependent depth-wise routing, and Block Attention Residuals make the mechanism efficient by routing over block-level residual summaries. However, a single block summary stores only the low-frequency total residual displacement inside a block, discarding directional structure such as attention-vs-MLP imbalance and early-vs-late block dynamics. We propose WAV v1, a lightweight multi-resolution residual routing method for decoder-only Transformers. Instead of representing each block only by its accumulated residual sum, WAV v1 augments every block with two directional detail bases: a phase basis that contrasts attention and MLP updates, and a split basis that contrasts early and late sublayer updates. These bases are routed together with standard block summaries through the same depth-wise softmax mixer, while negative detail-source initialization and detached RMS matching stabilize training. On character-level TinyStories and Text8 language modeling, WAV v1 shows a clear depth-dependent benefit. Although it is not consistently beneficial at 12 layers, it becomes competitive at 24 layers and outperforms all baselines at 48 layers. At 48 layers, WAV v1 reduces validation loss relative to Block AttnRes from 0.4960 to 0.4738 on TinyStories and from 0.9363 to 0.9305 on Text8, with negligible additional parameters. These results suggest that directional residual details, not only block-level sums, are important for scaling residual routing in deeper Transformers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WAV v1，一种轻量级多分辨率残差路由方法，用于解码器-only Transformer。该方法在标准块残差基础上增加方向性细节基（相位基和分裂基），通过深度softmax混合器进行路由，并使用负细节源初始化和解耦RMS匹配稳定训练。在字符级语言建模任务上，WAV v1在深层（48层）显著降低验证损失，表明方向性残差细节对深层Transformers的扩展至关重要。
Motivation: 标准PreNorm残差流使用固定单位权重聚合子层更新，而最近的注意力残差方法仅使用块级残差和，忽略了注意力和MLP之间以及早期与后期子层更新的方向性结构，限制了深层模型的性能。
Method: WAV v1为每个块增加两个方向性细节基：对比注意力和MLP更新的相位基，以及对比早期和后期子层更新的分裂基。这些基与标准块残差和一起通过深度softmax混合器路由，并采用负细节源初始化和解耦RMS匹配来稳定训练。
Result: 在字符级TinyStories和Text8语言建模上，WAV v1在12层时优势不明显，但在24层时具有竞争力，在48层时优于所有基线。48层时，TinyStories上验证损失从0.4960降至0.4738，Text8上从0.9363降至0.9305，且参数量增加可忽略。
Conclusion: 方向性残差细节（而非仅块级和）对于深层Transformers的残差路由扩展很重要，WAV v1提供了一种轻量级的实现方式。

papers.title: AI-Driven Test Case Generation from Natural Language Requirements: A Survey of Techniques and Research Gaps
papers.abstract_en: Software testing is critical for verifying that systems meet specified requirements, yet remains among the most time-consuming and expensive activities in development. Requirements-based test generation allows test cases to be derived early from requirements artifacts, but generating them directly from natural language is challenging due to inherent ambiguity and imprecision. Recent advances in AI, natural language processing (NLP), and large language models (LLMs) have made automating this pipeline increasingly feasible, while introducing new risks including hallucination, reduced traceability, and inconsistent evaluation. This survey addresses four research questions: what AI and NLP techniques have been proposed for generating test cases from natural language requirements; what tools and frameworks support these approaches; how generated test cases are evaluated; and what research gaps remain. Following Kitchenham and Charters' systematic review guidelines, we searched major scholarly databases spanning 2000-2025 and, after applying strict inclusion criteria, identified 21 primary studies. The literature is organized into three evolutionary eras, revealing that no existing approach simultaneously satisfies six key quality dimensions: automation, ambiguity handling, domain applicability, traceability, evaluation thoroughness, and hallucination control. The survey makes three main contributions: a three-era evolutionary synthesis of AI-based test generation; a six-criteria gap analysis showing no current approach fully addresses all quality dimensions; and four actionable research guidelines targeting hallucination, traceability, complexity sensitivity, and compliance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该综述系统梳理了从自然语言需求中利用AI/NLP/LLM技术自动生成测试用例的研究，涵盖2000-2025年的21篇主要文献。论文将技术演化分为三个时代，并指出没有现有方法能同时满足自动化、歧义处理、领域适用性、可追溯性、评估全面性和幻觉控制这六个关键质量维度。
Motivation: 软件测试耗时且昂贵，从自然语言需求直接生成测试用例面临歧义和精度挑战，现有AI技术虽然带来可能但也引入幻觉、可追溯性下降等问题，领域缺乏系统综述来识别研究空白。
Method: 遵循Kitchenham和Charters的系统综述方法，检索主要学术数据库，经严格纳入标准筛选出21篇主要研究，按三个演化时代组织文献并进行六维缺口分析。
Result: 无现有方法完全满足六个关键质量维度；综述提出了四个可操作的研究指南（针对幻觉、可追溯性、复杂度敏感性和合规性）。
Conclusion: 当前AI驱动的自然语言需求测试生成领域尚缺乏全面解决方案，未来需重点解决幻觉控制、可追溯性等问题。

papers.title: MacArena: Benchmarking Computer Use Agents on an Online macOS Environment
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents (CUAs) operate graphical user interfaces (GUIs) through vision and control primitives, and their capabilities have advanced rapidly, driven in part by standardized online evaluation benchmarks such as OSWorld, which serve both as evaluation tools and as training environments for reinforcement learning. However, macOS remains underserved in this landscape: the only existing benchmark, macOSWorld, covers a narrow slice of first-party applications with simpler tasks, and runs on x86 virtual machines incompatible with Apple Silicon. We introduce MacArena, a benchmark of 421 manually verified tasks spanning 50 applications that combines a curated port of OSWorld tasks, content sourced from macOSWorld, and 49 new macOS-native tasks, all running on Apple's native Virtualization framework on Apple Silicon. We argue that macOS presents distinct GUI challenges beyond what Linux-based benchmarks capture, and our evaluation supports this claim: strong model performance on existing benchmarks can reflect familiarity with task distributions rather than genuine cross-platform GUI competence. Notably, model rankings invert between ported and macOS-native tasks, with a leading model trailing by over 26% on the MacArena subset, suggesting that macOS poses a genuinely harder environment for current GUI agents.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Second Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond (AIWILD) at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MacArena是一个针对macOS环境的计算机使用代理（CUA）基准测试，包含421个手动验证的任务，覆盖50个应用程序。该基准测试结合了从OSWorld移植的任务、macOSWorld的内容以及49个新的macOS原生任务，并在Apple Silicon上使用Apple原生虚拟化框架运行。评估结果表明，现有模型在移植任务和macOS原生任务上的表现排名反转，领先模型在MacArena子集上落后超过26%，表明macOS对当前GUI代理构成了更大的挑战。
Motivation: macOS在现有CUA基准测试中未被充分覆盖，已有的macOSWorld仅涵盖少量第一方应用且任务简单，且基于x86虚拟机不兼容Apple Silicon。需要一个全面的macOS基准测试来评估代理的跨平台GUI能力。
Method: 构建MacArena基准测试：包含421个手动验证的任务，跨越50个应用程序；任务来源包括OSWorld任务的移植、macOSWorld的内容以及49个新的macOS原生任务；所有任务在Apple Silicon上使用Apple原生虚拟化框架运行。
Result: 评估显示模型性能在移植任务和macOS原生任务上排名反转，领先模型在MacArena子集上落后超过26%，表明现有模型对任务分布熟悉而非真正跨平台能力。
Conclusion: macOS对当前GUI代理构成更难的测试环境，现有基准测试可能高估模型的泛化能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IRAF: Interference-Resilient Adaptive Fusion for Noise-Robust End-to-End Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Systems
papers.abstract_en: Full-duplex spoken dialogue models allow voice agents to listen and speak concurrently, enabling natural interaction with real-time overlap. However, end-to-end dual-channel models that jointly encode user and agent streams may degrade in realistic acoustic environments: interfering speakers leaking into the user microphone can be encoded as part of the user query, corrupting the LLM's conditioning and causing unstable turn-taking and reduced response quality. We propose Interference-Resilient Adaptive Fusion (IRAF), a lightweight, streaming-compatible module that modulates the contribution of user audio to the LLM frame by frame. IRAF predicts a scalar reliability gate from target-speaker and user audio embeddings and rescales user representations before fusion with agent embeddings. Experiments on MS-MARCO and InstructS2S-200K show consistent gains in response quality and full-duplex interaction under interfering-speaker conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出IRAFA（抗干扰自适应融合）模块，用于端到端全双工口语对话系统，通过逐帧预测可靠性门控来调制用户语音对LLM的贡献，从而在干扰说话者条件下提升响应质量和交互稳定性。在MS-MARCO和InstructS2S-200K数据集上实验显示一致改进。
Motivation: 现有全双工对话模型在真实声学环境中，干扰说话者渗入用户麦克风会污染用户查询，导致LLM条件不稳定、轮换混乱和响应质量下降。
Method: 提出轻量级、流式兼容的IRAFA模块，利用目标说话者和用户音频嵌入逐帧预测标量可靠性门控，在融合代理嵌入前重新缩放用户表示。
Result: 在MS-MARCO和InstructS2S-200K数据集上，在干扰说话者条件下，IRAFA在响应质量和全双工交互方面取得一致提升。
Conclusion: IRAFA有效增强了全双工口语系统在噪声环境中的鲁棒性，且保持流式兼容和轻量化。

papers.title: Depth over Fidelity in Fixed-Budget Noisy Evolution Strategies
papers.abstract_en: Noisy evolution strategies under fixed evaluation budgets face a depth-fidelity trade-off: spending evaluations to denoise intra-generation rankings reduces the number of distribution updates the optimizer can execute. We argue for depth over fidelity and propose probabilistic elite membership (PEM), which replaces hard rank-based weights in evolution strategies with conditional expected rank weights that integrate over ranking uncertainty. PEM preserves the conditional mean update while reducing conditional update dispersion, a Rao-Blackwellization of the noisy rank-based step. We instantiate PEM via residual bootstrapping (RB-PEM) with capped per-generation overhead, complemented by an adaptive probe-and-switch mechanism for low-noise regimes. Across the COCO bbob-noisy suite and external tasks including RL policy search and hyperparameter optimization, RB-PEM achieves consistent gains in high-misranking, budget-constrained settings.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). 28 pages, 16 figures, 7 tables, including appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对固定评估预算下的噪声演化策略，提出深度优于保真度的观点，并引入概率精英成员（PEM）方法，通过残差自助法（RB-PEM）实现条件期望排名权重，取代传统硬排名权重。在COCO bbob-noisy基准套件及RL策略搜索、超参数优化等任务中，PEM在高误排序、预算受限场景下取得了持续的性能提升。
Motivation: 噪声演化策略在固定评估预算下面临深度-保真权衡：增加去噪投入会减少可执行的分布更新次数，影响优化效率。本文旨在解决这一矛盾，主张优先保障深度而非保真度。
Method: 提出概率精英成员（PEM），以条件期望排名权重替代硬排名权重，实现Rao-Blackwellization，降低条件更新分散性。通过残差自助法（RB-PEM）实现，并附加自适应探针-切换机制处理低噪声场景。
Result: 在COCO bbob-noisy套件、强化学习策略搜索和超参数优化任务中，RB-PEM在高误排序、预算受限设置下一致优于基线方法。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，通过PEM的Rao-Blackwellization可以有效提升噪声演化策略在固定预算下的优化性能，适用范围包括多类随机优化问题。

papers.title: Multi-Scale Feature Attention Network for Polymer Classification using THz Dual-Comb Spectroscopy
papers.abstract_en: Reliable polymer identification is essential for ensuring the quality and safety of recycled plastics, yet conventional sorting and spectroscopic techniques often struggle to deliver robust discrimination. Terahertz Dual-Comb Spectroscopy (THz-DCS) offers a promising alternative, providing rapid, high-resolution, and non-destructive measurements. In this work, we leverage THz-DCS to classify 12 types of polymers, including pure polymers, multilayer films, commercial blends, and biopolymers. To handle the complexity of these spectral signals, we propose the Multi-Scale Feature Attention Network (MSFAN), a novel deep learning architecture tailored for THz-DCS data. The framework integrates feature gating for signal recalibration and multi-scale parallel convolutions to capture diverse frequency patterns. These features are further refined through cross-feature attention and attention pooling, enabling the model to intrinsically highlight the most informative THz regions. MSFAN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art models, reaching a classification accuracy of 85.2%. This study demonstrates the potential of combining THz-DCS with deep learning techniques for effective, scalable, and interpretable polymer classification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多尺度特征注意力网络（MSFAN），用于太赫兹双梳光谱（THz-DCS）聚合物分类，在12种聚合物（包括纯聚合物、多层膜、商业混合物和生物聚合物）上达到85.2%的分类准确率，优于现有模型。
Motivation: 传统聚合物分类方法难以有效区分回收塑料，太赫兹双梳光谱作为一种快速、高分辨率、非破坏性的替代方案，但其光谱信号复杂，需要专门的处理方法。
Method: 提出MSFAN架构，集成特征门控（feature gating）进行信号重校准，使用多尺度并行卷积捕获不同频率模式，并通过交叉特征注意力（cross-feature attention）和注意力池化（attention pooling）进一步精炼特征。
Result: 在12种聚合物分类任务上达到85.2%准确率，一致优于现有最先进模型。
Conclusion: 研究表明，将太赫兹双梳光谱与深度学习结合，可以实现有效、可扩展且可解释的聚合物分类。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometric Second-Order Feature Correlation Learning for Self-Supervised Speech Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) yields powerful, context-rich representations for speech emotion recognition (SER), yet aggregating these representations into holistic descriptors remains a bottleneck. Conventional first-order aggregation implicitly assumes feature independence, which overlooks the latent Riemannian geometry and discards higher-order relationships essential to the representational power of the backbone. To address this problem, this paper proposes a novel Second-Order Correlation (SOC) layer. Instead of treating features in isolation, SOC models feature correlations as covariance descriptors to capture synergistic co-occurrence patterns, which serve as discriminative signatures for robust emotion recognition. By mapping these descriptors from the Riemannian manifold to a Euclidean tangent space through Log-Euclidean mapping (LEM), the proposed method preserves geometric integrity while enabling direct linear discriminative learning. Extensive experiments on the ESD and RAVDESS datasets demonstrate that SOC recovers discriminative information lost in first-order pooling and effectively aggregates high-dimensional SSL features.
papers.summary_zh:

Method: 提出二阶相关性（SOC）层，将特征相关建模为协方差描述子，再通过对数欧几里得映射（LEM）将黎曼流形上的描述子映射到欧几里得切空间，实现线性判别学习。
Result: 在ESD和RAVDESS数据集上的实验表明，SOC能恢复一阶池化丢失的判别信息，有效聚合高维自监督特征。

papers.title: FAIR-Calib: Frontier-Aware Instability-Reweighted Calibration for Post-Training Quantization of Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) refine tokens iteratively but commit them irreversibly, leading to a "stability lag" where early decisions remain fragile even after being written. We reveal that Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) error easily flips these borderline decisions at the write frontier, which are then permanently locked in and amplified. To address this, we propose Frontier-Aware Instability-Reweighted Calibration (FAIR-Calib), a two-stage PTQ framework for dLLMs. Stage I probes a full-precision teacher to estimate a position prior that combines frontier hits and masked-stage reliability. Stage II performs off-policy, layer-wise calibration by minimizing a reweighted hidden-state MSE, effectively prioritizing the protection of fragile frontier states without requiring expensive end-to-end diffusion rollouts. We further theoretically justify our weighted objective as a surrogate for output KL divergence. Empirically, FAIR-Calib consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on LLaDA and Dream (W4A4), significantly reducing frontier decision flips and suppressing post-commit mismatches across diverse benchmarks.
papers.comment: Accepted as a poster at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）在后训练量化（PTQ）过程中早期决策易被翻转并放大（称为稳定性滞后）的问题，提出前沿感知不稳定重加权校准框架（FAIR-Calib）。该框架分为两阶段：第一阶段从全精度教师模型估计位置先验，结合前沿命中与掩蔽阶段可靠性；第二阶段通过最小化重加权隐藏状态均方误差进行离策略逐层校准，优先保护脆弱的前沿状态。理论上证明了加权目标是输出KL散度的代理。实验在LLaDA和Dream模型上（W4A4）显著优于现有基线，减少前沿决策翻转和后提交不匹配。
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型在迭代细化中不可逆地提交token，导致早期决策虽脆弱但被永久锁定，而PTQ误差易翻转这些边界决策并加剧不稳定性。现有方法未专门针对dLLMs的此特性进行校准。
Method: 提出FAIR-Calib：Stage I利用全精度教师模型估计位置先验（结合前沿命中次数和掩蔽阶段可靠性）；Stage II进行离策略、逐层校准，优化重加权隐藏状态MSE损失，避免昂贵的端到端扩散展开。理论上证明加权目标近似输出KL散度。
Result: 在LLaDA和Dream模型上采用W4A4量化，FAIR-Calib在多个基准上一致优于现有最先进方法，显著降低前沿决策翻转次数并抑制后提交不匹配。
Conclusion: FAIR-Calib通过优先保护脆弱前沿状态有效改善了dLLMs的PTQ性能，且无需端到端扩散过程，具有理论保证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Elmes*: Automated Construction of Fine-Grained Evaluation Rubrics for Large Language Models in Long-Tail Educational Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) for education requires measuring how models teach, not only what they know. Existing benchmarks emphasize domain-general correctness or depend on manually designed rubrics that scale poorly to long-tail pedagogical scenarios. We introduce Elmes*, an end-to-end framework for constructing, refining, and applying fine-grained scenario-specific rubrics. Elmes* combines a declarative multi-agent engine for teacher--student--judge interactions with SceneGen, a self-evolving module that co-optimizes evaluation criteria and test data from expert-defined pedagogical dimensions. Using Elmes*, we build Edu-330, covering 330 scenarios across 11 subjects, 3 grade bands, and 10 task types, with over 1{,}000 second-level indicators. Experiments on Edu-330 and four expert-authored gold-standard scenarios show that educational capability is multidimensional: top-tier LLMs differ mainly in creativity and values integration, knowledge-strong models may fail at Socratic scaffolding, and the education-specialized InnoSpark achieves the best human-evaluated average score. LLM judges preserve human-comparable rankings with much lower scoring variance, but exhibit judge-specific biases such as self-preference. Ablations show that expert-scored few-shot anchoring improves human--LLM alignment, while reasoning enforcement and greedy decoding are model-dependent. Elmes* thus provides scalable diagnostic infrastructure for pedagogically grounded LLM evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Elmes* 框架，用于为长尾教育场景中的大语言模型自动构建细粒度评估标准。框架结合多智能体引擎和自进化模块 SceneGen，生成包含 330 个场景、1000+ 二级指标的基准 Edu-330。实验表明教育能力是多维的，顶级模型差异主要体现在创造力和价值观整合，知识强的模型可能缺乏苏格拉底式引导能力，且教育专用模型 InnoSpark 获得了最佳人工评估平均分。LLM 评判者保持与人工可比的排序但方差更小，但存在特定偏差。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 教育评估基准侧重于通用正确性或依赖人工设计的标准，难以扩展到长尾教学场景。需要自动化、可扩展的细粒度评估标准构建方法。
Method: 提出 Elmes* 框架，包含声明式多智能体引擎（教师-学生-评判者交互）和自进化模块 SceneGen，从专家定义的教学维度协同优化评估标准和测试数据。
Result: 构建了包含 330 个场景、11 个学科、3 个年级段、10 种任务类型和超 1000 个二级指标的基准 Edu-330。实验显示教育能力多维性，模型差别主要体现在创造力和价值观整合；教育专用模型 InnoSpark 获得最佳人工平均分；LLM 评判者能复现人工排序但评分方差更低，存在自偏好等偏差。消融实验证明专家评分少样本锚定改善人机对齐，推理强制和贪心解码依赖模型。
Conclusion: Elmes* 为教育学基础的 LLM 评估提供了可扩展的诊断基础设施，能够揭示模型在多维教育能力上的差异。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Queen-Bee Agents: A BeeSpec-Centered Architecture for Governed Enterprise MCP Orchestration
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise agent systems increasingly need to connect large language models to private tools, internal knowledge, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) interfaces. In this setting, raw task capability is insufficient: organizations also require policy enforcement, tenant-scoped isolation, and execution that remains within explicit operational boundaries. We present Queen-Bee, a governed multi-agent architecture in which a Queen control plane retrieves capabilities, plans task-scoped execution, and compiles a structured BeeSpec that is executed by specialized Bee agents under constrained tool access. We implement a working prototype with tenant-scoped MCP connectors, audit-backed execution-time governance, retrieval-driven weak incubation, and multiple provisioning backends. We evaluate the system on 59 enterprise-style tasks spanning governance-sensitive requests, retrieval-driven provisioning, scoped local execution, and chemistry workflow integration. The retrieval-driven Queen-Bee variant achieves a task success rate of 0.964, zero governance failures, and substantially better scoped execution quality than both a static Queen-Bee baseline and a permissive single-agent baseline. We further show a multi-Bee chemistry workflow with explicit approval gating and a concrete top-3 shortlist grounded in real upstream evidence and screening artifacts. Additional comparisons with hybrid retrieval and LLM-guided provisioning show that richer provisioning backends are viable but do not outperform the lightweight structured retriever on the current small, highly structured capability registry. The results provide prototype-level systems evidence rather than a production deployment study, and suggest that enterprise agent platforms should be evaluated not only by capability, but also by governed provisioning, isolation behavior, scoped execution quality, and artifact-aware workflow coordination.
papers.comment: Technical report. Prototype-level systems evidence; 59 enterprise-style tasks
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Queen-Bee，一种受监管的多智能体架构，通过Queen控制平面检索能力、规划任务并编译BeeSpec，由专门Bee代理在受限工具访问下执行。在59个企业风格任务上，检索驱动的Queen-Bee变体达到0.964任务成功率、零治理失败，范围执行质量优于基线。研究为原型级系统证据，强调企业AI平台应评估治理、隔离和范围执行质量。
Motivation: 企业智能体系统需要将大语言模型连接到私有工具和内部知识，但除了任务能力外，还需要策略执行、租户隔离和操作边界约束。
Method: 提出Queen-Bee架构：Queen控制平面检索能力、规划任务执行并编译结构化BeeSpec，由Bee代理在受限工具访问下执行。实现租户范围MCP连接器、审计执行治理、检索驱动弱孵化及多种配置后端。
Result: 在59个企业风格任务上，检索驱动的Queen-Bee变体任务成功率为0.964，零治理失败，范围执行质量优于静态Queen-Bee基线和宽松单智能体基线。
Conclusion: 结果提供原型级系统证据而非生产部署研究，建议企业智能体平台应按治理配置、隔离行为、范围执行质量和工件感知协调评估。

papers.title: Coordinated optimization of departure sequencing and section-track allocation in railway short-term concentrated departure scenarios based on qubo and hybrid quantum algorithms
papers.abstract_en: This study examines the coordinated optimization of departure sequencing and section-track allocation in railway short-term concentrated departure scenarios. A quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) model is formulated to represent departure-position assignment and section-track selection within a unified binary framework. Because the quality of a dispatching scheme depends on time-dependent operational interactions that cannot be fully captured by a static combinatorial model, a simulation-based evaluation layer is introduced to assess section occupation, intermediate-station waiting, platform-capacity pressure, running-time fluctuations, and delay propagation. Within this layered framework, conventional heuristics, quantum-inspired algorithms, and hybrid algorithms are compared on the same decision structure. The results show that the QUBO model can generate feasible candidate schemes after decoding, while the simulation layer clearly differentiates the operational performance of the competing algorithms under both normal and disturbed conditions. In the tested scenarios, QPSO-QAOA performs best under normal conditions, and the quantum-enhanced methods reduce comprehensive cost by 4.28\%--26.26\% and total delay by 4.37\%--24.25\% on average under dynamic conditions relative to their conventional counterparts. These findings suggest that the integration of QUBO-based modeling and simulation-based evaluation provides a useful methodological framework for railway short-term concentrated departure scheduling, although validation with real operational data remains necessary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究铁路短期集中发车场景下出发排序与路段轨道分配的协调优化。构建了一个二次无约束二进制优化（QUBO）模型将其统一为二进制框架，并引入基于仿真的评估层以评估调度方案在动态条件下的性能。实验表明，混合量子算法QPSO-QAOA在正常条件下表现最佳，量子增强方法在动态条件下相比传统方法降低了综合成本4.28%-26.26%，总延误4.37%-24.25%。但验证仍需实际运营数据。
Motivation: 铁路短期集中发车场景中，出发排序与路段轨道分配需要协调优化，但静态组合模型无法充分捕捉时间相关的运营交互，因此需要新的建模与评估方法。
Method: 提出一个二次无约束二进制优化（QUBO）模型，将出发位置分配和路段轨道选择统一为二进制框架；并引入基于仿真的评估层，用于评估区段占用、中间站等待、站台容量压力、运行时间波动和延误传播等动态性能。
Result: 在测试场景中，QPSO-QAOA在正常条件下表现最佳；量子增强方法在动态条件下相比传统方法降低综合成本4.28%-26.26%，总延误4.37%-24.25%。
Conclusion: 本文提出的基于QUBO建模与仿真评估的集成方法为铁路短期集中发车调度提供了有用的方法框架，但仍需实际运营数据验证。

summary_sections.result: 在测试场景中，QPSO-QAOA在正常条件下表现最佳；量子增强方法在动态条件下相比传统方法降低综合成本4.28%-26.26%，总延误4.37%-24.25%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文提出的基于QUBO建模与仿真评估的集成方法为铁路短期集中发车调度提供了有用的方法框架，但仍需实际运营数据验证。

papers.title: ErA: Error-Aware Deep Unrolling Network for Single Image Defocus Deblurring
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ErA (Error-Aware Deep Unrolling Network), an end-to-end frame work for single-image defocus deblurring. ErA jointly learns a compact kerne basis and per-pixel weights, while an error-aware term in Augmented Lagrangian unrolling corrects kernel estimation errors via alternating updates and ResUNet denoisers. It achieves state-of-the-art PSNR/SSIM on DPDD, RealDOF, and RTF, and shows strong generalization on CUHK without ground truth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ErA（Error-Aware Deep Unrolling Network）用于单图像散焦去模糊，通过联合学习紧凑核基和逐像素权重，并在Augmented Lagrangian展开中引入错误感知项来纠正核估计误差，使用交替更新和ResUNet去噪器，在DPDD、RealDOF、RTF数据集上达到SOTA PSNR/SSIM，且在无真实标签的CUHK上展现强泛化性。
Motivation: 单图像散焦去模糊中，核估计误差是影响去模糊效果的关键问题，现有方法缺乏有效的错误纠正机制。
Method: 提出ErA框架，联合学习紧凑核基和逐像素权重；在Augmented Lagrangian展开中引入错误感知项，通过交替更新和ResUNet去噪器交替优化潜像和核，从而纠正核估计误差。
Result: 在DPDD、RealDOF、RTF数据集上达到SOTA PSNR/SSIM，并在无真实标签的CUHK数据集上展示强泛化性。
Conclusion: 错误感知的深度展开网络能有效处理散焦去模糊中的核估计误差，在多个基准上取得领先性能并具备泛化能力。

papers.title: Synthetic Benchmarks Overstate Forward-Forward Scaling: Real-Data Limits of Layer-Local Training
papers.abstract_en: Forward-Forward (FF) learning [Hinton, 2022] replaces backpropagation with strictly layer-local goodness updates. Recent FF-CNN work has narrowed the gap to BP on 32x32 benchmarks, raising the question of whether layer-local training is becoming a viable alternative at realistic scale. To probe this rigorously, we develop DTG-FF -- dynamic temperature goodness, decoupled normalization, and multi-layer fusion -- as an instrument that sets FF-family state of the art across nine real-data benchmarks (91.8% CIFAR-10 and the first FF baseline at ImageNet-100 224x224), and use it to audit how far layer-local training actually scales. (1) Real-data scaling. Under identical recipe and backbone, an architecture-matched BP-DeepSup baseline beats DTG-FF by 2.40/5.93 pp on CIFAR-10/CIFAR-100, and the gap widens with class count. At 224x224 the same instrument reaches only 49.4% -- the first FF baseline at this scale, versus typical BP above 75% [Tian et al., 2020] -- exposing a real-data ceiling invisible at 32x32. (2) Synthetic vs. real K-conflict. DTG-FF increasingly outperforms BP as class count K grows on synthetic teacher-student tasks, yet on real images the FF-BP gap reverses sign and widens with K. A within-dataset CIFAR-100 coarse vs. fine probe isolates label-hierarchy from image distribution: synthetic K-sweeps confound output dimensionality with fine-grained discrimination difficulty and thereby overstate FF transferability. (3) Systems audit. FF can be implemented without storing depth-wide activations, but on commodity 8 GB hardware standard BP+gradient-accumulation reaches 4.18 GB / 157 imgs/s versus DTG-FF's 7.90 GB / 138 imgs/s, so a memory-based justification for FF at this scale is not supported under fair baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过提出DTG-FF（动态温度善度、解耦归一化和多层融合）方法，在九个真实数据基准上实现了前向-前向（FF）学习家族的最佳性能，并系统评估了层局部训练的实际扩展性。实验发现：在真实数据上FF与BP的差距随着类别数增加而扩大，且合成基准高估了FF的扩展能力；在ImageNet-100 224x224尺度上，DTG-FF仅达到49.4%准确率，而BP通常高于75%；内存优势在公平比较下不成立。
Motivation: 前向-前向学习作为一种替代反向传播的层局部训练方法，近期在32x32小尺寸基准上缩小了与BP的差距，但其在更大规模和真实数据上的实际扩展性尚未被严格验证。
Method: 提出DTG-FF，包括动态温度善度、解耦归一化和多层融合三个组件，用于提升FF性能。以此为基础，在相同架构和训练设置下对比BP-DeepSup基线，并在合成和真实数据上分析缩放行为。
Result: 在CIFAR-10/100上，DTG-FF分别达到91.8%/74.5%，但被BP-DeepSup超出2.40/5.93个百分点，且差距随类别数增加而扩大。在ImageNet-100 224x224上，DTG-FF仅49.4%（首个FF基线），而典型BP超过75%。合成任务上FF优于BP，但真实数据上相反。内存对比显示，标准BP+梯度累积占用4.18 GB/157 imgs/s，而DTG-FF占用7.90 GB/138 imgs/s。
Conclusion: 合成基准会高估前向-前向学习的扩展性，真实数据上FF与BP的差距随任务规模增大而扩大，且内存优势在公平比较下不成立。

papers.title: WorldBench: A Challenging and Visually Diverse Multimodal Reasoning Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: In real-world applications, models are expected to perform reliably across diverse settings. Yet, many existing multimodal benchmarks expand task types without capturing the visual diversity needed to handle open-ended visual inputs. We present WorldBench, a challenging and visually diverse reasoning benchmark to evaluate Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). We build a taxonomy of thousands of visual concepts across multiple domains (e.g., living things). Guided by this taxonomy, we curate a broad collection of images from search engines and existing datasets to comprehensively represent the visual world. Through structured trial-and-error, we manually design challenging questions that frontier MLLMs fail to answer. On quantitative and human evaluations, WorldBench achieves higher visual diversity than any existing diverse benchmark. Evaluating 15 MLLMs on WorldBench reveals weaknesses in visual understanding: even the strongest model reaches only 64.0% accuracy, while some models perform marginally above chance-level. We hope our work highlights the importance of visual diversity in building multimodal benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WorldBench是一个旨在评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）视觉理解能力的多样化推理基准。该基准通过构建涵盖数千个视觉概念的分类法，从搜索引擎和现有数据集中收集广泛图像，并手动设计前沿模型难以回答的问题。实验表明，即使最强模型（如GPT-4V）也仅达到64.0%准确率，突出视觉多样性在多模态基准中的重要性。
Motivation: 现有多模态基准扩展了任务类型，但未充分捕捉视觉多样性，导致模型在开放视觉输入下表现不可靠。
Method: 构建了一个包含数千个视觉概念（如生物等）的分类法，据此从搜索引擎和现有数据集收集多样化图像，并通过结构化试错手动设计前沿MLLM难以回答的问题。
Result: 在15个MLLM评估中，最强模型仅达到64.0%准确率，部分模型表现接近随机水平，显示当前模型在视觉理解上的显著弱点。
Conclusion: 强调视觉多样性对于构建多模态基准的重要性，并希望WorldBench能推动相关研究。

papers.title: Human Adults and LLMs as Scientists: Who Benefits from Active Exploration?
papers.abstract_en: A long-standing finding in the causal learning literature is that adults struggle to identify conjunctive causal rules, where an effect requires the simultaneous presence of multiple causes, while performing better in disjunctive settings. However, most demonstrations of this ``conjunctive handicap'' rely on passive observation paradigms with limited evidence, where learners have no control over evidence generation. This paper asks whether this bias persists when adults are granted agency through active exploration. Using a modified ``blicket detector'' task, adult participants freely intervened to identify causal objects under conjunctive or disjunctive rule structures. We show that active exploration substantially improves adults' conjunctive causal reasoning, although conjunctive rules still require more tests to infer than disjunctive rules. We further compare human performance to a range of large language models in the same setting. While some state-of-the-art models approach human-level performance on hypothesis inference accuracy, they often exhibit less efficient exploration strategies and similar conjunctive-disjunctive performance gaps.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 48th Annual Conference of the Cognitive Science Society (CogSci 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在因果学习任务中，主动探索是否能改善成年人识别合取因果规则（conjunctive causal rules）的能力。实验采用改进的"blicket detector"任务，允许自由干预。结果表明主动探索显著提高了合取推理，但合取规则仍需更多测试。与LLM对比，部分模型在假设推断准确率上接近人类，但探索策略效率较低且存在类似的合取-析取差距。
Motivation: 因果学习文献中，成年人在识别合取因果规则时存在"合取障碍"（conjunctive handicap），但先前研究多依赖被动观察范式。本文探究主动探索是否能减轻这一偏差。
Method: 采用改进的"blicket detector"任务，让成年参与者自由干预以识别合取或析取规则下的因果对象。同时将相同任务呈现给多个大语言模型进行比较。
Result: 主动探索显著提高了成年人合取因果推理，但合取规则仍比析取规则需要更多测试。部分LLM在假设推断准确率上接近人类，但探索策略效率较低且存在类似的合取-析取性能差距。
Conclusion: 主动探索能帮助成年人克服合取障碍，但合取规则仍更困难。LLM在探索效率上不及人类，但推断能力接近。

papers.title: Deployed trusted-node quantum key distribution over 300 km with a multi-core fiber access link
papers.abstract_en: Quantum key distribution (QKD) is increasingly considered for deployment in realistic communication networks, where long distances, heterogeneous fiber infrastructure, and coexistence with classical traffic present substantial challenges. Here, we demonstrate trusted-node QKD between Linköping University and the Stockholm hub of the Swedish national quantum communication infrastructure over 270 km of deployed single-mode fiber, extended by a 33 km multi-core fiber (MCF) segment emulating a metropolitan access link, for a total distance of 303 km. The two sub-links use commercial QKD systems whose receivers are interfaced with external superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors, enabling operation at losses beyond those supported by standard internal gated-mode detectors. We operate the link while actively switching the QKD channel between two MCF cores, with co-propagating Ethernet traffic and injected broadband optical noise in the other cores. The results demonstrate the integration of commercial QKD into demanding, dynamically reconfigurable fiber infrastructure relevant to future hybrid quantum-classical networks. Finally, using the generated secret keys, we illustrate how limited and time-varying QKD throughput affects one-time-pad-protected image transmission: image fidelity depends strongly on the available QKD-generated key budget and the choice of compression algorithm, highlighting application-level challenges for QKD-based encryption in realistic scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文展示了在瑞典部署的303公里信任节点量子密钥分发（QKD）链路，结合多芯光纤接入段。使用商用QKD系统和超导纳米线单光子探测器，在动态可重构光纤基础设施上实现与经典通信共存。结果表明QKD可在高损耗、多芯光纤场景下运行，并分析了对一次性密码本图像传输的影响。
Motivation: 量子密钥分发在实际通信网络部署中面临长距离、异构光纤基础设施及与经典通信共存的挑战，现有系统在更高损耗环境下性能受限。
Method: 使用商用QKD系统并外接超导纳米线单光子探测器，在303公里部署光纤（含33公里多芯光纤段）上演示信任节点QKD。QKD信道在多芯光纤的两个芯之间主动切换，同时其他芯承载以太网流量和注入宽带光噪声。
Result: 成功在总长303公里链路（含270公里单模光纤和33公里多芯光纤）上实现QKD，运行损耗超过标准门控模式探测器支持的范围。证明了商用QKD在动态可重构光纤基础设施中的集成能力。
Conclusion: 实验结果突出展示了QKD在现实动态网络中的可行性，但有限且时变的QKD吞吐量对一次性密码本图像传输的影响表明应用中需考虑密钥预算和压缩算法选择。

papers.title: Local Guidance, Global Impact: Gaussian-Reshaped Trust Region Unlocks Behavior Transitions
papers.abstract_en: While Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) demonstrates strong performance in stationary settings, we show that its standard optimization paradigm struggles in continual and non-stationary environments. The failure does not stem from insufficient model capacity or overly restrictive clipping. Instead, PPO performs persistent, directionally inefficient local updates, which indicates a lack of geometry-aware guidance for accumulating meaningful behavioral change and ultimately hindering transitions toward new behavior patterns. Although divergence-based regularization introduces partial geometric awareness, its monotonically increasing penalties implicitly discourage large policy deviations, even when such shifts are necessary for effective adaptation. To address this limitation, we propose Gaussian Trust Region Policy Optimization (GTR), which reshapes the trust region using a Gaussian kernel. The resulting constraint is bounded and non-monotonic, providing strong local stability while progressively relaxing under sustained high-advantage updates. To further improve robustness, we introduce a Mixture Gaussian Anchor that adapts to recent policy trajectories, reducing variance induced by stale references. GTR is architecture-agnostic and achieves strong performance across games, simulated robotic control, open-world exploration, and language model post-training. These results demonstrate that geometry-aware trust-region design can be a promising direction for robust reinforcement learning in complex non-stationary environments. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/GTR_demo/README.md.

TL;DR: 本文指出PPO在非平稳环境中的失败源于缺乏几何感知的更新指导，导致方向低效的局部更新而无法实现行为转换。作者提出高斯信任区域策略优化（GTR），用高斯核重塑信任区域约束，使其有界且非单调，在强局部稳定性的同时能随高优势更新逐步放松。GTR是架构无关的，在游戏、机器人控制、开放世界探索和语言模型后训练任务上均表现优异。

Method: 提出高斯信任区域策略优化（GTR）：使用高斯核重塑信任区域，产生有界非单调的约束，既能保证局部稳定性又能在高优势更新时逐渐放宽约束；此外引入混合高斯锚点，通过适应近期策略轨迹减少陈旧参考引入的方差。
Result: GTR在多种任务上取得强性能，包括游戏、模拟机器人控制、开放世界探索和语言模型后训练，且架构无关。
Conclusion: 几何感知的信任区域设计是应对复杂非平稳环境中强化学习鲁棒性的有前景方向。

papers.title: Perplexity Can Miss SAE Feature Damage Under Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Quantization is a standard path to deploying large language models, and quantized models are typically judged acceptable when perplexity or downstream accuracy remains close to the full-precision original. But behavioral parity need not imply feature fidelity: the sparse-autoencoder (SAE) features used to interpret a full-precision model may change after weight rounding. We test this directly by using a frozen SAE as a fixed measurement basis, encoding full-precision and round-to-nearest (RTN) quantized activations on identical tokens, and measuring per-feature survival by Pearson correlation across bit-widths from INT8 to INT4 on Pythia-70M and Gemma-2-2B. Our central finding is that perplexity can miss feature damage: on Gemma-2-2B, INT7 improves perplexity while degrading 18.7% of active SAE features, and under sliding-window evaluation INT6 also improves perplexity while only 51.3% of active features survive. Feature survival is graded rather than cliff-like, with 62.4% of active Pythia features and 51.3% of active Gemma features surviving at INT6; most non-surviving features are blurred rather than fully damaged. Survival is also predictable from full-precision feature statistics alone, with cross-validated AUC 0.92--0.97 and peak activation as the strongest marginal predictor. Finally, RTN quantization and matched-perplexity magnitude pruning damage strongly overlapping feature sets, with Jaccard overlap 0.79--0.86 and damage-score Spearman correlation 0.98. These results show that behavioral metrics alone are insufficient evidence that full-precision interpretability findings transfer to quantized models, motivating feature-level audits of compression.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究量化对稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征的影响，发现困惑度（perplexity）不能反映特征损伤。在Gemma-2-2B上，INT7量化改善了困惑度但导致18.7%活跃SAE特征退化；INT6下仅51.3%活跃特征存活。特征存活率可从全精度特征统计量预测（AUC 0.92-0.97）。RTN量化与幅值剪枝破坏的特征集高度重叠（Jaccard 0.79-0.86）。
Motivation: 量化模型通常用困惑度或下游准确率判断是否可接受，但行为等价不一定意味着特征保真度；全精度模型的可解释性特征可能在量化后改变，而困惑度可能掩盖这种损伤。
Method: 使用冻结SAE作为固定测量基，对相同token编码全精度和RTN量化激活，通过Pearson相关衡量逐特征存活率，在Pythia-70M和Gemma-2-2B上测试INT8到INT4。
Result: 困惑度可掩盖特征损伤：INT7改善困惑度但退化18.7%特征；INT6下仅51.3%特征存活。特征存活率可预测（AUC 0.92-0.97）。RTN量化与幅值剪枝的特征损伤集高度重叠。
Conclusion: 行为度量不足以证明全精度可解释性结果迁移到量化模型，需要特征级压缩审计。

papers.title: Spatially Distributed Task-Oriented Compression for Multi-Emitter Localization and Characterization with Spectral Overlap
papers.abstract_en: Radio frequency spectrum awareness requires the ability to detect, localize, and characterize emitters in dense and contested wireless environments. In this work, we propose a task-oriented distributed compression framework for joint multi-emitter localization and characterization using spatially distributed receivers. Each receiver observes a short window of complex IQ samples, converts the observation to a time--frequency representation, and encodes it into a compact latent vector. A central fusion decoder combines the receiver latents to estimate an unordered set of active emitters, including their locations, center-frequency offsets, occupied bandwidths, and waveform families. A permutation-invariant training objective is used to handle the arbitrary ordering of emitters and predictions. Experiments on synthetic multi-emitter scenes with spectral overlap show that even extremely compact receiver-side representations can preserve useful information for emitter counting and waveform-family estimation. However, accurate localization and spectral-parameter regression require larger latent dimensions. Increasing the receiver latent dimension from $d_{\mathrm{rx}}=1$ to $d_{\mathrm{rx}}=16$ provides the largest improvement, while further increasing to $d_{\mathrm{rx}}=64$ gives smaller gains. These results demonstrate the potential of learned task-oriented compression for communication-efficient distributed spectrum awareness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多发射器定位与特征化任务，提出一种基于空间分布式接收机的任务导向压缩框架。接收机将短时IQ样本转为时频表示并编码为紧凑潜在向量，中央融合解码器估计活跃发射器集合（位置、频率偏移、带宽、波形族）。实验表明，极低维度（d_rx=1）也能保留有效信息，但精确参数回归需更大维度（d_rx=16收益最大，d_rx=64增益减小）。
Motivation: 频谱感知需要在密集、对抗性无线环境中检测、定位和特征化发射器，现有方法通信开销大，需高效分布式压缩方案。
Method: 每个接收机独立计算时频表示并编码为潜在向量，中央解码器以排列不变性目标函数融合多接收机信息，输出发射器集合的估计值。
Result: d_rx从1增至16时性能提升最大，增至64时增益减缓；极低维度仍支持发射器计数和波形族估计，但定位和频谱参数回归需要更高维度。
Conclusion: 任务导向压缩可在极低码率下保留光谱意识任务的关键信息，但精确参数回归需权衡通信与精度。

papers.title: Broadband Hyperspectral 3D Imaging using Dispersed Structured Light
papers.abstract_en: Hyperspectral 3D imaging enables the capture of dense spectral information and scene geometry but has traditionally been confined to narrow spectral windows, typically the visible range. In this work, we introduce a broadband hyperspectral 3D imaging (BH3D) method to extend this capability across the full visible-near-infrared and short-wavelength infrared (SWIR) spectrum (450-1500 nm). This broad coverage is critical as it captures complementary physical cues: visible wavelengths reveal surface appearance, while SWIR bands provide insight into subsurface properties and material composition. However, realizing BH3D is challenging due to fundamental sensor constraints between visible-spectrum silicon and SWIR-spectrum InGaAs sensors, which necessitate complex multi-spectrograph designs. Here we propose a single-spectrograph BH3D system, using a stereo setup comprising visible and SWIR cameras, that reconstructs dense broadband hyperspectral reflectance together with accurate 3D geometry. Our key idea is to extend dispersed structured light to the broadband regime using a single spectrograph. We model the image formation of broadband dispersed structured light, and estimate hyperspectral reflectance and depth. We validate our approach on diverse real-world scenes, demonstrating accurate reconstruction with a mean spectral angle mapper of 0.13 rad, root mean square error of 0.03, and mean depth error of 4.5 mm. We further demonstrate identifying metameric materials, performing imaging through opaque layers, uncovering hidden features on banknotes, and revealing blood vessels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种宽带高光谱3D成像（BH3D）方法，使用单个光谱仪和可见光-SWIR立体相机，在450-1500 nm范围内联合重建高光谱反射率和三维几何。通过将色散结构光扩展到宽带机制，实现了平均光谱角0.13 rad、均方根误差0.03、深度误差4.5 mm的精度，并展示了同色异谱材料识别、透过不透明层成像等应用。
Motivation: 传统高光谱3D成像局限于可见光窄波段，无法捕捉SWIR波段的次表面和材料信息，而多光谱仪设计复杂且昂贵，需要一种单光谱仪的宽带解决方案。
Method: 提出单光谱仪BH3D系统，采用可见光和SWIR相机构成立体设置，将色散结构光扩展到宽带范围，建模宽带色散结构光的图像形成过程，联合估计高光谱反射率和深度。
Result: 在真实场景上平均光谱角0.13 rad，均方根误差0.03，深度误差4.5 mm；展示了同色异谱材料识别、透过不透明层成像、钞票隐藏特征揭示及血管成像的能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法首次实现了单光谱仪下全可见-近红外-短波红外波段（450-1500 nm）的密集高光谱反射率和3D几何重建，并验证了多种实际应用。
